I will be back to buy this product. Thanks for the wonderful service.

The tea is fine. I didn't find it that tasty ... I find I prefer Mint Medly or PLantation Mint. I guess I also prefer individually wrapped bags to preserve freshness. But nothing wrong with product; just a matter of my taste, I think

For Christmas this year, I received a box of Sahika Turkish Delight and I loved it. I decided I wanted to get another box to share when I went back home, so I ordered this product. Unfortunately, the consistency is gritty and it's not nearly as flavorful as the original Sahika brand. I won't be buying Sultans again.

Great price but once I tasted it I realised why it's such a great price. Because it is not the real super fantastic pink salt that I have come to love. This salt has a very prounced aftertaste, the kind you find with cheap table salt. I took this bag over to my sister who had the real pink salt. Side by side we could see and defintely taste that this wasn't the real stuff. We concluded that it must be a very small amount of pink salt added in for color and mixed with regular table and sea salt. Again, the aftertaste is very strong, something you NEVER taste with the genuine Himalayan pink salt- one of the many reasons people pay so much for it. And this defintely ISN'T it.

(FYI- In San Francisco, Rainbow Grocery has it for a great price in the bulk section. If I still lived there I wouldn't be trying to buy my pink salt online and ending up with this mess! :))

I definitely recommend this salt, it's highly nourishing, and relatively inexpensive compared to other natural salts on the market.  Others cost an average of $10.00 for 10 ounces, this is less than $10.00 for a 2 pound bulk size.  It adds a great flavor to food, and beverages.

I am a real fan of Rishi teas and my favorite is the Mystic Mint tea.  I used to buy their "Sweet Mint", but I believe this one replaced it and tastes just as good.  I drink this tea hot or cold and it never disappoints!  4 stars instead of 5 because they went to double packaging it in a pouch in the can & you get less (1.76oz for Mystic Mint compared to 2.9oz for Sweet Mint).  I would rather get more product and less packaging for the same price.

Mambas bring me back to when mamma used to take us to the five and dime store and spend our whole allowance ($1) on these delicious little treats. I am 34 now and i still LOVE em'. I agree with the reviewer before me, Leah, when she said that you shouldn't be eating these while you have braces. I have a hard enough time trying to eat them with my dentures in. However, she spelled eating with two t's. You should be ashamed of yourself. Oh and i hope that the kid whose braces fell off loses all of his teeth as well.
My husband and I love these... (in regards to the previous reviewer... you shouldn't be eatting chewy candy with braces on)
I love the Black Teas but since my wife can't do caffeine I thought I'd introduce her to the outstanding quality of the Tao of Tea. She really loves the Cranberry Orange.

Chebe pizza crust mix is the best gluten free pizza crust available, and I've tried them all.  To be honest, its so good I prefer it to regular wheat pizza crust.  This is one of the very few products out there that not only nicely replaces the wheat version, but actually supersedes it in taste, texture, and quality.  My children - neither of whom are celiac - request Chebe over regular pizza.

This is the best mix we have found.  Makes great bread sticks and wonderful calzones! I make a batch and freeze it until were ready to have it then cook it.  It works well in our toaster oven as well as our regular oven.  My daughter and I can't eat gluten.  We both really missed bread stuff.  This is a perfect replacement!  We have used other chebe mixes and have not been disappointed.  Everyone who is GF knows things have a different taste and texture but this is really close to the old things we used to love.  I think you will like it as well. This was an especially great find to help make the transition for my 5 year old.  If she give it a thumbs up you know it's got to be good!!

Amazing!!  Have tried other pizza crust recipes but this is the best!  It is quick and tastes great.  I have tried most of the Chebe products and have never been disappointed.  I love the fact that the crust is seasoned;  adds so much taste.

Ok so the first few times I tried this product I had mixed feelings. After a few additional tries I figured out the best way to make the crust. First instead of the 2 tablespoons of oil you will use about 1/4 cup. Don't add it all at once. Instead use your fork to mix the crust and after it is ready to knead you will slowly add the oil till you get a gum like texture. Whatever you are using to cook it on (I use a pizza stone) oil it. When you put the dough on the spread (I do mine by hand) fold it over itself a few times to start it. Then you will move it to the edges. You will have extra dough a the edges but make sure that you get the inner areas as thin as possible. If you do not this will result in the dough not cooking all the way through. You can either remove some of the extra dough around the edges or leave it (I leave mine and I love it). If you leave it, it will rise and it will look like a 14 inch soup bowl or a giant hat. You can season the edges before you cook it for dipping in butter or save the crust for crutons. Im not gonna lie, it took me a few times to figure this out but this is the best result that I have gotten from it and it is GREAT.

This is a staple in my kitchen, and we eat pizza usually once a week. This dough takes some getting used to, it has a lot of seasoning added to it, which covers up the "it's not real dough taste" but it tastes great. I have never tried to make this without eggs, but I make it using just water and eggs and oil and it usually turns out pretty good. This is one of those things to have on hand though, it's really easy to make and you can use it for a variety of different things. For our dairy free pizza, we loaded it with sauce, fresh veggies, and some pepperoni...pretty good!

This is the first crust mix I've been able to roll out without much trouble. I used a little soy flour and that was it. I added too many toppings so it didn't come out as it should have but I liked the flavor finally!!! I'll try less sauce and fewer toppings next time.

Since being diagnosed with a wheat allergy several years ago, I have been on a mission to find good tasting, wheat free baked goods.  This crust is very good, it just takes a little more milk than the recipe on the back calls for.  I now look forward to making pizza every once in a while instead of it being a complicated chore.

Amazing gluten free crust! I had made this for a friend who also has celiac disease, making him the main pizza and me a little mini one, (just big enough for one pepperoni) to try just in case it tasted like so many gluten free mixes-awful-but this tastes like 'real' pizza-if I didn't have self control, poor guy would never have had a pizza to eat!!! It was delicious, and had a delightful rise and acted like normal wheat dough-I could roll it out and not get sticky. I am now a maniac for manioc (ha ha!), but truly, a wonderful mix-I went out and tried all the chebe mixes-they're affordable and delicious. (I've only been gluten free for a few months-not long enough to have forgotten what 'normal' food tastes like and still haven't learned to settle for anything less than the taste and texture I remember from my yummy gluten-filled days. Well, thanks to the Lord for creating manioc, and to Chebe for boxing it up for me, I don't have to settle!!!
Try this-you won't be disappointed! Then go buy the cinnamon rolls for desert or breakfast the next morning-again, yum!!!

I was excited to find this product and found that it has an excellent texture that is light, chewy and crisp.

However, the product has a distinct aftertaste that neither my wife nor I found to be pleasant. I have found that keeping the crust very, very thin and cooking the crust until it is very browned reduces the aftertaste but doesn't eliminate it.

My daughter and I loved the chebe pizza mix.  When you would open the package you would smell the oregano and it was heaven.  I just ordered more and obviously they changed the recipe.  I opened the package and was overwhelmed by the smell of vinegar.  Vinegar is not listed as an ingredient but that was what I smelled.  There was no sign of the oregano that was listed as an ingredient.  I cooked it so long that the cheese was burnt but the crust still was not browned.  It didn't rise at all and eating it was like chewing rubber.  Chebe wasn't the best rising product out there, but the taste always made up for it - now that's gone I won't be back.

This mix makes an excellent gluten free pizza dough. I tried several other brands before, but their mixes came out like a batter that you level on a baking sheet and comes out cake like. Chebe pizza mix is nothing like that. When mixed, it actually forms a dough ball the you can roll out with a rolling pin or work flat with your hands. It is gently seasoned, enough to give it an Italian flavor, but not over powering. When it is baked, the pizza crust has a slight chew to it like regular pizza dough. You can cut your pizza like normal and actually pick it up with your hands without it falling apart. I ordered it by the case based on the other excellent reviews that it got, and I don't regret it one bit. My husband and kids do not have to eat gluten free but they even like the pizza crust. Chebe Bread Pizza Crust Mix, 7.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 8)

I love this product.  We cant eat gluten and it makes a nice alternative.  It's not the same as regular pizza crust, but when you havent had pizza in a long time, it tastes delicious.  I double the liquid in this otherwise it's too dry and crumbly.  I also add rice based cheese instead of regular cheese, since we cant eat dairy, which makes the crust a little more chewy.

Only 2 of the 5 members of my family have celiac disease, but everyone really enjoys this mix! It's easy to make and I was pleasantly surprised with the flavor and texture. It's not your typical pizza crust, but they add herbs to give it a great flavor. I've made the pizza and calzone with this mix and the crust was nice and crisp on the outside and a little chewy on the inside. I've tried a few really horrible gluten free pizza crusts and was about to give up before I discovered this one. My kids actually fight over the last piece of pizza when I make it. :-)

I have been making homemade pizza for years and my family prefers homemade.  Finding a satisfactory gluten-free substitute was difficult.  We really like the chebe pizza crust.  In fact, my daughter (who does not need to eat gluten-free) likes it even better than my regular crust.  It makes an excellent thin crust pizza.

Using this Chebe mix for Pizza crusts are finally made tasty! Easy to make as well and if you have a look at [...] you will find a link that takes you to a site where they have a lot of very good uses for their products.

We got our box as a gift.  Even using the right amount of water it turned into a tapioca booger.  You'd never known until it was cut thought.  I'm just thankful we could scrape the toppings off and put them on a new crust.
I have been on a gluten free for 25 years, this is a Great product. It is the Best Pizza crust I have ever eaten.

We have been creating GF pizza at home now for several years thanks to Chebe.  You have to be fairly accurate with your measurements or it is a challenge to correct and oversight.  It is best to thoroughly cook the dough on both sides before you add your toppings.  The consistency is great because it has allowed us to add any additional spices that we choose to the dough.  Out of the various GF doughs that we have tried, this is the only Brand that consistently delivers a quality mix
First time we have used Chebe produce.  We loved it.  Has great taste and easy to make.  Will buy again.

trying out gluten free options..i found this pizza crust.

OH so good we make up two pizzas a week for the family.

and now use our Oven Stone (highly recomend you do so as well)..it crisps the crust up SO well!

TY Chebe a Crust i can comsume *big ol grin*

This product is the best gluten-free pizza crust I've tasted thus far.  The price is great, especially compared to store boughten crusts!  I would also definitely recommend grilling this crust. It turned out great.

We have found that if we don't put in the optional 1 cup of cheese the crust is crisper.  We roll the dough as thin as we can (if it sticks to the counter we rub a little olive oil on the counter) and then put it in the oven for 5 minutes before adding the toppings.  Then add the toppings and put the completed pizza in the oven for 15 minutes.  Chebe bread makes great pizza crust!

If you need to quickly put together a gluten free pizza dough crust this stuff is pretty good.  You can assemble everything right before making the pizza - no need for yeast or letting the dough rise, and you don't need to worry about defrosting anything.  That being said, I still prefer the taste of homemade gluten free dough with yeast- however that takes more planning and prep time.  For busy moms with a gluten free household, I'd say it's a great staple to have around the kitchen.

Chebe pizza mix is one of the best gluten-free mixes we have tried. The spices are very well done.  Be sure to spread the crust thin, otherwise it can be a little gummy.  We always pre-bake the crust before adding toppings and finishing off the baking process.  Because Amazon offers free shipping, it was far more economical to order from them rather than the gluten-free dealer we usually use.

I have been considering going gluten free, due to health concerns and as I am reading the book "Wheat Belly."  I purchased this mix to play around with the gluten free thing.  I was rather impressed with the end result, except for one main thing - the instructions say to NOT oil the pan, and as I figured when even the dough stuck to the pan, I was unable to get my pizza off the pan without a big mess.  I did notice that it was a bit easier after it had cooled a bit.  I would think that perhaps some corn starch on the cooking pan may have helped this, but I am not much of a cook and the instructions make no mention of any additional steps.  I also only managed to cook the pizza for about 10 of the 15 minimum minutes, as the cheese was starting to get too brown.  I did however enjoy the taste, which I consider to be quite acceptable as a pizza lover.  It's not a replica of your favorite pizza joint, but for instance I think this wins hands down over the pillsbury refrigerated dough mix!  An added bonus:  I haven't had to sprint to the bathroom after eating it!  I would like more information about the modified tapioca ingredient, and I notice Chebe gives some explanation on its website, but I find it a bit confusing.

My SO and I love this crust.  When making it looks like it is not going to become dough like because so little liquid is used.  However just keep kneading and it will come together.  The first time  we made it, it did have a slight after taste but only two or three bites in the whole pizza.  So we used a recipe posted in the review about using 3/4 a cup of olive oil drizzled in slowly while kneading and the dough came out a almost the same as before but no after taste this time.
This is the best crust mix for making homemade pizza.  I won't buy any other and I am not required to eat gluten-free!

this has so much flavor with the seasoned dough mix. i've made this for those that do  not have a gluten allergy and have gotten wonderful comments as to how flavorful it is. deefinitely will continue to purchase this!
We have been getting this product for a while now and have never failed to be impressed by its' quality and flavor. High praise all around!

We have looked far and wide for a gluten free crust. Hands down this is the best we've ever made. We add rice milk to the mix instead of milk,a little more liquid ,1 more tablespoon. It's the bomb. Makes a great pesto pizza. Need to adjust time with pizza sauce. AAAAAAAAAAAAAAA+ mix. Will never try another one. Use the same crust for flat bread with salad.
Tastes wonderful and pleases the gluten free and the gluten eating alike.  My (non-celiac) husband loves this stuff and requests I make it as often as he can get away with it.  We love it!

I've tried many GF pizza crusts and this is now my favorite because of ease of use and taste. I'm the only GF member in my family so now when the kids want pizza I can whip this up pretty easily on the side. It's not quite as economical since it's not bulk, but sometimes the convenience is worth it.

While the flavor of this dough is good, I've made it four times, for different ways, and the resulting texture isn't at all what its creators say it should be.  For that reason I can't imagine it performing well as a pizza crust.  As a flatbread, it's fine.  Regardless of how much liquid I put in the dough, the edges dry easily, like a cracker, but the middle in some cases was still doughy.  So, if you just want a tasty gluten-free treat, it's great.  But it doesn't perform as its intended.

This stuff is quite tasty, and gets the job done; but no one would ever mistake this pizza crust.  Let me be clear, I bought a few of these and I'm very happy with the results. It makes a flavorful 'tray' to hold your sauce and fixings, but calling it pizza, only just. If you need to go gluten free, then this is better than any other I've tried. But if you're looking for a great new pizza crust, look elsewhere.
Great concept, but poor result!  Oily, dense, with a slightly "funky" taste.  I tossed them all.

I realize that the taste won't be for everyone, but I certainly have learned to love this drink, not only for it's flavor, but for it's nice ongoing stimulant effect. It does have a heavy ginger taste in the beginning that ends refreshingly. Cold is the best way to drink this one. The effect difference between this one and other more well know energy drinks is that this tends to give an extended, more even "energy" result with less of a crash at the end. Some very unique herbals are mixed in here such as Goji, Acai, Camu Camu and Jiaogulan. Other well known additives are Ginger, Green Tea, Ginseng, L-Theanine and B Vitamins.

My new favorite!

It's a great drink, with all the benefits mentioned (and sweetened with honey/pineapple/sugar cane), but this may be the first time I've ever been able to get a product significantly cheaper at Whole Foods than on Amazon...bizarre.

I could not find an ingredient list anywhere for the Routin Sugarfree syrups.  So I ordered 6 bottles from another website (because I am a sucker for a "deal") and received them today.  Not only does this caramel taste wretched, it contains artificial flavors, 2 different preservatives and caramel color (is this considered "natural"?  I also tasted the SF almond--yuck. Just wanted to give anyone else interested in avoiding these ingredients & horrible taste experience this info...

This delivers! I love it in my soy milk, sometimes with raspberry or peach accompanying it.  Or making chocolate violet creams. Can't forget putting it in club soda or mineral water.  Try making violet/peach or violet/raspberry yoghurt too...Lovely violet flavoring- so hard to find. Thank you Monin- I'm thrilled to find you!!!!
Excellent syrup with a unique flavor especially when mixed with a squeeze of lemon and diluted with water. Makes a refreshing drink reminescent of the bottles flavored waters sold in France

This syrup is very, very sweet, and it does not have a very strong violet flavor.  I was hoping to use it to flavor ice creams and yogurts, but it does not have enough violet flavor to work in this way.  I've tried just adding more of it to increase the flavor, but then the sweet taste becomes too strong.  If you are looking for a sweetener with a hint of flavor, this will be great for you, but if you are trying to make violet flavored treats such as are available in Europe, you will be disappointed with this syrup.

I was first hesitant to get this, because it was "plain," so in my mind, I thought the taste was going to be a little "plain" or boring. But I was wrong. It's a great snack that's crunchy, tasty, and nutritious! The chocolate and chipotle flavors are also awesome.

(:, and finally, high blood pressure and weight gain.

Day to day stress has always been bad, and this cup of tea always makes it better. I'd recommend it to the worry-warts, and the people that have small panic attacks from time to time. It surely helps, and the best part is that it tastes delicious!

I have in the past maybe partaked of some tea every once and awhile. I always just drank Celestial Seasonings Herb Tea, Sleepytime, 20-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6), and that was that. My boyfriend brought his love of tea into our place and Now its a daily and nightly ritual. Tea is so much more soothing than say a cup of cocoa or coffee. Less heavy, caffeine free, and natural.

We found Tension Tamer amoungst Celestial Seasonings multitude of tea flavors. Who doesnt want their tension to be tamed? Its absolutely the tastiest , relaxing, comforting hot beverage ever.It contains eleuthero ginseng,ginger root,chamomile, peppermint, cinnamon, and lemon. Nothing over powers, everything connects and leaves you content as can be. Seriously just smelling it will make you close your eyes and breath easier.

My dog, Gretel, has expressed nothing but undying gratitude for these phenomenal treats.  She morphs into almost human appreciation for them everytime I share of the bag.  They're small, though firm and crunchy, so I can regulate her intake nicely. She's only about 28 pounds, so this bag promises to hold out for some time, whence I intend to order more.

I had never ordered these before and did not know what to expect, but certainly for the high price scorched dog cookies were a big surprise.  I threw them out and will never order anything made by EVO again if this is indicative of their quality control. The price was reduced, but garbage is still garbage at half the price. I am going to ask Amazon to refund my money!

I used to buy these individually, but when I saw them here at this price I was very happy. You will not find these cheaper anywhere else. Summer strawberry is my favorite flavor and this tastes great. One of the best brands for fruit leather.

These fruit bars are great!  Not too sweet.  Not too sour.  Just enough flavor.  I like to use them as a snack before a workout, or in the middle of a long bike ride.  They are individually wrapped and easy to pack.  Yum!

I love Keebler cookies and these chocolate-mint covered grahams are a long time favorite so I thought getting 6 packages at once would be a no-brainer. Unfortunately, the box must have gotten some hard knocks in transit because each and every package arrived with about a quarter of the cookies magically transformed to cookie-dust!!!

As much as I love the brand and this flavor, I doubt I'll re-order them. From here on I'll probably just rely on getting one package at a time from the market...

For anyone who remembers those fudgy little cookies and has been missing them, this is a good news/bad news story. The bad news--the crisp cookie part of this treat is a chocolate one, unlike the plain vanilla of Fudge Patties past. The good news--you probably won't notice the difference.

For the uninitiated: this is a lighter, more crisp version of a vanilla wafer (though chocolate), slightly hollowed out to accommodate a dollop of creamy fudge. The whole thing is then covered in more chocolate.

This is no gourmet cookie; but for chocolate lovers who've never forgotten the joy of biting into that thick, creamy fudge layer before finding the crunchy cookie inside, it's not bad.

Serving suggestion: Best eaten at warm-ish room temp, when the outer blanket of chocolate is just soft enough to be a bit tacky but not messy, allowing your teeth to sink into the inner fudgy layer...with a glass of milk nearby.
The sugar content is more than I thought it would be, wow, are these sweet. I love sugar, but not that much, in my desserts.

My son just got back from Europe and was raving about how wonderful this product is and how much he loved them.  What do you know he brought me back one!  It was fantastic!  The filling was really creamy and tasted great!  Please get this product in!

Yuck....nastiest Pina Colada mix I have ever tasted in my life....and I have been a bartender for over 20 years. Left a terrible after taste in all of our mouths. I have traveled all over the tropics and have never tasted a Pina Colada as nasty as these. Go with "Bacardi frozen mixers" in your grocery store's freezer section. Now that is the best tasting Colada mix you will ever have....I guarantee it.

I got this product too add extra flavor to coffee without having ground cinnamon floating on top. I tried several other extracts, and this is by far the best, with excellent aromatics and the "heat" of the cinnamon coming across well. The only downside is that it does not bring the more savory taste of ground cinnamon with it. I do not think that this is a shortcoming of the product; rather the savory compounds simply are not alcohol soluble, this would probably require some sort of oil base instead.

The mouth of the bottle does not pour particularly well, and tends to dribble. I would recommend using a measuring eyedropper to dispense it. I ended up using one marked for children's medicine, it fits in the bottle and works well.

I purchased this beautiful waiters corkscrew a few years ago. I used it perhaps once a month. It fell apart, the metal strip in between the two pieces of olive wood broke. I contacted Laguiole directly, I no longer had the receipt. Their very curt reply was that the only warranty was through wherever I had purchased it. They would not even allow me to ship it to them to look at. I have purchased many things in my life, and when something breaks after a month or two, it has always been the manufacturer I have had to deal with.
With a company manufacturing and selling such supposed quality items as these, they should work with customers that have had one fall apart. I was told they would not accept it if I mailed it to them. They claim to have a lifetime warranty, but won't accept me sending them back a broken item? Fine, there are other top quality manufactures I will use for top quality corkscrews, cutlery and other such items. I'm done with Laguiole, its not acceptable at this price.

The first time I tried white chocolate passion fruit truffles was a couple years ago at Godiva. Ever since then, I had been trying to find something similar, as the item was limited edition. This is even better! Also I have never been much of a fan of white chocolate but let me tell you, it's one of the most scrumptious desserts I've ever had. I've eaten almost an  entire box in a sitting (don't judge. The chocolates come surround in a cold pack so you don't have to worry about them melting if you live somewhere warm. COMPLETELY WORTH EVERY PENNY!
I grew up eatting saladitos but since I have moved to Florida they are hard to come by.  Every now and then I crave something salty and this does it.
The packages should have been 2.4 oz and the packages that we received were only 1.2 oz.
we love these they are better than the plum saladitos because they are meatier and moist compared to the plum saladitos. They are also bigger than the plum saladitos.

I love these Saladitos.  They are very moist and taste like they've been soaked in lemon.  I realize that one would have to have a taste for this type of candy, but for anyone who likes Saladitos these are the best tasting to me.

I can't get over how expensive and elusive freeze dried chive is to find and have searched far and wide in the wholesale clubs looking for a larger container than the standard .16 oz offered in the grocery store for McCormick's freeze dried chive at $3.99 or higher.  Sour cream and chive is almost a staple in my husband's diet and he goes through it like water so I gave this a try.  I have to say that the McCormick's does have a stronger taste and the chive is younger and better preserved, but comparing prices, The Traders Choice gives you a full ounce to .16 for about the same price so the value can't be beat and you can afford to use a little more to get the desired taste.

Very disappointed with this product. I started using freeze dried chives bought from Super Target stores (Archer Farms brand). Thought I'd save some money and buy in bulk from Amazon. This Traders Choice product has neither chive aroma nor taste. Rather surprised no one else has complained. Suitable only for garnish, in my opinion.

I've been having a hard time finding dried chives locally, especially at a reasonable price. So when I saw this deal on Amazon, I was very happy. The price is excellent for 3 containers ths size. I gave one to my son and one to my daughter as we all love chives in our salads and for cooking certain dishes. I think we'll be all set for some time to come!

The cookie part of these isn't sweet; tastes just like an animal cracker. The filling tastes just like Nutella, I think it's a great flavor combination. There are 25 packs of a dozen cookies each in the box. Some nutritional info from the label: serving size- 2 cookies, calories-140, trans fat-0, saturated fat- 6g.

OK, OK, so these are not the most nutritious snack, but come on! They're cookies! An occasional indulgence isn't going to hurt anyone.

If you think you'll like the taste combination of animal crackers and Nutella, then buy these. If you are worried about saturated fat, buy some fruit instead.

If you've ever had as Bahlsen Hit cookies (normally a plain cookie with chocolate filling) you'll know these have to be good. A creamy center that can easily be eaten separatly by nibbling off the cookie top and bottom. A dry cookie that isn't too sweet but full of flavor.

Great for a mid-day snack. I always have a roll in my desk draw at work.

Very Very Tasty!

These cookies are very tasty, surprisingly crisp and light, and don't taste at all like comparable inexpensive packaged cookies from the US. They are made in Poland for a German company and taste a lot like many confections from Europe, where crisp wafers and balanced tasting fillings are the norm(rather than the over-sweet cream fillings common here in the US)

Contrary to another review here, the ingredients/nutrients list states that are are 0g of trans-fats in theese cookies. However, there's a LOT of saturated fat. That's a concern because if you're a normal healthy adult, you could easily eat a package of these in one sitting (only 5 ounces!)...in which case you would have had about your week's worth of saturated fat in one sitting! Since our country has a massive (literally) weight problem, that's something to be aware of.

Hard to beat the taste for the price, but eat with care.

I LOVE this cookie. I have been eating these since I was a little baby! I was so sad when they were hard to find in the U.S. for a few years... but VERY excited when I saw them for sale at a grocery store a week ago!!! As for it being "bad" for you - honestly, you don't need to eat a whole bag! I have two and am content. There is no point being greedy - you're only hurting yourself.
I think they taste better than Gnutella, and MUCH better than Hersheys crunchy wafers. These have a unique and fluffy taste, and whenever I am eating them, I am reminded of patisseries found overseas. They are especially tasty out of the fridge and without filling melting on your hands.

*Update January 25, 2008:
I finally bought the 25 package deal and they took a week to get to my front door (but it came along with the newly released HP#5 ). I used to munch on these as a little kid and then they went MIA for about a decade. The chocolate has a slightly different taste than what my taste buds are used to now but that's because they're not American, they're German cookies... obviously they're a bit different!! And as for nutritious value... come on now, they are cookies not fruit. All in all, I am very happy with them and will probably buy them again - you can't beat the $.40/packet price!

I buy a case of these or the cocoa variety whenever Amazon features them on the Friday Sale -- generally about six dollars less than the listed $22.00.  The 5 ounce packages are paper reinforced cylinders, easy to pack and easy to open, great for a take-along treat.  (The packs don't re-close, however, so you pretty much have to devour all contents once opened.)  For Christmas I made up small gift baskets using these, a coffee mug or two, and some instant cappucino.

I RESERVE 5 STARS FOR FRESH-BAKED COOKIES. THIS 4 STAR COOKIE CONSISTS OF TWO LIGHT CRISPY WAFERS WITH A CHOCOLATEY TASTE REMINISCENT OF BROWNIES...NOT DARK CHOCOLATE... AND IN BETWEEN, A LIGHT CREAMY FILLING...NOT AT ALL LIKE THE DENSE OREO FILLING. THEY WOULD COMPLEMENT ICE CREAM NICELY. NOT TOO MANY NOW!

I've seen some reviewers commenting on the sugar and sodium content of Roland Sriracha. If you go to the Roland website, [...] or look on the actual bottle you'll see the sodium content is only 125mg per serving and sugar is 1gram per serving...about the same as Huy Fong. It is NOT 2500mg of sodium and 18 grams of sugar per serving (which is 1 teaspoon) as suggested by a few reviewers and one obviously incorrect website. Even a teaspoon of pure table sugar only contains 4 grams of sugar! Check your facts before posting.

Anyway, this sauce is okay. It's been growing on me as I get through the bottle. Still not as good as Huy Fong which is tangier and doesn't have such a garlic taste to it.

So, I got a few "chili-heads" together and did a double blind test between the two, asking the taster which they like the best. The Roland won, 3-4. However, when we read the nutritional label and saw how much salt it had in it 2 of my friends said that they wouldn't buy it for that reason alone. Yes, this looks like the one you want.  It feels like the one you want.  But this isn't the one you want.  You want the one made by Huy Fong.  This one tastes quite off.  Somewhat more garlicky and completely unsatisfying to those who like the real stuff.

Tastes really good, but it's sodium content is absolutely retarded. I used to eat a normal sized serving daily, and it caused my hands and eyes to swell after walking about an hour. That hasn't happened again since I stopped using this crap... But it tastes good.

Don't buy this brand. Buy Huy Fong. It has a small portion of the sugar and sodium that Roland has. There's no way you're only going to eat one tsp of this. If you have 2 you're going to get more than an entire day's worth of sugar. Do yourself a favor and buy the real thing.

I decided to try this sriracha out because I have been a fan of the Huy Fong (rooster) version for years. My initial impression was just "eh". I don't think its anywhere near as flavorful as the other version. There is a bit of heat to it, but its not a flavorful kind of heat. The other reviewers have talked about the sodium content and I was quite shocked. Both versions have the same serving size (1 tsp) and while the Huy Fong version has 100 mg per serving (4% of daily allowance) the Roland version has 2500 mg per serving (84% of daily allowance) so steer clear if you have high blood pressure. On another nutritional note, The Huy Fong version has 5 cal/tsp while the Roland version has 100 cal/tsp, so definitely not low calorie...

Overall, if you had to choose between the two, I would definitely go for the original sriracha made by Huy Fong foods. It has more flavor and is much healthier for you!

I came across the Fizz Pops here by accident and ordered them immediately.  I hadn't had them since I was a kid and wanted to see if they were similar to those I remembered.  My grandparents used to bring one for me and one for my sister every time they visited.  I also recall them being in glass jars on the counters of small stores as we drove "up north" to visit grandma and grandpa.  I don't know what brand they were, but they were almost identical to these Paskesz Fizz Pops.  The best way I can describe them is that they are like compressed confectioner's sugar with a very light fruit flavor.  Kind of like the texture of a sweet-tart, but without the tart.  If you suck on them like a regular lollipop, it will hurt your tongue and the roof of your mouth.  They don't dissolve in the same way that hard candy does.  Instead, you kind of chip away at them with your teeth and chew the little pieces that come off.  Now, if I didn't have this good childhood memory, I admit there's a chance that trying them as an adult for the first time, I might not be that excited about them.  But, it was fun to find them again.  Everyone in our family liked them.  And, I found one friend who remembered having these as a child, too and said "Oh, I missed those lollipops that hurt your mouth if you sucked on them too hard!"  So, if you don't compare them to a regular lollipop and judge them on their own, you might find you like them, too.

From Wikipedia:
Şalgam is a popular beverage from southern Turkey's cities of Adana and Mersin. Although the Turkish word şalgam literally means "turnip," şalgam is actually made with the juice of red carrot pickles, salted, spiced, and flavoured with aromatic turnip (çelem) fermented in barrels with the addition of ground bulgur. It is traditionally served cold in large glasses with long slices of pickled carrots, called tane (or in some accents, dene.) Hot paprika relish is added just before drinking. Hot or regular, it is a popular drink with Adana kebab.
Şalgam is often served with rakı (alcoholic beverage)--not mixed, but rather in a separate glass. While Şalgam is commonly used to cure hangovers, consuming excess amounts may cause bloating.
