I will definitely buy more Coco Polo but am hoping the price will become more affordable, still looking at other products.
The choclate used is not very complex or flavorful, making the bars a bit bland.  I was so excited to find this product but it was a disappointment--definitely not chocolate for chocolate lovers.
I was disappointed in this coffee.  I thought a french roast dark would have a stronger flavor.  It is too mild for me.
This coffee was just ok.  It was very mild for a French Roast.  I probably will not purchase again.
This is a nice, mild cup of coffee.  Not too strong, but good flavor.
This coffee is an acceptable addition to my k-cup collection. Although not of exceptional flavor, it is mellow and interesting and worthy of consideration.

We have this formula and love it. The packs are great- easy to throw into a DP bag and the formula is easy on our LO's tummy. No excessive fussiness, gas or constipation. Easy for our lil buddy to go back and forth between this and breast milk while supplementing.

This is the only formula my baby liked after trying all of them. He could tell the difference between the powder version of the same vs. the ready to eat version. Wouldn't touch the powdered version but can't get enough of the ready to eat formula.

We feel our 6 mo old takes this formula better than the powered ed version. not sure if her stomach gets upset with powder but this ready made formula is so much easier to package for daycare and off you go. if you go through formula quickly, get a case or two and you'll be amazed how fast you go through it.
packaging of the containers is always solid. they use pretty thick card stock. sometimes the seal is a bit hard to get fully off, and you have a little clear plastic left on the top, if you dont remove it and try to pour the formula, you might make a small mess if you pour too slowly....

Purchased Kefir grains for the second time, sadly let the first die from neglect. Since then I have discovered the many health benefits and want to start over. These grains arrived quickly and were well packed. The instructions were concise and well written. The kefir grains are beautiful and the amount was well worth the price. I am more than pleased with this purchase.  Thank you

I love this mixer to make chocolate martinis. While I can buy it almost anywhere in Texas. I could not find it in upstate NY, so I purchased it online. It was delivered quicky and I am very happy with it. My only complaint would be the total price online. It is under $4 in the store ( if you can find it) and online it was $37 plus shipping for 6 bottles, which I thought was expensive. But when you have to have it, you have to have it!!!! :-)))

This product has become UNAVAILABLE in local stores here in southeastern PA.  What has happened is that America has a love affair with sugar.  So much so, that if the food they put in their mouth is not loaded with it, they don't think it tastes good.  23g of sugar is a federal requirement in 12 oz. soft drinks, or at least it seems so.  As I've gotten older, I've given up things that obviously contain lots of sugar.  But companies are sneaky.  They know that sugar works and is addictive.  Sugar is cheaper than tea.  Add more sugar, remove some tea.  The formula is a winner.  That explains the skyrocketing diabetes in the U.S., but the companies don't care.  And it's not their fault.  Nobody forces you to take these items off the shelf and put them in your cart.  Until maybe now.  I used this concentrated tea to make my own iced tea for years.  Maybe it's just my fellow citizens that don't buy it anymore, but vendors have dropped it from the shelves.  All my visitors to my home always commented that my iced tea was very good.  I'd use the standard sugared mix, but cut off the last 1/3 of the recommended dosage, and instead added this concentrate to make it more tea, less sugar.  It works, and it works well.  But now here I am on Amazon, buying a product that I should be able to find in stores, but no dice.  And no, I don't want to spend $10.00 on energy charges to boil a boatload if teabags and deal with all of that.  This is easy.  Kudos to the seller: fast service, reasonable price.  Good health to you and your family. For the rest of you out there, don't forget to brush.

I ordered the required minimum of 6 rather large bottles (I would've been happy with one or two, but that wasn't an option).

I was amazed when they arrived in a rather large box... because I could hear the glass bottles clunking around in there. I opened it, and there they all were, loose and floating around inside the box. The plastic lid on one was broken, and all the other plastic lids were loose. The only thing keeping the dry tea powder secure was the paper seal at the top of each jar.

So, in the end... the product is USABLE, but their care in packing was non-existent, and it's just by luck that the bottles themselves hadn't broken.

I used brew my own tea for iced tea, but now that my life is more hectic - I'm happier that there is an easier alternative.

I've tried other instant teas and I find the Nestea to be my favorite. It doesn't have a processed flavor like many other instant teas. I prefer purchasing the unsweetened variety so I can customize the sweetness of my tea. It also tastes great when you squeeze a bit of lemon in it.

The tea completely dissolves quickly - even when stirred with ice cold water. My 10 and 11 year old can even easily make themselves a large glass. One jar lasts quite awhile.

Maybe it's weird, but my husband and I save the jars that this tea comes so we can drink tea out of it. I also like to make this in a water bottle before running errands so I'm not tempted to buy expensive bottled teas or pop.

My wife and I have been using this unsweetened tea hot for years. great if your watching your sugar. Received this product in four days. One day earlier than ship date. My only issue was in the packaging. One of the bottles was broken and the inside was just lined with air bubble strips and no indication on the carton of fragile or glass enclosed.

The product itself is fine but the packaging is terrible.  When I received my package, the lid on one jar was cracked and another jar was smashed into a million little pieces.  Instead of taking an extra 20 seconds and wrapping each jar in bubble wrap, some genius threw all six jars into the box then covered it with a single plastic air bag.  Looking at the other reviews, it sounds like this is a common problem.  I would strongly advise not buying this product unless you like playing with broken glass.

I mistakenly ordered regular Nestea instead of the Decaf. I was able to exchange without any problems and received very quickly. Bonnie, the customer service representative, bent over backwards for me concerning another issue that was resolved well beyond my expectations. Absolutely would order again and suggest no one have any doubts ordering from this company. BTW - Packaging problems are solved.

Nestea 100% Instant Tea, 3-Ounce Containers (Pack of 6) Twenty odd years ago I retired and on the first day I decided to give my wife her tea in bed. Nestea of course. I have continued the practice ever since and rarely miss a day unless I am out of town. Even when visiting our Time Share in St Maarten the bottle goes with us. Recently my wife was unable to find the product in the 4 grocery stores we visit regularly, and our supply of bottles began to dwindle. We called on the phone, sent EMails and was unable to find a source. We mentioned it to our son in San Diego who came back by EMail **Cleaned out Walmart. 14 jars will be on the way tomorrow. Hurray> Next day EMail from him said Amazon had it and gave details. We ordered 12 more bottles by computer and they arrived shortly in good order. Since I am 86 and she is 83 I would expect we have a life time supply. She was happy as a clam and the tea goes on. Thank you, Thank You.

For over a decade my family has always enjoyed this brand of tea; especially my mother who drinks it pipin' hot daily with Cremora. Other family members occasionaly enjoy it as a nice cold drink. However various supermarkets around my local area are no longer stocking this item; even the gluttonous Wal-Mart is now "boycotting" it. So naturally I turned to Amazon who has the audacity to charge $8.66 a jar (including shipping! The most I've ever paid for this item was probably $2 a jar. My tea arrived in a box within a box with some bubble wrap and packaging. However, I found the box in the middle of my driveway on a hot day (which is a bad omen to begin with). Why wasn't it on the porch? Why not at least leaning up against the garage? Was it thrown onto the driveway by a harried UPS worker? What I do know is that I can't use one of the jars (it arrived broken) and it's not returnable. In today's economy, I'm trying to make smarter decisions with where I throw my money. This tea product is a luxury for me. I, like you, have roamed around stores without luck of finding the product. I decided I'd go with Plan B which is to search the Internet and was thrilled to find it on Amazon. However, Plan C is to "move on" and most likely start making "Cold Brewed Iced Tea" from tea bags. Good luck if you order this... but maybe it's time to "move on." Lipton is thriving on the shelves but Nestea tastes better in my opinion! I give the tea 4 stars for taste but one star for packaging.

I ordered this product and when it arrived I just happened to see the UPS driver hurl the box at my front door and I heard jars breaking. I opened the door, yelled for the driver to come back and pick up the box and handed it back to him with tea pouring out of the box.

After contacting Amazon and explaining what happened I recommended they have the boxes marked fragile as they were glass. After several weeks I came home to find a box on my porch marked with 2 fragile stickers. I picked it up and heard the broken glass and tea once again pouring out of the box. Opening the box I found 2 jars of the 6 shattered. The box was over sized with the jars simply lying inside rolling around and it was easy to see how they break.

I would not recommend buying this product from Amazon unless you like destroyed product.

I'm sure there is probably someone out there who likes the taste of this stuff. I'm not one of them.

If your goal is to find a quick-to-make unsweetened tea, you might consider bottled tea instead. This stuff tasted really bad to me.

If you sweeten it, its probably fine. I know their sweetened varieties are good.

It is hard to find a good vegan smoked salt.  The smoke scent was not that strong when I first opened it.  Now; the scent is stronger, but the taste is still minimal.  It is easy to make your food too salty, hoping to make the smoke taste stronger.  It does the trick, but don't expect a strong flavor.
I ordered this in early December for my dad for Christmas.  Product never arrived, and was finally cancelled in late January.  Disappointing!
I am still waiting for my order that was paid for and ordered in late December. I have never waited so long to receive a product!
I love Crystal Light products but I must say when I first tried this I thought I died and landed in Heaven! I drink it every day and can't get enough of it. I plan on ordering more really soon!

I first purchased this in a package Crystal Light Mocktails Drink Mixes, 3-Flavors, 15-Count along with the Appletini and Margarita flavors. The Appletini and Margarita were good, but not as good as this Mojito Drink Mix. This has the taste of lime and is sweet but also a little tart, much like a real Mojito. It also has a slight minty taste which I really like. It doesn't have aftertaste.

Each canister contains 5 packets that will make 2 quarts each. I usually use them in my Contigo AUTOSPOUT® Addison 24 oz. Water Bottles 3 pack Blue, Charcoal, Honeysuckle and just mix it to taste. It has 5 calories per serving which is 1/8 of a packet so it's good when you're trying to watch the calories. The ingredients are: Citric Acid, Maltodextrin, Aspartame (Sweetener), Acesulfame Potassium (Sweetener), Sugar, Magnesium Oxide, Contains Less Than 2% of:, Natural Flavor, Yellow 5, Blue 1

I like it best over ice. I fill my water bottle about 3/4 of the way full add the Mojito Drink Mix and then fill the bottle the rest of the way with ice. It dissolves very easily. It also makes a good cocktail in a pinch if you add rum or vodka. Two thumbs up for this great product from Kraft Foods.

Authentic mojito taste this product does not make. It is very tasty nonetheless.  As someone who grows his own mint leaves and fancies himself a mojito connoisseur, I was pleasantly surprised when I stumbled upon this product.  Its very existence demonstrates how the parent of Crystal Light, Kraft, invests in product innovation.  In fact, it is somewhat interesting how boring companies like Kraft and P&G can invent new products to entice consumers to spend their money - even on products that have no caloric or nutritional value.  That being said, I encourage Kraft to craft more mojito-flavored products.  In fact, I would even volunteer to be a beta tester.

These lights have exceptionally good light output.  I bought the 30 Watt version and they were too bright when I used them in a light fixture with 5 lamp sockets.  These are still rather bright in the same 5 socket light fixture, but acceptable.  The light output will become a little less with time. When compared to an incandescent bulb, these appear to be pure white and the standard bulb a weak yellow glow by comparison.  Once you adapt to these full spectrum bulbs, you cannot go back to standard incandescent bulbs. Now I am replacing incandescent bulbs in all areas of my new house except in areas of low usage or places the bulbs will not fit. These bulbs will fit in most fixtures, however. I am replacing the fixture in my garage to put some 45 Watt full spectrum bulbs into a cluster light fixture. I live in the Houston, Texas area so cold weather is not normally a problem.  Fluorescent bulbs often are weak in light output in cold weather until they warm up after a few minutes.  When warm, they work fine. I have not tried this particular bulb series in a cold soak environment yet.  The payoff should come this summer when electric bills are at their peak.  These bulbs are very efficient and produce a lot less heat than incandescent bulbs.  I look forward to the day that LED bulbs become affordable and brighter, but for now, this is the way to go. Definitely avoid the so called warm white fluorescent bulbs in the stores.  Order only full spectrum CFL bulbs or those rated 51K or 55K or anything in the 5000 to 6000 Kelvin light spectrum. I would avoid the bulbs in the 6000 Kelvin range.  They probably have too much of a blue shift.  The 51K or 5100 Kelvin bulbs are perfect. Then it is just a matter of selecting the wattage you want.  For multiple bulb fixtures, these 23 Watt bulbs are perfect.  For single bulb fixtures, you probably want a higher power bulb than these. I am using a 45 Watt 51K fluorescent bulb over my breakfast nook and it is just right. These full spectrum bulbs are great for SAD (Seasonal Affective Disorder) people like me.  I get winter depression when it is cloudy and bleak for a long time. Normally Houston has plenty of sunshine, but this winter has been unusually cold. Well, at least I am not in the frozen north. This is quite a switch for me because I just moved from the San Francisco area.

I'm not sure why these are labeled as super mini bulbs. These bulbs are larger than standard incandescent bulbs and will not fit in many of my fixtures. I suspect amazon has mixed up the bulbs they are selling. I checked the manufactures website and this model bulb is not the item number that matches the super mini bulbs. EP2357AE bulbs are listed as 23-Watt Full Spectrum Bulbs. E2352AK is the product number for 23 Watt Super Mini Bulbs and they are not full spectrum bulbs. As of the date this review was typed the manufactures website is not showing a Super Mini 23 Watt Full Spectrum Bulb. I'm returning these. I also purchased the 15 Watt Super Minis and they are not the correct item either.
If you decide to purchase these bulbs you may want to check the manufactures website after you receive the bulbs to make sure you did in fact receive the right item.

Bought two six-packs about a year ago. Today we're down to five working bulbs. Three of them were unusable out of the package due to flickering/buzzing problems. The rest have died during normal use. Really like the light color and efficiency, but these bulbs definitely don't last long at all for the price. Pretty disappointing.

I just received my 6-Pack of bulbs and 2 of the 6 don't work, and another one has debris floating in the tube.

The bulbs that work appear do work well; however, there is no excuse for poor quality - back they go!

Since my husband and I are summer person who live in 4 season place, I bought these light bulbs to make our cold winter little more cheerful. These bulbs come with eco-packaging which I like, and it was bonus that I didn't have to deal with bulky packaging. First I turned on the light, I noticed it is little dim, but after couple minutes, it reaches full strength. For my small bedroom (10'X 7'), one light bulb was enough to make the room bright.
When I read while I was lying down, I noticed that the light actually doesn't hurt my eyes even if I look directly. I do have very sensitive eyes, so I was very happy that this bulbs don't make my eyes tired.
Also, I bought more lamps and had short of these bulbs, so I went ahead and used my plain old light bulb. My husband and I could not believe that how dim, irritating the yellow light bulb was compared to our full spectrum bright soft white light bulbs. I don't think I can go back to normal light bulb ever again, and now I told all my families to change theirs as well. They are all happy just like me. Energy saving is extra bonus on top of every benefit to have this light bulb.

My Amazon instant update says I bought these 2.5 years ago, so it's time for a recap review. I initially thought these had decent brightness, understandably somewhat dimmed compared to other similar 23-watt bulbs because of the full spectrum coatings. Now, however, they have reduced in brightness well beyond their initial levels and 1 of the 6 bulbs failed completely. For the price, this is a significant investment of money and I expected them to last much longer, especially since they are only used 20 or so hours per week. Essentially I'm at an estimated 2k or 3k (max) hours of use and I think it's time to replace them because we have 4 bulbs (2 each in 2 overhead fixtures) in one 13' x 16' room and it's hard to see at night because these bulbs have lost so much luminance. So the 8,000 hour lifespan is fairly misleading if my 6 bulbs are typical of the quality you can expect.

The reviewers who stated that the bulbs were too big, were not joking.  I went ahead and purchased these thinking that those reviewers had older lamps, etc.  I have contemporary lamps with a 'harp' and these bulbs don't fit. :(  I took off the lamp shade to try them out, and it's a very industrial looking light.  Very bright white.  Bummer.  I guess I'll have to stick to the GE 'A' cfl bulb I got at the grocery store.
WoW just received these bulbs today and suddenly rooms with the old incandescent seem so dreary now. We really like these bulbs. Cheaper too then buying special SAD therapy light boxes.

These are super bright, the packaging (which is all recycled cardboard) states them to be 100watt incandescent equivalent. These emit white light, super white; best used for task lighting; i.e. you don't want them as overhead or lamp lights in your dining room, or living room.

There are lots of suckers out there buying these bulbs. In order to sell these bulbs, the tree hugging manufacturers make many claims that are blatant lies. Nobody seems to care because these fakers are "saving the planet".
Let's clear up some obvious issues.
1. These don't begin to produce the light output of a traditional 100 watt incandescent bulb. Pure nonsense. They have the light output of a 60 watt bulb. MAYBE!!! Enjoy the romantic mood.
2. They don't last 7 years. I replaced all the bulbs in my house two years ago. Half of them are kaput. Another lie.
3. The light temperature isn't neutral. Install these in your kitchen and your food will look inedible. Especially anything with red sauce.
You could switch back to the good old incandescent ones, but by years end, they will be taken off the market. The 100 watt ones were banned at the end of 2011. The 75s are next.
Thanks Washington for running our lives. Where would we be without you? Answer: Better off.

The Amazon description claims the bulb is 92 CRI, but the Earthmate website claims 88. I'm really not sure which (if either) to believe.

I'm using these for some plants, and while the colors definitely do look nicer than with a standard warm fluorescent, I don't really see much difference between these bulbs and other decent "daylight" bulbs. These do seem to be high quality CFL bulbs, but I don't think there's much to justify the higher price as compared to other options.

Had high hopes for these, but alas, these bulbs feature that unnatural, too-blue, fluorescent quality of light we all hate so much in CFL bulbs.  They take a while to "warm" up, but the final light is far from "warm."  Good for garages, basements, and closets only.

Just bought these after Christmas from The Vermont Country Store. They are out of them, so I searched here and to my surprise found them!  They are great with a cup of hot tea or coffee.  They are a variety of mostly shortbread cookies, along with two different wafer cookies, dipped in dark chocolate.  I like that they aren't too sweet and my kids enjoy them too.

Growing up in Germany these cookies are the ones I used to buy. Hans Freitag makes the best cookies! I love the one with milk chocolate but keep coming back to buy the dark chocolate for friends and family. They are not as sweet as American cookies but just sweet enough. I have gifted these several times and they have always been well received. They great part is you get 5 bags! At the price they are selling them, it is hard to beat! For any dark chocolate lover, these are a nice treat. If you like milk chocolate, these might be for you Hans Freitag Noblesse, 14-Ounce (Pack of 5).

These sprouting trays are simply the best. With little effort I grow a wide variety of delicious and fresh sprouts in my kitchen. The trays stack up nicely and I have six of them, one on top of the other. They require little space. Believe it or not, it's like having a small farm in the house that produces an impressive amount and array of "fresh vegatables", albeit in sprout form. The sprouts grown in these trays stay fresh and never develop an unpleasant smell. They taste crisp, are pleasant to eat and have become the mainstay in my daily intake of vegetables in my diet. I clean my trays outside with a spray nozzle attached to my garden hose. This makes cleaning quick and easy, then I rinse them in the sink with some bleach in the water to sterilize them before growing a fresh crop. The trays are foolproof and have changed the way I eat. With the price of vegetables rising in the supermarkets, I've found these trays to be a great money saver - to say nothing of the superior nutrition that eating sprouts provide. I would highly recommend them to anyone!
- Chris Morton

When I opened the box, I thought I had spent a lot of money for some plastic bins.  However, they fit together well, I had no spilling of water, and they are totally dishwasher safe.  The little instruction booklet, though not very flashy, was very helpful in getting me started in sprouting.  Definitely a good investment.

I began sprouting in the 70's with a glass jar and cheesecloth.
Having used a few sprout gadgets over the years, I can say without hesitation that this Sproutmaster sprouter is simply the best.
It has worked well with seeds, nuts and legumes.
It cleans up easily.
Because sprouts are kept in the dark during sprouting, I leave the lid off on the last day for the chlorophyll action to green them up even more.
I have been using the Sproutmaster now for 10 years.
Three trays are ample for a family of five. You'll learn seed selection & timing rotation as you go.
It is worth every cent I paid for it.

I have used just about every type of sprouter over the years, but the sprout master is the one for me.  It makes perfect sprouts every time.  Drainage and air circulation is excellent.  The level of difficulty is: EASY.  They work well when stacked.  I like my sprouts growing vertically I have learned.  I prefer greening them up before eating, so this makes the perfect design.  Plus the sprouts look absolutely gorgeous in the sproutmaster, unlike Easy Sprout, or jar sprouting where they are all bunched together.  Make sure you sterilize the tray with vinegar and water soaks before sprouting new sprouts. If you do that, you should have no problems with mold.
These are GREAT for growing any amount of sprouts, from a 1/2 tray to 3 full trays... LOVE THEM!!
We are pleased with our Triple Sprout Master. We always have sprouts or wheat grass to eat.
Thanks for getting the original NECCO candies back.  The new formula ones are just awful!  Please keep these in stock.

Fast forward to now: just a few years ago, I found Neccos at a dollar store and began buying them again-but, for some reason, the Necco company decided to "mess with perfection" and re-formulated the flavors to reflect the ones they used many years ago (before my time)

Then one day I was checking something else out on Amazon,and they popped up-not the new and improved ones-but the ones I enjoyed from childhood!!
I then ordered 2 boxes of them from Amazon and have been in "Necco heaven" ever since!!
I enjoyed the wayback machine with this purchase and found these wafers in good shape at an excellent price. I have been sharing with my office and they too find the memories roll in with each taste.

I usually like Timothy's coffees, so I thought for sure I would like the hazelnut version.  It doesn't taste or smell like hazelnut coffee.  I can drink it, but I think Van Houtte and Gloria Jeans makes a better version of it.

I did not like this coffee because it tastes more like French Vanilla.  I thought it was Hazelnut.....that is what the title says but it has vanilla in it.  The company was great and exchanged the coffee for me.  Buy this only if you like vanilla taste in your coffee.
This coffee has an EXCELLENT flavor.  We LOVE our Keurig one-cup brewer!

I finally bought my man a Keurig coffee maker for Christmas -- we have one at work and Timothy's Hazelnut is one of his favorites. Good price for 2 boxes. Other stores in our area have them around $10.99 for one. It's definitely a "flavored" coffee and not bold, so if that's not your style, go for a bolder brew.
Found this hazelnut k-cup bitter. Very bitter. Couldn't even finish the box.  Didn't even get half way through the box.  Threw it out.
This product has too much vanilla as others have stated.  It's not truly a Hazelnut coffee, but a blended vanilla hazelnut combo. I will not be purchasing this again.
I am not a hazelnut fan...but the mrs. is.  She loves the keurig and she loves Timothy's hazelnut and french vanilla.
This is good coffee, but the Gloria Jean's K-Cup Hazlenut coffee is better to me.

(I posted a similar review for Timothy's French Vanilla K-cups) Has a mediocre taste but its very weak even when brewed on the small cup setting. Timothy's is the best Hazelnut coffee so far, I have tryed Gloria Jeans, yuk, Green Mountain, ok, Timothy's by far exceeds all in flavor, and I am a hazelnut connesseur. You have to try this one! Colleen in Connecticut

I absolutely love the Timothy's Hazelnut DECAF K-cup - it is my favorite DECAF.  I found this caffeinated version tastes more burnt, and is not quite as smooth. Not a bad cup of coffee, but there are others I like better (the Kona blend, the Private blend, the Columbian Dorado, and my personal favorite Sugar Bush Maple (seasonal)).
Timoty has a variety of coffees in K-cups. The coffee's are very good and the variety is large. The order arrived as promised and in good condition.

This has been my coffee of choice for a long time and I was pleased to see it on Amazon.  I signed up for recurring shipments (for an even greater discount!) but received word not too long ago that it is no longer available.  I hope it comes back, it was a good buy.  I recommend it if it becomes available again.
the order came very quickly & the coffee is wonderful.  i will certainly buy more of this coffee.

Just FYI, I checked the nutritional information on this product and it states it has 20 calories per stick.  Each tablespoon of Agave Nectar has 60 calories so each stick is 1 teaspoon.  So you would need three sticks for a tablespoon serving.  Just thought I would throw that out there for anyone thinking about buying this product and trying to figure out how many sticks they need to use in their tea or coffee, LOL!  I'm a two sticker;o)
this ia a good idea; however, difficult to open.  must squeeze/twist pretty hard & product oozes free - usually all over fingers.  also, portion size is a bit too small.  still love agave.

I have used agave for many things and find that it is a better alternative to sugar. It will not give you the sugar plunge you get from sugary products. If you are using this product in beverages please realize that it is not going to give you that same sugary, syrupy flavor that some people are used to from regular sugar or substitutes. It is a subtle sweetness.

I have served this product to friends, and those who are used to a sugary taste in their tea didn't care for it as much as those friends who don't use a lot of sugar. It really depends on what you are used to. I have no complaints about this product.

Agave is also better for people who have diabetes, as it does not spike blood sugar levels.

Don't pass up on trying this great alternative to sugar. It is worth letting your tastebuds adapt to the subtleness. It is also great for baking. Also, this is now labeled as organic, so another reason to try it.

I bought this in an effort to help myself quit smoking while watching my weight.  Also, I'd been looking for a smaller honey container to use to sweeten my hot tea when I'm at work.  These honey sticks definitely helped.  The honey was very good, the stick/straw seems to be a great way to package it as it doesn't spill out easily.  Plus, each stick is only 15 calories, so you can watch your proportion if that matters to you. I will definitely purchase this again.

I was hesitant about this product based on some customer reviews that said there were difficulties opening the little sticks and that they (the customers, not the sticks) got agave all over their fingers... I wonder if Stash read the reviews and changed their packaging?  I have not had this problem, and I'm usually *awful* at opening packaging! With these, I simply bite off the end (gross, I know, but I am a student and I don't/can't carry a knife around with me in my bookbag all day) and squeeze it into my coffee.  It's a great way to have my agave with me because most coffee shops and cafes have not yet started stocking this alongside their poisonous sugar alternatives (you know, those pink, blue, and yellow packets).  Keeps my blood sugar from spiking, sweetens my coffee--what more could you ask for?

These little goodies are so full of flavor and so good. I bought these for my granddaughter in Minnesota and sent them to her. She was thrilled, shared them with her sisters and now they are wanting to get some.
Great gift idea!!

These are great to have!  I toss one in my daughter's lunch...have a few in my purse for a "pick" me up, etc.  Tasty, tasty!  Other people are so curious when I whip one out.  They are amazed it's a straw filled with honey.  This is the place to find the best price on these honey sticks.  Thanks for having them on subscribe and save.  Great program!

I picked up these honey sticks because I'm in a chai tea phase and thought they'd be nice to add to a simple black tea. Upon taking one from the box, I was treated to a wonderful scent of cinnamon and spices that reminded me of Christmas time. I brewed my tea, added the stick of honey and stirred. As I took that first sip, I couldn't much smell the honey I just added. As the tea coated my tongue I was waiting and waiting for the scent of the honey stick to hit my tongue and it never really did. I could taste a tiny bit of honey, but nothing more than if I added plain clover honey to my tea. It was rather underwhelming. My second cup I tried 2 sticks and it was a little better, but for the price, I'd much rather just buy chai tea bags.

All in all, don't expect it to taste the way it smells. Far too weak in just a simple black tea, but smells divine still sealed up!
These honey sticks are so nice in a cup of tea.  You can even remove your tea bag with them!

These Chai Honey Sticks are SO good!  I enjoy eating one or two when I have a craving for something sweet.  It also makes a fun non-sugar sweet treat for my toddler.  The straws are the perfect size to add to a 6oz cup of tea too.
These are straws filled with lemon flavored honey.  I love them.  They taste great and are easy to take with you.  I use them at work- very convenient for quick hot tea without the messy honey.

These are GREAT for carrying in my purse for eating out, or when we're traveling, as most places do not have Agave Nectar!
Just wish there was an easier way to open them...I'm carrying a small pair of scissors to open them!

It's great to have agave in a portable format.  But is is difficult to open.  The directions say to pinch to open.  They are not so easy to pinch.  I have found if you bend the tube about 1 inch above the end then pinch the end it helps.  But the agave often gets on your fingers.

I was disappointed in this product, as I had read and heard that this was an excellent sweetner, and it only took a small amount.  NOT TRUE!  I had a 8 ounce glass of tea, and added two "straws" of Nectar, and you couldn't even tell anything had been added.  Expensive if  you had to use a whole pack to slightly sweeten anything.

When I ordered these, based on the description, I thought the honey was somehow hardened into stick-form and thus would 'melt' into a cup of hot tea. I was surprised when I discovered these sticks were actually thin plastic straws filled with honey! There is no way I'm going to insert a plastic straw into a hot cup of tea. I'm not sure it would work anyway; I suppose you could cut open each end and then blow the honey in the tea. Does Stash think you're going to sip on these straws? I don't know what the company was thinking when they produced this product, other than as a candy to be eaten.

I believe the term "stick" does not accurately describe this product and is misleading. I doubt it's intentional, however. The Stash Tea Company is an excellent company and has many high quality teas and products.

The honey flavored with chai spices is good enough but frankly, it it a very expensive way to buy honey. Better to buy a jar and flavor it yourself. I wound up using these Chai Honey Sticks by cutting open one end and pressing out the honey into a tea cup/pot, which was messy and time consuming.

I love Stash tea... drink it every morning. But this product is a bust and I would never purchase it again.

I've tried many brands of green tea and this is by far the best.  The only thing better was a loose tea I bought in Japan.  Remember to let the water cool a little before adding the bag.  And I would suggest checking your local Asian market for a lower price.  I usually pay $19.00 for a pack of 100 bags.

Although this tea was not packaged in the nylon mesh bags as expected, it is excellent for brewing in a two-cup tea pot. Mellow and light. Service from the third party was unexpectedly rapid, and they included extra goodies - additional tea and shampoo. I was highly satisfied. One recommendation for the distributor is to also offer the Sencha Green Tea in the nylon mesh bags. This is what I thought I was getting, and got I believe the same product in a different tea bag. The nylon mesh allows for more mellow brewing.
I've spent a year in Japan and have been a tea drinker all my young life. This is by far the best packet tea I have ever had. Maeda en products are tops.

Let me first say that I am an AVID green tea drinker. I go through anywhere from 6-10 tea bags a day, so I am always on the hunt for new and better teas. That being said, I had really high hopes for an authentic Japanese Sencha. Unfortunately, I wasn't a fan of what I got.

When I brewed my first batch of this tea, I noticed the very green color, which is hard to find in teas from America. But, when I started to smell the tea as it was steeping, it smelled like something familiar, but I just couldn't put my finger on it. The smell wasn't exactly bad, but it was definitely not how I wanted my tea to smell. Eventually it hit me. This tea smelled like CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP!

At first I thought I was crazy, until other people would walk into my house and ask if I was making soup... The taste is very strong, and unusual. Needless to say, I only used about 4 out of the 100 tea bags. I won't be buying again.
Looks brown with a little bit of green and I do not want to drink it so what's there to do I already opened it and I doubt it's just my bag or if I could even get a return

Soft, not rock hard, not going to pull out my tooth fillings!

I have never tasted such amazing wonderful magnificent licorice! Anything else , is not true licorice! This may be a bit "strong" of flavor if one is used to the nasty corn syrup watered down no flavor kind of candy. I very much feel this is TRUE licorice....

this is made with wheat ... Wheat and flavor (natural herbs?) natural oils... GOOD stuff, instead of that icky sticky awful corn syrup stuff. My mouth feels clean after this Anise (?) licorice, unlike other candy.

This actually HELPS ,naturally, motivates my lower GI tract, so no worries. heh.sorry. Maybe some folks might find this helpful information. EWwww. sorry.
Great product! Nothing artificial.  It peals into 3 layers for more mileage out of your tire treads........
This licorice was very very good.  It was a little sticky, but that didn't keep me from eating it.  If your favorite candy is black licorice, you'll buy more of this.

Love this stuff!!  Really good black licorice, maybe a bit more authentic than American licorice bars of the past were.  So, if you liked licorice bars in the past, this is a wonderful relief and treat.  Good price too !!

Because that's what it tastes like. Seriously, this licorice is awful.

It is sticky. Some licorice you can hold between your fingers and pop into your mouth. Not this stuff. And heaven-forbid you get it near an angora sweater.

I also find the texture vaguely unpleasant. Some reviewers appreciated the softness of the product. To me it just felt characterless and mushy in my mouth. Not completely unpleasant, but not pleasant.

But more important than the tactile feel of the confection is the taste. And it gets worse with every bite! I've had some food items that tasted unusual at first, but got better and better the more I ate. Not Tire Tread licorice. Every bite has me sinking further into the taste of the manufacturing of vulcanized rubber.

I don't think this candy's problem is too much of a licorice taste. I've had various licorice products from Europe and Asia. No, the candy has a vaguely dirty taste, like it's been tooling down the road before hopping in my mouth.
VERY sticky and moist, but interesting and appealing texture. Soft but not mushy and a licorice blast! I could eat a pile of this yummy tread but limit myself.

Nice that it has all natural ingredients. However, beet juice seems to be very sweet. Also, as mentioned before, it sticky!

Lets say it is unique. Not in a bad unique way.

(Review of Dilettante Chocolates Champagne Truffles)

I use the rice bran and avocado oil from this company. I have been using using both oils for months and just discovered I can start getting it on Amazon - I am so excited!! The rice bran oil has little to no taste when I cook with it- which I like because it doesn't take away from the taste of the actual food. I have been doing a lot of research on oil smoke point levels and how cooking with oils like olive oil at high heats changes the good properties into bad ones (it basically turns it into a trans fat).  I decided to switch to rice bran or avocado oil exclusively for cooking purposes because they have higher smoke point levels. Now I just use my olive oil for salads and dipping bread etc.

WONDERFUL OIL, LEAVES NO TASTE OF OIL, BUT COOKS GREAT, ACTUALLY GOOD FOR YOU!!!
I HAVE USED IT FOR FRYING, AND WORKS GREAT IN DRESSINGS. MY FAVORITE OIL NOW.

I had a bowl of Cooked Organic Brown Rice for lunch today. The brand was Minsley and I found it at Costco in a packet/box of six bowls. The individual bowls could be microwaved for 90 seconds and then opened and stirred. It couldn't get any simpler. The rice turned out a bit stickier than expected, but no problem. The rice was quite excellent and this is such a handy way of fixing up a bowl! Then, the question is, what do you want with it? Well I had a can of wild sardines packed in extra virgin olive oil and I added most of the oil to the mixture plus a small amount of an Asian hot chili sauce for extra flavor. Very good. Add the quality of the brown Rice ingredients to the sardines in olive oil, and you have a nutritional powerhouse. This is a great product, and so handy. I'll be having it with a lot of other things.

Gary Peterson
After trying multiple herbal teas this so far is the only one I like and it's hard to find too.  So many of the herbal teas have flowers like hibiscus or lavender in them which do not belong in tea!

After searching for a great tasting orange-flavored tea that was more affordable than what Teavana sells, I found this Honeybush, Mandarin, &Orange tea in the shop at Animal Kingdom at Walt Disney World. It was so good, but I didn't want to have to drive an hour each way to buy more of it after my daughters and I quickly finished off the first box of it. I searched on Amazon, and found a great price for a package of six of them that cost the same and was very affordable. I love it.

I am not a tea drinker and, when I do drink it, I choose herbal.  I find this particular blend the best herbal tea I have come across.  Unfortunately, the local stores have stopped stocking it but I was able to order it :-)
I found that the amount of tea in the bags were about half the amount that we recieved when we had the same brand and type of tea at a conteninal breakfast. So I got the SHORT bags.

This grape juice has a very strong tasting grape flavor quite unlike the other brands I have tried. Shipping was super fast and subscribe and save is very helpful. I would have liked a milder grape flavor for my taste.
I've loved everything I've ordered from Nueske's. This breakfast basket was a great treat. Their applewood smoked bacon is still my favorite!

I believe the title says it all.  The original box was obviously damaged and taped with packaging as if a third grader had done the job.  Upon receiving it and seeing it's appearance I then counted the number of bones which ended up being eight short....about 15% off.  I then contacted the vendor and amazon and never received a reply back.  Therefore I am very disappointed with both the condition of the product, the vendor, and amazon.

These bones are made in China so we have no idea how they are manufactured, but regardless they made our dog very sick. Lots of diarhea and gas from these bones - I sent the entire box back for a refund. Purchase at your own risk.

I am just finishing the first box of these pressed rawhide bones for my rottie. She loves them, they last longer than regular rawhide, and she isn't able to chew off large chunks like with the regular rolled rawhide. The price is great and the convenience of buying in bulk is a time saver. The only change I would make is to remove the cardboard strip that comes on each bone to cut down on packaging, but not a huge deal.

I have tried this bones before from local stores that charge 3 and 4 times as much for them.  That is even after you add in shipping. Now you need to understand that my puppies are 2 and 8 years old. These bones are the perfect size for them and they last so much longer than plain rawhide. I suggest them for all dogs that like to chew, or even maybe the ones that don't.  You might be surprised, they might like them too.

I have three power-chewers, and pressed rawhide bones are a must-have around our house. My dogs will quickly destroy cheap rawhides. With the choking hazard presented by bones that come apart too easily, it can be a challenge to find a decent pressed rawhide without breaking the bank. We were paying $5 - $7 a piece for a good quality bone at our favorite pet store. We can go through as many as 5 a week...ouch. Adds up fast.

I dug around to try to find a quality replacement that would save us some money and stumbled on these on Amazon. I figured they would be flimsy for the price, but decided to give it a shot. I was astonished at the quality. They are great. These bones last as long as the ones I was buying from the pet store. The price is unbeatable. About a $1.70 a piece. That's a HUGE price difference. Even the box is great. We tear off the front flap, the way the item is pictured, and put the whole thing in a deep drawer in our kitchen. Very handy for us. We average about 1 box every three months. I haven't really counted, but it seems we burn through less of these than the others, too.

I am a firm believer that what you don't pay out in quality food and treats for your dogs, you pay out in vet bills, poorer health and shorter life span. So we buy top quality pet foods, etc. I really love it when quality comes with a great price, too. These have made three dogs VERY happy. They've made my wallet VERY happy, too. Excellent bang for your buck! I highly recommend these.

I love the pie. However, I wish that the pie was softer and melt in my mouth while eating it. I think that it might actually be a large peanut butter cookie with spreading of peanut butter, chips, and Reese's cups.

They don't leave a sour taste in your stomach like coffee can and you can keep them anywhere, your desk, your car, in your pocket or purse.  I wouldn't be without them.

My late father in law turned me onto these.  He always had some in the car.  I have one in place of my morning coffee when I know I won't be near any bathrooms.  Half a one in the afternoon keeps me moving and productive until dinner.  The mocha mint is a great flavor.

Moving from Brooklyn, NY to Phoenix, AZ in 1970 was quite a culture shock.  Only one Italian Deli.  Couple of years ago Progresso stopped making their Caponata... I searched high and low for one that was as good.  Well, I found an even better one, 'Cento' Caponata is great!

For this review you're going to get two opinions. Darshan1 and chocolate enthusiast extraordinaire, Darshan's Mom.

Darshan says: As an amateur chocolate consumer, I found this fairly similar in taste to Hershey's Special Dark at first, um, chomp, but after a couple chews, I noticed it's a fair amount creamier and much more satisfying than Special Dark. I favor milk chocolate (I think Cadbury milk is my favorite) so this was a little bitter for me (it actually is a little stronger than Special Dark), but compared to some 82% stuff that my mom sometimes has where I feel like I'm going to choke for the bitterness, this was quite good. A very good compromise (in my opinion) if we were going to split a chocolate bar for dessert. I like the fact that it's "Fair Trade" chocolate since a lot of cocoa harvesting involves some harsh child labor practices, and since it's one of the few fair trade brands that I can get at the nearby regular grocery store instead of having to trek to a gourmet store, I'd probably start buying their milk chocolate variety.

Darshan's Mom says: Newman's Own organic dark chocolate satisfyingly combines the creaminess of milk chocolate with the taste of a somewhat mild, but luscious, dark chocolate. Since it's merely 54% chocolate, the heavenly, bitter tang of 75% to 8o% chocolate is missing. However, the rich smoothness of the product almost makes up for that. Being a confirmed chocoholic, I've taste tested chocolate in France, Belgium and Switzerland, the holy trinity of European chocolate according to a local chocolate store owner, but, in order to be perfectly fair, of course, I've forced myself to sample chocolate in Germany and Italy as well. I've made pilgrimages to American restaurants famous for their chocolate temptations, visited a cocoa plantation in Tobago and prepared numerous chocolate desserts over the years. So, I think I know chocolate. Yes, for those of us who crave deep, dark chocolate, Newman's Own comes up a little short, but it is surprisingly delicious nevertheless. Another plus, it's organic. If it's priced well compared to the better-known European chocolate bar brands, it could easily become one of my top choices for everyday enjoyment.

This chocolate is perfection.  The texture is so smooth and melts in your mouth not too fast and not too slow.  Dark chocolate but not too dark, seriously just perfect!  And it's organic, which makes it even better!  Would buy this in a heartbeat.

What I mean by its neither here nor there is that it is somewhere in between a dark and a milk chocolate. The result is that it lacks the intensity, bitterness and depth of dark chocolate yet is slightly creamier, yet it also lacks the smoothness and sweetness of a milk chocolate. So it really is not my favorite at all. Plus, it has a strange aftertaste that I have difficulty describing. All in all, its very decent and much better than an ordinary Hershey's bar yet is just not satisfying enough that I would want to get it again. I do appreciate the fact it is organic and like the size and thickness of the bar, but I just didn't enjoy it that much.

This chocolate, unlike many dark chocolates I've tried, has more the sweetness and smoothness of milk chocolate. There is very little bitterness. The cocoa level is 54 percent, and is organic, making it a less guilty indulgence.

This chocolate goes well with Pinot Noir!

This chocolate bar was so good. Dark chocolate is my favorite kind of chocolate and this bar didn't disappoint. To me it tastes like a Dark Chocolate Hershey bar. This chocolate bar leaves a good aftertaste. I tasted the chocolate for a good half hour or so afterwards. It kept making me want more.

This bar is 330 calories, a little more than I wanted in one sitting so I divided it into 3 separate servings. This was easy to do because it's like 6 little squares put together so I just broke them into 3 different bars.

I highly recommend these chocolate bars.

This chocolate is good, but I've had better.  I give it three stars for the flavor and texture, and one more star because it's all organic.  For the price, I expected a smoother flavor.  Scharffen Berger's Extra Dark chocolate is much smoother.  Newman's tastes like it has some powdered milk in it.

I can't tell the difference between organic and non-organic chocolate just based on the taste of it. I highly doubt many people could. But the taste is really great. Not as bitter as some dark chocolate is, and it melts really well in the mouth - not waxy at all like a cheaper version might be.

This is really good chocolate, period.

I shared my chocolate bar with 2 friends. We all agreed that we liked it. I'm just starting to get into dark chocolate. I've been a long time milk chocolate lover. This bar is only 54% cocoa so it wasn't too bitter or overwhelming for me. I really liked the taste and texture and will buy this chocolate.

What my friends said:

"The dark chocolate was smooth with very little bitterness. If you let it melt on your tongue for a few seconds then sipped a 20 year old single malt, it was quite dignified , just like Paul Newman himself." -- Fred

"The chocolate was rich yet very smooth and delicious, just like Paul Newman himself." -- Jackie

I just LOVE dark chocolate! The highger the cocoa concentration, the better is my motto. While this bar's concentration is higher than a lot of readiliy available drug/grocery store picks it really doesn't shine for me. There are so many more easily purchased choices out there that are truly delicious. Highlight of this bar? It's Organic and that's important to a lot of people today. Low Point? It has a really waxy consistency that borders on the artificial. Mouthfeel is important to me...if I'm going to "spend" calories eating dark chocolate, I want it to be the most amazing taste experience available. The overall taste is not bad, there is just better to be had. I recommend that Newman's Own go back to the drawing board on this one. Oh, and it's kind of an odd sized bar. Larger than an "individual" bar, but smaller than the average multi-serving bar (in case anyone is interested!).

Summary: a very good "starter" gourmet dark chocolate for those who aren't into strong flavors...

We eat a disturbing amount of chocolate around our house, whether it's Lindt, Ghiradelli, Sees, Cadbury, Toblerone, Scharffen Berger, Godiva or even Hershey's, we've had it.

We tend towards the very dark chocolates, although i do have to say we had some Lindt in the 90% range which was just a bit too sharp. I'm also a espresso aficionado.

This chocolate has a very smooth texture. It's well tempered and starts out quite firm in the mouth, then melts to a very smooth consistency. It's fairly sweet for a dark chocolate - not as sweet as a Hershey's special dark, but more than other dark chocolates in this range. 54% cocoa gives a much stronger taste than Milk chocolate and here it still has a very creamy finish with no sharp aftertaste. Still, I found it simply "chocolate" without any accompanying flavors you tend to notice in the stronger chocolates.

If you like your coffee black or like cappuccinos then this might be for you. If you drink Turkish coffee or espresso then this probably won't have enough punch for you.

I eat a lot of good chocolate like Valrhona, Domori, & Green & Black. Newman's Own is in no way on par with better chocolates, but it is better than average. They tried hard to make it something special but I won't be buying again. There are much better chocolate bars out there.

I received 1 bar via the Amazon Vine program to review. Let me just say I love chocolate in any form, but dark chocolate is probably 4th down on the list of favorites. That being said, I find most dark chocolate is either too bitter for my liking, often leaving me with a slight pucker in my mouth and/or a chalky after-taste. Newman's Own Organics Dark Chocolate was a pleasant surprise on the taste front. Yes, it's dark chocolate, but no bitter aftertaste. It's smooth and just sweet enough to remind me of bittersweet chocolate, more than dark.

The reason for 4 and not 5 stars has more to do with the price of being environmentally aware. Perhaps that explains the price hike on this bar of chocolate versus some others? I love that Newman's company puts a portion of its proceeds back into helping others, and that too may explain the price hike, but I don't have to like it. Not when other brands are just as tasty and cost much less.

Similar chocolate in quality and taste: Dagoba Dark (59%) Semisweet Bar, 2.0-Ounces Bars (Pack of 12) focuses too on being environmentally friendly. My suggestion if you like dark chocolate and want to help the planet, you consider Dagoba, Newman's Own Organics and Endangered Species Black Panther, Extreme Dark Chocolate (88%), 3-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12) for your own head to head taste test to determine your favorite.

If you're going to be purchasing your chocolate with the environment and natural ingredients in mind, you should also figure out which one tastes best to you.

If you are primarily a milk chocolate lover then Dark Chocolate can take some getting used to as it does have an initial taste that leans to more bitter than sweet.  But, that is not to say that it isn't good or that you won't grow to love it.  Besides its the dark not milky that is so good for you.  Plus, this is organic which makes it even better for you.  Paul Newman's Own is always a good choice brand wise and I feel that this product is no exception.

While I can't say that I ever ate a piece of chocolate I didn't like, this chocolate bar is up there with the best of them.  It had a nice rich, sweet flavor and disappeared pretty quick at our house when I left it on the nook table to share.  I like to support Newman's Own products as they donate all of their after tax profits to charity. Plus this chocolate bar was also organic, so what is not to like? If it wasn't fattening it be the perfect food.
Has a nice texture and not too bitter, but I would not pay more for it compared to other dark chocolates.

I had high expectations of this chocolate as I've enjoyed other Newman's Own products. However, this dark chocolate left much to be desired. It didn't have a very "cocoa" taste- I could barely tell it was dark chocolate. In fact, it was just bland in general.

I buy dark chocolate nearly every week from other brands and I'm used to it having a more distinct smell and flavor.

This particular chocolate bar was "perfect" in my opinion, since I often find dark chocolate bars to be "too bitter." Instead, this one seems somewhere in the middle, between the REALLY Dark chocolate and the light chocolate. It is smooth, and enjoyable.

While the information lists a bar as a "single serving," I consider one square (there are 6 in a bar) to be adequate to meet my desire for chocolate, and still maintain my girlish figure. ;-)

Background for those who care about organics, fair trade, and sustainability:

Nell Newman co-founded the Organics line back in 1982, and it split from Newman's Own in 2001. The company has a serious focus on organics, and is a member of the Rainforest Alliance, ensuring that the chocolate is not only grown organically, but also in a socially and ecologically appropriate manner. Newman confirms that all chocolate is purchased at fair trade prices.

Since the Rainforest Alliance recently issued a joint statement with Fairtrade and UTZ Certified, you can be assured that this chocolate was not produced by slave labor.

For most people considering purchasing these bars, this is not an issue, however, I try to be conscious of social issues, and researched this information for those who find it important.

I'll admit that I am spoiled by really great chocolate from my local chocolate shop so this bar was a bit of a disappointment.  It was hard, waxy and not very flavorful.  Not even quite as good as that chocolate bar from that big factory in PA.  On a personal note, as a Vine reviewer, I only received one bar instead of the entire pack.  Unless you're really into organic, you can buy better chocolate at your nearby superstore.

I consider myself something of a chocolate connoisseur, I love it and have tried many different types and forms of chocolate at quite a few "tastings".

I had hopes that this chocolate would be divine. It wasn't. It tasted waxy and strangely, not all that chocolate'y. It was also shockingly small after seeing the caloric content -300+ calories in a bar barely the size of my iPhone!

Since I work on a system of "worth the calories or not" when it comes to sweets...I immediately placed this chocolate bar in the "not worth the calories" category, and that is why I can't recommend this product. Seek chocolate cravings elsewhere!

Like most dark chocolate this bar is not sweet nor creamy; however, it doesn't have one of those "I just gotta have it" tastes to it either.  It comes scored in six squares so you can break a piece off when you're having one of those "I could rip the curtains off the window if I don't get some chocolate," days.  If you are purchasing it because you prefer organic, then you won't hate it, but I'm not really in love with it either.

This 54%-cocoa dark chocolate bar from Newman's Own is tasty enough. Picky chocolate lovers might find it too sweet, but it whacks the craving as far as I'm concerned. I just find it way too hard. It's a quarter inch thick, so it's a solid chunk of chocolate when you bite into it or break off a piece. I've been putting it in the microwave for a few seconds to soften it, but I can see disaster looming there!
This was a good but not incredible chocolate bar. A little too much sweetness masked the chocolate flavors. I've definitely had better but overall its quite tasty.

This is good chocolate and I probably would have eaten as much of it as I had. The only dark chocolate that is better in my experience was some from Switzerland I received for a Christmas present. The fact that Newman's Own is organic is a nice touch and for some reason makes it seem okay to eat more of it.

I don't think you will be disappointed.

This chocolate is good, but it tastes more like a candy chocolate due to its sweetness. It has a good mouth feel and texture but for "dark" chocolate it tastes a little to sweet. Packaging is good, and the sample I got was well preserved, not old or dried out like some chocolate bars you get in the store.

Overall as a candy or treat this is good, environmentally responsible chocolate.

So, I don't really know how to express my feelings over a chocolate bar. In my household, there is no other choice besides dark chocolate--that's all we do. Whether it's the conventional Special Dark or the ritzy high end selections, we've tried it all. I was excited to check out Newman's Own, an organic variation weighing in at 54% cocoa. When we go upscale, we tend to venture into the 72% range, so I was interested to see the difference.

Me: I liked the bar. It was appropriately sweet (but perhaps not dark enough) and had a smoothness I enjoyed. Spouse: Didn't like it as much as I did. Not enough cocoa content, rather generic in conception. Value: While we split over quality, we agreed that the price tag on this chocolate was probably a bit high. We've had better alternatives for less--in some cases a lot less! Obviously, no one is going to hate a chocolate bar--I'd just recommend that you sample one before investing in a large quantity. Make sure it delivers the bang you require for your buck!

3 Stars from my spouse, 4 stars from me--product at 3 1/2 stars. But since I write the review, I get the round-up!

Though I like the organic idea I do not like that much organic food suffers in taste.  So it is very pleasant that this chocolate is available.  I would not compare it to some of my favorite premium chocolates but it is certainly as good as most of the mass market chocolate bars.  I prefer dark chocolate that is more bitter than this but I know my tastes are not the norm so most people will enjoy it more than I.  A good idea for a more healthy treat.

This is a fairly high quality confection. The flavor is smooth, round, and fruity, almost raisin-y. However, I am a dark chocolate lover, and dark chocolate lovers won't be seduced by refinement alone.

So I consulted my spouse, a light/milk chocolate lover, and we both agree that while tasty, Newman's Own Organics dark lacks that subtle, almost spicy bitterness that brings out the complexity and assertive flavors of chocolate at varying cacao levels. Now obviously 54% cacao isn't going to register on the palate like 70%, 75% or 90% cacao, but there can still be that "snap" to chocolate, which is often compared to notes in coffee or chili pepper, even at the lower percentages. I can still, for example, perceive that note in many grocery store brand chocolate morsels, although the overall quality of those will not match the Newman's. By comparison, the Newman's has a waxiness that reminds me of Dove or Cadbury's.

I will say that this is probably a safe choice for company, where a little something sweet is desired that won't be too much for less-than-diehard fans of the dark stuff. It's agreeable; just not distinctive enough to kill for, which is pretty severe criticism where chocolate is concerned!

Ok, so I am a little biased. I adore the late Paul Newman, his family, his enterprise, his charity, and all of his products. But I also love me some dark chocolate! I take my chocolate tasting very seriously and wouldn't give it high marks just based on sheer good will. This is some seriously good stuff! Even though I love dark chocolate, I am not what one would call a chocoholic. I have restraint. I typically have a bar in my cupboard, then after dinner break off a piece or two. I savor it, then I leave it at that. Tonight I tried a piece of this delicious confection had to eat half the bar all at once. It was SO GOOD! What I love about it is it's creamy consistency. You usually find that in only milk chocolate, whereas dark chocolate usually has a sharp, almost bitter taste to it. You don't get any of that bitter taste in this bar at all - and yet it's a true dark chocolate. How do they do that? There are lots of subtle undertones of flavors, and it makes for an amazing dessert. And of course coming from Paul Newman, it's heaven sent.

Bonus too that they took such great care in choosing the best fair-trade organic chocolate. That's a big deal because if you look at most commercial chocolate sources, it makes the diamond industry look tame. This makes Newman's Organic a truly guilt-free delight. Enjoy!

For those wanting dark chocolate, this simply is going to do the trick. It's 54% cocoa solids and really quite sweet. In terms of texture, it's a bit grainier than average. It's not shiny, but kind of matte, and melts pretty reasonably.

Each 2.25 oz (64g) bar has six large-ish squares, making portion control a little challenging.

In terms of flavor, this definitely earns a solid three stars. It's really not bad at all, like a very reasonable cocoa. It's so sweet that it tastes a little like a really high end milk chocolate at first, with a good finish for a milk chocolate. All in all, for a dark chocolate this is better than Dove (less "smooth" because it's grainier, but definitely a better finish), but can't hold a candle to a good high end dark chocolate like Lindt.

In terms of organic chocolates, Green & Black makes a darker, smoother, better finishing chocolate, and the bars are bigger, too.

I happily accepted a review bar as I am a fan of Newman's Own chocolate, usually buying the orange flavored version of this bar Newman's Own Organics Orange Dark Chocolate Bar, 3.25-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12). (All Newman bars are available in both 2.25 oz and 3.25 oz sizes.)

With only 54% cocoa, this bar is not particularly dark tasting, for people who are extra-dark chocolate fans. To my taste, it is somewhat sweet (not bitter) and almost creamy. For those wanting a darker chocolate, Newman's does have a 70% cocoa bar: Newman's Own Organics Super Dark (70%) Chocolate Bar, 3.25-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12).

I prefer this bar (and its various-flavored versions) to the higher cocoa content bars as an everyday treat that I can have a bit of here and there and enjoy a silky chocolate flavor and yet not feel over-caffeinated afterwards.

This chocolate is very creamy and delicious either raw or melted. It is only 54% cacao, which is either very good or not so good, depending on your preferences.

My wife and I love dark chocolate, and try to make our chocolate desserts (such as brownies, ganache, mousse, and chocolate buttercream frosting) as chocolaty as possible. This chocolate might not have enough punch for us, compared to the
Ghirardelli 60% and 70% cacao (bittersweet) chocolate that we usually buy. This chocolate is not as intensely chocolaty as either of those, and is sweeter and more creamy. I enjoy milk chocolate (which has much less cacao than dark chocolate) more than my wife does, and liked this chocolate more than she did.

This is a very good start if you are just getting into dark chocolate, though, or are already sure of what cacao level you prefer.

This organic chocolate is absolutely delicious...so smooth and creamy.  There is a rich, deep chocolate taste and excellent texture...not waxey or grainy at all, with just the right amount of sweetness.  Chocoholics...this is the one for you.  Fabulous!

Smooth and rich and so yummy!  What more can you say about good chocolate?  Well, it is also organic.  When I received this candy in my mail, I couldn't wait to open it.  I broke off a piece and put the rest of the bar in the freezer.  I will enjoy another piece later with a glass of wine.

I honestly wasn't sure what to expect with Newman's Own Organic Dark Chocolate.  I happen to love dark Chocolate but realize it is for some an acquired taste.  Also, the term "organic" can sometimes mean something more natural but less satisfying either because of a harsher flavor or a strange texture.  Neither is a concern here.  This chocolate is not only satisfying for a dark chocolate lover like me but its rich creamy texture makes it an excellent choice for a quality chocolate for those who normally find dark chocoalates too strong.  This is not a quick fix bar to gobble down at lunch or on the run but one to savor with an after dinner beverage.  For a first entry into the chocolate market, I think they have a winner!

I found this chocolate bar to be truly delicious. It has a perfectly respectable ingredient list.. all organics, essentially evaporated cane juice, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin and vanilla, all USDA organic certified). The cocoa is listed as "Rainforest alliance certified."

The chocolate is only 54% cocoa, so it is not bitter or overwhelming like some dark chocolate. This would be a nice bar for someone wanting to make the move from milk chocolate, but not liking the super-high-cocoa-content bars.

One thing to note is that this bar is smaller than most that I see on the market. I though that was just the angle of the photo and didn't think much about it, but it actually is smaller. It comes with scores for 6 square pieces that are a bit larger than I might otherwise give myself, although even with that, I'll admit that I planned to eat one piece and ate two instead! The chocolate is creamy, and nicely satisfying. Probably not the bar for a super-serious-chocolate lover, but a nice quality bar for someone wanting to support organics and find something a bit nicer than average, but widely likeable.

I'm a huge chocolate fan. It's my favorite sweet. I like all types - and this one is really scrumptious. It's rich and creamy without that bitter aftertaste I associate with so much dark chocolate. It's not exactly melt in your mouth but neither is it extremely hard and crunchy. It has a nice texture and I found it very pleasant.

It is rich so I don't think I could eat the whole bar at once. I wish it was breakable in smaller chocolate squares - as it did not break off evenly for me. I love organic products and chose to buy them whenever I can and money allows. Everything is better with chocolate!

This chocolate bar arrived today, and I didn't wait very long before trying it! :) What can I say, I can't resist chocolate. And I liked it!

It's 54% cacao, so it's not going to be the most intense dark chocolate experience you've ever had. But it's quite tasty, and if you think the darker chocolates are too bitter, this may be exactly what you were looking for.

It probably won't make me break up with my usual indulgence, Ghirardelli's squares, but I'd definitely consider a dalliance from time to time. Mmm, chocolate.

Delicious dark chocolate bar. Not too bitter, as some dark chocolates can be, but neither is it too sweet. I thought I tasted something a little different in the mix, but the ingredients don't list anyting out of the ordinary. According to the package, the ingredients are Organic Dark Chocolate (Organic evaporated cane juice, organic chocolate liquor, organic cocoa butter, organic soy lechtin and organic vanilla). The cocoa is "Rainforest Alliance Certified" organic, which the Newman's Own Organics has been associated with for years.

Another thing that's nice about Newman's Own chocolate is that the company backs its claim that their cocoa beans come from farms and plantations that do not mistreat their workers or engage is slave-labor practices.

I used to hate dark chocolate. I didn't care for its dryer texture or bitter taste. Then I was diagnosed with gestational diabetes and chocolate pretty much became a no-no. Through careful experimentation though, I discovered I could occasionally enjoy a square of dark chocolate with higher cacao percentages because they have less sugar. I began to appreciate the flavor of chocolate without the milky sweetness and have since been a big fan.

Keeping that in mind I'm always trying new brands and blends in search of the perfect dark chocolate bar. Unfortunately, as much as I love Newman's Own as a company and many of their other products this chocolate was just not for me. It's too sweet and the vanilla taste came through strong. It melted into a watery consistency in my mouth and almost had an alcohol-like tang to it. Once I'd noticed that tang I checked the ingredient list and sure enough it's made with chocolate liquor which some may like but I personally don't care for when I reach for dark chocolate.

At only 54% cocoa this is pretty low on the spectrum of darker chocolates and with it's texture would be a great introduction to dark chocolate for someone who doesn't like it usually. It kind of reminded me of an oversweetened version of Lindt Lindor Truffles Dark Chocolate, 60-Count Box's centers. If you like organic and fairtrade chocolate this is certainly not a bad place to start but I would recommend trying Theo Classic Organic (70% Cacao) Dark Chocolate, 3-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12) (or any other Theo chocolate bars which are my FAVORITE Organic and Fair trade chocolate products) if you're looking for something similar but with a higher cocoa content.

To me, dark chocolate is the only kind worth eating. I've always loved it. I'm aware that many people don't like the flavor. I really think this Newman's Own Organics dark chocolate is a great even for people who normally prefer milk chocolate. It's 54% cocoa, which truthfully is a great balance between sweet and bitter. I personally prefer even more cocoa content, up to 70%, but 54% is a good compromise for those looking for a more traditionally sweet candy bar.

Like any dark chocolate, if you're expecting creaminess you won't find it here. The chocolate is hard and not easy to break into squares. That's just the way dark chocolate is. But the texture is great - very consistent. Its flavorful and the 2.25 ounce bar is a perfect size if you're looking to indulge.

Newman's Own makes generally fantastic products, pretty much everything I have tried - from their perfect Italian salad dressing, to their crisp pretzels, to this dark chocolate bar - is awesome. They use quality ingredients. And with the millions of dollars they've donated to charities, it's a way to support good causes.

Maybe it is because this chocolate only contains 54 % cocoa (vs. let's say the 70 % Lindt) but I found the taste disappointing. This might be premium chocolate, and it might be organic and Rainforest Alliance-certified. But the flavor still is surprisingly bland and cheap - a tad too sweet and creamy, with a bit of a waxy texture in too thick a bar. This is just a run-of-the-mill dark chocolate and nothing to entice the palate with.

This 54% dark organic chocolate by Newman's Own is passable.  It is very dry, as are the higher percent dark chocolates, but not as flavorful as others, such as the Lindt or Godiva brands.  Although I enjoy many Newman products, I would not buy this chocolate, I enjoy either of the other brands much more.

How can you not love Newman's Own Organics anything let alone Newman's Own Organics Dark Chocolate?!? These candy bars are so tasty.  They melt nicely in your mouth and just a few blocks really satisfys my need for chocolate!  I love the fact that it is organic, but I really love that it is fair trade as well.  No slave labor in this delicious chocolate candy bar.

This dark chocolate bar is 54% cacao, with a solid chocolate taste--not overly sweet as some bars are, but not at all bitter. The chocolate melts nicely in the mouth without the waxy texture that some cheaper bars have. While the nutrition label lists this bar as one serving, for me it is two generous servings at 2.25 ounces of flavor. It is also 330 calories (200 from fat) which also makes me want to split it into at least 2 servings or share with a friend. It is easily broken into six substantial squares, so that makes sharing easy. Half a bar is a very satisfying treat. If the price is not too hefty, this is a bar worthy of satifying a serious chocolate craving.

I love all types of chocolate but especially dark chocolate. I would consider this to be one of the best dark chocolate bars that I have tried so far. It is very smooth and rich without a bitter aftertaste. These bars are 2.25 oz. and each has 330 calories. For the size of the bar I would consider that 330 well spent calories. The size is just enough to satisfy you without being too large and excessive.

These chocolate bars are 100% organic. I don't buy a lot of organic products but it is nice to know that this product is 100% natural. Each bar contains 54% cocoa which is dark but not the darkest that I have tried. My personal opinion is the darker the chocolate the better it tastes for the most part. These are definitely worth trying.

I have always enjoyed Newman's Own products including the doggy treats but this chocolate didn't do it for me. Could be my aging taste buds but we all taste differently and this didn't excite me. Wasn't a bad taste just kinda bland, not exciting.

I am a lover of dark chocolate. Unfortunately, this chocolate will disappoint true dark chocolate lovers. Its waaaay too sweet! Its not bad chocolate - its creamy, its rich, its got good cacao flavor, but they put too much sugar in it. I prefer the very complex, slightly bitter, very dark (71% cacao) Dove Silky Smooth Dark Chocolate instead. Also, the Newman's chocolate is broken into six relatively large 1.5 x 1.25 inch squares - IMO just a little too large to just put one square in your mouth and allow it to melt away. The Dove is broken into 1 x 1 inch squares - the perfect size to melt on your tongue. Even the wrapper on the Dove is better as it is true foil and easily allows you to keep the remaining chocolate wrapped up tight. The Newman's comes in gold paper meant to look like foil, but its only paper - it does not close well. Overall, disappointed.

Serving size: whole bar (64g)
Calories: 330
Fat calories: 200 (22g fat, 34% DV)
Saturated fat: 13g (65% DV)

The fact that all the ingredients are organic should account for some credit. Otherwise, the product tasted similar to any other dark chocolate we have tasted in the past. Slightly less bitter.
