I love think thin bars, but these were old and the chocolate had bloomed when I received these. Go to the store and buy them there. They cost a little more that way, but it's better than eating crumbly old bars.
I eat these all the time as a meal replacement/snack. They're pretty good - I enjoy the taste and you can't beat the convenience. I'd recommend them to people.

I have subscribed to Amazon for these bars & am so glad I did. I have seen them in Trader Joes for a whole lot more. Buying in bulk, I have plenty on hand for a quick protein snack. Always fresh & on time. I think they taste pretty good. It's my sugar free candy bar replacement. I eat one when I'm craving a chocolatey sweet.
I eat one of these for lunch every day. They do a better job of satisfying my appetite than Lean Cuisines or similar products. Tastes great compared to other (higher calorie) protein bars.

Ok Protein bars are gross.  Especially for someone who really doesn't like chocolate as much as the rest of the world. I'd eat a snickers bar, peanut butter cup and a twix but that's pretty much it.  Chocolate cake yuck. Ice cream.  Yuck. These chunky peanut butter protein bars are pretty tasty. The consistency is good, chewy, but not overly so. I did expect more peanut chunks, though. They are very filling, and serve well as a lunch replacement.

I got these bars in the peanut butter flavor because they were cheaper than what I could buy them for in the store.  Not really low fat but has a good protein content.  Seems to fill you up for a few hours and it's healthier than a candy bar.

I decided to give these a try after being practically addicted to the peanut butter clif builder bars - I wanted to see if I like something else more ... and it turns out I was extremely disappointed with the taste of these bars.  Actually, not only was the taste sub-par, but I did NOT like the consistency either when compared to the more firm clif builder bars.  Won't be buying these again.

I was recently on the LA Weight Loss plan and was hooked on their "protein" bars--that is, until I found out how much sugar they contained, and what little protein they actually had. The price is actually comparable to other bars on the market.
I liked it at first, then started to taste like cardboard.  I like the dark chocolate better, but Atkins Advantage chocolate chip oatmeal is best.
I just opened my latest order and it appears the recipe has changed.  I can't taste the peanut butter and it tastes to sweet.

I bought these to help as I am on the go all the time, and wanted a healthier alternative to keep me away from fast food. I like the taste of these, and they keep me full. Also love the fact that they are Gluten free as I think I do have a tolerance to Gluten products haven't had the time to get tested yet

I will order these again, they are very yummy for being on the go and helping me stay on a good eating path
Great peanut butter/chocolate taste.  Sugar free. Wonderful, protein-rich in-between meal snack/meal replacement. This is perfect for fitness enthusiasts and body builders.

These bars are a great alternative to typical protein bars. They are not full of sugar and carbs like most other types. They taste good and are filling. One bar was not enough for a full meal for me, but with a piece of fruit or a small salad or something, it's great.

I love Think Thin Bars.  Love them.  I eat one every morning. This crunchy peanut butter is my favorite.  "Subscribe and save" seems like a bargain, but by the time I was six months into the program, the bars I was receiving were bloomed, chalky, and gave every appearance of having been stored in a hot place, which certainly compromised the quality and eating experience (and maybe even the nutritional value, like the vitamins).  I cancelled my subscription, and am back to buying them at a higher price at my local grocery store.

Bars appear to have been either mishandled in storage/transport, or they are just old.  Bars on surface should be uniform chocolate color but instead are dry and ashy.  This is a disappointment, considering I ordered a whole case.  Taste is also dry.

They taste good, they are healthy and low in carbs. Great snack and sometimes in a crunch, a meal replacement.

That said, my last shipment from Amazon was not so good. The chocolate had bloomed and the taste was not quite so good. This means that the warehouse where they're kept probably fluctuated in temperature a lot. This isn't a reflection on ThinkThin. I have bought these bars for years but I didn't know where else to post this comment.

Otherwise, I am really into these and even take them with me on vacation.
This box was really good and these bars are a great way to snack. They fill me up for about 3 hours and keep me from getting the tired cranky feeling when I'm on the go.
I found that the flavor  is not great but its a good source of protein and affordably priced so 3 stars when you consider everything.
The taste is pretty good, not great.  They do fill me up when I am hungry and on the go and do not want to eat bad fast food.

When I first saw the reviews for this product, I got very excited and purchased two boxes.  When I got them, I was disappointed to realize that at least part of the protein was from soy -- in general I tend to stay away from unfermented soy products -- and I found the taste rather meh.  They weren't awful but overall, I don't think I'll buy them again.

I'm very happy with these bars and Amazon's great price & quick shipping!!!!  I wanted a good, healthy, high protein, low glycemic, etc. meal replacement/ snack bar to eat on the go that I can keep on hand to help me reduce my caloric/ fat intake and stop me from eating unhealthy, fatty foods so I can shed a few pounds.  I went to Whole Foods and asked the employee working in the health bar area and she told me that this brand was a favorite for high protein, no sugar, and pretty good tasting.  She also told me that Chunky Peanut Butter and White Chocolate Chip were the favorite flavors.  I bought them both and liked them and saw that Amazon has them cheaper so I bought a box of each.  I was concerned when I read the reviews on here and someone said the bars were stale/ old/ not fresh, so I was prepared to send them back if need be. I checked the expiration date and they expire in a little more than a year.  I checked the wrapper of my bar from Whole foods and it expires 11 months from now.  Amazon's is fresher, go figure!!  With subscribe & save I'm saving like 60%...LOVE IT!!

I really like this thinkThin bar but was surprised when I first tried it as it's not especially crunchy...at least not crunchy like "crunchy peanut butter" crunchy. The inside of the bar is soft with pieces of crisped soy to serve as the "crunchy" bits and the outside has a thin chocolate flavor coating. The peanut butter flavor is not overpowering - just yummy - and I find the bar very filling. I could never eat two in a row! I recently ordered these from Amazon for the first time and am quite pleased with them - they arrived via USPS within a weeks time and were fresh and in perfect condition. I'll keep these tasty & satisfying bars on my Subscribe & Save schedule.

Amazon clearly has stacks of these just sitting around at a warehouse for months! These bars were chalky, so they tasted old. Besides that though, I don't know how much I would've like these bars anyway. I mean I love anything peanut butter, but these bars just didn't cut it. They tasted like cardboard. Sure, the box I got was old, but I can't imagine the taste being much better when fresh. Allow me to suggest a couple of other bars that I do like, 'pure protein' bars or my favorite 'supreme protein' bars.
I eat a bar after my workout (taste great) and it has lots of protein and NO SUGAR, which is what I need.  Highly recommend them, ESPECIALLY when they are on sale (they are pricey!).

Tastey and healthy protein bars to satisfy a meal craving on the go.  I travel a ton so instead of eating ANOTHER airport salad or since there are limited breakfast options (I like egg whites or FRESH fruit) when traveling these are great... I like them best with my morning and/or afternoon coffee. If you love peanut butter and chocolate you'll love these bars!
The bars make for a nice snack and they taste "natural" but are not something that I would eat for pleasure.
Think Thin bars are delicious - no sugar but lots of protein - great for an afternoon pick-me-up snack!

I've seen this in stores for almost double the price, so this is a great value.  I use these bars to replace a meal a day to help me meet my weight loss goals.  At 20G of protein with no sugar, they're perfect.  The taste is pretty good - while the flavor is listed as "chunky" peanut butter, it's not really that chunky or crunchy.  However, I've never had the "creamy" one to compare.
We love these bars but i won't order them shipped from anywhere anymore.  They came melted, white, and didn't taste as good as they do when they are fresh.
What few people know is that spearmint is an appetite suppressant.  Tazo tea creates a wonderful flavor with this blend.

A very pleasant flavored green tea.  The added Lemongrass and spearmint give it a "softer" flavor and takes off the harsher edge that green tea has.  Sort of a cross between a green tea and an herbal tea.
I love this tea.  Green tea on its own tastes bitter to me.  I love the additions of the spearmint and lemongrass.

One of the most unique teas I've ever tasted. I first started drinking this tea because I wanted to start substituting green tea for coffee. So one day I ventured into my local Starbucks and order a green tea. The barista then served me up this wonderful cup of tea. Curious I read the label hanging out of the cup and began my mission to purchase some of this Zen tea. After a few misses I found a Tazo box at my local pharmacy Duane Reade (which is less of a drugstore and more of a supermarket). The tea that brewed was wonderful and flavorful, but I have to admit, I was a little disappointed. I mistakenly thought that the box of Tazo tea housed the sachets like those I had tried at Starbucks. I would later discover the `tins' (as I call them), which are sold locally at Starbucks (duh).

In my opinion both the filter bag and the sachet taste strikingly similar. However, I still favor the sachets as they were my first experience with Tazo.

Whoever is the Tea Master at Tazo is doing a superb job at keeping taste very consistent.

I brew the Zen tea piping out and let it sit for a while longer than usual. I find that if I let it steep for to short I get too much lemon grass, as it takes a while for the green tea flavors to steep out. It's really an art to balance the complex flavors of this tea, yet well worth the mastery.

This is my favorite hot drink to curl up on the couch with in cool weather. It is also delicious iced on a hot summer day. The slightly minty flavor is so tasty. I flavor mine with a bit of honey or raw sugar. So good! I'm super picky about my teas, and this one is perfection for me. Also love the name Zen. I swear it actually relaxes me when I settle down with a cup. This is good tea!

The mint in this blend gives it a nice zip to sip in what would be an otherwise boring cup of green tea.  It's offered at a great price too. Unfortunately, this company will not ship to Hawaii. I would be willing to pay for the freight... it's that great!

First, this is a good tea, but it is not the exact one like at Starbucks. The one at Starbucks is different kind of teabag that has a silk like bag. It's leaves are different too. They are more fuller and these are more ground. Now I realize why the tin box (Tazo Zen Green Tea) at Starbucks could be twice as expensive as this (the tin box has 15 bags for $8.00 at Starbucks). If you want the rich experience of the Zen Green Tea, buy the tin box from Starbucks. And of course, 'You get what you Pay'!
Tazo Zen Lemongrass & Spearmint is the best green tea I have ever enjoyed. Usually, green tea, gives me ashama. Not this brand. It was so smooth, no bitterness. I am in love with this tea.

I find this to be a great alternative to Moroccan Mint when I cannot find any loose leaf form. I do not taste much of the Lemongrass, just very little hints of it. It is strong with the green tea (It's not a gunpowder green like the type I enjoy best, but it's not a grassy taste which I find is often the other end of the spectrum from Gunpowder) and it is strong with spearmint taste.

This was the year I decided to break a few bad habits, one of which was drinking soda. For most of my life soda was one of my major sources of hydration, which recent studies have shown is not the healthiest of drinks even if it happens to be the diet variety.  So, I bought this tea and it has become my favorite tea.  All summer long I made a big pot, let it cool, and then refrigerated it for the next day.  I filled my Klean Kanteen with ice, poured over the green tea with lemongrass, and was good to go for the entire day.  This tea has a clean and refreshing taste.  No sugary coating of the teeth, just a delicious drink that leaves you refreshed, and possibly even with a better breath since it has some spearmint flavor too.

I've recently started to drink tea... this it's been a great choice
I mean am a beginer in tea's world

the product was a little slow getting here, but had a nice note from the seller explaining it got lost by deliverer. The product is great! Nice light mint flavor. It is hard to drink regular tea now that I'm used to Tazo emongrass & Spearmint.

The following recommendation is based on having enjoyed over 100 tea varieties in the last 2+ years.

This tea has a pleasant flavor when prepared as recommended.

Nice!
YUM! Soft, never gets bitter - even if I forget to take out the bag... it's THAT good hot or chilled. At the end, you're left with the refreshing spearmint flavor on your taste buds! mmmmmm!

Tazo Zen green tea with lemongrass is an absolutely wonderful tea. The lemongrass moderates the slight bitterness that is common in plain green tea. I've experimented with adding a twist of lemongrass to a plain organic green tea, and the flavor is similar. The lemongrass complements the green tea flavor, deletes any hint of bitterness, and contributes a very faint lemon scent and flavor that can't be duplicated with ordinary lemon. I drink other green teas (for example, Tazo's decaf Lotus at night, or Tazo's jasmine when I'm in that flowery jasmine mood), but Zen is far and away my favorite. And, no, I don't own stock in the company!

As a tea lover, I must say that this is one of my favorite teas of all time. Tazo does a wonderful job balancing out the hints of mint and lemon within this green tea blend. This tea is perfect as is. No sweetener needed!
I purchased this online because these teabags are no longer available at the Starbucks stores.  They have transitioned to a new loose leaf configuration which costs more and has fewer servings.
I purchased this tea at the very end of September 2010 and paid 19.46 for 6 boxes and now less than 6 months later it is 27.29. Seems like quite a price hike for the same item.

the photo looks great. Too bad what i got had slivered almonds - not a single whole almond in the box!
don't waste your money. the picture looks NOTHING like what they send. They should have to put up a photo of what it really looks like. they wouldn't sell any!!!!! VERY DISAPPOINTED and feel cheated

I was looking for an inexpensive way to get pure hibiscus tea, as I'm a big fan of it. A pound of it at this price seemed like a good deal so I gave it a try. Upon receiving the tea, I discovered some other ingredients in this tea, particularly orange peel and cinnamon, that overpower the hibiscus (the eponymous and most important ingredient, as far as I'm concerned) and made it more like potpourri than hibiscus tea. Fortunately, the components are in recognizably large pieces (which I see as sign of high quality) that I can pick out the undesirable bits.

So if you're thinking of buying, be advised that this tea has cinnamon and orange peel. I wasn't able to find that description anywhere on the product page.

I bought this tea after hearing about reported health benefits and because herbal teas have never really worked for me and I wanted to give another go at it. This tea really blew me away with it's complex melody of flavors, lack of bitter overtones and ability to steep for a long period only making it for the better. I'm actually surprised at my response and feel fortunate to have come across this product (thanks Amazon!).

I originally purchased Davidson's Pure Organic Hibiscus to test it's affect on my blood pressure. Since that tea is not available at the moment, I decided to give this one a shot.

Note that (as others have pointed out) this is not a pure hibiscus tea, and does not claim to be. It also has orange peel, lemon myrtle, and cinnamon. The tea IS predominantly hibiscus. The aroma is very different from the pure tea, but the hibiscus taste and color are still very much there.

To me, the additional ingredients compliment the hibiscus taste quite well. I believe the ratio of hibiscus to other ingredients is spot on, and I personally have no problem drinking this tea as an alternative to pure hibiscus for blood pressure purposes. You can always strengthen your brew!

Just like all other Davidson's bulk items I've purchased, this is a great tea at a great price.

I have been having problems with this item.  Even though, per the website, it says that this is Te de Hibiscus, in actuality it includes OTHER items -- like orange peel, cinnamon and lemon myrtle.  It's NOT until you actually get the item that one learns that it is NOT 100% Te de Hibiscus.  This item WILL be removed from my list of things to order from Amazon, because of this.

I purchased this as a less expensive alternative to Tazo's Passion Tea and am very pleased with it. This tea brews up with a very intense flavor and the hint of orange and cinnamon are a perfect compliment to the hibiscus.  Be forewarned that this is a very tart tea and you may need quite a bit more sweetener than you are accustomed to using.  I am still working out the exact ratios for a perfect cup, but it seems like a teaspoon (or a teaspoon and a half) to 14 oz of boiling water steeped for 5 minutes will produce a very strong brew that can been poured over ice and still remain very flavorful.  (I prefer mine iced.)  I know that sounds like a small amount of tea, but this is very concentrated and therefore a terrific value for the money.  Another great perk is that you can let it steep for as long as you like and it will not grow bitter like some other teas do.

05/31/2011 Update:

I am saddened to say that I will not be purchasing these bouillon cubes from Amazon. I don't know if it was a fluke but the last box that I purchased came complete with bugs. If you buy these bouillon cubes thinking they will be like the salt-filled cubes you buy at any grocery store, think again. The texture is different. Solubility is different. Taste is different.

First let's discuss texture. The texture of these cubes is a lot like firm butter that was just taken out of the fridge. You can cut it like butter, so dividing is not a problem the way it is with salty, powdery cubes. It does tend to stick to the foil wrapper, but comes off easily using a knife, fork, or even spoon.

We will go on to solubility. When you put these into hot water or put them in cold water then heat in the microwave, they do not break down as quickly as you might be accustomed to. The pieces that come apart in the water need to be stirred momentarily and pressed against the side of the container with a spoon. This does not take more than a minute.

The taste is different, too. It has an inviting aroma and tastes like actual vegetable broth. There is no overpowering salty taste, and these can be used to make a stronger tasting liquid than high-sodium cubes.

This bouillon makes a great gravy when you use the whole cube in 1-1/2 cups boiling water. Stir 3 tbsp of corn starch into 1/4 cup cold water. Stir cold cornstarch water into boiling liquid till thickened. Add a little pepper and serve.

I've also used it to flavor soy based textured vegetable protein (TVP) for use in meatless meatloaf and other dishes. I just use it in place of the boiling water. I like to use a bit stronger broth for that purpose.

I give this product very high marks. Buy with confidence. Whether you are vegetarian or not, whether you are salt-restricted or not, this bouillon does not disappoint.

Another review mentioned that the company recently retracted the "NO MSG" claim, but too little, too late. I have already consumed and gifted away most of my 12 boxes with the understanding this was an MSG-free bouillon. If you are avoiding MSG, I recommend doing some research because there are about 50 different names that can be used to hide MSG in an ingredient label. "Yeast Extract" is the perfect example of this. There are a lot of other names for flavor enhancers out there that always or sometimes contain MSG. Unfortunately, I did my research about a year after I purchased this product, but hopefully this review will save some other health-conscience consumer from making a purchase they regret.

This is a good soup -- there is no doubt. The corn, carrots and potatoes are plentiful (no skimping on ingredients in the cans I've tried). Together, the ingredients make a thick and hearty soup that is perfect for a cold winter day. I did not feel the need to add salt -- the corn is not bland in flavor and the soup already has a lot of sodium. Moreover, I felt no need to add crackers. The soup can hold its own.

Some posters have noted that this soup has a high level of fat. It does -- 13g per one cup serving. Fat, of course, is not bad in moderation. In my quest for the perfect corn soup, however, I have found an alternative option. It is worth noting here for those who may have particular dietary considerations. Imagine foods makes an organic sweet corn soup that has 3g of fat per 1 cup serving. The soup comes in a boxed container and is just a corn base. There are no special flavorings. As a base, it is a good corn soup but when you add several cups of frozen corn kernels (and cooked potatoes if you have the time and desire), you can have a soup just as hearty and delicious as Wolfgang Pucks but with less fat and calories. This option does require about five minutes more of your time (if only adding frozen corn). Wolfgang Puck's soup is quick -- in two minutes you have a steaming bowl of great corn soup and you don't have to wait for kernels to thaw.

If you are not looking closely at fat (or eat fat it in moderation) and want something quick, this soup is great. If you are looking for a healthy alternative, I would take a little more time and build a hearty soup using the organic sweet corn soup from Imagine.

If you are tired of eating soup that tastes like it has been in a can for years, continue eating your Campbell's and Progresso soups. Wolfgang Puck's soup is outstanding, the best you can get out of a can. His corn chowder is the best corn chowder I've ever eaten. Fat is flavor, so if you want a delicious soup, get this one.

Yes, it's high in fat - it's also the best canned soup I've ever had. I like the seasonings in all the Wolfgang Puck soups I've tried so far, but the organic corn chowder is my favorite. The corn is plump and sweet, and the carrots and potatoes make it hearty meal in itself.

It's very easy to prepare, just cook the chicken in a skillet with some oil (I prefer olive it's healthier), sprinkle in the garlic/ginger spices (included), then add the butter chicken spices (included) and add the tomato puree (included) with water. Then add some dairy or non-dairy to "cream it up" and simmer. Couldn't be easier.

It is a smidge more than just mild, but I love Indian food any way! If you NEED truly mild food, this is NOT for you.

It is healthier to make it yourself - 1) YOU get to choose how much or little oil you add (I've paid $25 for a very oily Butter Chicken at an Indian Restaurant in London that didn't beat this or a very fattening cream-based Butter Chicken in SF that could stop your heart), 2) YOU get to choose if you want to add cream with fat and cholesterol or non-fat or even non-dairy. Yes, of course it has some affect on the taste and texture but not enough to concern my palate.

Now, the coriander is a little stronger than some other recipes, BUT it is not ruinous or overpowering. The garlic, ginger and turmeric are all well-balanced. There are so many versions of Butter Chicken that you can always find something different, but this is good stuff! The case of 6 boxes of this have a shelf life of 2 years.

It serves 3-4 people and the aroma in my house is such an incredible bonus! True, I have all the spices in my cabinet to make this, BUT this is TRULY an easy and simple way to make good, quality Butter Chicken! GOURMANTRA Butter Chicken has my 5-stars!

This wine was very, very sweet. The kit was super easy, so I have no complaints about the product. It came with everything you need minus fermentation equipment, and had easy instructions. I'm really just giving it a low rating because of the sweetness. If you like sweet wines, you will probably like this too.

I purchased this wine a while back, directions are great. Only problem I had was opening the bags of concentrate! Very difficult, other than that when bottling the wine the flavor is great! We're waiting about 2 months to really let the flavor set in. Everyone at work wanted some wine, thinking this will have to be purchased again soon for a new batch!
I like Cerelac product, they tast good and have a lot of variety. my daughter like is better than any other brand. thank you Amazon for bringing this item.

I grew up in Malaysia on Nestum/Cerelac products. So when I was able to find it here in the US, I didn't hesitate to get it for my baby. He loved it more in his milk then as a 'meal.' Plus I know how rich in nutrients this is & from the time he was born, my husband & I stressed on healthy; nutritionally beneficial foods.
Very good product, not overly sweet or tart. Low calorie, all-natural. It's a lighter taste than most lemonade mixes, and very refreshing.
My all time favorite tea.  I was thrilled to discover that I can buy it year round (stores only carry it during the holidays).
I buy this by the case just like the previous reviewer. All of my family loves it. I drink it all year round. My grandchildren especially expect some during Christmas. It is soooooo yummmmmy!

This is my favorite tea.  I buy quite a bit around Christmas since it gets expensive in the middle of the year.  It is a peppermint softened up with a slight vanilla flavor.  In the spring and summer, I drop a bag into a pitcher of water to make a diluted sun tea.  The tea is almost like a mint flavored water and is very refreshing served iced.

This is my favorite holiday tea! I love this flavor even more because it's not just a strong peppermint! It's a sweet peppermint and Celestial Seasonings also added the perfect amount of vanilla and cinnamon, so perfect this the first tea I ever tried in my life that does not need sugar or anything added to it! It's so yummy this tea tastes just like a candy cane! And since it's decaf I can drink this anytime of the day! My local grocery store was selling these so I bought a few boxes to last me through winter! But the more cups I drank the more I loved it! I went back to back to the grocery store to stock up year round but they were already sold out :( I'm so glad I can still get this on Amazon! I highly recommend this tea if your a candy cane/peppermint fan! :)

This is my favorite tea of all time. I drink many different varieties including teavana and other loose leaf gourmet teas and teabags, and this one is still my favorite. It is great to drink all year and not just during the holidays.
I buy at least a case of this tea every year so I have some all year long and for gift giving.  Most of the people who have received it say that they enjoy it too.

Vegan. Natural. Kosher. Gave as a gift to someone who really appreciates high quality macadamias. Very positive response. "Best quality" mac nuts (and this is from someone who has been to Hawaii frequently and has sampled many "macs" in her time.) This review is out there for those for whom this makes a difference. See all of my reviews for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" in Listmania. Your "helpful" votes count and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you.

I've tried a lot of macadamias and these are, by far, the freshest and best-tasting of them all.  It'll cost you a little more, but it's worth it. The downside is the fact that they're always running out of stock.  I've read many posts outside of Amazon referencing these nuts and they're quality, so it's not like the market isn't there.  That being said, if you're not addicted to mac nuts it won't drive you crazy; just pick them up when you see them.  Maybe it's a marketing ploy, like the whole "tickle-me elmo" fiasco a while back, but that's a conspiracy for another day.
I had to hide these in the garage to stop everyone from wolfing them down.  Yummy Yummy

Whole family loves Azar Macadamia nut- Thanks a lot!will buy again!
must underlined - no salt added - very special Thanks for this effort!!!!
This are the best macadamia nuts I have ever purchased online or in a store.  The nuts are fresh and are in whole pieces.  Will definitely be buying more!  YUMMY

These are some of the best macadamia nuts that I have eaten.  The nuts are big and not a lot of small pieces.  They are fresh and have lots of flavor.  I think the packaging helps keep them this way.  32 ounces is a lot of nuts for the money. I have purchased four bag of these nuts and will continue to buy them as long as they are available.

These nuts are indeed  fresh and very delicious.  The resealable package works well. Despite a long journey from my package forwarding company in the US, the nuts arrived  intact.  Unlike some major brands, they not at all greasy.  I will definitely order these again.

The quality of the nuts is ok, but no where as good or as cheap as Costco use to sell.

We added the sea salts ourselves, somehow they don't seems to taste as good.
The product is frest and salt free as expected.  Price is still on the high side.  See you can be more competitive in the near future.
Grab it when it's available.  Can sell out. Rarely a bad nut. They aren't overcooked like some mac nuts I have bought at Costco. Great tasting and very fresh.

These crackers are a great way to get whole wheat into your diet & into children's.  They are low in fat & sugar, and they taste great.  I haven't met a child yet who doesn't like them.  The ingredients are good as well.
Great texture and balance of sweet to butter is just about right. Adults and kids both love them. Recommended
The title says it all! These butter biscuits are DIVINE! Everyone loves them--my parents, my students, my colleagues, and, of course, me! You will love them, too!

These cookies are fabulous. Flaky, not too sweet, fluffy not gooey layers. Small but not too small. Suggested serving size of 6 is good. Lots of things these days have completely unrealistic serving sizes. I know they have sat fat but I really don't care. I have been unable to find anything like them. They remind me of REAL bakery cookies.

These are every bit as good as the other two reviewers stated. Awesome butter cookies!!! There's a lot of butter taste in these cookies and they're not overly sweet. Just right! I'll be buying again when the 12 pack runs out. Amazon please make sure you keep these in stock on a continuing basis!
These Bahlsen Butter Leaves are the best cookies! Not too sweet, not greasy, soooo "just right!" Order extra! They go fast!

These cookies didn't disappoint.  They are delicious and go really well with a cup of tea or coffee.  They have just the right amount of sweetness...not cloying.  (I think American desserts usually go overboard on sugar).  I highly recommend them.

The title says it.  Some of the cookies arrived with the chocolate melted.  Others were stuck together or had the wafer separated and stuck to the chocolate top of the cookie below.  It appears that the box was a little overheated and banged around somewhere along the way here.  It was 65F here when the package was delivered.

Having grown up on these cookies I was pleased to see that they now come in the more healthful whole wheat version.  Same great taste...light on the sugar...even my husband who hates sweets will eat these with his ice cream.

Rich, dark chocolate thinly covering a tart orange marmalade-like substance on a soft sponge cookie. It melts in your mouth and leaves you wanting more. Chocolate and orange are an addictive combination.  There are other brands out there of these sponge cookies, but the Bahlsen brand is by far tops in the quality of the ingredients used.

Have always enjoyed Balsen products. Found the nuss-dessert cookies while on vacation at Sanibel Island Florida. We were really excited to find them on Amazon, we had searched through out the Chicago area since last April.
They are the best. Taste like fresh hazelnuts and are great with either coffee or tea. (or later with wine).
So good that I bought a case, but they are reserved for special moments(like now).

This is without a doubt the most incredibly addictive packaged cookie in the world. The dark chocolate dipping at one end is a great contrast to the rolled wafer of the cookie itself. Why did I ever buy a whole case! Bless Amazon for carrying the Bahlsen line of fabulous cookies because it is not available in Montana.
These are soo good with a nice cup of coffee. They are light, buttery and very flavorful with the finely chopped nuts.
We've ordered for them every month and only once the package inside the seal had a small hole and wasn't as fresh.

My husband and I have been buying these cookies locally for years because we love them so much; they are far better than the milk chocolate version (but then, we love DARK chocolate!). In the past couple of years, our local grocer has stopped carrying them, we would request them, they would get them for a few months, and then they would stop carrying them again. I am so glad to see that I can get them via amazon.com! These are wonderful cookies with warm milk, cold milk, or a little Scotch . . . mmmmmmm!
This product was delivered on time and included more than I thought I was going to get - a full 16 packages. I first purchased these in England and have loved them ever sense.
Will always buy these if I can find them. Hate to have to buy from Germany. Need a grocery store.
I was not very happy when i recieved my order. All the cookies were melted. Very good product. Word of advise. Don't buy any products in the summer time that will melt.

It tastes perfect. I like it.
You would "feel" the butter in the cookies.
Great cookies.  Not overly sweet as most American cookies can be, with a hint of citrus.  Could not ask for more.  There is only 12 or so cookies in the box, but a decadent treat.

If Rice Crispy bars were made with good chocolate, and didn't taste like wax, they might taste like this.  Wow- What a yummy treat.  These are coated with a LOT of chocolate, and for me are more like a candy than a cookie (and I don't have a problem with that!)  I would not have wanted to order them in the summer, because I feel sure they would have melted.  The chocolate taste is wonderful, and I love the crunchiness.  The Sell By date is not until 9/2010 a full 8 months from today (1/21/2010), so I'm pleased with their freshness.  I don't think they will last very long in our house, but still, it's nice they are fresh.  These are packed very well, so they should not arrive crumbled or damaged in any way.  My cookies are perfect.  If you like crunchy chocolate treats this is for you!  Delicious!

I'll start with something really important to me- the sell by date. I bought these cookies in January of 2010, and they are good until 9-2010, which is important to me, since I hate eating rancid food, so I just throw it out. I've always loved these cookies, and my market sells them for much more than the subscribe price, so I'm happy to subscribe and save. I love currants, and it's hard to find things flavored with them. I have to admit, the currant taste is not strong, but they are delicious anyway, and I love the puff pastry. Further, I'm allergic to GMO corn starch (genetically modified corn starch)- and just try to find cookies in US stores without corn starch (and 95% of all corn is modified in the US, and does not have to be labeled so). So these are a real treat for me- since they are a cookie I can actually eat.

The cookies are flaky, as puff pastry always is, and slightly sweet. As other people have said, this is not a terribly sweet cookie, but it is quite sweet enough. I enjoy mine with tea, and I also take them in my lunch. If you take them in your lunch, put them in a little box- because they ARE delicate, and you might end up with delicious crumbs if you don't protect them. I know this because I squashed them once.
these cookies are a perfect treat....very light and crunchy wafer sweetened by  the right amount of chocolate....great price and fast service

I don't know what Bahlsen was thinking over the last several months, but I looked high and low for these cookies in supermarkets and specialty stores...none were to be found. Then, after checking with Amazon (and its tracking mechanisms), Voila! I ordered a whole case and that should satisfy our deep appreciation of these cookies... a perfect blend of high quality dark chocolate and a crisp, thin "chocolate vehicle"--i.e., cookie.

These appear to be, on first glance, similar to Nutter Butters.  On taste, however, they are lighter, more delicate, and infused with hazelnut.  There is more air in the cookie, so when you dip it in coffee, it becomes saturated rather quickly and the cookie folds into your mouth, with the sweet center taking center stage.  Nuff said.

I am very happy with Amazon service including the speedy shipment. I am also very happy the product Amazon is carrying. This product is only available in selected specialty stores in the area. And tend to be expensive. Sometime they only carry small selection in store. You have to wait long time for a special order. Amazon is making the product available with a wide selection of variaty and affortable. Thanks.

A light and crisp flaky cookie surrounding a brightly flavorful nugget of jam. The only problem - I can eat a whole box without stopping to breathe! And buying them by the case makes them very affordable. My next order is already in...

I first had these cookies at our Oktoberfest where they were giving out samples.  I loved them and could not find them at World Market so I went to the internet and found them available at Amazon. They are very light and flaky.
When we couldn't find these in our local grocery store anymore, we were very glad to find them available through Amazon. these are light and delicious and a true treat!

I bought these cookies for myself and as a gift for my dad for his birthday. Unfortunately, 2 out of 4 of the boxes I gave my dad as a gift had mostly broken cookies, and were stale tasting. Not a great gift idea, and not really packaged or handled well. I have bought the delice cookies in the past and had no problems other than a random broken cookie in a box. I have not opened all of the boxes yet of course, but will hope to find a couple that are not all broken up to give to my dad.

I am an adventurous person who likes new things and when Amazon began selling the Bahlsen line I tried a number of their products and found them to be enjoyable and tasty, but the Hannover Wafer Cookies are, to my palate, rather bland and tasteless. The texture is pleasing, though a little grainy tasting and the creme filling has little flavor. They're very high in saturated fat, and  devoid of flavor..Think I'll stick with the Bahlsen Delobas'.

This tea is fantastic - but this is a TERRIBLE DEAL. Check out another site for a better price.  You shouldn't pay more than $14.00 for a 24 count box of this green tea.

Tillamook pepperoni and beef sticks are the best ever. the taste has you begging for more and more.
I wish they sold them locally. they simply have a great smoke taste and aree mild that they don't give you heartburn.

This was my first time ordering rice paper and I didn't know what brand to pick so I was kind of nervous at first.  The product arrived much faster than I had expected and it was exactly what I had needed.  The price was good too so I was quite pleased with the experience and would definately continue to order this item in the future.

I recently started a new medication and unfortunately one of the side effects was dry mouth. My doctor recommended I try sugar free lemon drops to help alleviate the discomfort of dry mouth. After doing some research I decided to give Brach's Sugar Free Lemon Drops a try. I was a bit hesitant ordering a whole box of these lemon drops without knowing how they would taste, what the after-taste would be like and even if it would work. After having used them for couple of weeks, I wholeheartedly recommend this product. I keep a bag in mine and my wife's car, one at work, in my night stand drawer and in a candy dish in the kitchen. My wife usually hates the taste of most sugar-free products because of the after-taste, but I was surprised when she said she really liked these! Give these a try if you too suffer from dry mouth and see if they work as well for you as they have for me.

This cake tasted as good as a home-made (or better!) cake but took 1/2 the time.
Seriously. And I'm a total baking (as well as natural foods) snot!
Not convinced of my credentials?
You should see the rye, sourdough and challah breads out of my oven today.
Not to mention the batches of cookies.
The amount of flour and butter I go through on a weekly basis for cookies, cakes and breads would let you know: i'm the one person in 100 whom you'd classify as a good home baker. I'm definitely not a "mix" baker. And while baking my own birthday cake just seemed un-festive, asking someone else to bake my cake seemed like it'd spell disaster. But Someone else offered. And that Someone Else, not as comfortable with my cake pans as I, used Naturally Nora. And both of these baker "elves" agree: "it was delicious and easy to make." And from my guests' opinions,
no one could tell the difference between this mix and home-made. Soooooo tasty. And the icing mixed up as a breeze.
Next year, when I'm considering mixing up my own birthday cake or using a Naturally Nora Mix, the decision is easy. Nora. All the way.
!
You won't believe how easy and tasty it is.
I'd show you a picture, but there's none left.

What a great idea! Nora's chocolate cake and yellow cake mixes are now staples in our kitchen. My daughter discovered that the chocolate cake mix makes great brownies if you decrease the baking time. She makes them for all her sleepovers and everybody thinks they are homemade. She also makes a wonderful coffee cake with the yellow cake mix, spreading a mix of cinnamon and brown sugar and cocoa over the batter and swirling it in with a knife. I'm delighted that she has started to bake on her own and that the ingredients are all natural -- Nora's mixes cost a little more than the artificial-ingredients mixes from Betty Crocker and Duncan Hines, but they are worth every penny. Highly recommended!
Naturally Nora Sunny Yellow Cake Mix, 19.1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
Naturally Nora Cheerful Chocolate Cake Mix, 19.1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
My wife loves this product because my four-year-old daughter loves to have "parties". We found this makes makes wonderful easy and natural cupcakes.

I ordered this based on the glowing reviews and was so disappointed.  It is the blandest chocolate cake we have ever tasted.  I've made three boxes of it and always end up spitting out my first bite of the final product.  It also calls for a ton of eggs/oil.  It's just not good at all.  I do, however, love that it is natural.  I don't think "natural" should have to mean "bland", though.  In my opinion this needs a much stronger, richer chocolate flavor.  In my last batch I tried adding chocolate chips for some additional flavor and it did not do the trick.  Not sure what to do with the last three boxes.

Don't expect anything fancy with this cake mix; you have to buy this for the taste alone.  It rises unevenly, as do the other cake mixes I've purchased from Naturally Nora.  The flavor is subtle and sublime.  It's perfect with her chocolate frosting.  Good enough for birthdays or everyday.

If you do not enjoy the flavor of licorice, this tea is not for you. I cannot drink it alone but mixed with other teas, it is okay. i Mixed it with tazo calm and it did help so i gave it 3 stars. but the licorice was just overpowering.

We switched over to all Holistic dog food products after our 12 yr old mixed breed started itching,scratching,shedding and losing weight.  I can't say enough good things about the Holistic Select products.  Our dog has never been healthier or happier, no more scratching or shedding!  I highly recommend their products.

These are the only treats our german shepherds get. Our male has allergies to beef, chicken , lamb and who knows what else. This fish based product works great, and they love them. They are a little pricey. A dollar or so less and it would be a 5 star.

I like to feed my dog healthy stuff but one dog trainer wanted me to bring "high currency" treats so I bought some hot dogs and Daisy certainly enjoyed them.

However, she actually goes nuts over the Holistix way more than she ever did for hot dogs and I'm happier feeding them to her. And they're not so stinky to carry around, and not perishable either.

Daisy is about 14 pounds and I break the Holistix into 3 or 4 pieces. It's a little crumby but that way she gets several treats over the course of the day. I use these to help motivate her not to bark at dogs that we pass on our walk. When I mention "treat" she starts dancing on her hind legs walking backwards sometimes half a block in anticipation of one little morsel of Holistix!

I have been buying the Whitefish, Cranberries, Apples, and Blueberries variety. I think we tried another variety once and it was OK but mostly I've just stuck with these. On amazon they are listed as "Menhaden Fish Meal." That is what is listed as the fourth ingredient right before "whitefish." I knew it was the right item by the blue label area and the picture of the bag. Previously I had bought them elsewhere.

These are not cheap but if you break them up like I do and ration them out, as you should with all treats, a bag lasts quite a while.
We try different treats for our dogs and they seem to like the Holistic Select biscuits very much.  This has good quality ingredients just like their kibbles which our dogs like as well.

I bought these as a goof as they reminded me of when I was a kid and whenever I give one to a friend it starts a whole conversation about when we were growing up and you would buy them in a candy store and we just laugh about the old days.  Only problem I found is many of the packages are filled with green and purple my two least favorite flavors but aside from that also that they are packaged individually in the summer is great I keep a package with me all the time

Our shih tzu Piper had dental surgery to remove four broken teeth. Her dental surgeon vet blamed hard chew treats for the broken teeth. In hindsight some of the chews were so hard that I had to use a saw to cut them in half for sharing between the two dogs. The vet advised us to use the bend test. If the chew isn't flexible, don't give it to your dog.

The Nylabone Healthy Edible passes the bend test. Looking at the bone-shaped treat, one would think it is a hard object and a long lasting chew. Piper and Gabby both like these chews. Depending on the dog, these treats can be long lasting without jeapardizing the teeth of the dog.

Being a spudophile, I'm pleased that ingredient number four is potato starch. Despite the Nylabone name, these chews contain no plastic. Also lacking are sugar, salt, preservatives, and gluten. The ingredients are natural and it is edible and highly digestible as advertised. Our pooches give the American made Healthy Edibles their barks of approval.

These are great as a treat, but not as a chew. They are so well liked they don't last. What I can't understand is why a seller that offers Amazon Prime charges albout 3 to 4 times the cost that other prime sellers are charging for the same items and think they will make a profit. I guess it's buyer beware and be a bargain shopper if you don't want to seriously overpay.

Our 14 lb Mini Schnauzer easily started splintering this bone in a matter of minutes and being an 'ever hungry' dog he just swallowed these pieces. Seeing this I took the bone away after he ate about a third of it. Less than 24 hrs later when it was time for his breakfast at 7:30 AM (his standard time) he refused to eat! This was the first time he ever refused to break his overnight fast!! But after a few minutes the hunger must have gotten the better of him; he gave in and ate almost all of it (usually he cleans up his little bowl) and about an hour later he threw up all of it in FOUR rounds of puking!

I could see small, softened yet still relatively firm pieces of this Healthy Edible "bone" in his vomit. What a shame I went for this thinking it would be a great alternative to feeding my dog indigestible nylon.
I buy about 4-5 bags of these at a time, our Pug just loves them. They are always "fresh". If not, they won't be easy to break in half and she won't eat them. We call them her nightcap.
Dealing with Amazon is always a pleasure ! the products are the best and always on time.

I am on the record in several reviews here at Amazon as saying that in my experience, which is pretty good with mueslis in the US and Europe, Dorset Cereals make the best mueslis anywhere. This cereal is no exception. I truly enjoyed this great blend that concentrates on sunflower and pumpkin seeds for a nutty flavor, and on raisins and date for sweetness.

What I don't like is Dorset's new packaging in 12-ounce boxes. I have noticed at local stores that this is the new standard size across the board -- a dramatic reduction in size per box of 30-40% compared to the previous standard sizes of 18-21 ounces per box.

While sizes have been cut, prices have remained essentially the same. This is basically a price hike of one third or more. Raising prices is actually fine, but doing it by cutting box sizes seems sneaky and rubs me the wrong way. Dorset has priced itself out of the market for me for a while.

If the price seems reasonable to you, I repeat that Dorset makes outstanding products and you can't go wrong on that score.

I read about Dorset Cereals in the British magazine Country Homes & Interiors and was thrilled to find them, for a short time, at local grocery stores. I am so happy amazon carries them because they are amazing.  The quality is very good, and it makes an excellent muesli with yogurt, shredded apple, vanilla yogurt and a bit of maple syrup.  I have tried the blue box (my favorite), the orange box and the purple box.  I can't wait to try the other flavors.  Thank you, amazon, for carrying them.  They are expensive but worth it.

I ordered 2 cases of Campbell's soup.  They were obviously packed by an incompetent employee - who just put the tray of cans in the bottom of a much larger box and threw a couple of pieces of bubble wrap on top.  Both cartons arrived with no external damage, but the heavy cans had shifted around, in one carton 3 were open, with soup spilled around.  In both boxes, several cans were dented.  This was not the shipping carrier's fault - this was just incredibly poor packing.  I sent a photo and described the damage in the packaging review that was available right after purchase.  Amazon did not bother to even acknowledge that.  Beware of ordering any canned products from Amazon, I certainly will not do it again.

Well, I was cruising the snacks isles of my local Costco Warehouse store and found these Kirkland Signature "Everybody's Nuts California Pistachios with Salt and Pepper" in a three-pound bag. I couldn't resist! Yum! These are great! They're nice and fresh and have a zesty salt and pepper taste. I love just regular pistachios, which I usually buy, but these have an extra and quite delicious kick. Three pounds is a big bag, but these won't last long, I assure you.

We're going to have a small party within a few weeks. I'm going to put a bowl of these out with the pre-meal munchies. My bet is that the word will spread fast and they won't last long.

Gary Peterson

I love salt.  I love pepper.  I also love these nuts.  You will not regret purchasing these nuts if you want plenty of flavor and satisfaction.  Once you start eating them though, it won't be easy to stop.  I will probably purchase these for gifts for my family at Christmas.

These are tasty, very salty.  For the price, it's disappointing that so many shells are empty.  We expected to find shelled pistachios at the bottom of the bag, assuming they fell out of the shells in the package, but there weren't.  We won't buy this product again.

This sack pistachios is much better than the ones I have bought from folks such as Swiss Colony. However, there is nothing special even about these pistachios. I am now convinced that Walmart or a local grocery store is the best place to purchase pistachios and even the cheapest.
I love these salt and pepper pistachios. They arrived in great shape and are as fresh and tasty as if I'd picked them up at Costco(which no longer carries them).

I ordered these delicious pistachios and they came quickly.  They are addicting.  Around the same time as me eating these like an addict, I got addicted to the dunkins oreo coolattas.  I started to get serious diarrhea and I'm not sure which gave it to me so I stopped eating both.  But before it came out in liquid form, they were fabulous.

They tasted awful. I've had many different salted and salt & peppered pistachios, but these are by far the worst I have ever had. Every nut was COVERED in pepper and a tiny amount of salt. All you could taste was black pepper, it was grossly overpowering. I will not buy this again, terrible quality and terrible product.

These pistachio nuts have a really good flavor.  However, this was compromised by the fact that well over 50% of the nuts were in the roaster too long.  When nuts are roasted too much, as they carbonize they become harder and more bitter.  Instead of "green" in color, too many of these were "brown" which means they were overdone.  I used to roast peanuts and nuts like these would have been fed to the pigs.  These are "supposed" to be guaranteed by Kirkland, however, this is not honored by them. Don't corporations know that lying is a sin?

Let me start by saying I was never a big fan of pepper and I first bought a smaller bag of these pistachios by mistake at the grocery store. Now I am "ridiculously addicted!" The salt and pepper seasoning is simply delicious. I stop eating them only when my lips have swollen to four times their normal size.
We neeed to get this product back on the shelf. You don't put a product this good on the shelf and then take it off without notice. PLEASE, PLEASE bring it back i'm like a junkie with no FIX
I was able to get some good use out of this soup, but I had to jazz it up in various ways.  By itself this soup is very bland:  I was disappointed with the 'subtle' sweet potato taste.  2.25 Stars.

This spice I have found is packed in a large wide mouth jars. It has a very fresh flavor. I use it by the teaspoon full in my sauces. Its packed for easy storing and can be put in a smaller shaker say a dry cheese dispenser for the stove top.
This is a great way to stock up on your favorite spices. Look at the per lb. price in the box store. You will be shocked! With Amazon free shipping one can not go wrong.
First of all it was mostly a bag of broken pieces and crumbs.  They were the thickness of a cracker and bland (stale) tasting.  I wouldn't waste the money.
Not particularly fresh - I imagine they could have been pretty good - but If yours come like mine did - I wouldn't bother.  I threw the rest of the package into the compost  :~(

Because the grains of teff are small, the bulk of the grain is the bran and germ. This makes teff nutrient dense as the bran and germ are the most nutritious parts of any grain. This grain has a very high calcium content, and contains high levels of phosphorous, iron, copper, aluminum, barium, and thiamin. It is considered to have an excellent amino acid composition, with lysine levels higher than wheat or barley. Teff is high in protein, carbohydrates, and fiber. It contains no gluten so it is appropriate for those with gluten intolerance.
It bakes like buckwheat, so it is best to mix it with other, lighter, gluten free flours. I highly recommend it.

I was first introduced to Pu-Ehr tea by a Chinese friend, who told me that most westerners do not like it. After one sip, I agreed with him, and after one cup, I was hooked. That's the way it is with Pu-Ehr tea - initially an acquired taste, then an addiction.

This tea is quite a good Pu-Ehr for the price. Some low quality Pu-Ehr tastes very musty and earthy; this does not. I brew one brick in a 22 fluid ounce (0.65 liter), and this yields the entire Pu-Ehr experience. (A can contains 25 bricks.) The first cups are mild, but the bottom couple of cups yield the heavy duty Pu-Ehr jolt.

Never add sugar or milk or lemon to Pu-Ehr, just take it straight or with dried chrysanthemum blossoms.

I'm SO glad I gave these tuo chas a chance!!! I've recently become a huge pu-erh fan, so I've been on the lookout for great pu-erh that won't cost me a leg. I keep hearing that tuos don't usually have great quality, that often tea dust and poor quality leaves are compressed to make the "nests" (and yes, I've tasted those often enough to say it's true), but that's not the case here. In fact, this has become one of my favorite pu-erhs. (I've also tried Rishi Tea Pu-erh Classic, 3.2-Ounce Tins (Pack of 3), which I thought was bound to be better simply because it was loose leaf, but that is not the case. I was not impressed... this one is much tastier.)

I can get 3 huge mugs (each with a strong brew) out of 1 little tuo. The 4th one is already too watery, but the 3rd is still as strong as I like. This tea made me understand those comments about good pu-erh being "a mouthful", thick (I used to wonder what on earth it meant); it is like gulping milk, very interesting experience. I can't really describe the flavor, except to say that it's mellow, sweet, and very yummy. As all pu-erhs, it never gets bitter. To make this taste like heaven, I sometimes add a little bit of Numi Organic Tea Chocolate Puerh, Loose Leaf Tea, 16 Ounce Bag for some chocolate/vanilla/orange flavor - perfection in a cup!!!

I was wondering how many tuos actually fit into one of these little tins... and the answer is, quite a lot of them! That was another good surprise.

Was surprised to see that though it was loose leaf tea that it came in individually wrapped briquettes. Very cute.

Very dark, full body. Easily able to get 4+ steepings out of it. More if you don't like it strong & steep it for less time.

Form: bottle-cap size pressed cakes, dark color. Opens to medium-sized leaves. Looks to be at least somewhat tippy. Could be wrong about that, though.
Color: Dark as coffee, but with a more reddish tone. Quite pretty actually.
Smell: smoke and some faint sweetness.
Tate: Very assertive. Dry hay dust. Wet mulch. Smoke. Long-lingering smokey/woody after-taste.

I prefer it strong and thick usually dropping two Tuo Cha nugs in my tea pot. I'm here to report the following; calm alertness, healthy as green and if you believe might help drop a few points on your disappointing cholesterol numbers before your next visit.

It's true......strong earthy aroma is apparent primarily during the first flush, but is very part of the brew process, brew is clear not cloudy and taste is never sharp or tannic. Be warned I've tried the flavored varieties, and filler is not my cup of tea. If you like it sweet add a little honey and say goodbye to the beans!

I have found that adding the vinegar to individual servings when ready to serve has a better taste than mixing it into the entire salad during preparation. I add it to pasta sauce for extra body; Amy's organic low in sodium soups that I dilute and add wild rice blend and the quinoa, as well as anything else that I can think of along the way. I'm learning a whole new way of enjoying mealtime. It's exciting and good-for-you eating!

The quality of all Eden organic beans is excellent. Being preservative free with very little sodium (less than 100 mg per can), the flavor of the beans comes through and is excellent. This is particularly true of the kidney beans.

Note that you'll find brown specks in some varieties of Eden beans. Do not be alarmed: the specks are kombu (kelp), an organic sea plant that's used as a natural preservative. The kombu can be consumed with the beans, or you can rinse it away.
Beans are one of the healthiest foods you can eat at a really low price. This is an awesome product. Thank you Eden Foods!

Amazon.com customer service is great and responsive - they shipped the replacement out with complimentary next-day shipping... and it arrived in exactly the same condition. In the end, I got everything I paid for, but 1. do I want to go through this every time I order it? No. And 2. it's hugely wasteful because of course the dented cans are unusable because the seal could be compromised, offering the perfect breeding ground for botulism.

I can fairly say that this is typcial for canned products in general from Amazon, too. Again, customer service was great and sent quick replacements (again with a high damage rate), but it's not worth the hassle and waste. 3. Top with grated cheese of choice to just cover, and continue to simmer until cheese melts.

The white and brown rice is much better.  This rice is nothing like I expected... cannot eat without masking the flavor.
This was by far the worst brown rice I have ever eaten. It was mushy and tasteless. I bought a dozen of them on automatic shipments. I am tossing 11 of them away and cancelling the auto delivery.
Coffee Time is a long time New England treat in milk for lunch. It goes back several generations in my family and to be able to get it sent to North Carolina brings "home" HOME!

This is the same great coffee syrup I had as a kid in NYC but couldn't find for years. Then, lo and behold, they started carrying it at my local A&P so I was getting my "fix" there. Suddenly, they stopped carrying it'! Soooo, of course, I had to go to Amazon and they have it. I am happy again '! Can't wait to get my order.
BTW, this is a full-flavored, thin syrup which is delicious in milk. If you like light and sweet iced coffee, you would surely love this in a glass of milk. Think chocolate milk but coffee instead! Never tried this any other way but could be used to flavor anything you might bake...just cut the sugar since this is concentrated like any syrup would be. Enjoy!

I haven't been able to find any coffee flavored syrups in area supermarkets for years now, so I ordered this product. The flavor is good, although I wouldn't mind if the syrup was a little thicker, especially when used on ice cream. I enjoy mixing it in a glass of low-fat milk, adding a shot or less of Kahlua or Tia Maria, and putting it in the freezer for several hours. Makes a tasty frozen treat.

I especially want to thank the Amazon seller from whom I purchased this product. In addition to shipping the six squeeze bottles in a cardboard box, Lil-BigShots took the time to wrap them in pairs inside protective bubble-wrap mailing envelopes. I've had some products from Amazon sellers arrive in poor condition, and I appreciate the extra time and effort taken by this seller.

I used to drink this 40 years ago!  I loved it and still do!  So happy to see it is still on the market. If you like coffee ice cream, you will love this! It tastes like Kahlua and cream, without the alcohol.  What a treat!

I used to buy Camp Coffee (Chicory and coffee essence) in England, and that stuff was lovely! I found this in a small store today, and thought I would try it as I really miss Camp. I'm drinking it now and it is bloody awful (which I should have known) because it is sweetened with corn syrup. I do not understand how anyone in this country - USA - can find it acceptable to have everything sweetened by foul CORN SYRUP which tastes DIFFERENT to sugar and leaves a weird feeling?/taste in ones mouth. If you demand real sugar, then you probably won't like this product.

Really nice whisky, sweet malt, floral citrus, salt, honey character (only an Orkney malt can taste like this), velvety smooth mouth feel, wonderful oily, if too short, a finish.  Excellent with high quality cheeses and Italian meats before dinner.

I cannot, however, justify spending $$$ to have it shipped to my home. The cost per 16.9 oz bottle totals almost $4.00 and that's just too much.
There's not a strong flavor, but it's a nice drink. It certainly benefits from the comparison of the zero-calorie, stevia-sweetened lemonade.
I had purchased this for my family, a little overpriced but I would purchase again.  It's just a tad sweet with only 100 calories per bottle.  My son takes these with his lunch for school.

I have two senior, indoor cats. Before I introduced Wellness into their diet they were both vomiting almost every day for a month. My vet ran tests but found nothing remarkable. The next step would have been x-rays. I was perplexed and worried about my little ones. Although I did not order this food as a "cure," my newfound awareness of my cats' sensitive digestive systems and what was going into their food drove me to seek another alternative to the Iams Indoor Weight and Hairball Control catfood I was feeding them. They were also hacking up constant fur balls despite the special catfood and daily brushing.

My cats have not vomited once in the 2 weeks since I switched them to this catfood! They seem to have more energy too. As if that weren't enough, I have not seen one hairball. Their coats are gorgeous, thicker, shinier and those dry flakes are gone. They are shedding less - when I go to brush them there is less fur in the comb. These are the results after only 2 weeks! I am very impressed with these Wellness products and I am picky about what I give to my furry children. Of course my vet continues to push the Science diet (which my cats hate) and Eukanuba, telling me about the "tests and trials" these brands have run that no other brands have, but I believe nature equipped my cats with good instincts about what they should and should not eat. They love this food and it appears to love them back. I feel good about the ingredients. I will continue to give it to my babies along with the Wellness Healthy Weight Formula and the Wellness canned catfood.

I read the great hype about this cat food.  It sounded like the best thing I could give my cat.  Unfortunately, I didn't even finish a complete 4 lb bag when my cat got blocked and he had to be rushed to the clinic.  So even though they say it is for their urinary tract health with proper pH to prevent struvite crystals, don't believe it.  (I would have rated this food zero but the system made me rate it at least one star.)

I agree with another review in that too many biscuits are broken when they arrive at my house. BTW I had the same problem buying them directly at the store.

I have fed my dogs these biscuits for about 25 years. The dogs love these biscuits but the real reason I feed them is because they are the hardest biscuits I have been able to find. The dogs take a long time to eat them and have to do a lot of chewing. This cleans their teeth. Since I started feeding these biscuits not one vet has suggested that my dog's teeth needed cleaning. I've probably had 5 or 6 dogs in that time and 5 or 6 vets too. I figure what I've saved in cleanings has more than paid for the biscuits plus the dogs like the biscuits.

One thing worth noting is that my dog's diet is more than half dry food; I don't know if a dog on a wet food diet would have the same success.

I have been giving this bisquit to my dog. Tired of buying the bag frequently, I searched for a better deal online for 20 lb box. I got the box cheaper than buying equivalent amount of bags even after adding shipping cost. My dog loves this bisquits. Only problem, though it is minor. was that there are more broken pieces than good conditioned bag product. It is understandable but I hope there are less of that.

These are large and hard biscutes, great for a large dog.  But I have little dogs and for them to eat these I have to break them up because they are a bit to big for their size.  This works well and they enjoy them.

Not too long ago, I tried Chimes Ginger Chews and I loved them. I found them at a nearby Fresh and Easy Neighborhood Market and, at the time I noticed there were two varieties available. Gary Peterson

Only reason that I didn't give them a 5-star is the shipping costs make them an expensive treat.  If I can find them locally, I will buy them on a regular basis. We purchased from the original website 8 flavored sugars all but the raspberry was worth the money the rest had little or no flavor at all! It was expensive and not worth the money.
This drink is amazing! They make another that is just ginger ale, but this jasmine tea one is much better. I would definetley recommend it, just shake it up as you drink.
This decaf cappuccino tastes just like the caffeinated stuff. I live in a small town and was unable to find decaf cappuccino anywhere. This stuff is very good and I would highly recommend it.

I buy Hodgsons Mill European Cheese bread for my bread maker.  My mom told me to add 1/4 cup of poppy seeds to that mix for an outstanding bread.  She was right, as usual. I bought this for my husband as a gift because he is in LOVE with Nacho Slim Jims. The convenience store we usually buy them from was out of them for a while. Some of us can curl our tongue while others can't. Some can cross their eyes while others can't. The list of some can while others can't goes on and on. Why am I bringing this up? Simple: I get almost no taste from this tea. I note the glowing five star reviews from so many others (which led me to buy this tea) which I interpret to mean that they can taste some element here which I can't.

I will give this product kudos for being the best looking tea I can ever remember seeing. It's a gorgeous dark red color so is aesthetically pleasing at least to the eyes. However, to my taste, the tea has a weaker flavor than even the mildest green teas. It isn't a patch, flavor-wise, on this company's excellent Yorkshire Tea or Twining's Irish Breakfast -for two examples.

My recommendation is for anybody unfamiliar with this tea is to order the smallest amount possible. You may be in the group which finds this tea to be wonderful (the majority here) or you may be like me and find it almost tasteless. In case you are like me, being stuck with 20 or so servings is bad enough. Being stuck with something like 100 or more would be vexing to say the least.

I thought the flavors stood out meaning you can easily tell what flavor you are eating. I have been craving salt water taffy. After having my husband search around our city, we realized we could not find it anywhere. I used my trusty amazon account and found this seller. I am a tea addict and I have different teas that I drink at different times of day/night. I drink this particular tea almost exclusively when I'm at my computer writing in the evening. It's a rich black tea with a very comforting  and tasty quality. It is not "fruity" the way that herbal teas are--not at all overpowering and sweet and it's a shame that people might think it's an overly-flavored tea, it's not (Twinings should kill the word "flavored" on the box). This is probably my favorite bagged black tea and I have a hard time finding it at the local grocery stores (but there are always 97,000 kinds of berry teas from the herbal companies--blehhh!). OK, it's only tea, I'll calm down :).

I like to drink different flavored teas. These tea bags are flavorful and robust. They aren't your grandmother's Lipton. The tea is fragrant and has good flavor, whether you drink it hot or iced. I recommend this as a pleasant change from the usual orange pekoe.

For some reason, this is a hard tea to find locally.  It's a delicious mild black tea with a slightly sweet bite of blackcurrant flavoring. According to the label, you get your antioxidants with your caffeine.  It's soothing and delicious both hot and iced.  This is my personal favorite of the berry teas so far.

I first tried this at a hotel in the UK a few years ago and fell in love with it. Sadly I couldn't find the Twinings' blackcurrant tea and had to settle for another brand at the market there, and hadn't forgotten about this since. To my elated surprise, I recently discovered that Amazon was selling them and immediately bought a TON to stock up. Should have checked a long time ago..

This is by far my favorite tea. Rich, soothing, deliciously aromatic, it is definitely incomparable to the really strong (gross, may I add) berry type teas that too often dominate the tea aisle in the grocery stores. Love love love it. It tastes great iced, but I love mine hot, with a tad bit of honey.
