Someone in another review had mentioned this, and I do agree. Cheap chocolate flavor is not necessarily a bad thing. My husband likes that flavor. Keep in mind my perspective is from someone who typically eats the real deal, your mileage may vary especially if you haven't had the real deal in a while. The raspberry dark chocolate flavor and mint dark (received a mini sample of that one) tastes better than the milk and plain dark in my opinion.
There is also a product called "DeMets sugar free turtles", available in Walgreens and Walmart, $2.00 a bag. They are also made with Erythritol (like Chocoperfection) instead of the usual suspects of malitol (that's in the Russelstover sugar free stuff) that cause GI issues. Can't tell there is no sugar in the Demets and no upset.

I first ordered the Dark Chocolate bars and found them to be very good for a sugar free product. They have a very smooth mouth feel and good deep flavor. I usually like Milk Chocolates so the darker chocolate is not what I am used to. I am going to experiment with mixing with the milk chocolate bars and using to coat nuts and in other baked goods.

I recently received the mixed sampler which also included the Milk Chocolate, Almond, and Raspberry. I love the raspberry. It has the wonderful flavor of raspberry liqueur and makes the dark chocolate sing. This is the one I will reorder the most. My second favorite is the almond.

I have not experienced any noticable gassy effects. The chocolate is very filling and satisfies my sweet tooth with a small amount. As I said I am looking forward to experimenting with this product in the kitchen. Enjoy!

I love this chocolate! It's with erythritol too which is PERFECT for someone on the candida-diet. My favorite flavor is Raspberry chocolate...

Split peas create a thick enough soup, I can't imagine why they needed corn starch, let alone why they had to use more corn starch, by weight, than actual PEAS. I went ahead and prepared it anyway, figuring it would surely at least be edible.

Well, it was edible. It was pretty salty, but I could live with that. It was the texture I just couldn't take. This soup has the mouthfeel of a soup thickened with corn starch (surprise, surprise)--like egg drop soup at a chinese restaurant. Which is fine for egg drop soup, but I found it utterly impossible to reconcile with my conception of split pea soup. Any peas were few and far between, floating in the viscous starchy liquid alongside a few sad rehydrated carrots. Just... gross. I finished one bowl and dumped the rest down the garbage disposal.

I definitely recommend this tea as a hot latte on a crisp fall day in your cutest flannel and plaid scarf. You can add in some friends to share, or be like me and keep it all to yourself.

Arm & Hammer Baking Soda can be used to clean countertops, sinks, and appliances. It can be used to deodorize the refrigerator, closets, car interiors, garbage cans, and food coolers. It can be used to help clean the laundry. It can extinguish small grease and electrical fires in the kitchen.

The use of baking soda for antacids is effective, but it should be used only rarely. Any persistent indigestion requires medical attention. What is "indigestion" could be a cardiac emergency. Also baking soda has a high sodium content.

It can be used to whiten teeth. Some people use it for deodorant. A small amount in warm water makes an excellent gargle for a sore throat.

It can be used to deodorize carpet and upholstery, but it is important to check for colorfastness in a small spot first.

We use it for cooking. My mother used it in her peanut brittle. I remember how it used to foam when she added the baking soda, and her recipe is in Flavored with Love: Mary Lou's Family and Friends Can Cook My friend Cathy uses baking soda in her delicious crawfish cornbread, and her recipe is in The Collard Patch When we cook collard greens, we often add a tiny little pinch to the collards - only 1/8 teaspoon to tenderize the collard greens. Several of the recipes in THE COLLARD PATCH include that little pinch of baking soda.

If baking soda is ever found to be toxic, I am totally boned. To me, this is exactly the right consistency:  fine enough to blend into a recipe or solution but sufficiently abrasive to clean, when used that way.  It's even replaced my $xx Philosophy exfoliator and does a better job.  Yes, the big box can be a hassle, but I've purchased or re-purposed lots of smaller containers, china saucers and bowls, even silver salt cellars (which it keeps brilliantly un-tarnished) and when repackaged, it looks very exclusive and "special." My whole family--especially the eight-year-old--loves these wide rice noodles (chow fun). They are not easy to find outside of a Chinese market, so buying in bulk is a good idea. I love the mouth-feel of rice noodles anyway, and wide is just that much more fun. Plus, they are not flimsy (like rice vermicelli), so are easy to stir-fry. I use a simple Cantonese style, with some soy sauce, some oyster sauce, and a little beef stock. Be sure to use plenty of oil when you stir-fry, as the noodles do absorb it. But your dish will be so beautiful, it's so worth it. Lastly, if you are on a no-gluten diet, you are gonna go ga-ga over these!

The directions on the package for presoaking are good--but instead of warm tap water (which has more lead in it from the pipes!) use cold water and warm it in the microwave. Be sure your noodle container is large enough so that the noodles won't stick to each other too much (and you will have to stir from time to time--again, to keep them from sticking). If you have to do something else, you can store the partially softened, drained noodles in the fridge--they'll be fine when you get back. Then saute as usual. Serve quickly so that the noodles don't get mushy. Voila! A fabulous and easy meal with minimal work (just a little advance effort).

Amy's Light in Sodium Organic Lentil Soup , 14.5-Ounce Can (Pack of 12)

I bought these because of the good reviews and because it makes more sense to buy lentil soup canned than it does to spend $6 every day getting the same thing from Pret, Soupman, or Hale and Hearty in Manhattan during the workweek.

Since it's not exactly a complicated soup, and since I liked the soups at all three of those places, I figured I couldn't go wrong with this item.

I was mistaken.

This soup's texture better resembles gravy than soup. The smell and the texture also reminded me far more of a can of beans than lentil soup.

Now, Pret's lentil soup is also quite thick, so I'm not sure that's what puts me off. Pret's soup is indeed loaded with sodium but I don't think that accounts for the difference in taste, as this product isn't even the low-sodium version.

Taste, of course, is subjective, and it's clear that others like it. As for me, well, I've got 11 cans of soup for which I need to find a homeless shelter.

Amy's is one of the few soups that use first-pressed olive oil instead of cheaper oils. As much as I like their lentil soup, they make other outstanding soups including my favorite, Amy's SouthWestern Vegetable soup. I know you would get many more sales if you included their vegetable soups as well as other soups.

A delicious, protein-packed natural food staple in a can, and a convenient fast food suitable  for omnivoures, vegetarians and vegans. By itself it has a mild, stew-like taste and texture, but it's extra delicious when used as a base with added herbs, vegetables and/or rice. We eat a lot of this soup so it's nice not to have to lug home all the cans, and with the free shipping it's slightly cheaper than at any of our local stores. The case has always come well padded and I've never had dented cans.

My wife has food sensitives to gluten, eggs, nuts, and dairy (among other things), so it's hard to find really good foods that conform to our needs.  Amy's Lentil Soup not only fits her diet restrictions, but is so good that we'd both eat it even if there were no restrictions.  We order a case every couple of months (with free shipping through Amazon!) and have turned our friends on to it as well.  I didn't even know what a lentil was, but I'm a convert.  All healthy food should be so delicious.

My 8 year old female Beagle has always had off-and-on runny stools for the six months or so that I had her. She was on Iams, but even that didn't help her digestion. I saw this stuff on Amazon for a reasonable price, and bought a 50 pound bag. I packaged the 50 pounds into gallon zipper bags so that it would stay fresh, and kept some in an airtight plastic container to scoop out of.

Although it's recommended to slowly ease your dog from their old food to this stuff over the course of ten days, I discovered that it only took five days for my dog.....it would have probably been less but I was determined to follow try to the rules and dilute this with her old food. I suspect I could have just switched her over without a transition period, because as soon as she was getting just this food, her runny stools stopped. Since then, she's been very regular and the results have been firm, never runny. (I'd still follow the guidelines for your own dog)

Wheat-free, baby, and so much cheaper than my local pet store's wheat-free kibbles! The kibble's usually the "boring" staple, but this one my dogs dance for when I'm filling their bowls! I get the large-size bites now, but before Castor made the difference sizes, this worked fine. The vegetables are visible, it's actually pretty kibble, go figure! I still give them fresh veggies, especially carrots to keep the cataracts away (my dogs are getting old), but I like knowing they're getting veggies when I'm out of carrots and broccoli. Very digestible, easy pick-up after.

This is a wonderful dry kibble. I love the real fruit and vegetables in the food and my dogs do also. I foster rescued Pomeranians and Schipperke for Recycled Pomeranians and Schipperke Rescue in Dallas, so I need a great quality food to get this furkids back up to snuff. We have seen remarkable improvement in our fosters' coats. Their coats have gone from sparse and lifeless to full and shiny.

I would HIGHLY recommend this food.

I recently switched my two-year-old 55-lb beagle/lab mutt to Ultramix from Blue Buffalo, which he had been eating for the last year. He didn't necessarily have a problem with the BB food, but every now and then he had an upset stomach, would throw up, etc. for no apparent reason, so I decided to try something new. After about a month since switching to the Ultramix, I truly believe he looks and acts healthier. His coat seems much more sleek and shiny, he hasn't thrown up once and he cut his poop schedule down to 2 a day from 3, which i've read means he's getting more nutritional value out of his food. Also, while he's always excited to eat anything, you'd think I was giving him a t-bone steak whenever we feed him the Ultramix - he really goes nuts for it. The little fruit pieces seem kind of gimmicky - but overall I feel like this is a great quality food that has truly made a difference in my dog. When I originally went to buy him new food a year ago, I went in with castor and pollux in mind after reading some great reviews about it online but the saleswoman in the petco convinced me to try blue buffalo -- wish I had gone with my original plan the whole time!

Castor & Pollux Ultramix Adult Canine Fomula Dry Dog Food, 30-Pound Bag

My pitt-mix has been eating Castor and Pollux Ultramix for well over a year now. Not only does she love it, but it has been the only dog food that she has been able to eat without having some sort of reaction to it. She was fine while she was eating puppy food, but once we started gradually moving her up to adult food, she started having all sorts of reactions. Even with tests from our vet, the process of finding her a good dog food that she could eat became a horrible trial and error process. We went to every extreme and started losing hope and then we found this product!!! Once it became obvious that she could eat it without any sort of reaction, we switched our little dog over to it too, and she's crazy about the banana chips and little dried peas.

And I love that I can subscribe and save with this because it's a good deal and saves me the hassle of getting out to the pet store and hoping that they have a deal running while I'm there!

We have been using this food for both our dogs for 2 years.  They are happy, healthy & have great coats. They never have digestive problems, which is of great importance to us! I means they are using all the food, w/o fillers.  We would recommend this food to everyone! The home delivery is acceptional and always on time.

My dog loves the Lamb Ultramix but hates this formula! :( I will never purchase it again. I may even switch brands because the only food he kinda likes is the lamb. My other pup loves the Grain Free Ultramix formula so she will stay on that. I just may have to take this at a loss and get rid of the food.

I did a lot of research before deciding on this brand. For the price its one of the better choices. My dog doesn't like to eat all his vegatbles and will often leave the carrots on the floor near his bowl, but other than that seems to like it. This isn't one of the dog food's full of filler.

Some time ago I overhauled my dogs' diet after learning that the so-called "premium" brand I had been feeding them had by-products and other undesirable ingredients. One of my dogs is a little fussy and it was hard to find something else he liked. We finally settled on this brand. I like that you can actually see some of the vegetables and fruits that are mixed in, there are no by-products and it's less expensive than some of the other natural and organic brands.

I have three dogs a ten year old Mini Dachshund, a 1.5 year old boxer, and a one year old hound mix. I wanted to LOVE this food because of all the great reviews and how healthy it seemed. I loved that it had bits and pieces of peas, carrots, bananas. My dogs seemed to really enjoy the food and ate a lot of it, BUT... my boxer developed TERRIBLE smelling gas. I mean, enough to clear the room. Some nights I had to sleep in my daughter's room because it was so bad it would wake me up from a dead sleep. My dachshund started to develop really bad breath, which can be common in small dogs as they get older, but her breath had no smell before being on this food. My hound mix's hair started to thin and fall out around the base of her tail. It just seemed too coincidental to start having problems with all three of my dogs after starting this food.

So we switched back to Eukanuba Adult dog food after trying out the C&P Ultramix for about three or for months and ALL of the problems have disappeared. Well, the dachshund's breath is still a little funny but NO WHERE near as bad as it was. The boxer still has gas, but it is back to the point to where I only hear it... I don't smell it. And my hound mix's hair looks good again.

Do I think this food is terrible? No, it seems to work for a lot of people and their dogs. It just didn't work for us. I wish it did. The auto delivery option was so convenient, great service. It just wasn't for my dogs, I guess.

Ordinarily my dogs cannot get enough of this flavor of C&P.  When I spend this kind of $$ for kibble, I expect them to eat every last crumb. This has always been the case whenever I have purchased the same brand, flavor, dog size package from Wholefoods. When not one, not two, but all 3 of my dogs turned their noses up at the first bag ordered through Amazon.com. I almost cancelled the auto-order. Thinking it may have been a single stale bag or similar, I didn't stop the second auto order. I will begin feeding them from that bag this evening. Review to follow.

Bought one bag of this from a local store because it sounds and looks good. My dogs usually have solid stool since I give them coconut meat daily. But after eating this one, they started having very loose stool!

I'm on a diet plan that encourages me to "keep the furnace burning", so I end up snacking twice a day between my three meals. These cookies really taste great, and they also hold me over until my next meal.

If there was anything I can compare them to, they're kinda like...sophisticated capt'n crunch. They're light and crispy, with a sort of almond butter in the middle. It's not a formal cookie shape. It's more like eating a large handful of cereal for a snack. The Honey-flavored variety tastes much better though.

As a bonus, you don't get that nasty protein aftertaste, or the weird chewy textures.

I am stoked to find this snack on amazon. FYI, Kay's Naturals also have "protein chips" that are quite good as well. If you're on a diet, and crave Doritos, aim for the chili flavors. Kay's Naturals Protein Chips, Chili Nacho Cheese, 1.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)

UPDATE: THE BATCH I RECEIVED WAS STALE, AND BROKEN IN PIECES. I've had "good batches" of this cookie before, so it still is a great snack. I've emailed the distributor to inform them of the bad batch. It could be that Kay's decided to package up the "bottom of the barrel" so to speak, and that's what I ended up with.

I'm a huge fan of Jelly Belly jelly beans, so I really enjoyed this gift box of 50 different kinds!  My favorite is definitely tangerine - but it's always a treat to try new and different flavors.  This box comes with a guide that tells you which flavors are which, so you can avoid the ones you dislike (for me - peanut butter jelly beans.. gag!).  It's pretty good size with a decent amount of jelly beans for the price - Jelly Bellies have never been cheap!  It's well worth the cost though, and a GREAT gift this year for Christmas!

I bought both the 50 Flavor Gift Box and the Bean Blast Basket for corporate Christmas gifts. The Basket was much more expensive and didn't have nearly the wow value of this 50 Flavor Gift Box. It's shaped like a Monopoly game box and has the substantial feel of a real gift. It's also reasonably priced at around $15. Of course, the jelly beans are top notch and the unique flavors speak for themselves.

This is an excellent gift item or treat for yourself.

Jelly Belly really does have true-to-life flavors! EVERY SINGLE FLAVOR in that box tastes exactly like what it should. A little pamphlet comes inside the Jelly Belly box, which tells you what different jelly beans you can mix to create a certain food. For example, 2 peanut butter jelly beans + 1 jam jelly bean = peanut butter jelly sandwich. It has a lot of fun combinations and surprisingly, they all taste like the foods that they should!

This is really a great gift. Everyone I've given it to can't stop talking about how real these flavors taste, and the kids have lots of fun looking at the pamphlet and mixing the jelly beans to create foods!
Nice assortment, the wife and I enjoyed coming up with all sorts of flavor combinations.  I would buy this again

Product is exactly as described and the packaging looks/feels quality.  Haven't opened it or tasted the jellybeans as it is a gift. It was packed for shipping well and arrived in 3 days on the cheapest shipping method.

This Jelly Belly box is a fun twist on the theme, and makes a great gift.  My father enjoyed following "recipes" on the back to make new flavors (e.g. blueberry + butter = blueberry muffin). Since each flavor is sorted into its own compartment, it's easy to figure out which you like the most.  This is not a large volume of beans, but it's a well designed package.

This was a gift for my dad. It came quickly and in pristine shape.It was packaged beautifully and sealed well. My dad loved it. I definitely reccommend this to anyone. It's pricey--but worth every penny!
My Mom and I used to love to eat Jelly Beans.  I now live over 3000 miles away.  For us, giving Jelly Belly was a trip down memory lane.

The 2-pound bag is a better deal (and it's $17.99 at Bed Bath and Beyond, which is over $10 less than on Amazon).

This 21-ounce box of separated flavors arrived with all the flavors mixed-up. The clear plastic sheet which is supposed to keep beans in place in their own compartment was not effective, and the beans all piled-up in a few compartments.

Yummy beans, but not separated-by-flavor.

This collection defies superlatives.
I enjoy them.
The kids love them. Each time we take out the box it's like Christmas morning.
They even play a game to see who can identify the flavor.
A great buy, a great gift and great fun for all.
BTW the many different special flavors apparently help the kids to keep consumption limited so they don't get as sugared-out as with other sweets.

I ordered this item for my 66th birthday which really came a day later than my birthday.  The box was beautiful and had all the candies labeled in their compartments.  I do not like black licorice so that got thrown out. I have to order more, but did bribed my grandchildren with this treat.  Liquor is quicker but candy is sweeter.  The downside is that I lost a large portion of my old filling. But will order more and maybe sugar-free.

My friend loves the huge variety of flavors and said they all tasted good, but when the box arrived you could tell that the jelly beans had all gotten mixed together.  That was a little upsetting because I wanted the gift to be perfect. I could have bought the jar of jelly beans, but I wanted them to be seperated by flavor.

The jelly beans tasted great as always but unfortunately during shipment all of the beans got mixed up within the box.  Jelly Belly needs a better packing system to prevent this from happening.  The whole point of this gift box (vs the bags) is to have the beans separated!

I'm sure they were fine, my grand-nephew to whom I sent them for Xmas didn't bother to let me know if they arrived or not, but I am sure they were fine.  Thank you.  I know they were delivered in a timely manner. Happy New Year.

Get this box of jelly beans and plan a quiet evenning with your significant other.  These are great jelly beans and you can have at least a couple hours of fun trying these with someone an making up your own mixed flavors.  This is quite a bit of candy.  Worth the price if you like gormet candy.  You have to try buttered popcorn with either blackberry or blueberry, simply amazing flavor.

Jelly Bellies are the gourmet version of the jelly bean. They are unique because of the variety of flavors and the ease with which you can recognize flavors. Even better, there are combinations of Jelly Bellies that can yield even more flavors. Jelly Bellies are small, but they are packed with a great flavor.

Jelly Bellies are a special treat and while there are not an every day snack, I love to indulge upon occasion. They are worth every penny each time I splurge to get them.

Enjoy!

The box was packaged nicely, not mixed up like other people have commented, and I was really excited for this. I watched the package's tracking info like a hawk. Anyway when i opened it up it looked normal but they were all stale, so I gave them to my little cousins who usually love jelly beans, but they threw them at me in disgust. How do I complain to amazon? Everyone has tasted jelly bellies and knows they are great. Its not a matter of quality, I think i just got a bad box. Do i return it? Probably not because tons of jelly beans are missing, the box had been opened, and its a "food". What do i do because i am not happy.

The best thing about jelly bellies is that they seem to be using higher quality ingredients than other American manufacturers but I remember when jelly beans didn't have to be gourmet to taste good.  I bought a 7 oz. bag of 30 flavors from Target and I find that bag to be too much for me but I would have bought the full 50 flavor assortment if Target had sold it because of the organization and identification of flavors.  I wasn't supposed to get cantaloup in my 30 flavor bag but I did get one and that flavor was so much better than tangerine.  I also liked the root beer.  The popcorn flavor was interestingly reminiscent of artificially fragrant movie theatre popcorn.  The jelly belly flavors are interesting but I prefer the lightly flavored pastel jelly beans available during Easter.  I believe they are manufacturered by Brachs.  They are gentler tasting than jelly bellies.

DHL did a terrible job with the delivery of my gift box in a timely manner.  I tracked it from a local area for two days and then noticed it went back to Rhode Island for a night and back to the Latham office.  It was finally delivered two days after the stated date.  The contents of the box was all jumbled and mixed together from the "handling."  I will not order from a company that uses DHL again.

Sorry, but this was a disappointment. My husband is a jelly bean fanatic, but these expensive beans did not impress him. Yes, it was fun to see if you could combine the beans to create salsa (you could), but many of the flavors were disappointing. My favorites were the root beer and cream soda; everyone's least favorite was the buttered popcorn.  A novel one-time gift.

I wanted to buy Vomit flavor and other weird ones, but can't do that online, so I bought this 50 flavors, and was disappointed to find that they are all "good" flavors, with no vomit or other known jelly belly weird flavors.

Im not a big fan of extra strong dark chocolate, but the health benefits are many so I figured I would try a few of them out. This is by far the best one. Actually has more of a sweet taste and any bitterness is hard to even notice. Packed with antioxidants. A few squares a day is a great addition to any healthy diet.

I love chocolate. Good chocolate. I've tried fancy bars, local bars, hand-poured bars, organic bars, and almost everything else, and THIS is my favorite. The chocolate is perfectly dark without being bitter, the orange has an incredibly satisfying crunch and a slight (very slight) chewiness that makes the texture of the bar divine, and the flavor of orange and chocolate together are heavenly.

If only they sold it in more places!

Not only have i had just about everry brand of belgian chocolate this side of the atlantic, i have had this one several times.  But this seller sent bad chocolate. It has a powdery appearance and is very brittle to touch and taste.  Can't eat it at all.  And i guess i can't return it either.

This is the best chocolate bar I've ever tried.  The salty taste is in perfect balance with the chocolate.  I'm not the only one that thinks so, since our local grocery store sells out of this particular bar almost as soon as they arrive.  The other Chocolove bars are fine, but this one is tops.

My husband and I occasionally enjoy a few pieces of dark chocolate in the evening and this chocolate is a real treat. It is hard to find such good chocolate at less than $3 per bar. We order a couple cases each fall and keep them in the freezer till we need a new bar. This is not bitter chocolate and just 1/6 (3 small squares) of a bar is only 80 calories and satisfies our desires for dark chocolate.

I first tried this at a small coffee shop and the memory of the taste haunted me until I found it on Amazon.  It is a wonderfully decadent treat in which to indulge, whether to forget your bad day or to reward yourself for a job well done. You can taste the real orange peel shavings in this chocolate and it is that perfect blend of dark chocolate and orange, which is the most divine combination.

Bought some of these in New Mexico at a co-op store and couldn't find them locally in Florida. Bought on line thru Amazon at a lower price and free shipping. The candy is wonderful and it's truly a sweet deal.

I am a fanatic about fabulous chocolate and even more so when it's combined with orange. AND, boy oh boy, Chocolove has hit the nail on the head with this delicious chocolate bar! Well worth  the price. I would definitely recommend this chocolate...so fantastic!
Someone gave me a bar as a gift.  I had no idea it would be this good.  Better than other orange/choc combos, it has a nice crunch to the peel bits. Yum.

Bought one of these at Whole Foods about a month ago.

The secret: they freeze-dry the orange peel and this leads
to a really strong orange taste with each bite. You get a little
bit of peel this way.

I've loved orange chocolate since i was a kid and my Dad
brought some home from trips. This is an excellent
version.

I absolutely love dark chocolate (77% seems to be the magic number) and have tried many different varieties.  This is one of my favorites due to the complex flavor and great dense and smooth texture. Also, this pack of 12 is a economical way to purchase.
I am a dark chocolate person and I love this bar.  It is low in sugar and high in cocoa flavor.

I have tried several and this one has just the right amount of sea salt added to not distract from the chocolate, but adds to the flavor.  It is my favorite.  I have many strong favorites for dark chocolate bars, but this one seems to be the only one to get this combination right.
Our local pet store stopped carrying these and so we were excited to find them online.  Our Dog eats the same brand of food and it keeps her healthy and at a good weight.

My Pug is so picky, she doesn't like the little ones, but loves the bigger ones.  I don't know what the difference in them is, but she does.  So I would not recommend these if your dog is picky, go ahead and get the bigger ones and break them up.

I had a cough that was keeping me up night after night and not getting better. I had to sleep sitting up for 4 or 5 nights in a row. My friend swears by lotus root for the lungs and I am not so into homeopathic solutions, but she sent it to me. Within one day I slept through the night, but night 2 I was lying down and the cough was gone. I wasn't taking any other medication. There are no side effects at all. Try it, it doesn't taste awesome but if you add some soy sauce, sea salt or ginger it is better. And drink as much as you can, its food, so its not harmful. There are no directions as to how much to take. Some people make an entire pot out of the packet and then keep it in the fridge and re-heat it a cup at a time. I made a cup at a time and had about 6 cups the first 2 days then less each day. In less than a week I was 100% fine.

I was looking forward to getting this product. I loved the classic brulee, however the chocolate tasted like chocolate pudding with sugar on top. It had no special taste and it was expensive. I gave this a three star only because the classic is still very good for a boxed dessert. If you are looking for a bargain do not order from this store there is better pricing out there.

Perfectly roasted (not burnt)...perfectly ground
Italian Espresso I prefer, because it's rich and creamy flavor is not over roasted like Starbucks.

This coffee is simply superb. It strikes just the right balance between Arabica and Robusta, with a well-rounded, creamy, yet robust flavor. It's perfect for both moka coffee makers and espresso makers (I use it with both). This coffee is very popular in Naples and throughout Italy, and for very good reasons. To add to its value, it's also reasonably priced (as far as imported Italian coffee can be reasonably priced here in the US, anyway). If you're looking for the REAL Neapolitan coffee flavor, this is it. As they say in Italy, "Provare per credere" (trying is believing). Enjoy!

I buy Bob's Red Mill ground flax seed meal from Winco Foods grocery store for about $4 per pound and my kids love it--or at least they tolerate it. We put it in pancake mix to add fiber and nutrients--start out with just a little bit until the kids get used to the different texture and then increase the amount gradually. We always add a little whenever we bake, or make hot cereal. But mostly just pancake mix.

The packaging is very good, product is always fresh and nutty tasting. Never bitter. Should be refrigerated or kept in the freezer. Lasts a very long time in the refrigerator, not sure how long (about 2-3 months before we finish it all).

Whole flax seeds last much longer, even without refrigeration, but they must be finely ground before consumption to get the nutrients.

After trying several of these to see if they could of got better, in the end they didn't. They are now in my cupboard when I am sure I will get aggervated by their mere presence and throw them out. The flavor was disqusting, and the beans were way to big and bitter. Dont recommend them to anyone.

I send the Diletante Espresso Bean Blend to my son in Miami. They are sent directly to him and that in itself
makes it easier for me. He loves the 3 different chocolate flavors and they help keep him going with a boost of caffiene to
make those Professor's lectures easier to stay awake in!

I recieved these about 4 days after I ordered. Pretty happy with the time it took to ship them. They were shipped in a USPS envelope, it was bursting at the seals. I was concerened that they would be smashed or damaged, but they turned out ok due to the cool weather. During the summer months I think the seller should consider using a box!

The beans were of great quality, great flavor and the chocolate had excellent taste. The bag itself seals at the top, so that will help keep the contents fresh. I plan to keep these in a jar for customers on my desk, and of course to keep me awake!

Will buy again when a I run out!

I bought this as a gift for Christmas in a nice glass jar from Old Time Pottery. My boyfriend thought they would last forever but they were gone by March. People would come to his cubicle just to take a few. My only complaint is that 1/6 of the bag came stuck together. They easily broke apart but made one side of a lot of the beans flat. This was mailed in December but I guess the warm Georgia winter melted them in transit. For the price, I hoped that all of them would be intact. Taste was not compromised though. Yum!

Nuts are of above average quality, though strangely about 5% of the nuts have an almond taste to it. Better than most store bought brands. No real complaints.

However, I have to put a low rating on this due to the price increase. I know this type of review note is frowned upon, but the nuts are not worth the money that they jacked the price up to. My total order one week ago was $34.48 shipped. Went I went to reorder, the price is now $50.90 including shipping. I do not understand the reason for the sudden price increase, but while the nuts are good, they are not worth this exorbitant price. At $10 a pound, you can find a better deal for pistachios on an equal or better level.
My first review didn't show up, so am trying again. These look and feel like plastic and my pit bull that will eat anything will not eat theses. Thirty bucks lost as I had to order regular pig ears

This is absolutely the best chocolate I've ever had. I used to get it periodically at a Dutch import store near me, but I went there today and they didn't have any. Naturally I was inspired to check Amazon and write this review.

Let's just say any time I go to Europe, I come home with this in my suitcase.

If you are a milk-chocolate fan, you must try this most wonderful brand.  Not too sweet, it is a beautiful, creamy, delectable and exquisite experience in chocolate tasting! My guess is that Heaven will be paved with Cote d'Or milk chocolate.  The dark is excellent too!
Smooth and creamy!  Bars are double - two packs.  Not cheap, but well worth the money.  Melts easily so I store in the refrigerator.

This did not work for our puppy.  It left her with quite the upset tummy.  It was the food she came home from the breeder on, but something must have changed when she got home.  We have since made the switch to eukanuba and she is a much happier pup!  Plus, I am happier too since I'm no longer cleaning up after her all the time!  As always, Amazon was great, but I would not recommend this food for your puppy.

This dog food has all the ingredients you don't want in a dog food - corn, by-products, etc. For about the same price, Diamond has their Naturals line that is MUCH BETTER in terms of quality. Diamond Naturals Puppy food doesn't have corn or by-products.

I honestly don't know why Diamond puts out this awful dog food when they can make quality ones for right about the same price - given the choice, who would take the one for less quality?

Our puppy was on this when we got her, we bought a small bag and slowly changed her food to the Diamond Naturals for Large Breed puppies, and the difference is fantastic. We'll stick with the Naturals, and never have her go back to this variety.
Good product for the price.  My dog is not picky and he puts it down fairly quick.  Would recommend for the bigger puppys.

Let me start by saying that I am NOT a person that ever reviews anything. If I dislike something, I throw it away and use it as a learning experience. With that being said, I must also say that I am a HUGE lover of everything Zevia and anything related. Every single Zevia product that I've tried, I've LOVED! That is until Dr. Zevia. I am an avid lover of anything cherry and anything Dr. Pepper related. I was so excited when my case of Dr Zevia arrived that I ran inside, opened the box and immediately opened one. This is when I gagged LOL! It is soooooooooo similar to robatussin that it's nauseating. I thought that maybe it would get better if it was super cold, no it actually got worse. I have 23 cans of Dr. Zevia that I have NO idea what to do with lol. It might be good in a milkshake or in some sort of food as a flavor enhancer but it definitely isn't a great soda.

I also like the Black Cherry flavor now. I first tried them when I started doing lower carb eating and I have to admit that being someone who has never liked diet soda AT ALL, they took some getting used to. I've tried all the flavors and after not having had any regular soda for about two months, I actually like these. The Dr. Zevia and the Black Cherry seem to be just sweet enough for me with the way I eat now. I'd like it if they came out with a creme soda flavor too.

Dr. Zevia has to be may favorite of all of the Zevia flavors (and I really do like them all).  I think it tastes just like Diet Dr. Pepper.  And the stevia aftertaste is very minimal... more so than the other Zevia flavors.  I would highly recommend Dr. Zevia (plus, the name is so cute!).

Whenever I drink a soda at home, it is always a Zevia soda.  Dr. Zevia has a slight cherry flavor and is similar to the other Dr.  I have noticed very little aftertaste from Zevia soda, much less than from regular diet soda.  From the reviews I've read, it's clear that you either really like this soda or you don't.  I really like this soda.  I was a big consumer of the other diet Dr. and both big-brand diet colas for many years.  I really didn't like the artificial sweetener in the average diet soda.  Thank you to the people who make Zevia soda.  It is more expensive than regular soda, but I think it's worth it.  It is great to be able to enjoy a diet soda that tastes great and contains nothing artificial.  My only negative comment would be about what happens when you pour Zevia soda in a glass over ice.  The carbonation seems to dissipate very quickly when poured over ice.  Not to worry.  Drinking it right out of the can works fine for me.

This stuff has managed to become a suitable sub for coke and is probably responsible for about 10 lbs of the 40 I lost. Tastes like a cross between a diet DP and a cherry coke. Since it's more expensive than regular soda, I limit myself to one a day, but it definitely satisfies that craving! Highly recommend!

I really like the taste.
Awesome how it has no sugar so It doesnt keep me up at night

*At first i didnt really like any of the zevias, but after trying them each a couple times, i just cant get enough. though this is my favorite.*

And the price went down from 27$ to $21 which is pretty cool.

Fantastic!
Unfortunately this soda tastes like cough syrup.  I was really hopeful for this but the cough syrup taste is horrible.  It was fine as a soda, but the flavor was horrible.

I was really excited to find this soda. Taste isn't bad, takes a couple of days to get used to. It's only fizzy when you first pour it out, then it turns into what looks like flat soda. The dealbreaker here is this soda has caused horrible diarrhea. I'm actually posting this review from the toilet as my stomach makes noises. This is my 3rd trip today.

I'll try my luck with the occasional Splenda soda. This has been a bad experience. I'm scared to give it to y kids because I don't want them to have an accident at school.

I have been buying Zevia for a while now and finally came upon it on amazon, way better deal on here than at the store. Dr. Zevia is like Dr. Pepper and Cherry Coke combined, which actually tastes wonderful. I highly recommend this soda but if you are a Dr. Pepper addict you might find it slightly lacking.

I am still looking for some more natural soda like this to curb the occasional craving. I am sorry, but this was gross tasting. Nothing like Dr. Pepper. Maybe other flavors are not bad, but the Cola one is.

Because it has "Dr." in its name, you think you're getting a Dr. Pepper knockoff.  Instead, you get only the cherry flavor of Dr. Pepper.  So, in fact, it's more like Cherry Cola than anything else.  I couldn't taste any of the other major flavors that are in the real (diet) Dr. Pepper.  It's not bad, but I really don't like cherry cola, so it's not for me.

I haven't had soda or carbonation in years. I got this for my parents who, to avoid sugar, drink nothing but aspartame filled fresca black cherry and peach. Figuring that is so much worse, I was so excited to find Zevia and currently am awaiting my parents to try the flavors. I myself grabbed a Dr. Zevia because I loved Dr. Pepper back when I used to drink soda. Now it has been years, so I cracked it open and noted a considerable spice and cherry smell. I took a sip and felt a punch to the throat like I downed some great tasting apple cider vinegar. That's not a problem with this product, it's just what happens when you haven't had carbonated drinks in years. It tastes just like Dr. Pepper, maybe a little bit like a diet but that's not a problem because it tastes great all the same AND you're not compromising your health. This is the benefit of capitalism, someone wants a better product, someone makes a better product. I want to get everyone I know on this stuff and off of their monsters, fresca's, diet pepsi's and so on...

it was ok.  Just ok.  Didn't love it, didn't hate it.  I went to drink it hoping for it to be just like dr pepper.  At first I felt like it was lacking in sweetness, but that was just because stevia lacks that mouthfeel of sugar.  I adjusted to the sweetness thing by the second gulp and that was ok.  It was actually pretty ok except for the lacking bite.  I got the stevia aftertaste (not too bad of one) where I was expecting bite.  Disappointing... not dismal... I got the variety pack... This was the first one I tried.  I'm likely to drink the other one... but its just not the same.  I actually looked back at the can a few times to convince myself it said Dr. Zevia and not Cola... It is passable as a cola (haven't tried the cola yet).  Hopefully the other flavors will be better.

I must say, I'm a lover of Dr. Pepper, so when I saw this product made with Stevia I was very excited.  I was disappointed that it did not taste anything like Dr. Pepper.  After I got past the No Dr. taste, I was fine.  As an alternative to sugar sodas it's good.  It has the sweetness and carbonation you expect from regular soda, without the after taste of many diet sodas.  Just more along the generic end as far as flavor goes.
After trying Dr. Zevia I am disappointed at the taste.  It is nothing like Dr. Pepper but has a "whang" to it.  I am anxious to try the other flavors however but I can not recommend Dr. Zevia.

It is a naturally sweetened soda with Stevia, but I expect more robust flavor simular to Dr. Pepper.  I wouldn't even say it is close to Dr. Pepper.  I was disappointed, especially when I love the "Cola" flavor of Zevia so much.

This is one of Zevia's more successful flavors.  It's more reminiscent of the flavor of Dr Pepper than a clone, but it still tastes very good.  I don't notice any kind of aftertaste.  I've bought this on its own before, and will again.  It's one of my favorite flavors.

I picked this up from my local health food store.  I have tried Stevia and occationally use it in tea or coffee.  I think they used way too much of the sweetner. It was horrible. I wish they just put a lot less of the sugar subsitute.  It did not taste like what it was supposed to.

I gave up soda a few weeks ago and saw this while shopping today. (I'm really new to health food!) I really miss the fizz and buzz of soda, so I thought I'd give it a whirl. I thought it was fantastic. It's sweet, but not in a syrupy gross way like a regular soda usually is. I'm used to Diet, and maybe that's the key to appreciating the flavor of this beverage, or maybe its that I have been off soda for a while. I really love that I can drink this casually and know I'm not poisoning myself with a ton of chemicals I can't identify. I would love to subscribe, if someone who has can tell me how well it ships :)

This was my first Zevia product, so I have no idea how it compares to the others.  But based on the flavor of this, I doubt I'll find the courage to try any others.  Please don't think you will be getting a drink that tastes even remotely similar to Dr. Pepper.  The "Dr." part is fitting because it tastes like medicine.  Brushing my teeth afterwards helped erase the memory.

I purchased a case of this product in the hopes to find an alternative to the high calorie, high sugar beverage I normally drink.  Dr Pepper has been my favorite for years.  I have tried other beverages that were supposed to be cheaper versions of it, only to be disappointed every time.  I thought, with this version (Dr Zevia) being so much more expensive and using stevia to sweeten as a healthier alternative than sugar, that this would likely be closer to the brand name beverage it was trying to be like.  Unfortunately, I found it not only wasn't closer to the flavor, it was much worse than any I had tried in the past!  It was like drinking carbonated cough syrup!  I did not return it because my son decided to drink it and suffer through it to try to reduce his caloric intake, but if he wants more of it, he will have to buy it himself.  I will never again spend 4 times the amount I spend for the real deal, just to be disappointed by what is expected to be a high quality product.

I am from the south and grew up on Dr. Pepper. In wanting to break a near daily habit of 1-2 cans, I first switched to a cane sugar cola (to at least get off HFCS), then tried Dr. Zevia.
Honestly I nearly vomited when I took the first sip of this stuff.
The strongest taste is the clove, then a funky aftertaste that was just like cough syrup.
I tentatively tried another sip - I couldn't detect any cherry, only clove and cough syrup.
I tried a three more cans over a 1-month span (thinking maybe it was just the surprise of how NOT like Dr. Pepper it is), and same results. Yuck. Yuck. Yuck.

This doesn't taste anything remotely like Dr. Pepper, not even close, not even in the same universe.
If you are a die-hard regular Dr. Pepper fan, you will most likely detest this product as much as I do.
On the other hand, if you aren't looking for a DP sub, or are used to an aspartame drink, or like clove and cough syrup, then you might enjoy this product.
there is no after taste like other diet items. this hits the spot. i subscribed to it and still find myself order extra. great for kids. they love them and keeps them away from all the sugar.

As a diabetic who likes soda, I mostly avoid sugary sodas.  Until a year ago, I drank the usual Aspartame-sweetened diet sodas; however, being analyzed by a naturopath and being told I was basically embalmed from the Aspartame (which turns to formaldehyde at 90 degrees), I had to quit ingesting Aspartame in any form.  The Dr. Zevia is a tasty substitute for the Dr. Pepper I used to drink.

I originally started buying Zevia a year ago for my diabetic mother - we actually did some glucose testing just after drinking a can and our glucose levels did not change so that was good to know. The flavors are good, especially Dr. Zevia. I recently was able to but the new flavors in Chicago (cream, grape and Mountain Zevia) - the grape was the best!

Recently I switched our entire office to Zevia since I always felt bad buying sugared or chemicaled drinks for the company. At first a couple people were reluctant but now everyone is hooked.
I bought these for my son who likes Dr. Pepper.  He didn't like these.  He didn't want me to get anymore Dr. Zevias.

I've tried 12 of the various Zevia sodas by buying the 24 can multi-flavor case.  I liked several of the flavors very much, but not Dr. Zevia.  I'm a big Dr. Pepper fan and Dr. Zevia isn't even close.  It was the worst of the 12 flavors I tried.  It tasted almost like a watered down cherry cough syrup and had a wicked aftertaste.  I won't buy it again.

Colas sweetened with stevia- truly a product which has come of age BUT this particular flavor leaves an aftertaste which is identical to cherry cough syrup- YUCK.  I have tried many of the flavors so far and you can see my reviews for them on each flavor- I strongly recommend the Grape (white grape used for flavor- yum) and the Root Beer is real good too- and the Cola and Black Cherry both get a thumbs up also.  But this one- NOPE.  Not sure where the positive reviews are coming from honestly...

I've tasted a large number of Dr Pepper imitators, and Dr. Zevia is by far the worst.
I like Stevia sweeteners, you see, and I assumed Dr. Zevia would be delicious.
Don't buy it, don't drink it. It tastes like chalky cherry cough syrup. I've only been able to drink it when mixed with Coca Cola or Dr Pepper, and that defeats the purpose of diet soda entirely, doesn't it?

I'm not even willing to try the other Zevia flavors, I still have 17 cans of Dr Zevia I can't handle. Blech.

Bought some ginger ale and black cherry at my local Giant supermarket. Thought they were okay. My wife's favorite is orange which they didn't carry. I ordered a case on Amazon. It was an incredible disappointment. I can honestly say the worst beverage product we've ever tasted. We threw the 21 of the 24 cans we received. It was undrinkable.

I haven't had any of the other Zevias, but this tastes awful to me. I'm a regular diet drinker and I was pumped this product uses Stevia. But the smell is precisely like cough syrup and the taste isn't much better. I dropped in some vanilla sweet leaf and held my nose and it was tolerable. Wish I didn't buy the whole case.
Wow!  Obviously not healthy since I have to add 1 3/4 sticks of butter to make the crust, and time consuming to make since I had to grate 5 lime peels, but flavor made it totally worth the effort!

Had this for the first time and it was wonderful. The black currants are nice and tart and the walnuts add a great crunch to the whole thing.  I'm not that much of a cereal person but I could get hooked on this stuff!

Used to LOVE this cereal, now I don't trust them. Kelloggs took over Kashi. It seems that 'Natural' is not regulated by ANYONE! Even though there doesn't seem to be any GMO'd soy in here (list of ingredients), don't know where else they cut corners to make $$$$.
Best cereal we have tasted that is good for you.  I have subscribed to it and got an even better price!!!

I've been looking for a cereal like this for many years. It tastes great, stays crunchy in milk, and has just the right amounts of fruits(currents) and walnuts. In my opinion when a cereal shows walnuts on the box or lists them on the box, like many do, they should 'have walnuts' in the cereal. This one does and plenty of them. For the price ( walmart has it for $3.50 per box in my area) it has all the nuts you will want unless you just want nuts and no cereal. You don't need to "look" for the nuts to find them. It has taste, crunch, protein, fiber, the nuts provide omega 3s , and all this in a natural cereal that is economical as well. Kashi has many cereals that are good for you , but I was surprised to find this one is so good I probably eat too much of it . The only thing which isn't top quality with this cereal is the box which is made of re-cycled cardboard. You can enjoy it and know you are helping the environment at the same time.
PS: Amazon will undoubtely edit the name of the store I said had this for $3.50 per box in my area. It has "mart" in the name and it is written on the "wall" of the store. Wonder if they'll edit this too ??

This is an incredibly good cereal. I've never had currants before and was a bit suspicious, but they are seriously the bomb.

I just make sure that I only get 1 currant per spoonful because they can be a little bit strong, but I'm a bit OCD anyways so you may not mind.

Another thing I love about it is the flakes. They are thick unlike most crappy cereals so they aren't all soggy by the time you take your last bite(which is a sad moment).

I found it at Grocery Outlet which was super cheap but I don't think they have it there anymore... I'm hesitant to pay $5 for a box of cereal but this one is totally worth it.

I'm not much of a cereal fan, but my wife and I bought a large box from Costco on a whim. Easily the best mass produced breakfast cereal I have ever had, unfortunately it's crazy expensive. The costco box was a good deal, but this is not (less cereal, more money). I'm not willing to pay over $6 a pound for cereal, but if that's not a problem for you I'd give it a try. So delicious

The item pictured may be the old, brown box, but the product delivered is the newly formulated Black Currant and Walnut cereal.  Hmmmm.  I wonder why they took out the added Vitamins and minerals?  And the ingredient list is not quite the same - and now seems to upset my tummy like the high protein 'Crunch' cereals do.  Not nearly as badly though....  Still.  It is the only cereal with black currants that I know of.  The real 'super fruit'.

I have been eating this cereal for about 2 years now and never tire of it.  I used to get it in my local grocery and then I had to get it in the Dallas area - 300 miles away.  Finally couldn't find it even there, so looked online and there is my cereal - wonderful to have it back again and auto-delivered no less!  I don't have to search and call stores to see if they have it and what their price is (some groceries in the Dallas area had it but charged about $2 more per box than the other Kashi cereals by listing it in the organic section).  I know that I can order early if needed so I never run out.  This cereal has a little sweetness and it has the crunch of the walnuts and the wonderful flavor of black currents - delicious with fruit and milk, or just milk or by the handful!
This cereal has it all as far as I'm concerned- it's a box of yummy healthful crunch! Perfect for breakfast or a late night snack ;)
Liked it somewhat but a little bland, would have liked more walnuts and fruits.  We did like the non-sweetness which I always look for in cereal and other...

I've tried so many whole grain cereals, I can't remember them all...to be honest many are best forgotten. Kashi U is easily the best of Kashi's many variants (and I really like several of Kashi's offerings). It is an interesting mixture of textures, but the black currants are the magic ingredient. The cool sweetness they bring to the party makes this a cereal standout. Add a little bit of Silk Light Vanilla soy milk and you are in breakfast bliss.

This has to be the best researched and best constructed cereal ever produced for the mass market. As other reviewers have said, all aspects of human health were addressed, it is very tasty with great textures. Ever since I bought my first box, the only time since then I ever buy other cereals is when U is not available. Even the box and the ink are cutting edge as far as environmental concerns. I feel good for hours after eating it, and heartily recommend it with Tempt original hemp milk for that much extra omega 3 and 6 (it tastes great with moo milk as well). The retail price when not on sale is about $4.99/box- expensive, but worth it. the bulk price is much better, and if you buy enough to get free shipping, it's a great deal.  Since U is such a wonderful product, you may not want to eat any other cereals, in which case a 4 pack will only last a couple of weeks...

Whole lot going on in this cereal. It is very tasty and just the right combination of ingredients to make it especially yummy. I love nuts in my food, any food and the walnuts in this cereal really make it pop.
Thank you,
EW

This is one of those cereals where the "fruit" is a mix of 99% grain and chemicals, and 1% extracted fruit juice. If you want a really natural cereal, or one where the fruits don't taste disgusting, look elsewhere.
buy other brands this one isnt worth the money. Loaded with strawberries? What a joke there is more flavoring than berries in this mix and the mix quality is that of much cheaper brands

These packets are convenient and easy, a couple of spoons, 1/2 cup water mix and your are ready to go. The honey butter taste is subtle, I usually like butter and jam on my biscuits but did not need any to supplement the flavor.

I have used boxed bisquick for years, for whatever reason, these packets mix easier and are moister than using the standard bisquick recipie.

I was pleased to be able to order this Bisquick mix because the stores in our area no longer carry it.  We love these honey flavored bisquits, but will be hard pressed to use all 22 before the expiration date. I ordered them in the middle of March and they have a June expiration date. It would be good if the expiration date was longer or if it was given in the product description.

Ok, I left off one star because I'm annoyed with company that they don't sell in box anymore, only 'per use' packages. The product is great. Mixes easily, bakes quickly and tastes so good. I make dumplings in the stew also but the recipe is on the box, so I'm winging it...which is why I miss the box as my memory fades!
My family LOVES these and they are sometimes difficult to find.  They are also quick and easy.

I was buying these regularly at my local market and until recently they stopped carrying the product. My family loves these and they are so fast and easy to make their a perfect addition to any meal. I bought two boxes of 22 packets which per unit came out cheaper than when the market had them on sale. They're a great buy!

This product is definatley true to the name complete...They turn out so melt in your mouth good that they don't even require butter!!!! They are simple to make and fool proof....Plus with the free shipping and no retail markups much cheaper than buying them at the grocery store. The case I got had a good experation date and I have no doubt that we will devoure them long before they expire.
I buy this in the store. It is very good. Wonderful flavor & easy to make. I like to make breakfast sandwiches out of these. A good quick item for your pantry. Highly recommend.

There are no stores in my area carrying this product any longer. I am so very grateful that I can buy it through Amazon. My son laughed when he came in and saw a box full of biscuit mix, but he was really glad that I was able to grab a handful and send them home with him. This is a wonderful product and I love that I can get it in just a couple of days without having to run all over town just to find that none of the stores here carry it any longer.
We love these biscuits and would be lost without them.

All you do is add water..mix + bake!  Has nuggets of honey in the mix but these do not come out overly sweet, very subtle.  Instant breakfast addition and I also bake them to add something different at dinner.  I use subscribe + save so get them cheaper and always have on hand.  Have tried the garlic/cheese, they're good too!

We love this product at home and when we go in our RV. It is quick, tasty and hits the spot. We use it for breakfast, dinner or with soup. My grandchildren love it. I am a "from scratch" cook so to find something we really like in a easy package I am all for it. I put the water directly into the package and mix it in the pouch when we are in the RV. Can it be any easier?
It is hard to find this product in the market, so I just purchased a full case. It was sent very quickly and arrived in a matter of days. I will use the service again.
Laurel

These things are very good. I make them in a toaster oven with convection setting and can cook 6 average sized biscuits with this mix in about 10 minutes. It's the perfect size and very quick. The flavor is excellent. I'm glad that I found them here and tried them. Thanks, Amazon.

I loved this great purchase at less than ten bucks, and they're M&Ms!  What's to say about them?  If you haven't had them, go out and buy a pack, they're a fantastic candy!  I prefer the ones with almonds best, but considering how cheap the milk chocolate version was, I wasn't going to pass up a great deal like that!  Thanks Amazon, I will keep coming back!
I use these at work for treats, nice to get a larger sized bag at a decent price. No problems with the quality. They came packed in dry ice which was a pleasant surprise!
Shipped quickly.  The candy was fresh and tasted great.  What more can I say?  I wish we bought more.  There

i had to order another 2 42 ounce bags today. the others i purchased at amazon did not last very long unfortunately. they are fresh. they are in a nice quality resealable bag to keep them fresh. they are delicious. watch for the lowest price. i am very happy with the freshness and quality of this product. it looks fresh and it smells fresh. i have ordered the 42 ounce size multiple times so far and i have no complaints.

I was tired of getting bags of assorted chocolate candy that always had a variety no one would eat.  I love that amazon was selling this product and it came in "bulk".  I won't run out of the office candy again!  I went ahead and bought all of the favorite brands so I can keep everyone happy.

What can I say! I love peanuts M&M's. I love them more than the regular kinds. They're filling and tasty. I got one of those M&M gumball machines and filled it up with this. I just love them. Go M&M's!

I ordered the 4 large bags. I received them in a timely manner and appreciated that they were shipped in a minimal amount of packaging. The four bags were simply shrink wrapped together and put in the box with my other items. I have only opened one bag so far but the M&M's were in great condition. Great price, delicious product, excellent service.

Edit (10/01/10)- The price for these is now $35 more than when I bought them the first time. I can buy these for less than $10 a bag at the store. So the price is now closer to ridiculous then great.

I received the package early, which was great. The candy packaging looked fine but I didn't discover the problem until I opened the bag. Half the bag of Peanut M&M's was cracked! I was really embarrassed to share them with anybody because the entire bagful was dusted with M&M debris. Not happy with this purchase at all.

First off, the initial arrival: It came in a bigger box (since other things were ordered as well) when I opened it the 2 yellow bags set neatly and ready for me to eat! Packaging, no other boxes or bags were used or necessary. Review of the value: this is going to put it in perspective;
1) The average size bags are about 1.69 ounces
2) The larger size bags range from 9-11 ounces depending on which one as they make several.
3) This bag was just over 42 ounces and they go up to 60 ounces in certain packaging.
In theory you could go out and buy a bunch of the 1.69 ounce packages and to equal the total of about 84 ounces and at about $1 a bag you'd only buy about 48 bags at $.99 a bag it would be cheaper to go with these bags - however, the cost of this item was a little disappointing because I expected a little more in the bags. Aside from a portion (probably 25% of the height) of the bag being air, I was just hoping for more M&M's. Overall I give this purchase a C+ value as it was cheaper to buy this way. But, as always beware of pricing for example another seller on Amazon charges $9.19 for the same bag (but you have to pay for shipping). If you wanted to buy using Amazon Prime, like myself then you could get regular M&M's (no peanuts) for only $15.63 - about $10 less so that may be worth the savings. An okay value - but at the end of the day it was cheaper than buying them individually. 73beats

So I'd like to start off by saying that I am a huge fan of the original Nuvo (aka the "pink one"). It's very sweet, just the right intensity, everything. I'm not such a fan of this new flavor, however. I guess everyone's different. If you're expecting the signature sweetness of the original flavor, you might be a bit disappointed with the lemon sorbet flavor. I'm not sure but my guess would be that they decided to market this version to please the customers that didn't like the original's sweetness. In any case, you won't like it if you're looking for the sweetness like I was. However, if you're after a pretty strong drink that's kind of tart and maybe a little bitter, you'll like it. I understand why people may go for this one, but I personally won't be buying it again. I prefer the sweeter original flavor.
this was due to be released this summer but has yet to reach the shelves whis is crappy!!! what are u waiting on???

I used this organic pumpkin in a pie this week. Normally, I use Libby pumpkin, but wanted to try organic this time. I prefer Libby. This organic pumpkin from Farmer's Market really changes a pie.

First, the entire texture is different. It isn't nearly as smooth, and it is a bit dry. The other ingredients are the same, so I know it's the pumpkin changing my pie's turnout.

The flavor is also different. Oddly enough, it doesn't have as much pumpkin flavor!

Honestly, it makes my home-made pumpkin pie taste more like a cheap store-bought. Really not nearly as good as when I use Libby pumpkin. I'm say to say this, as I really prefer organic products, but when it changes the texture and flavor this much, I cannot recommend it. Too bad I still have another can.

If you do end up purchasing some to try, I'd recommend adding just a little extra sugar to your pie to help enhance flavors. Add a little more cinnamon, too.
This is the cheapest way to buy K-cups. The Milk Chocolate Cocoa is good and quick to make anytime of the year.

I purchased tea from Lana's because I'd been looking for a good flavored chocolate tea. This tea is superb! I also received free samples and the product is well packaged to ensure freshness.  This tea is delicious and I urge people to order from Lana's - there is a long list of tea flavors on her website!
I am more than pleased with this product.  I also appreciate the personal attention that the seller showed to me.  I will definitely be a repeat customer.

This is the crispest, cleanest ginger beer I have ever had.  It says "fantastically fiery" and it is.  Not too, overpoweringly, ginger-y, but definitely not the watered-down, sugary mess you get in every other ginger drink in the U.S.  Can I give it a sixth star?  Hands down, WORLD'S BEST.

If you've never tried ginger beer, it tastes a lot like a very intense ginger ale. The ginger flavor is simply more pronounced than what you find in ginger ale.

Barr's is not so sweet as some of the alternatives, which means you can drink it straight as well as mix it with vodka (Moscow Mule) or rum (Dark and Stormy).

We bought a case to mix cocktails at a holiday party and it was a huge hit. Locally, ginger beer sells for at least $12 for a six pack, so getting this product for less than $1 per can was great. We'll buy Barr's from Amazon as often as we can.

Out of all the ginger beer's and ginger ale's I've had in my fairly long life I can honestly say that this is by far the best.  It truly is Fantastically Fiery, not too sweet and so refreshing and satisfying it fairly dances on your tongue.  I'm not sharing my case with ANYONE !!  Hope you get it in stock soon so I can order another case, the current one is going fast !!!

After trying many Ginger beers I found this product on Amazon and I'm hooked.  A bold ginger taste that soothes my addiction to ginger.  I'd recommend this product to any ginger enthusiast.  Delivered fast too!  Five stars

For me, this brand has just the right amount of zip without being too harsh.  We like it much much better than Goya.  The price was right, and with Prime it came with free shipping.  We are very happy with our purchase.

If they used a lot less sugar this might have been a good drink, however there is so much sugar in this drink that it tastes like ginger flavored sugar syrup.
Totally horrible drinking experience.
46.5 grams of sugar!
Over a ounce and a half of sugar and not a gram of salt to balance it out.
This is not Ginger beer, it's sugar beer.
If you want real ginger beer flavor, avoid Barr's Ginger beer.
This will only disappoint you.
There are much better brands available.
D & G, Soda Ginger Beer, 12-once (24 Pack)
This was a perfect mixer for our favorite mixed cocktail!  There was just enough bite and sweetness in this ginger beer. Ginger ale just doesn't cut it for a great Moscow mule!

This is a good Ginger Beer. The can speaks to it being "fiery". Well, it had a little heat. What I liked about the GB was that it was not overly sweet so it did not add to the flavours of the drinks I mixed it with. I also tried Cock n Bull, which was considerably more fiery but a little too sweet for mixing although a great GB for a stand alone drink. I liked the price and the flavour so I will order again.

I am looking for the hottest GB. So far Fever Tree Premium Ginger Beer has been the hottest. Anyone have any other recommendations?
The beer is the best of three brands i have sampled.  The cans are 330 ml which is not 12 oz as the product description says.

Recently discovered Ginger Beer. It's just like ginger ale, but more spicy and gingery (to my tastebuds anyways). I picked this up because it sounded like it was "spicy" and was a good price, but I found it to be too sweet. 42 grams of sugar per serving . . .

I like Fever-Tree Premium Ginger Beer, 6.8 Ounce Glass Bottles (Pack of 24) much better.

I had no idea what real pickling spice was until now.  Up to this point I had only purchased supermarket brands which pale in comparison.  The minute you see the bottle and open it to smell the spices inside you'll see what I mean.  My corned beef has never tasted so good!

If you like spicy snack food, this is it.  I love this product.  My favorite is the ketchup fries.  I tried the buffalo one and Wow!  Too hot, but good.  The regular ones are good.  My store will not stock up on these so I'm buying here.  These are REAL tasty.  Will buy again.  Also, they don't weight you down.  They are light and no trans fats.  Yum!
These are very good and make a great gluten free and dairy free snack. We are always looking for snacks that are like normal snack and taste good. This one works out great!

I tried the Classic baked fries with kethcup.  Had I read the ingredients first I would never have bought them.  They are made from potato flakes like pringles and I have never liked Pringles.  These tasted odd to me and we had a houseful of company and a bunch of children under age 6 and no one liked them.  I crushed them up and put them under the bird feeder and only the chipmunks would eat them.  Nothing wholesome or good about these.  Back to my delicious Cape Cod potato chips, I will never wander away from you again!
I am in love with the cheddar cheese fries.  They remind me of a long forgotten snack food of the 1980's, a spicy crunchy bag of fries, only without the spicy.  As other reviewers have said, "YUMMY!"

This review is for the Southwest Cheddar cheese fries by Snikiddy. I've tried the regular Cheddar cheese ones as well, but that's a separate review. I do have to say, the Southwest is much better than the regular flavor.

Snikiddy is an all natural brand. They use better, pronounceable ingredients. Although there still is corn content. They claim they are gluten free, vegetarian, no msg and even kosher. This particular flavor has ramped up spices in its flavoring mix. It even has white pepper, which is unusual for a snack food. But good! There's jalapeno powder too. So you can definitely tell they took the Southwest aspect of this snack seriously.

I really liked the taste of this snack. Unlike the regular cheddar, it had a tastier cheese flavor. But wow, was it ever spicy. My nose started running while I ate it because it was so spicy. But even with the spicy, you could still taste the cheese. The texture was still a little chewy while eating after the initial crunchiness, but with a better flavor it wasn't as bad. The spiciness is a little much at times, but definitely worth it for the flavor.

I really did enjoy this particular flavor of Snikiddy fries. And considering there are limited flavors of Snikiddy snacks in my area I'm glad I liked at least one of the flavors.

It's hard to find good decaf loose tea that is affordably priced and tastes good. I'm pleased to report that this English Breakfast from Coffee Bean Direct hits the mark on both counts. Excellent taste - depending on how long the steeping process, it ranges from a very light, refreshing taste that goes well as an iced tea, to a very hearty - but not bitter - taste that really hits the spot.

I've had better tasting tea, but on a cost/value basis, this is outstanding.

The downside is that, as with any decaf loose tea, you're not getting the full leaf format that our caffeinated tea brethren enjoy. This is very fine, almost powdery in consistency. This is where the higher priced teas pay off -- whilie their decaf process also results in broken leafs, it is not anywhere as fine or powdery as this.

The fine/powdery nature presents some challenges in brewing, since the typical perforated tea ball will not be suitable. I'm using a mesh tea ball and it works pretty well, albeit there is still some tea residue in the bottom of the cup. If you want absolutely zero leaf residue you'll need to use one of those tea bag systems where you put the loose tea in a bag. Those, however, are not reusable more than a few times. As usual, trade-offs.

Of greater significance is that the decaf process for this particular tea is not perfect - there is still some caffeine left. I'm very sensitive to caffeine levels, and this tea clearly has more caffeine than, for example, a bagged Lipton decaf. I'd put the caffeine level below what a regular green tea would hold, but there is still enough there to be noticeable. Again, I'm very sensitive to caffeine, so for most people I imagine that would not be an issue.

I've been trying various teas since I had to give up coffee years ago (blood pressure problems). This is the first one that I've questioned whether the dominant taste I perceive is a contaminant. The taste is quite strong, and unlike any tea I've tasted (and I have tasted a variety of English breakfasts, Ceylons, and Assams, among others). I've given it 3 tries (interspersed with pots of other tea), and established that the taste is not the water or the vessel.

I concede the possibility that some people may value this taste, but I don't. Now I'm going to compost it and move on.

There aren't a lot of choices of decaf tea that isn't prebagged, so I was happy to find this.  I put it in a coffee filter in my iced tea brewer, and it works great. It doesn't have a super-distinctive flavor, though.

The tea is amazing in taste and color. I highly recommend it.
The "dust" described in another review is due to the Co2 decaf process they use. It is a natural process that does not use toxic chemical solvents to de-caffeinate the tea leaves.
If you want a decaff tea that tastes like regular English Breakfast Tea, give this a try. You will not be disappointed with the taste.

"To decaffeinate using carbon dioxide (CO2), water-softened materials are "pressure cooked" with the gas. At high pressures and high temperatures, carbon dioxide is in a supercritical state, acting as both a gas and a liquid. It becomes a solvent with its small, nonpolar molecules attracting the small caffeine molecules. Since flavor molecules are larger, they remain intact, which is why this process retains the flavor of the material better.". "Caffeine is not removed completely using any of these methods, but under federal regulations in the United States, caffeine levels must not be above 2.5 percent of the product in order for a product to be labeled "decaffeinated."".

These anchovies are packed whole in salt, meaning that in order to bring them to the looks of filleted anchovies you are used to, you will have to clean them yourself. Depending on skill, this process takes between 20 minutes to ... maybe 1.5 hours, so be prepared to work hard for your fish. The idea is to place them under running water (from your faucet). The skin will peel and when the water hits the fish around its fin area it will make the fillets part and you could easily extract the bones. This process requires a bit of skill which can be easily gained with repetition.

On the other hand, the taste is definitely at par with that of Ortiz anchovies, making the Agostino Recca anchovies the best in the world as well. The fish is fleshy and not overly dry, and the flavor is interesting without being overpowering. The "fishy" taste also survives the salting in these anchovies.

For those of you praising anchovies in salt, I would like to recall the fact that you have a choice of the olive oil to put them in - if you like extra virgin oil with the fishes you can have it! (most anchovies sold in oil would use a lighter, less pungent oil)

Given these considerations, I recommend these anchovies wholeheartedly, but you need to know that you have to work to get them!
