I use this along with the Amazing Grass Green Superfood and several other 'health' products to keep a decent meal plan going. They are a little salty for me, I'm not a fan of salt at all though, but beggers can't be choosers here!  Even if you are busy in your everyday life these are a great pick-me-up!

I love Miso soup and wondered if this instant version would be any good. Although
it cannot compete with the restaurant soups for an instant soup it is very good and
easy and fast to prepare.

I found this soup to be tasty, but on the salty side so I added more water to taste.  Tofu in product not impressive, but the spinach is amazing the way it hydrates into spoon size pieces.  The biggest downside is the cost.  Almost $1.45 a cup is spendy for instant soup....Cup a Soup brand (at Amazon) is about $0.30.  And bouillon is about 0.05.  If you are looking for something hot then there are other choices.  Was an interesting experience though.  Seller was great and product received quickly.

I love this stuff-I think it tastes great! And I even grew up in Japan in a Japanese household with a Japanese mother who makes much better miso soup but since my mom doesn't live nearby, this is the perfect substitute for me. Don't tell my mom-she'd be horrified! I gave it 4 stars because I wish there was more tofu in it. Also I only use about 1/3 to 1/2 cup boiling water instead of 2/3 cup.
This is good for a powdered product. I prefer the separate soybean paste with a packet of dried seaweed & tofu, but this has a good flavor. A bit salty for my taste.

I love this soup it is the best tasting instant miso, except it has MSG added that is the only bad thing about it. If Kikkoman would take that ingredient out it would be almost perfect for instant miso.

I am a HUGE fan of miso soup. I've tried many of the instant miso soups thanks to my asian market. Kikkoman's Instant Miso is by far the best soup out there. It's the closest you can get to the "real" thing without actually making the soup yourself.
However, this company is selling it at a ridiculous price! I've purchase the EXACT same thing at Walmart for $1.99/package (which comes out to $0.67 per packet). This company is trying to sell them for over $3 per package (or over a $1 per packet!) - not even including shipping. I'd do my homework and buy elsewhere because this company seems to specialize in rip-offs.
I trusted the other good reviews, but this tastes awful and has a bad aftertaste.  Yuk.

I researched some of the ingredients on this item and i found that powdered bonito is a fish derivative however the ingedients listed on the page here only says powdered bonito but on the actual package it says powdered bonito(fish).I think the people who sell this item should modify the ingredient listing on this page.
Great product, good taste and texture, not much more you can say about pasta really!

These are one of the best caramels we have ever had.  They are always soft but yet come out of the wrapper easily, rich and buttery.  A real tasty treat.  My husband is very picky about his caramels and these definitely pass the test.  We have also tried the chocolate ones, which are also tasty, but prefer the regular caramels the best.

This food is definitely worth trying!  I called Hi-Tek Rations to confirm that all of their ingredients are sourced here in the USA.  They have also never had a food recall.  I love that the food is delivered to my door.  The dogs love it too!

I was looking for a less expensive alternative to Wellness Core. After doing quite a bit of research, I decided to give Hi-Tek Naturals Grain Free a try. I liked that it's protein-focused, but at the same time not ridiculously high in protein like some foods can be. I liked that the food is sourced and made in the US. (The company answered my email in under 20 minutes when I asked them about it.) I also liked that it has probiotics, and I've been able to tell from past experience that my dogs really seem to do better with foods that have probiotics as opposed to those that don't. Far fewer loose stools and upset stomachs in general. But most of all, I'm pleased that my picky dog actually likes the food. The nuggets are quite small, about the size of peas, which is fine for us but something to keep in mind if your dog likes a bigger nugget.

I have been wanting to get my dogs on a grain free diet to help with allergies and have struck out with a previous brand but my dogs love this food!  One of them actually jumps around like crazy when I start putting it in the bowl.  Great dog food for a great price.

Hi-Tec Naturals Grain Free Chicken and Sweet Potato Formula has been a real life saver. Finding a dry dog food our three Picky Pekingese would eat wasn't easy.

Our Vet suggested we try Grain Free dog food after our two year old male began to have signs of digestive problems. Also, our older female had been licking her feet (most likely allergies from something in her diet).

We tried several types of Gluten Free (dry kibble)dog food and my picky eaters wouldn't touch it. They had always been fed a small kibble mixed with a small amout of canned dog food. We also tried chicken and rice (which I prepared for them) of course they liked it. However, it didn't seem to correct the digestive problem for our little boy.

Since we discovered Hi-Tek Naturals, Grain Free, all three of our Pekingese will eat it and are doing fine. They seem to like the taste and will chew
the kibble, chewing is better for their teeth anyway.

We are former breeders of "Show Pekes" and wish we'd found this produce earlier.
Thanks, HI-TEC NATURALS from Bach Choy Pekingese

I have tried tons of these sweeteners and I really dislike aspartame as it have a funky aftertaste and is generally too sweet.  These, however, are powered by Splenda and that are terrific. There is no after taste, they are not too sweet and I do not think you can tell the difference between these and the "real" thing.  Great option for those of us trying to cut back on sugar!

I have been using this 4C Totally Light 2 Go lemonade mix with Splenda for several years.  I initially purchased it at Walmart and then when WM stopped carrying it I was getting it direct from 4C.  I'm glad I finally checked Amazon as it if half the cost versus getting it direct from 4C and paying shipping charges.  I really like the taste and when I use this lemonade mix I find that I drink more than when I recently tried to just drink plain water.  I do mix it half strength and like it fine that way.

This product was so misrepresented that I no longer use Amazon as my first choice when I'm looking for a product.  I ended up spending my gift certificate and was totally ripped off for 3 packs of nuts that I can purchase in a store for $5.  Don't be fooled by this product no matter how they try to dress it up.

Tully's French Roast is my favorite morning coffee. This supply is unusually bitter.  Since I have been buying locally in smaller quantities, I feel I have been dumped upon with old product in this purchase - and will likely toss it. Advice:  buy nearer home and check "use by" dates.  This box comes with loose K-cups inside and no date whatsoever.
My wife tried quite a few brands of K cup coffee, and finally decided on Tully's French roast as the one she wanted. Saw the great offer on Amazon, and couldn't pass it up.
Out of all the K-cups I've sampled Tully's French Roast is the tastiest, no bitter after taste, a good waker upper!
This is my favorite coffee.  I like a strongly flavored brew and this fills the bill and the "smokey flavor" is an enhancement I like.

I didn't think I was a Green Mountain Coffee Roasters fan - I usually think their coffee is mediocre, at best - but this is excellent.  I make one cup per "small" Keurig serving - and it's almost an espresso.  I love it, and I am very fussy about coffee.
I ordered this coffee because we were having guests for a week from out of town.  I knew they liked French Roast coffee.  Well it was a total success.  Great coffee and conversations.  Thanks.

This is a great option if you are looking for a bold roast K-Cup. This is my new favorite. Coffee People Organic used to be a favorite but they seemed to have quit making it or the new replacement is not as good.
I love this coffee.  I love my coffee strong and rich tasting and this fits the bill. I will definitely purchase this again.

Tully's French Roast is a solid choice and one of my staples.  This is my favorite French Roast currently available in a K-cup.  Maybe someday Peets will come in a K-cup, sigh.  One trick if you find it isn't as rich as you normally get in your favorite bistro, is to make a smaller size portion.

I'm a big time coffee drinker and I tend to like my coffee strong and Tully's French Roast blend delivers! I'm not going to go into all the details about how it taste like "this or that" because everybody's taste are different. But if you like a strong, not bitter, cup of coffee that will get you going in the morning, then this is for you.

When I want a nice strong cup of coffee, Tully's French Roast is my choice. Strong but not bitter.
I will buy it again!
strong, not much flavor, very little aroma. I tried it once, will not purchase another time. I have other similiar brands that met the standards i expected.
Best tasting coffee. Love dark roast with a bit of a bite. Can't go wrong with Tullys. Well worth the money.
Extra Bold and Smooth ! Great coffee. I'll be ordering more of this. I like an extra bold cup and this certainly fits and it is just a little better than the Tully's Italian Roast !

I prefer my coffee to be a bold Flavorful roast and this Tully's French Roast does that, and then some. I've tasted a number of different K-Cups and Tully's seems to satisfy the boldest tastes, their coffees always seem to be a little bit of heven.
For coffee lovers who enjoy a strong  cup of coffee in the morning then French Roast is the coffee for you. It has a rich bold flavor that will kick start your day.

Great coffee. I love this k-cup flavor. Delicious full bodied coffee for bold coffee lovers, doesn't disappoint. I always buy in bulk, because the price per cup decreases, but also because I KNOW I'm going to drink a lot. Love this coffee!
Excellent flavor-properly done French Roast. Smokey and rich. Sufficiently strong,  though I always think k -cups need more coffee in them.
Wonderful bold brew. Stands alone or with Hazelnut, Vanilla or half and half w/sugar or not, too. Tully's great blend! C'est Magnifique!
One of the best cups of coffee that I have every consumed at home. If you are a person that enjoys a rich and robust cup of coffee this is the one that you may enjoy.
Very Strong! Excellent taste. If you want a coffee that is full of flavor even on the largest cup size, This is the one to buy.

I give Tully's an AAA+ for marketing a great coffee. When you drink Tully's it tastes good from the first sniff to the last drop and leaves a pleasant that was real Coffee after taste.
If you like Sumatra you love Tully's French roast K cups. Please note that some people do not agree with me but to each their own. It's what makes the world an interesting place.........
Comparable flavor to Starbucks and cost much less. I don't know why anyone would buy a 12 pack. All flavors are good as well.
Ok not as good as Starbucks French roast but less expensive. Sprinkled a little cinnamon and added cream. That helped.

My husband thought the Keurig coffee maker was just another gadget, only to be used when guests wanted to make their own choice for flavored coffees.  When I purchased a small box of this  extra bold coffee, he said it was the best coffee he has ever had...home or in a restaurant!  I purchased this larger box, and he said, "Why don't we put the Keurig in the kitchen, and put our 12 cup coffee maker away"!  He is now having less cups of coffee...enjoying it much more...and absolutely no waste!

The last review I wrote was a true pan, this one is the exact opposite. My Buttered Popcorn Jelly Belly beans arrived today. They were packaged in a labeled plastic bag explaining what I got which was exactly what I ordered. The beans were fresh, tasty, had the Jelly Belly logo and splashes of yellow on each bean: just what I expected. This vendor gets top billing in my opinion.
This snack isn't a overly sweet, the outside part is like a cracker not a cookie.  And the filling is not overly orange tasting.

I read the positive reviews and I really liked the price so I ordered these rawhide chips. My yellow Labrador Retriever weighs 80 lbs and daily gets a rawhide chip (primarily Walmart generic brand) as a treat in the evening for years. My Lab will eat everything in sight (including socks) and never has stomach problems. After giving him only four rawhide chips in two days, my Lab developed a severe case of diarrhea and he's still sick after four days. He is an inside dog which makes it a real problem since he needs to go out hourly to do his business. Plus he's not feeling well and just lies around. I called the vet right away, and he recommended some immodium-type medication short term only. Since his appetite is fine and he isn't throwing up and he isn't getting any worse, his vet and I think he will be fine. The vet advised me to throw away the rest of the rawhide which I have done. I called Amazon.com and my money was cheerfully refunded which I greatly appreciate since I used the refund to buy the immodium medication.

This is just a warning to make sure you only give your dog one bone chip at a time and wait a day or so to make sure he can tolerate it. I don't know why these rawhides made my dog so sick but it could have been just a problem with this batch. I won't be buying this product again but I will definitely continue to buy from Amazon.com

My dog absolutely LOVES these... though he's not sure why. He takes them and runs circles... every once in a while he'll drop it and bark at it... then picks it up and start running again. Considering the rawhide is gone by the time I get home, I think he eventually figures it out... either that or I've got a TON of rawhide bones buried in my yard somewhere :o)
Seriously though - no extra stuff, just plain chewy rawhide fun - it's a winner in my boys eyes!

This was a very large bag of rawhide chips for the money.  The only complaint I would have is quite a few of them are just too small for my dogs to chew.  I have large dogs, so the ones that are 2" square are too small.  I would say maybe 10% of the bag contained small ones.  Still a good deal I would say.

I have been ordering these for a while.  My dogs have always liked them until the last batch.  All of a sudden, they do not like them and just leave them lying around.  I thought they smelled funny, like a chemical smell when I first opened the bag, so I called the company.  They said that they would check into it, and sent me a box of replacement dog goodies. Guess I never thought much more about it until I read some of the reviews about these chews making dogs sick.  Guess I won't buy them anymore...

they are the best thing in the world my dogs love them never been sick from them i think most of the hype of dogs being sick is made up probably from people trying to sell their own dog treats... any way my dogs love them!!!

I had ordered these rawhide chips in the past and they were terrific.  Over the past 2 months or so, they changed distributers.  Upon receiving the bag of rawhide, I opened the bag to give one to my dog and an overwhelming stench of Ammonia came out of the bag.  There was no way my dog would get one of these. I repackaged it up to send back but you CAN'T RETURN this item per Amazon policy.  So, I am out the $26.  I am so angry!!!  I wish I could give negative stars for the product and Amazon.

I have been buying this product regularly for over a year, and my dogs love them. They became unavailable for a while, and are now back, but it is absolutely not the same product as I was getting previously. The rawhides in the new bags do not seem to be of as high quality as before (they are not as white and have a different texture), and they smell VERY strongly of chemicals. If this was a solvent used in the treatment of the rawhide, I would expect it to evaporate off, but this smell persists, even leaving the bag sitting open for days.

I complained of this after the receiving the first recent bag from amazon, and they considerately sent me a replacement, but it is just as bad. I tried rinsing the rawhides well in water, which seems to help with the smell, and gave one to each of my dogs, and they loved them as much as always and showed no adverse effects. However, I don't think I can continue to use them -- the smell is really alarming.

Bernie, my 60-65 pound labrador retriever, loves these strips. I give her about 1 per day. The rawhide strips are on the order of 2-3 inches by 5-7 inches. They vary in thickness, but I'd say the majority of the strips are of slightly thin to normal thickness.

The five pound bag is resealable, though it's not the toughest of plastics. I've received some bags that have some small holes from being punctured by the rawhide strips.

The strips come from Brazil, purportedly from grass fed cows, which is excellent. I've noticed that most of the options I have in local stores are made in China. I'm not comfortable getting food products from China, given their recent past history with tainted pet foods.

The Amazon price at more than a quarter of a Benjamin feels steep, though when you consider you're getting five pounds and consider the price per pound, it's actually a good value compared to local options (at least for me).

My dog has chewed a lot of rawhide in his almost 7 years of life.  This was a great find because it was very nicely priced.  For some strange reason though, these seem to get caught in his throat.  I don't recall other rawhide posing a choking hazard like these chips.  After my dog is done with a chip, I have to fish out whatever is caught.  He's never had a serious consequence but I can't imagine what it would be like to have this chunk of rawhide lurking in the back of his throat for very long.  So, just like any other chew exercise, supervise your dog.

My dogs, two Lab mixes, love these chews.  The only problem is that the size of them is inconsistent.  The last bag I received they were all about a foot long.  The latest bag they are all about 4" - 5" long.  I think the shorter size works better because I feel the larger size is just too much and the with the smaller ones the bag will last longer.

I have a black lab/border terrier mix. She hasn't had any problems with any other rawhide (even the cheap brands). These made her violently sick with excessive vomiting and diarrhea (I was up all night taking her out every 20 minutes). This went on for 24 hours with no signs of stopping. She became severely lethargic. She wouldn't drink water or eat food and our vet decided that we should bring her in to put her on fluids because she became so dehydrated. In the end it cost $175 in vet bills. Today she is back to normal and the rawhides are at a garbage dump somewhere.

Amazon refunded our money with no problems whatsoever and I would still highly recommend them to consumers.
If your dog goes through dog chews as fast as mine do, this is a great buy!  The chews were good quality too!

What happened? We've been buying these rawhides for over a year and they were thin for the most part, but the last 2 bags the chips were so thick that I ended up giving them to dog shelters. Our dogs are labs not small dogs but the rawhides are so thick, they can't chew them. Disappointing to say the least. I wish there was a way to order them thin.

This is one of the best purchases I've ever made for my 2 dogs. They love these bones and when they eat them, they finally leave my wife and me alone for a few minutes! The bag is huge and it lasts a lot longer than any other combination of rawhide purchases I could have made somewhere else.
Paris is a Yorkie, loves me to throw the Rawhide so she can capture it. Provides hours of chewing enjoyment.
The rawhide chips are clean and easy for my older Golden Retriever to chew. She loves them. Hallanger
My dogs love these "chewies"!!  I also love them, the ones I recieved are very white, thin to medium thickness, and just right for chewing!.

We just got the package today, and five pounds of rawhide is a lot more than you might think. They are mostly thin, square or rectangular shaped pieces about 2 1/2 inches wide, of a good size for a medium-sized dog like ours. I'm not quite sure how many there are, but this bag is going to last a very long time for us. Very happy dog this evening, and I'm happy to have a more natural product and a very good price at about $5.20 per pound.

we have 3 dogs of various size (15 lbs, 50lbs, 80lbs) and they all liked different kinds of rawhide-chews until we got this bag... all 3 dogs love these!! It seems that they satisfy the desire to chew on something substantial, but are still "soft" enough that they are enjoyable the entire time (pressed rawhides can be too hard, rope/fabric toys are WAY to soft.)  great product when balanced with this price! In fact, I'm here writing a review because I'm ordering another bag... :)
bought this product several times - dogs love it - all natural and helps tremendously clean their teeth. i recommend it strongly.
My two dogs weren't crazy about these at first (they are used to flavored hides), but now they love them. Not many thick ones, but still a great value.

I love this product b/c you really get more than what you pay for.  The chewies are different sizes in the bag so my babies can pick what they want.  With 3 big dogs, I went through them alot.  It seems that this bag is so big that they last a little longer.  The best part is they are always available and super fast delivery!  Wal#@$t were always out and it would take up to 3 months before they may get 5 bags.  Dogs with chewie withdraws IS NOT fun.

This was a first purchase of this product and the description sounded great along with the price. The product I normally purchase was not available. Within a half day of having eaten just one or two of the chips my dog has developed diarreah each time (about four times now).  Definitely not normal and has not occurred with other rawhide products.  I'm sure it's this product that is triggering it.  No issues since I have discontinued using. Does have a bad odor in the bag.  I will be discarding and unfortunately can't even consider donating to rescue groups.  It's not an allergy, it's a bad quality product.

I was very happy to once again see these are available. For 5 lbs of rawhide, this is a great value!
Every night, at bedtime, my two dogs each get what they know as a 'chewie'. It's a part of their nightly routine that they really enjoy.
The rawhide sizes are perfect for the larger dog but too large for the small, 5 lb dog. To remedy this, I have cut them with a saw to a more suitable size. Works great!
Although some dogs may not be able to tolerate these type of 'treats', my dogs have not experienced any problems at all. My dogs absolutely love them!!
Three 90 lb dogs  2 goldens and a german shepherd love these. No adverse effects. They are large enough and thick enough that they do not get stuck in their throats. Great product.

We really like these chews- I should say, the dogs do. The price was great and we had it on subscribe & save- just found out it was cancelled by Amazon. :( I hope it returns soon!

We liked the variety of sizes of chips- certainly let one know these are natural products- but also because we have a big chocolate lab and a little silky terrier!! The thinner pieces made them easier to cut with penny shears for the small dog.

We never had a problem with our dogs getting sick from these chews and are very satisfied. Hope to see them back soon!

The brand I usually give my dogs has become a hit 'n miss findable item at the stores so I ordered 'Green Cow'.  I find that  My dogs still prefer the 'beef' or 'chicken' flavored chew flips they are used to and they get them when I can provide them.  'Green Cow' is a large, thick rawhide chew toss (6-7" L x 2.5-3" W).  I cut one in half using a jig saw to give to my smaller dog.  It's a bit thick for her.  'Green Cow' is a very good quality and something I trust and provide for my three dogs.

I bought this product because it is a great deal, rawhides in any brick and mortar store are outrageous, so I was very excited about this deal. However; this product makes my dog throw-up, and I know its not just rawhides in general because I have given her other ones with no difficulty. I also noticed she is not as interested in these rawhides as she has been in past brands (although this is not an issue because they as getting thrown either way. I have not contacted the seller about this yet but will be in the next couple days. I contacted amazon and they had great customer service and said they would look into the issue.

We have 8 canines of various breeds, age and size. There is no 1 size fits all for us.
These rawhide chips are the absolute best in quality we have found. The teeth cleaning ability of them is a God-send, the taste is enjoyed by our '4-paw kids', and..they last which gives them a good chewing session. I hope they come out with a smaller chip for our 'little kids' so they can have some as well. This particular product size is for larger dogs (80lb to 100+lb)which is hard to find. 1/2 the size of the original would be perfect for the smaller dogs (up to 50lb).
We love these chews and will promote them to friends and relatives as well as anyone that will listen. Our dogs love them and their teeth sparkle!
A superior product!
5 pounds of rawhides will last you quite and while, and my dog loved them! Nice and small to not fill him up too much but gives him something to do!

Honestly, we got these because it was cheaper per pound than the regular chips we buy. Our dog doesn't like them as much, but she also doesn't hate them so much that she finds other, inappropriate things to chew. One time I gave her one of these  and she took it into her bed, but fifteen minutes later I saw the chip outside her bed while she stared at it wistfully. I didn't even know dogs were capable of being wistful about a rawhide chip.

From previous reviews I worried about huge variations in size, while there some different sizes (which is good), there are very few scrapy pieces. Quality looks very good, super deal, for a little more than you would pay for 2 pounds at Walmart, you get 5 pounds of better chips

I love the green rawhide chips. The bag is large and a great dental workout for my five dogs. I also enjoy the fact that I am getting the chips as a monthly subscription. I don't have to keep remembering to order more rawhides.
I would like to know the approximate size of the rawhide chips. The last bag I received had chips that were twice the size of the chips in the previous bag.

I have been purchasing these dog chews for almost a year using subscribe and save. I have a 30 lb beagle and 75 lb Pyrenees-Brittany mix, and they both LOVE these chews. My big dog asks for one every morning. Sometimes the chews will not be cut in half (imagine a full foot long rawhide chew, instead of being cut in half down to a 6inch long chew), but that just means it keeps my dogs occupied for twice as long. I haven't seen any diarrhea or stomach issues as a result of these chews.

You get what you see - a GIANT 5 lb bag of rawhide dog chews. I've shopped around at Petsmart, Petco, Pet Supplies Plus, and my local grocery stores, and if you have a dog that likes to chew, this is going to be the most cost-effective, get-your-money's-worth option. $22 gets me rawhide chews for TWO dogs for a MONTH. You just can't beat that.
The price is excellent, the chips are big suckers though, some are longer than my dogs!! However I can cut them so it is a good deal.

The price certainly is right but for our two dog's (Lab and German Short Hair) chew treat experience nearly half of the chews are too large and much too thick. In competitor's products there are always some of the large/thick chews that I need to cut in half using a tin shears. With Green Cow many chews are so thick they will have to be sawed. We will use them up eventually but I have cancelled my subscription for periodic repeat orders. Just didn't work out for us!!
Can't believe what a huge bag of chips you get for the price.  My pitbull gets two of these every day--we have ordered them probably 6 times now.  EXCELLENT value!

My 8 year old dog and 6 month old puppy love these! I give them 1-2 per day because they love to chew. I am almost finished with the first bag and there have been no problems that other users have mentioned. Great price and the dogs love them!

My dogs get a variety of rawhide bones, from dingo's to the generic Wal-Mart rawhides. My German Shepherd and Boxer loveGreen Cow Rawhide Dog Bones, Natural Chips, 5-Pound Bag rawhide bones and with the costs of these bones skyrocketing, I was looking for a bulk pack that was affordable. I found it in the Green Cow listing here on Amazon. We ordered, and it arrived, very surprisingly, the next day. The good news is that this is a large bag and most of all, has not upset the sensitive stomach of my 120lb big GSD baby and my sweetie Boxer is very happy with her new treats. I have recommended this product to friends and family and will be ordering on a regular basis.

Unfortunately, my dog has apparently become very picky in her old age. I've bought her rawhide from various places online and in stores, but haven't, until recently, had any problems with her not wanting to eat them. These rawhide look very good. They are clean, smooth, and a good size. I've given her multiple chips because she'll eat one, and not the other. I kept trying because she would eat one, and seemed happy with it; then the next day, she would put it down and walk away.
Bottom line, I believe this to be a good product and a great value for the money. Just not sure if the issue is with the rawhide itself, or my dog's changing preferences. She didn't like the bag of rawhide I bought right before this one either.

The Green Cow Rawhide Chips are a great treat for your dog. The chips vary in size and shape, but most are about 6" long by 2.5" wide. Most of the chips are wafer-thin, but some are slightly thicker.

My 25-pound Wheaton Terrier mix gets one a day (when she's been a good girl) and she enjoys eating and tossing the treat around the house. I've been using them with her for months now and I've not had any bathroom issues with the treats. No gas or other problems either. The 5 pound bag is huge, the price is great, and the subscription service is very convenient.

Make sure that you supervise the dog when they are eating the chips as they have the ability to get stuck on the back of your dog's tongue depending on how they are eaten.

All in all...a great, simple, and tasty treat for your furry friend.
Our Corgi's & Shepherd adore these rawhide chews. They are a great price/value and I feel good knowing they are natural and not from CHINA

I've bought this item several times before, but now...

I would give this negative stars.  Used to get these on auto delivery and dog loved them. DISGUSTING! Didn't even bother returning.  Threw them out immediately.  Good-bye $26 bucks.

First off, I love the Latin American section of my Shaw's Supermarket. And I love Goya products. I decided I was going to pick up a package of them (the same one as pictured on the Amazon page) and they were delicious! Perfect amount of sweetness. And not to mention is was only 69 cents... AMAZING!

I discovered these biscuits in the States some years ago - upon returning I found only Winn Dixies the store to sell them? - Unlike the traditional Italian homedae puff pastry ones they are just as tasty , not too sweet and lovely with cheese!!

This product is very difficult to find, and it is a far superior bitter lemon than Canada Dry's. It has bits of lemon in the drink and is the perfect summertime mixer with gin, vodka, and especially rum.

I love Schweppes Bitter Lemon. The 0.5 liter is just about the right size, I seldom can drink a full can of soda at one time. The bitter Lemon seemed a little flat but I may have been subconsciously influenced by the expiration date. I bought 12 bottles and received them at the beginning of Sept 2012 and they all had an expiration date of 8/24/2012. I still have a few bottles remaining, I certainly hope the next time (if there is a next time) the expiration date will be at least 3 months.
Product was what I expected and tasted good. The quantity was perfect for the favors we needed we made 125 little favors with it.
Bought this product to fill 12 Fillable Baby Bottles Shower Favor 5" Tall - Blue. Was enough to fill 42 bottles. Good tasting candy. Would recommend this product to any potential buyers.

He brings me his Kong whenever I'm in the kitchen, without me having to ask him anymore. I put some inside and place it in the freezer for the next morning's treat. I also put a little on my finger for him to lick as a reward for bringing it to me. If he's happy, I'm happy.
The product inside of the can is probably ok, but the nozzle does not work, so my dogs will never know. I will not buy this product on line again!

I have made some dishes with sausage meat that was so tough, I had to throw the finished product out. I normally buy hog casings and make my OWN sausage when I get this frustrated but I finally realized I can just make the sausage patties and it is much easier. Italian sausage is a favorite, especially when you add the finished sausage to pasta sauce.
This seasoning takes the guesswork out of achieving that Italian taste. Saves a lot of testing different store-bought sausage and wasting time and food. There is nothing easier. Mix seasoning with pork. Let the flavors blend for awhile. Fry it up, add it to pasta or eat it by itself with peppers and onions. Put it on a roll and you'd think you were at a county fair.
The title says this is sausgage, but really it a box of salt and I have to make my OWN sausage with this overpriced box of spices.  And I was dumb enough to buy two boxes.  Don't be like me.
I have ordered the Sizzling Cinnamon Jelly Belly from this vendor twice. They have been exceptionally fresh both times. They are a favorite.

The best kippered snacks, when drained and rinsed slightly of natural oil, they taste so fresh, so pure. Best of at least several brands I've tried.SEASON No Salt Added Kipper Snacks, 3.25-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)

I had never tried them before, but they are sure delicious. I couldn't resist trying another pop-tart for such a low price. None of mine broke from the packaging but then again it wasn't shipped overseas. Definitely a good buy.

I got sweet tooth and this was a great value. Im on deployment and these things barely lasted a week. I can assure i am not overweight either.
Only downside is some came pretty destroyed. Not a product fault, just a shipping one. Be happy we live in a country where we can order food.

This product is good. It's not my favorite flavor but for those of you who love grape will enjoy this. I can't take away any stars for the product because it was fine, fresh, and good. Just not my favorite. I'll stick with the Wild Delicious Strawberry which is awesome.

P.S. I usually eat my tarts cold but this one worked better for me after 10 seconds (for two) in a microwave. Enjoy!
I personally didn't like the flavor. It tasted okay when you actually toast them, but raw it was an odd experience.
I can't find these poptarts anywhere near where I live, and amazon offers them for such a low price per unit that I had to buy them.

This product is portrayed as healthy and natural, but I was shocked and dismayed to see that it's shipped from halfway across the world. I understand buying electronics, shoes, etc. from China, but my FOOD? I doubt the safety of this food product, and don't see how they can guarantee that  it's vegan, non-GMO, dairy free, wheat-free, gluten-free, etc. Plus I don't see the point in purchasing something that has obviously left such a hefty carbon footprint. But beyond that, how hard is it to make a delicious snack like this in the USA, from USA-grown ingredients? Seriously?

I didn't notice the very tiny imprint on the package that says Made in China until AFTER I had ate this "healthy" treat.  It did taste very good, I must admit, but after seeing the ingredients and then where it is made, I plan on making my own Pumpkin Crunch.  Shouldn't be too hard!

We like pretty much all of the Mrs. May's snacks, esp. being a gluten-free family, but this is definitely the favorite of all four in our family (the children being ages almost 3 and 6). The cranberry blueberry and almond are close, but this is the best!

They looked healthy any I bought some at Costco.  I got them home and read on the back (in tiny text) "Product of China."  What the H*ll?  They have poisoned our pets, poisoned our toothpaste... do we really need them attempting to make our "health food"?  Not to mention the fact that China allows sweatshops, child labor, and nothing short of slavery. Then there is the whole communism issue.  Do not buy this product unless you can live with the risks and your conscience!

The tree arrived quickly and is in perfect health. The one I received was pot bound and needed a haircut but a quick root and stem trim and this problem was solved. The rosemary is a great little tree to have in a kitchen. It smells nice, is easy to care for and you can pinch off a bit to use in cooking.

Update August 2011 - This little guy is still going strong. I have had a issue with aphids at least twice but I sprayed the plant with soapy water and they went away. I don't want to use insecticide and especially not the systemic stuff since we use the rosemary in our food.
This is a very tasty, powdered instant decaf chai tea mix. It blends easily and well and tastes delicious. i like to take a few packets when I travel
Another beautiful item from Light Garden.  I have never been disappointed in an item purchased from this manufacture.  High quality and lasts for years.

The lamp is beautiful and much admired by our visitors.  The only problem I had was that I needed to purchase a power supply transformer to use it in NZ costing NZ$45.  The lamp still only cost me a total of NZ$180 though and a similar but slightly bigger tree in a local gift shop is $900.

I love my lighted tree.  It is beautiful and I've gotten tons of compliments on it.  My only wish is that it had a switch to turn it on.  Having to plug it in (in the particular location I have it) is inconvenient.  Other than that, I absolutely love it.  In fact, I ordered the red one after I had already bought the white one.
The adapter was missing and one of the holders to the pot was missing and the package was ripped and poorly packaged and shipped. I returned it and was refunded.

This product arrived very well packed. The branches are all compressed together when removed from the box so some artful shaping is required. The stems seem to be made of malleable wire wrapped in brown florist tape. The flowers are cut from some material (silk?) and mounted around each of the tiny "grain of wheat" lamps. The power supply is a relatively large and heavy wall-wart that will tend to slip out of the outlet. My outlets are old and I had to use a short stub of an extension cord so the power supply could lie on the floor rather than hang from the wall.

When illuminated, the tree is really lovely. The light is fairly dim and it makes a perfect accent piece in a darkish room. My sole concern at this point is how long the bulbs will last. As the package insert notes, they are not replaceable.

If you have a corner that needs an Asian accent, this could be it.

The chocolates were melting when they arrived, but that was the least of the problems.  There was nothing gourmet about the small box of chocolates we received.  I'd suggest finding a better chocolate of the month club because there must be reasonable alternatives.

Excellent cinnamon flavor. It keeps me going all year long especially when Starbucks runs out of my pumpkin spice. It is my favorite flavor and brand. I did have to order it
on-line because I only found it once at a store. It's a seasonal type of an item so on-line works best.

These are like rice cakes but tastier and more satisfying. They are extremely light (as in weight) but still hold up pretty well against dip. I really like the flavor and they're a great substitute when the rest of the family is having chips. The texture is pleasant and they have a great crunch. I'd definitely recommend this to dieters.

We have three dogs, and have limped along with different types of bedtime treats. These are the biggest hit ever, and their cinnamon smell is delicious. Our dogs will do anything for one of these treats. I highly recommend them!
The fern was packaged well and arrived in healthy shape, and was exactly as described. Would order from this vendor again!
was wonderful, fresh, exactly as described.  Will definately buy again!  my pig mastered it in about a week!

My dobermans love Yuppy Puppy. The enclosed pamphlet says it can take up to two weeks for your dog to learn how to work it, but that is probably an exaggeration as food is a great motivator. One of my dogs learned how to use it in under five minutes, using her paw, the other took about a day and prefers to use her snout to depress the lever. I tried to teach her with her paw but she learned her own way to do it. It is cute to watch them and is much anticipated when I say "Work the Machine!" Product is built sturdy for heavy use by mongrels and stays in place well. Doesn't tip over. Highly recommended.

Has a nice unique nutty taste, I thought this was a new cheerios flavor, but it's something altogether different.

Each piece of cereal has small little nuts on it, is very crunchy, and maintains freshness.

I tend to eat healthy cereal, so I likely won't switch to this, but as a snack it is quite good.

I am usually not a fan of sweet cereals, but I saw this new cereal from Kellogg's and it looked so good I decided to try it. It is reminiscent of Honey Nut Cheerios (HNCs), though I have only had that product once several years ago. Nutritionally, they are very similar (I looked up the nutritional data on the HNCs at their website). This product has 1 more gram of sugar than the HNCs and a little less fat than HNCs, but otherwise the nutritional data are very close.

I tried Crunchy Nut both as a cereal with milk and alone as a snack and enjoyed it both ways. As a snack, I found it a bit too sweet but still enjoyable due to its intense crunch. With milk, the sweetness was much less pronounced and I enjoyed it more. It holds up GREAT to milk. The downside of it staying so crunchy in milk is that the roof of my mouth got abraded a bit by the roughness of the nut bits. The milk gets colored a strange caramel color that was off-putting to me at first, but it wasn't a big deal.

I went through this box like lightning! I do eat cereal most every day for breakfast but I don't usually go through a box that quickly. Of course, I was also eating it as a snack in the evening, so that was part of the reason. Another is that this box is considerably smaller than the boxes of the cereal I usually eat (regular Cheerios, Complete Wheat Bran, Crispix). The box I had was 10.8 oz.

Note that I did not order this cereal through Amazon--I bought it at my local supermarket--as such, this is only a review of the cereal itself as I can't speak to the seller or the shipping. I do note that this product is not sold by Amazon itself but by another seller and that there are shipping charges. I always advise Amazon customers to be very aware of these shipping charges when buying from other sellers, as sometimes they are more than the cost of the product iself.

I liked this cereal.  When I opened it, the smell reminded me of Cracker Jacks, I suppose due to the corn & peanuts.  The combination of corn & oats was delicious & the lightly sweetened peanut flavor was a plus.  I'm not a huge fan of overly-sweetened cereals, and I found this cereal to be sweetened just enough.  It stays crispy in milk long enough for you to finish the bowl without the final spoonfuls being a soggy mess.  I docked them one star, however, because I found that many of the small peanut pieces had come off of the "O's" in transit & settled to the bottom of the package.  I'm not sure how they could be adhered better to the "O's" without adding additional sugar, however, so I suppose this was to be expected some what.

Seriously, how do you review a cereal? Let me take a swing at it.

Essentially, these are Honey Nut Cheerios with a little added crunch from nut like pieces (not sure if they are real nut pieces as they do not quite have the appropriate texture) adhered to the corn/oat meal donuts. They stay crunchy in milk longer than Cheerios but the flavor seems about the same. As far as nutrition, this is a sweetened cereal with all of the added RDA of vitamins and minerals associated with breakfast cereals. I find nothing disagreeable about this cereal, but the crunchiness brings to mind the 'non-nutritive coating' of Chevy Chase from Christmas Vacation.

Ultimately, it is all about the flavor of the cereal and whether it appeals to you, as most cereals of this sort are comparable. Try it, if you like it buy more, if not go back to your other favorites. P-)

I love Honey Nut Cheerios. One of my favorite cereals of all time. So I was intrigued by the new Crunchy Nut Roasted Nut and Honey from Kellogs. I tried it first as dry cereal and was less than impressed. The cereal is corn based so it had the aftertaste similar to Corn Pops cereal after the honey flavor wore off. I believe Cheerios are whole grain and oats so there is a very distinct taste difference.

After trying them with milk, I am much more impressed with the cereal. They stay crispy for a long time (much longer than Cheerios) and the flavor is very nice. The corn overtones are more subtle when mixed with milk so I get a similar taste to Honey Nut Cherios but with a hint of different flavor due to the corn base. It is very nice but this will not replace my Cheerios anytime soon as I prefer the whole grain and oats based cereal.

What's funny about me getting this cereal is that almost the same day my package arrived from Amazon, my wife had gone out food shopping and came back with a box of this cereal to try. So we now have multiple boxes of this which should last a while!

They look like puffy Cheerios covered in tiny bits of crushed peanuts and they definitely have the taste of roasted peanuts with a bit of sweetness. They stayed crunchy till the very bottom of the bowl, so the cereal seems to live up to its name of Crunchy Nut Roasted nut and Honey.

Overall, I found this to be a pretty satisfying cereal. If you like the taste of roasted peanuts, I think this is a pretty good choice. Just like Cheerios, they taste pretty good both with and without milk so they make a pretty good snack on the good too.

This new cereal from Kellogg's is another winner, in my opinion.
Kellogg's cereals has been a staple in our household for generations. This new cereal is a worthy addition to their lineup.
It's made from corn and oats in the familiar "O" shape. The "O's" are topped with roasted peanuts an lightly sweetened with honey.
In milk the cereal stays crunchy and is quite tasty. The sweet taste is just enough for me, not overly sweet.
It is good for you with 2 grams of fiber and protein and vitamins and minerals.

I've tried the flakesKellogg's Crunchy Nut Golden Honey Nut 14.1 oz and those are good too.

I've got a confession to make - I like cheerios. The good old fashioned original cheerios. However, I try to keep an open mind and am always up for an improvement. This wasn't it. The cereal isn't bad, it's just not that good. It's like cheerios but slightly sweeter. Not enough to make a real difference, just enough to get noticed. For the extra sugar content, it's definitely not worth it. The nuts that are supposed to be in here are completely invisible to my palette. If you want a sweet cereal, just eat honey nut cheerios. If you want a non sweetened cereal, just eat cheerios. This hybrid falls far short of both.

I was expecting this cereal to have the texture of Cheerios, but it is more like Capt'n Crunch. The peanut bits are barely visible stuck on the little o's, and really don't add any peanutty flavor. Since its name is "Crunchy Nut" I expected at least some peanut flavor, which I did not get, so I deducted one star for that.

Having said that, though, I like this cereal, both dry and with milk. It's crunchy and sweet. What it isn't, tho, is health food, and I don't expect it to be. What it is, is a crunchy sugar rush, perfect for when I have such a craving.

I am not a big fan of presweetened anything! This product is exactly what it says it is and what I expected when I tasted it. It stands up to milk and keeps its crunch until its entirely consumed and for me thats important. I could not eat this everyday but I cant think of any product that I could! My Grandson loves it for his snak but I dont give it to him on a regular basis as I think its got too much sugar for a regular diet. All and all I think this is as good as any presweetened cereal I have had but I couldnt eat it more than a couple times a month. This cereal has the same major flaw that all box cereals seem to have, they use a box liner that is not resealable and this limits there shelf life after opening. I think that some day one of the mfg will figure this out and make the liner resealable like the ziplock bags that maney bulk frozen foods come in.

Upon first opening the box, I noticed it has a peanut butter like smell. It reminded me faintly of Crackerjacks. The cereal is crunchy and lightly sweet. Depending on your opinion on sugar, you could find this too sweet or not sweet enough. The airy consistency reminded me of Kellogg's Pops. I liked that they remained crunchy from start to finish.

I would say that it needs more nuts to carry off the "Crunchy Nut" name. There are probably the flakes of like ten peanuts in this entire box. It doesn't taste very nutty at all. I think the airy consistency would have been nicely complimented by the solid crunch of whole nuts.

The cereal has a 100 calories, 10 g of sugar, 1 g of fat, and 11 g of carbs. It has no more than 25 percent of any vitamins or nutrients. The taste is obviously the best feature. It's pretty good. By the time I finish the box, I might like it better. I would buy it if it were on sale at my local supermarket.

I am beginning to think all Honey & Nut cereals are the same. I did not find Kellogg's Crunchy Nut cereal to be any different in taste from the other leading brands. It has the same sweetness, crunchiness and texture as the others. I would suggest reading the nutrition facts to compare this cereal to your usual brand of honey & nut cereal to see if one is nutritionally better. According to the box, a serving is 3/4 of a cup of Crunchy Nut cereal and contains 140 calories with 1/2 cup of fat-free milk. Each serving holds 1g of fat, 125mg of sodium, 23g of carbs (10g from sugars), and 2g of protein.

On a side note, I am finding Amazon to be in line with grocery store prices, especially if you sign up for automatic deliveries and purchase in bulk. I have been pleasantly surprised with the grocery orders I have placed. Everything has arrived fresh and safely packaged.

If you like Captain Crunch, it's a bit like that, only maybe a little more crunchy and shaped like Cheerios. I did like that it didn't get mushy in milk and had a good crunch to it, but I wasn't a fan of the taste. I must admit I was never a fan of Captain Crunch cereal either, so if you like that, you'll love this.

This cereal is tasty, but it's mostly sugary not nutty and there is a bit of an aftertaste to it.  The actual cereal doesn't look like on the box with lots of nuts on each piece.  It's really hard to detect a nutty taste at all.  My husband ended up just packing some in a baggy with his lunches and ate them with coffee to balance out the sugary taste.  If you like sugary cereals, you'll probably enjoy this more than we did.  There are 23 g of carbs per 3/4 cup and 10g of sugars.  The first ingredient is yellow corn meal and the second is sugar...that tells you enough right there.

Three members of our household tried this cereal, and in general it met with favorable evaluations. Only one of us pours milk on cereal and he was impressed that even after 5 minutes it still remained crunchy - probably because of the sugar coating. The other tester has the philosophy that nothing is ever sweet enough and this met their criteria (yellow corn meal is the first ingredient and sugar is the second). The third tester was a bit disappointed that there was not as much of a peanut flavor as they expected. The cereal pieces are not as textured with peanut slivers as they look on the box picture.

We all came to the conclusion that we would buy it, except for the price that it is presently listed at ($29.95 + $7.71 for 4 boxes). That seems a bit high for many budgets.

As soon as I got this I opened it to taste it, very crunchy and sweet. I like to carry this kind of tid bit to nibble on while I am out and about. I even gave a few to my dog, he liked it, but he'll eat anything.
In the morning I tried it with milk, I am not a cereal person but this appealed to me because it seemed like it would have a Cheerios flavor, it does not. The only problem, which is why I am not a cereal person is the sweetness, it is too sweet. The longer it lingers in the milk the more sugar oozes out. I had to pour out some milk and add fresh to cut the sugar. I must say it stays crunchy in milk, after 6 minutes the crunch was still there. So if you like crunch this one is for you. The tiny nuts fall off and they are a treat at the end of the bowl. All in all it is not a bad product but I am afraid it did not do it for me.

"February made me shiver," sang Don McLean when remembering our loss of Buddy Holly. As a blizzard moved into the Midwest this February, and freezing temperatures took over, the shivering started.

Proper planning would have supplied me with a broader range of food before the storm, but... that's the thing. I didn't. Snowed in, I could not leave. The United States Postal Service, however, was undaunted, however, and left the box of Crunchy Nut Roasted Nut and Honey at my doorstep, thanks to Amazon.com. Though not starving, I appreciated the newness of the cereal, different from my usual Cheerios, Apple Jacks and raisin bran. Would it be different enough to add to my routine?

Like as when manna came for the Israelites, I gave thanks. While watching "The Thin Man" series the next morning, I ate the cereal dry (as I usually do), reaching into the box as if it were popcorn.

What's In A Name?

* The crunch: loud and grinding, much like the sound of a dog eating a Milk Bone.

* The roasted nut: reminiscent of other cereal peanut butter flavors.

* The honey: I never tasted honey. I tasted a sweet undertone, but not distinctly honey.

* The 10.8 ounces: One box. It took three movies to finish.

I enjoyed the Crunchy Nut Roasted Nut and Honey, but cannot say I found it distinguished from any other cereal. The flavor is underwhelming, but adequate. I may have it in rotation, but it will not be a staple. May your coldest days be warmer with a good breakfast, excellent mail delivery, and Myrna Loy.

--Brockeim

This is not the kind of cereal that would ever be a staple in our house but the kids liked it well enough. The texture is good and doesn't get slimy like Cheerios does after sitting in the milk for a bit. Kind of an airy, crunchy puff. It was sweet enough that the kids enjoyed it without pouring on extra sugar but not so sweet that I couldn't sit down and eat a bowl myself. I would definitely consider buying it on occasion in the future.

i ordinarily eat plain cheerios or oatmeal for breakfast, so trying this cereal was like having a candy bar for breakfast.  that being said, i think this crunch nut cereal resembles honey nut cheerios in appearance, but the flavor is more like that honey smacks cereal.  i thought it was very sweet (but that might be because of what my usual breakfast is), and did not notice any nut flavor at all.

It is difficult to explain what exactly this new cereal tastes like. It's good, crunchy, and sweet. Definitely corn-based. It is closest in flavor to corn chex cereal with a dash of honey and slight nut flavor. It doesn't taste like a healthy cereal (bland and boring) nor is it as sweet as a kid's cereal. The perfect balance between the two will leave you satisfied and happy mouthed. I would recommend it as a good step between getting yourself or your kids off the sugary cereals and yet better tasting that the bladn healthy flake cereals.

This new cereal from Kellog's look like a cross between Cheerios and a miniaturized donut! The picture on the box (no surprise) is exaggerated, and while you don't need a microscope to see the nut pieces on the actual cereal, they are quite small.

They do deliver on the crunchiness and as the honey name suggests, these are sweet but not as sweet as their Crunchy Nut cousin, the Crunchy Nut Golden Honey Nut, 14.1-Ounce (Pack of 4). There are 10g of sugar per serving and 11 servings per box. Assuming of course you have the self-control to measure and eat one serving per day.

On their own, these are perhaps too sugary if you are health conscious or count calories/sugars, but as with other sweet/sugary cereal, you don't have to fill your cereal bowl with just one type of cereal. Mixing these with some of the healthier sugar-less cereal can still give you some taste, sweetness and crunchiness, but without the sugar overload. That's what gets them four stars.

I grew up with a working mother who left the house before I got up for school, so I ate cereal five days a week, every week, until I graduated from high school, so I feel that I am qualified to judge the quality of any cereal.

This latest product from Kellogg's is quite a good cereal, with just the right taste and a crunch that is very satisfying. It doesn't get soggy in milk, but I enjoyed it so much and ate it so fast that I really couldn't tell. Bottom line: I found it to be a very good cereal and think that you will also. I will definitely be purchasing this cereal for myself in the future.

My 8 and 9 year old kids uprated this cereal from a 3 to a 4 after the second day of eating it. Originally, my son said it tasted good but "didn't have that pop of excitement" he got from some other cereals (I don't know where he got that phrase). My daughter pointed out that it tasted somewhat like Captain Crunch, due to the fact the Crunchy Nut "O"s are coated with the same kind of crunchy coating. The second day of eating them, my son couldn't get enough, saying he was addicted to them. The fact the kids like them is great. Myself, I wasn't so excited. They seem like the kind of cereal I have seen before. They aren't bad; I can taste the nuts and honey, but I don't think I'd eat them on my own. One thing to note is that the crunch is not produced by the nuts but by the coated "O"s.

I'm not a huge cereal nerd having grown up on a steady diet of mostly Müslix and Kix, with only the occasional box of Trix or Captain Crunch in the cupboard. Though there are six million varieties of cereal products on the shelves, I pretty much stick to the occasional box of Raisin Bran or Honey Nut Cheerios, but of the brands that I do eat I have some very specific likes and dislikes. When I picked this box of Crunchy Nut I was skeptical that it would actually deliver on it's namesake, being crunchy and nutty. For my taste I find that the various nutty cereals usually don't have a very strong nut taste, and the "crunchy" varieties tend to lose all their bite after a few seconds in milk.

Lo and behold my surprise when I tried the other variety of Kellogg's brand cereal in flake form and it delivered wholeheartedly on both accounts. This variation, the O's, on the other hand is only slightly crunchy and not very nutty in flavor at all. I've read a lot of complaints that the Crunchy Nut flakes are too sweet, this is one area where the Crunchy Nut O's excel in that they have a much better balanced sweet flavor.

Overall though I found them to be pretty bland. They aren't coated with all that many peanuts and they lasted (crunch-wise) only a little longer than Honey Nut Cheerios or Fruit Loops before getting soggy. They're not bad, but not great either. Probably wouldn't buy them again which is a shame since I enjoyed the flakes version of Crunchy Nut so much...

I'm nuts about nuts, so I did like the nutty taste of this cereal. While it was a little on the sweet side, it was tolerable. The cereal did not get soggy in milk and was true to its "Crunchy" label. The box had the word "honey" on it, but the product contains more sugar than honey in its ingredients. All-in-all, I liked this cereal and would recommend that you give it a try. But for those averse to too much sweetness, it may not be what you're looking for.

The packaging for Kellogg's new CRUNCHY NUT cereal gives one the impression that it would be that company's version of the General Mills cereal, CHEERIOS, perhaps even the "honey nut" version. This cereal is much different, however. It is made of both corn and oats, and the corn flavor dominates. While there are some nut slivers on the rings, the nut flavor is overwhelmed by the cereal's sweetness, which tastes a great deal like the Kellogg's CORN POPS cereal. Further, the texture of the rings reminds me a great deal of Quaker Oats' CAP'N CRUNCH pieces, which is another corn/oats cereal. If you like a sugary, corn-flavored buzz, this cereal is for you. My personal preference is not for this kind of the cereal. My rating comes from my dissatisfaction with the flavor of the product and the vague packaging of what tastes most like a cereal intended to satisfy craving for sweets.

Since flavor can be so subjective, I will try my best to draw comparisons.  The new Crunchy Nut cereal is similar to Honey Nut Cheerios size.  They're slightly sweeter than Honey Nut Cheerios but with milk added, the flavor reminds me to Corn Pops.  And it's definitely sweeter than your Honey Bunches of Oat available at Costco in the 2 pack.  This cereal doesn't get soggy as fast as Corn Pops or Honey Bunches of Oat.  It's also 100 calories per serving.  I'm more of a Special K with Strawberries type of guy so I enjoy a little sour/fruity flavor along with my sweet cereal.  I hope this review helps in your decision whether to try it or not.

We regularly eat cereals both as breakfast of my champions (2 boys and a little princess), and occasionally as snacks. They like them mixed with milk in the morning and dry at other times. The one I can think it is more comparable to is Cheerios, except it looks twice as big, glazed and sprinkled with peanuts.

Some interesting comparisons between Crunchy Nut and Cheerios (identical servings of 3/4 cup):

Crunchy Nut has 110 calories, while Cheerios has 100 calories
5% vs 7% sodium
1% vs 3% potassium
8% vs 7% carbo
Same dietary fiber content

For allergy concerns:

Crunchy Nut has peanuts, wheat, traces of soybeans, and may contain tree nuts.
Cheerios has almonds and may contain wheat ingredients.

It tastes great. Only time will tell if it will also be a regular staple in this household.

I was expecting these to be like Honey Nut Cheerios, which I also like. These actually were different. Not necessarily better, but different. More of a nut taste (I suppose that explains the name). They are not as sweet tasting as some similar cereals (though the sugar content is about the same). They also make a good snack dry.

Personally I found these to be a nice change of taste and liked them quite a bit. So did my son (11), who ended up having it as a second dinner if he was still hungry but did not want a desert. My wife, however, did not like them, so obviously they are not for everyone.

I will be buying this cereal again.

I'm a daily cereal consumer. My wife is a health fanatic so I eat mainly organic cereal with very little sugar and as little refinement as possible. So that being said it was a treat to be able to try Kellogg's Crunchy Nut cereal. With 10g of sugar per 3/4 cup serving it is quite a bit sweeter then I'm used to. (Compare with Kellogg's Fruit Loops at 12g of sugar per 1 cup serving). Although it looks like Cheerios with nuts on it, it is not - the texture is heavier and crunchier and the taste is completely different. The nuts add a nice touch even though it would probably taste great without them. The vitamin content is quite high which means they probably fortified the cereal although I see nothing on the box that states this.

As I said I enjoyed trying this cereal but knowing my wife (bless her heart) she won't be buying this cereal for me any time soon. I'll be sticking to the healthier varieties but at least I know I'm cared for.

Don't get me wrong, this cereal tastes delicious. It has a nice crunchy texture, good nutty flavor, and a sweet glaze. If you buy cereal just for the taste, this is like gourmet Honey Nut Cheerios. Very delicious.

That said, it is not as vitamin enriched as some other cereals that have similar amounts of sugar, so the trade-off for the sugar is not as good. Crunchy Nut has 10 grams of sugar per 3/4 cup serving. Malt O Meal Honey Nut Scooters has 10 grams per 1 cup serving--totally comparable. But Scooters has more calcium, and zinc, and twice the iron and folic acid.

Also, Crunchy Nut costs about 3 times as much as Scooters.

My advice: If taste is king over any other consideration, buy this cereal. If not, there are other more nutritious, economical options.

This product was not bad, but was disappointing. The box promises "roasted nut and honey." While I could detect the "honey" flavor, rendered as a glaze more reminiscent of sugar than honey, there is little to no nut flavor. In deed the product image shows each "O" covered in nuts and promises, "nuts in every bite," the actual appearance is much different with no visible nuts on the cereal.

The texture is fine. The crunch holds up in milk. It is more of an airy texture than say a dense Cheerio. More the texture of Honeycomb brand cereal.

Nutritionally this product is mediocre. Again not bad, but could be better. Sugars rack in at 10g, less than many sugar sweetened cereal but still high. Fiber is 2g which is something, but a bit low. 1g of fat is gaood and none of it saturated or trans fat.

I will finish the box, but will not by more of these again.

When I tried this cereal right out of the box with no milk, it tasted pretty good. And really sweet. When I tried it with milk, it again tasted pretty good, but after awhile the cereal gave the milk an after taste that was a little different. Some flavor in the cereal leeched out into the milk and made it taste a little off.

Overall, this cereal isn't bad, but it really doesn't have anything that's much different from many other cereals already on the market. I tend to eat cereals that are a lot less sweet (like Cheerios) so I'll pass on this one.

I wasn't too fond of this cereal in any way. Out of the box, it has a strange, artificial butterscotch color. If it only tasted like butterscotch, I could forgive this unusual shade. But Crunchy Nut Roasted Nut & Honey is far from Kellogs' best effort! The cereal was rather bland, and the promised crunch reminded me only of the familiar "Captain" cereal of the same name. I just did not get the nut and honey experience that is available in other brands. As a new cereal on the market, this cereal won't last long, I predict. It isn't anything different than those that have been around awhile, those that present this variety much, much better. Also . . . Vine clearly stated "10.8 oz. pack of four" and I just received one box. Not that I miss it, but I at least could have given the promised remaining three to my sons who are in college. (There was no disclaimer that Vine reviewers would receive only one box.)

If you are looking for crunch...this is your cereal! I haven't had a cereal this crunchy since I ate Captain Crunch as a kid. It was almost too crunchy for me. The crunch overwhelmed the taste, which was a bit lacking. I was hoping for a full nutty taste but the nutty taste just wasn't what I expected. I get more nuttiness out of Honey Nut Cheerios to be honest. I don't think I'll eat this with milk as a cereal again but I may try it as a coating and batter for french toast.

This is a very tasty new cereal that tastes good either in milk or alone. It looks similar to Cheerios, but is crusted with peanuts. It has a nice peanut and honey taste and does not require any additional sweetner.

I do wish that this product had more oat flour and less sugar though. As is, I'm not sure what group they are trying to sell to. My 5 year-old liked it alot, but the marketing does not look geared towards that age-group. The over 30 group likes a little more fiber and less sugar in their cereal. I liked it, but probably will not get again, because of the above reasons.

Overall i like it though it is little bit too sweet for me. I know there are other cereals out there with even more sugar. The nutty flavor comes from peanuts. I would prefer something like almonds. The fiber content is good. The sweetness is probably not to make it taste like cardboards.

My family and I tried this product, and most of us quite enjoyed it. Only one child was not keen on eating it, but the other two gobbled it up. I thought it had a nice flavor, a little different than what I would normally buy.

UPDATE: Tried my second bowl today, and it is growing on me, so I bumped my rating from 4 to 5. Also, my wife tried it and loved it. She is normally a very picky eater, so that is a tough standard to meet. If they stock this at our local store, it may become a regular purchase for us.

These look like Cheerios, but taste like they are lightly covered in molasses and honey, with a little sprinkling of tiny oat and peanut slivers--sweet, but not sugary and are not too sweet. They are corn O's, crunchy and delicious and taste great right out of the box as a snack, or with milk. They leave a nice taste residue in the milk too, in case you like to drink the milk after you eat the cereal out of it. My taste buds tell me this cereal ROCKS! and will be a HIT!

Ingredients listed, in order on the box: yellow corn meal, sugar, corn bran, peanuts, honey, molasses, salt, whole oat flour, caramel color, baking soda, etc.

For 3/4 cup serving of cereal only: 100 calories, 1g fat, 0mg cholesterol, 125mg sodium, 25mg potassium, 2% protein, total carbs 23g (which include10g sugar/2g dietary fiber/11 other carbs).

Vitamin/mineral content at 10% each: Vitamins A, C, D, Zinc.
At 25% each: Iron, Thiamin, Riboflavin, Niacin, B6, B12, Folic Acid.

For those with allergies:
"CONTAINS PEANUT AND WHEAT INGREDIENTS, CORN USED IN THIS PRODUCT CONTAINS TRACES OF SOYBEANS, MAY CONTAIN TREE NUTS."

But, if all you want to know about is the taste, then yes, it is DELICIOUS!!!

First thing I did after tasting these was compare them to Honey Nut Cheerios. Although the nutrition facts are almost identical what really surprised me was that the Kellog's Crunchy Nut did not taste as sweet as the Honey Nut Cheerios. So in terms of flavor these are a hit.

Now the bad part. Go look at the list of ingredients...

Kellog's Crunchy Nut: "YELLOW CORN MEAL, SUGAR, ..."

Honey Nut Cheerios: "Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, ..."

Enough said...

What do you get when you combing Cheerios with Honey Smacks and peanuts? You get this - and it actually sounds good. Unfortunately the combination of the flavors is just okay. Not great, and I'm not sure it is even good. There is a weird cloying aftertaste, and the cereal feels too dry, the individual pieces too large, and too crunchy. It just wasn't for me. The kidlets think it is okay but prefer Honey Nut Cheerios or even Raisin Bran (my fave) to this - and that's not a good sign.

Bottom Line: YMMV, but I won't be replacing this box with another one.

These do not pretend to be like Cheerios. They are a completely different texture...very crunchy, with a nice amount of sweetness (more sweet than, say, Honey Nut Cheerios...much less than the super-sugar-coated cereals I'm trying to avoid). The sweetness comes from sugar (the 2nd ingredient) and honey and molasses...no corn syrups.

For me, these will make a nice evening snack...and for my son: breakfast.

One note: I don't care how much the picture on the box is "enlarged to show texture", the truth is that the depicted texture is exaggerated...not just enlarged. My son commented on this right away, noting that the box makes it look like there are BIG pieces of nuts on the cereal. There are pieces, no doubt, but nothing close to what is pictured. I still give the cereal 5 stars...I really like the taste (and the texture). It's just not quite what's pictured.

I was excited to try this cereal.  It is low in sugar (10g) and the calories per serving are reasonable (100 calories per 3/4 cup).  I loved the initial taste, but the after taste was a bit too sweet.  When you first taste it, the cereal is crunchy and nutty. However, it becomes too sweet after a couple of spoonfuls.  If it weren't for the after taste, I would rate this cereal 5 stars.  In good faith, I must tell you that I'm a runner and don't like sugary cereals (I usually buy Kashi's Go Lean cereals)- so if you don't mind a sweet after taste this may work for you.

My teens loved it, my husband and I did not. The younger ones liked the extra crunchy peanut taste. Of course what they liked the most was the sweetness. My son felt it had more of a honey taste than sugary and I would agree. They commented that they would like it more as a snack out of the box then in cereal. They still felt that Honey Nut Cheerios was much better tasting with less aftertaste.
I thought I was eating caramel corn which I can only tolerate once in a great while and in small doses. What I was hoping for was that Kellogg's would of listened to all the latest media hype about too much sugar. They didn't. This is way too sweet. I also wish they had used almonds or walnuts in this cereal. The protein to this cereal is only 2g per 3/4 cup. My teens may purchase this on their own but I will not be. I will continue to eat plain Cheerios, adding our own nuts to get some breakfast protein.

Open the box and the aroma will hit you! Its a delicious smell, like honey roasted nuts. The "O"s are smaller than cheerios and much cruchier. The honey flavor is throughout the O and not just a coating on the outside. The actual O tastes somewhat like a corn pop, only much crunchier, and with a hint of nut flavor.

Eat this out of the box and your hands won't be sticky like they are with the cheerios version. They make a great snack. Eat them in a bowl of milk and they hold up well against the milk and do not get soggy.

This is a great cereal that I will be sure to have in my pantry from now on.

This is the perfect cereal for peanut-lovers - little round o's covered with a sweet and crunchy peanuty layer, these are great as a bowl of cereal or even just as a snack out of the box.  My 3 year old was enjoying them as a snack on the go, and they were perfect to start the morning with.  Great tasting, definitely will purchase these when I see them in the store.

After trying to search for the "nuts" in as detail as the picture on the packaging for a while, I decided my eyes are not to blame.  The peanuts are almost invisible -though seemingly they add to the crunch.  For the relatively small package size (10.8 oz), low nutrition value (2g protein, 10g sugar) and the fairly high listed price - this product's value is questionable.  A relatively OK substitute for Cheerios if you want a change, but to make this a default choice may be only because you REALLY liked the taste and not worried about the low nutrition.  Overall, this product is not going to make me switch my cereal loyalties.

I will not lie. I love the taste of this cereal. Love it. I opened the box and it was all I could do to put it down. Yummy.

But...the sugar content is high. Way high. So as much as I love the taste, can I really see eating it on a regular basis? No. Giving it to kids? only if you want to peal them off the ceiling.

But I do love it...

I had high hopes for this cereal, as I am a big peanut fan. However, while the cereal itself is "not bad" it's lacking in many areas.

First and foremost it's not made with whole grains like Honey Nut Cheerios is. Another reviewer put it nicely when they said this is equivalent to eating candy for breakfast. The amount of sugar and refined carbohydrates is way too much for any type of health benefit whatsoever. The peanuts are so small and in such small pieces (more like granules) that I don't consider them anywhere near enough to consider any health benefits from the nuts.

The taste itself is good, and it's a bit softer of a crunch than most cereals, but outside of that it's just too many carbohydrates to be on the breakfast table. Kellog's could really improve this cereal by getting rid of some of the added sweetners and switch to a whole grain recipe. Until then, if you like sweet cereals with little health benefits then this is for you -- but otherwise, stick with Honey Nut Cheerios.

I tried Crunchy Nut about a year ago when I was visiting the UK. It was absolutely one of the best cereals I had ever had. When I saw it on Amazon, I had to try it to see if it was as good as it remembered. It is!

The brand I tried when I was in the UK was more like corn flakes and this one is more like cheerios. I was pleasantly surprised that this was not as sweet as I remember from the flakes brand. I liked the crunch this cereal had and it never got soggy in the six or so minutes it took me to eat a bowl.

At 100 calories for 3/4 of a cup, it would seem this cereal delivers taste as well as not hiking up you calorie intake for the day. Now I am no nutritionist so I would advise looking up all its ingredients for things that may not agree with everyone.

All in all, I enjoyed this cereal and would not hesitate to get myself another box.

This cereal is NOT for people who limit carbs or sugar intake but compared to many other pre-sweetened cereals it's not as bad (e.g., not as much sugar) as competitive products like Froot Loops or Cap'n Crunch.

While of course it's designed to be eaten with milk or yogurt it would also make a fun movie munchie right out of the box.

I'm a bit more health food conscious than this cereal's nutritional label would allow for in my household's cupboard but and based upon today's Amazon price of $29.95 for the four pack it's a bit overpriced for our household too; Not that we're poor but we are discerning as to what we spend our money on. We got a trial sample so all we had to lose was a little time on our weight loss efforts for a couple of day.
