We were so excited to find Tilda on Amazon and have been buying the 10 Lb bags every month ( yes thats how much we like it).. It is the finest quality long grain very aromatic and delicious. People from the Indian subcontinent prefer non-sticky long grain rice that comes out as fluffy but single grained in texture once cooked unlike the rest of asia where sticky rice is the norm. The amount of starch is what determines the stickyness. In case of basmati the finest are ones that are very long grained and not at all sticky. Must soak basmati in water for atleast 15 mins before cooking. we use the rice cooker and Tilda comes out perfectly. Biryani , Pilaf and simple plain rice all come out delectably with this. Tilda is definitely considered on of the finest basmati's back home in India and is most often the preferred rice at restaurants and for special occasions at home. At the price Amazon is making this available we have it everyday !

We have been eating basmati rice as our daily staple for over 25 years.  After trying this rice because of the reviews, and because our local supermarket was out of Royal Basmati Rice, we grade this rice very good.  However we judge Royal Basmati Rice to be slightly more flavorful and has a superior texture.
Tilda basmati rice is the best.  After cooking, the grains are separate and never soggy.  I only use Tilda rice products.

This is delicious! Better than some rice I've ordered in fine Indian restaurants. The flavor is delightful and I love that my apartment smells like Indian food when I'm cooking it! It cooks pretty quickly, quicker than generic grocery store white or brown rice. I don't know if this means anything about it's quality, but it is nice that it is done so quickly. It cooks up to a soft, medium or long grain and is fluffy. I can't say enough about the taste, texture, smell, etc.

Now as for the price and having to buy it in a 10 lb bag... I was a bit concerned about buying the 10 pound bag as I normally buy a 1 lb. bag of rice and I'm only cooking for two adults. This rice was so yummy that we went through a lot at first. Rice is shelf-stable for a long time so with eating rice once a week, I expect this will last 5-6 months. Plus the bag is a very sturdy plastic with a zipper to reclose the bag and keep it fresh. Also has a convenient carrying handle for taking it in and out of the cabinet. Very thoughtful packaging. The price when I bought was $1.86 per lb. for the 10 lb. bag. At my local big chain grocery store, the cheapest basmati rice is $1.97/lb. for a 10 lb. bag. If you buy a smaller bag you'll be paying $3-5 per lb. So this rice is a good deal.

Overall, this rice is delicious, convenient and cheap!
Alot of people have commented on the quality of the product and its superior tasting flavor. I have to agree with them that this is indeed the best Basmati rice ive tasted yet.

I got a 5 lb bag of the Tilda Basmati rice to try with a Sunbeam rice cooker I got for Christmas. The Tilda rice works very well in this cooker, coming out light and fluffy. I have a Prime membership at Amazon, so shipping cost isn't a consideration. I want to try a wild rice blend for my next bag. The packaging is good quality, heavy duty plastic, and it keeps the rice very well.
This is the easiest rice ever. It's perfect everytime with no measuring! Share some from this huge bag with friends as the big one is the value.

I've always used short-grained glutinous rice in my meals, but I needed something a little lower on the glycemic index. After much research, I discovered Basmati rice rated as low, if not lower, than brown rice (which I cannot stomach). Next came the question of which Basmati brand to purchase from. Since this was for health reasons, it was very important that I find a brand I could trust, and Tilda ranked high on everyone's list due to their reputation and genetic testing of their grains.

The rice arrived in a very convenient bag with an easy resealable slide along the top (in the photo where the gold band is). My rice was very fragrant but not as strong as Jasmine rice...a plus in my book. The rice was free of detritus and cooked up nice and fluffy in my Zojirushi rice cooker. The flavor was nice and subtle; a plus when pairing with delicate flavors as you don't want your rice to overpower the other food in terms of aroma, taste, and texture. I definitely plan on purchasing again.

Outstanding rice; tastes great. Best tasting rice ever. Recommend very highly.
Shipment was very timely.
Very pleased with item and company.

Love this rice. I eat quite a bit - and this stuff is very, very good. I use a rice cooker mostly, and this stuff just comes out perfectly - light, fluffy and almost sweet. The bag is a little weird to use - but I usually transfer it to a airtight container once I open it anyways.

We received a bag of this about a year ago as part of an indian-food gift.  After a year of eating it and loving it, there was no choice but to get more when the original bag ran out.  It's easy to cook, very tasty to eat (just plain with some butter and salt), never gets clumpy, and lasts forever.

I love to cook rice and figured it would be more economical to get a large bag. Let's just say that while it has lasted a long time, the rice is lacking. I didn't think it was possible for rice to be lacking but this Tilda Basmati rice just doesn't taste or smell the way I am used to basmati tasting and smelling.

I will not be purchasing this bag again.

It fails to meet my expectations.  I bought it because of the great reviews it had and the supposedly good taste and smell.  But let me tell you that's not the case.  While it's smells is not bad.  Taste like regular white rice. I tried cooked Washed and Unwashed. It was very sticky.  I have had Jasmine rice before that tastes and has a way better aroma than this.  I will not be buying this again.

Updated: I purchased Tilda Basmati because of the rave reviews, WOW whats not to like about getting an even better basmati flavor? This bag of basmati rice was packaged well, packed well for shipping, and shipped promptly. But the rice itself is very disappointing. It's instant rice, and not very good instant rice at that, with a basmati flavor. It cooks in ten minutes to a mushy pasty individual grain.
What with having ten pounds of it, I've tried cooking it every way that rice can be cooked, just in case I was preparing it incorrectly. Nope, tastes like someone made rice mush and then extruded it thru small holes and re-dried it. My family and I enjoy whole grain rices that generally take 55 minutes to cook and allow you to have a pleasant flavor and distinct individual grain texture to the mouth. I even tried using it as a filler for meat loaf or meat balls. It decreases the quality of any recipe you use it in.
The only explanation for all these rave reviews that I can see is that they're generated by the company, or that the purchasers have never tasted real rice before. This stuff is awful. After a year of holding it in my refrigerator, much to long to get a refund, I've just finished dumping 9 1/2 pounds of it in the trash.

Okay, it is a good rice. Tilda Basmati is a completely fantastic rice if separate rice grains are an important thing to you.

I should say that I purchased a Zojirushi NS-LAC05 rice cooker. If you want rice to make a difference, buy a really good rice cooker. Rice does not have to be a filler substance.

Tilda Basmati Rice has extra-super long grains. The grains are so long that many of them curl after being prepared. This is an absolutely superb rice if a fluffy, separate grain rice is of high priority. There is a place for that and I am quite thankful for my purchase for that category of need. Tilda really is a great, high quality rice for common rice needs.

Since I got my Zojirushi rice cooker, well, the cooker really brings out the differences in rice. If you just prepare your rice in a saucepan on the stove, it really doesn't matter all that much to buy an upper level quality rice IMHO. No offense to saucepan/stove-top people. Rice is a good and often necessary food item. Stove-top prep is certainly better than not having it. HOWEVER, my Zojirushi rice cooker has really made rice a whole 'nuther deal.

And to my point: Tilda Basmati is a really great rice if you want fluffy rice with separate rice grains. Fluffy rice with separate grains is a totally valid category. In fact, it may be what most people want. I feel that my Tilda Basmati is a very high quality rice. My only disappointment is that it is in that extra long grain category and the fact that it produces very separate rice grains, which could be a very positive aspect to many, if not most. I just happen to like rice that sticks together more.

I would buy it again in a heartbeat next time I need long grain rice that has very separate grains. Since I purchased a 10-Pound bag, I may not need to buy more for a while.

Very highly recommended if you want fluffy rice with separate grains. Not much good for sushi rice.

I'm not sure why this is shown as a TOY (would probably rate higher as a food or novelty item) - maybe because zombies like to play with their food?!? Just what is needed for your next Living Dead party. T A S T Y...

My baby is 10 months old. Teeth are coming, fever is present, fussiness is there, what's better than teething biscuits, right? organic, all natural, etc, right? Well, I gave one to her. She was gnawing away happily. Then she took a too big of a bite and a chunk fell down, and I tried it. To my shock I discovered that this biscuit is sweeter than the doughnut you would get at Dunkin, and sweeter than any danish you would have. It is sweeter than animal crackers, and I just had a few myself, as it was late at night, my baby asleep, and I wanted something sweet with my tea - I will NEVER give another one of these to my baby. Complete sugar rush and therefore, I can't imagine it is good for her. If you are a sensible parent and don't feed your child McDonalds - these 'all natural' and 'organic' biscuits are a waste of your money. I can't imagine anything that sweet is good for your baby.

For years, my favorite cracker has been the Keebler Clubs. One day, I saw the Multi-Grain version, and thought I'd give it a try--especially since I normally enjoy whole grain breads and was trying to lower my cholesterol.

I couldn't believe it, but the Multi-Grain version actually tastes BETTER than the original! I've bought several boxes of these crackers, and always make sure some are on hand. I use them with Asian tuna salad (canned tuna with mayo and sesame oil--you can add diced red pepper, too), chesee and Inglehoffer Sweet Honey Mustard, spreads, soups, and so on.

Very, very tasty crackers!
I got the 15 ounce unit pack of 6. I really like the taste of these crackers.  They do break up very easy but I still like them! J. Hall
Although I have ordered these before and love the crackers, this time they were outdated and sale!  Will think twice about re-ordering.

I've always loved the original Keebler Club Crackers, and these taste almost as good, but not as "buttery". They arrived in good condition (ie, not much breakage, unlike another brand of crackers that arrived in the same box, which were mostly DOA.) If you like the original, you'll probably like these if you're looking for a wholegrain substitute for the original.
Anything that says "enriched" in the ingredients is no better than the other food that is available, whether it has "a little" multi-grain in it or not.

So sorry Nutella ....... I first tasted this Nocciolata in one of the best hotels in Rome, I have never forgotten it, thank God I can find it here because I have been to all the healthfood stores I know and it was nowhere to be found.

This is one of the best chocolale hazelnut spread with good nutritional value.  Certified organic from Italy. 2g sat fat, 0 trans fat, 1mg chol serving size of 2tbsp 34g. 18g of carb but sugar is at 17g.  All in all better than other choco hazel nut spread.

I ordered this after looking (with horror) at some of the ingredients in Nutella. I'm so glad I did--it is absolutely scrumptious! My only problem is a strong temptation to eat it right of the jar by the spoonful. It is truly delicious. Do yourself a favor and try it.

i have eaten nutella for ever,i just wanted to try something new,so i purchased this product,WHAT A MISTAKE!this is just what i did not need,one more food addiction nocciolata hazelnut spread is not quite as sweet as nutella and is softer.this one is not for the kids,save every indulgent smear for you,IT IS WORTH THE PRICE!!

I bought this for three reasons:

1.Organic
2.Glass bottle instead of plastic
3.Sunflower oil vs palm oil

I was excited to receive this bottle from Italy and I was expecting it to blow Nutella out of the water.
However, after my first taste, I did not prefer it over Nutella. I cannot describe the taste but I am assuming its the sunflower oil since all the
other ingredients are the same. Sometimes, an organic product will taste different and not in a desirable way.

Whatever it is, I like the Nutella much better. I put both spreads on different crepes and when "testing" both, I found the Nutella creamier and richer in chocolate taste. I am certainly disappointed that Nutella tastes better due to the above list but I will try some other spreads, hoping to find an organic hazelnut that satisfies.

I tried this on a banana recently and I have to agree with the other five star reviews that there should be some sort of warning label about how addictive this stuff could be. Nothing like Nutella in flavor *or* texture and that for me is a *good* thing; the best I could do to try to explain the difference would be to compare/contrast - Nutella is to Hershey's what Nocciolata is to Godiva. Not that I have anything against good ol' Hersheys but my palate has grown up a bit over the years and I happen to LOVE the less sweet, more natural taste of this spread.

To me, this tastes more like milk chocolate than dark which the description says it is made with; makes sense as it does contain milk too. You definitely taste the fresh toasted hazelnuts as well. The texture is great for dipping that banana in the two tiny teaspoons the label says I can have. Somehow with the perfect balance of chocolate and hazelnut just that little bit does seem to satisfy my cravings though.

After starting a grain-free diet for health reasons I was sidelined from nutella, as it contains corn syrup. I was delighted to find nocciolata, which I prefer anyhow!! I eat a couple spoonfuls from the jar every night...mmmmm even better than ice cream!

This stuff deserves any rationalization you can come up with in order to attempt guilt-free consumption.  I used to get it regularly at a local supermarket, then it disappeared without an explanation or forwarding address.  Last week happened on a few jars at the same supermarket...was told that a jobber had left a box.  So, maybe someday they will just appear again, like magic.  As I paid $2.99 per jar, doubt that I would ever spring for the Amazon price PLUS shipping.  It's truffle-like and only the nutritional label keeps me from having more than a teaspoon [ok, half tablespoon] at a time.

I read the reveiws and decided to buy. Am I glad I did. I had asked about the sodium content, and nobody replied. I bought it anyway, and it turns out to have only 17mg.But be careful! The serving size is 2 TEASPOONSFUL, as compared to Nutella's 2 TABLESPOONSFUL. Big difference in calorie intake. But still, the consistency and taste are much better than Nutella. (Just eat less!)

Great tasting chocolate hazelnut spread. I try to buy organic whenever possible and also try to avoid products with soy lecithin.

This is a wonderful spread if you want something similar to Nutella without all the gunk thrown in.

This spread is good IF you enjoy the flavor of sunflower seeds/oil. I warn you, it's very strong. Another reviewer commented that this has a stronger hazelnut flavor than Nutella, but I must disagree. In fact, I couldn't even taste the hazelnut over the sunflower oil. Sunflower oil is not mild by any means, and I think the decision to use sunflower oil in this product was a big mistake.

You've been warned...

Nocciolata is smooth, creamy and rich. It has less sugar than Nutella, so it tastes less sweet. For me, that's a good thing.

It tastes delicious alone, or on toast or fruit. Putting it on something that is already sweet will give it that "too sweet" taste.

However you prefer it, as my grandmother used to say, - Mangiare!

(I can't wait to try it with a warm croissant).
Absolutely the best Nutella alternative. I actually prefer it over nutella, it tastes so rich and just plain phenomenal! A bit more hazelnutty than Nutella, gah just great!

I bought mine at Whole Foods and it was a smaller more beautiful packaged glass container than the other nutellas and more expensive but I figure since it came directly from Italy, it would have to be higher in quality, especially being organic. If you like OVERLY sweet chocolate paste, then it's for you. Based on the amazon ad, it's supposed to be used for desserts. I instead wanted to use it as they do in Europe on bread or waffles or butter wafer cookies. But, I found myself having to grab a gallon of water after every taste. I would prefer it to have less sugar like Justin's "nutella" Justin's Nut Butter Natural Chocolate Hazelnut Blend, 16 Ounce plastic jars (Pack of 3)

I love hazelnuts and hazelnut spreads, or so I thought. But it seems that the competition is still far behind Nutella in getting the right taste. The reason I bought this product is that American Nutellas have trans fats, which I obviously wanted to avoid, and the Nutellas sold on Amazon are not European ones or at least not German versions. But this hazelnut spread is just too sweet for my liking. It wasn't bad for a small change, but I will never buy any product other than Nutella, especially for this price.

Why would someone decides to package glass jars of $11 a piece in the box in which they ship books(you know those flat "boxes" that have just a flap for a top and the bottom). Box showed up with "Received Unsealed" stamped all over it. Two jars leaked out, one because metal cap got dented other because seal got broken and cap unscrewed.
It is so sad that even though shipping and handling charges double the price of an item it still arrives damaged when fulfilled by Amazon.
Just a note:This product is great which makes me even more furious that I have to send it back. We love Nutella as well but unless they switch from using palm oil I won't be feeding it to my toddlers. After it turned into thick paste in my 3 years old stomach which made him throw up all over himself in the car I'm very careful with products that contain palm oil.

This sugar is awesome! I bought it for my hubby because he uses WAY LESS of this type of sugar vs. regular, granulated sugar you find at the store. My local stores have some "organic" sugars but none like this. This bakes well, melts good, tastes great in my ice tea... you can't go wrong.

We were introduced to Siciliani olive oil by Chef Bettancourt at his excellent restaurant, "62 on Wharf" in Salem, Ma. It is the best I've had in over 40 years of dining, but difficult to find in local stores (thus we are delighted to order from Amazon). Believe me, you will never regret buying this product! Dip your bread into a little bowl of Siciliani, and WOW!, what a taste.

I'm sorry but in contrast to the other rave reviews for this product, I did not like it at all!  I purchased several e.v. olive oils and this one was most disliked by both my husband and myself.  We tasted it alone and with some fresh bread for dipping and we each experienced a funny feeling inside our mouths and a dry scratchiness to our throats that made us cough.  This has no place in my kitchen.  Sorry Siciliani :)
Like the reviewer from Marblehead, I learned of this oil from 62 on Wharf restaurant in Salem MA. I just echo what he said. This is the best dipping oil ever. Doesn't need anything added to it.
This is a good alternative to the Frantoia oil - a little less expensive and eligible for Prime shipping. It's perfect on bread, cheese, fish, soup, or salad.

Or so I assume, based on their wild reaction every time I open the food cupboard. Even as I type this, one of my cats is battling my keyboard for control of my hands so he can push me into the kitchen and make me serve him food. Or use my computer to check out stocks; I'm not sure.

After switching to a grain-free diet of my own, I decided to do the same for my cats. One, the little girl, is a hearty 11 lbs with plenty of belly swag that sways when she runs :3 Cute as it is, I imagine the extra weight can't be great for her long-term health. Following a bit of research on the subject, and after considering taking up hunting and training them to be in my party, I ended up on Amazon looking for grain-free foods. Much to my delight, I found a brand that wasn't exorbitantly more expensive as compared to the other food (Organix) that I had been buying previously, so I gave it a shot.

Enter Halo's Ground Whitefish flavor, harbinger of end sleeps.

The kitty alarm sounds at 6 AM sharp. If I don't have a food dish in my hands by 6:05, several paws of needle claws remind me of my human duty to their cat majesty--you know, in that "I'm-kneading-you-into-bloody-dough-because-I-love-you" way, all purrs. Food, once released to the hungry pit of tails and nudging faces, is devoured in a matter of minutes. Cries of "MOAAAR!" carry on throughout the day, noses turned up to the (almost) grain-free dry food I leave out for them. If I could afford it, I'd feed them six cans a day and train them to be ninjas. Whatever Halo's doing, they're doing it right.

TL;DR: Success. Would buy again. Cats are likely plotting to invest in Halo to secure discounts on fishy goodness.

Picked up a couple of cases of this on sale for my favorite feline to try, she can be notoriously finicky and will often devour the first can of some new brand of food but turn her nose up to the same after three or four cans.  Going strong at nine cans now and she is still pouncing on it like it was can 1.  Has a pleasant enough texture with a nice little bit of juiciness (gravy) to make it all go down smooth, an ingredients list that has actual ingredients in it and most important it makes her happy so that makes me happy.

Purchased this variety pack and although I was VERY impressed with Amazon Prime shipping (I literally received it in less than 24 hours!), the snack itself is average tasting.  Mostly like flavorless cardboard.  The best flavor is the jalapeno one, pretty spicy.  It satisfies the crunch and salt factor, but no way is this a replacement for real chips.  I recommend PopChips original flavor which reminds me of Munchos, or PopChips BBQ flavor; both are satisfying and taste very good.  I would NOT purchase these Gourmet Basics Smart Fries again.  I even joked with my co-workers when they asked me what I was eating.."They're Smart Fries, but they're not so smart since they don't taste that good!"  They tasted for themselves and they all pretty much agreed with me.
I love the bbq ones!!!! glad I ordered the variety pack, but I think bbq won over all of them. but they ALL are good

I'm really disappointed in these, unless for some reason I got a bad box of them!  I've been buying the plain Pop Chips for over a year now, very happy with them but was looking for something new.  Well, these are too salty for me,,,,,I can't eat them.  So I'm giving the entire box away tomorrow to get them out of here.  What a bummer!  That's the problem when you try something new with Amazon in the food category, you have to buy a boatload,,,and if it doesn't work out, you've wasted $20.00.  I don't  see what the point is in air popping something so it's low in fat but then making it way too salty,,,,sure defeats the purpose in my viewpoint.  Not good,,,,I'm really not pleased.

For the cost this is not a good snack but if you don't mind how expensive they are then these can't be beat for calorie counters. A single bag offers tremendous taste and fulfillment for such low levels of calories and fat. My wife loves Popchips and I don't count calories but we both love these fries (mostly). Brief flavour rundown:

Jalapeno is very hot. Tastes good. If you like jalapeno, you'll love these.

Honey Mustard is the best flavour. Rich, bold, strong taste, very flavourful and high quality.

Sea Salt is good but bare and basic.

Honey BBQ is great. Weak BBQ flavour compared to most potato chips but still quality.

Vinegar is decent, pretty good vinegar taste, again weak compared to most potato chips.

Vintage Cheddar is the poorest of the lot, with a dry and musty white cheddar taste, which though real, tastes fake.

This product was not as flavorful as I had expected.  The only flavors of the variety pack that I really liked were the jalepeno and the honey mustard and onion.  Two flavors I would not ordinarily enjoy. For the cost, I would not purchase again.

I have looked and looked to find any kind of potato chip type product that is seasoned with JUST salt and pepper and it's not at all easy to find! For some reason they over seasoned with garlic, sugar, onion and all kinds of other flavors so you barely notice the black pepper. These are just right - just sea salt and black pepper - very satisfying and the very few calories are a wonderful bonus!

Tge first bag I had was good and a nice change from chips but as I had these every day for lunch for a month I quickly tired of them. The jalepeno one is the best. They all leave a residue on your fingers.

My favorite of the Smart Fries flavors.  Vinegar taste, without eating away at your teeth, mouth and gums!  I have sensitive teeth, and love S&V chips, but can't handle too many at once due to the acid.  These are a great alternative.

eating these was sort of like eating a salted air bubble.  It was great for snacking because it takes a while to eat one package but they really tasted like salty air.  I am not sure I really liked them at all.
These are a great low calorie and low fat snack.  Satisfies the crunchy craving and sweet craving at the same time.  The Honey BBQ are delicious and a great value.

I bought a large bag of these from my local Marshall's store in BBq and Rosemary Garlic. I love the crunch and the fact that you can have so many per serving. The BBQ had much more flavor than the Garlic Rosemary. I just purchased the large variety to take to work when I need a little snack.

If you like salt & vinegar potato chips, you will LOVE these! They are good and tangy and you can still taste the potato, since they are just air-popped potato sticks. And there are tons in the bag. I think half the bag would have satisfied my salt craving! At only 110 calories, they make a great salty, low-cal snack. I will definitely keep buying these!
I like the other two flavors, especially the BBQ.  But the jalapeno is utterly gross.  Nasty, in fact.  There's just not much else to say.

Excellent snack food to hold one over until the next meal. Very light but filling... I was amazed at how much is in one bag. I have not tried all the flavors yet but the ones I did I enjoyed. BBQ, Sea salt, Honey Mustard and the Salt & Vinegar were very good. I would like to have had a bit more flavor on the Salt and Vinegar but it was still tasty.
They are great if you are on a diet and cant snack on unhealthy stuff.  The smart fries are a great snack fix.  All the flavors are very good.

lowest fat 1.5gms/serving - still tastes great!
this flavor bit spicy, but not too much - is awesome.

manf - plz continue to make this flavor - thanks.

I just bought a box of these salt smart fries and gave them to my kids trying to get them on a healthier diet. they loved them!!!! They said that they gave it out to their friends and so it seems that they all loved it! I got phone calls from their mothers asking were I bought this great snack from. There was a perfect hint of salt and definently not to salty like other reviews. I just ordered the 6 flavor case as the reviews were amazing. Thank you for making such a great snack.

This is a huge portion for 110 calories - if you like your chip snacks but find the usual, 10 tiny crisps in a bag 100 cal packs to be more frustrating than satisfying, give these a try! They are lightly salted and seasoned, and best of all I recognized everything in the ingredients as being actual food, not something from the lab!
Oh, and super fast shipping from this seller!

I love cheese-flavored snacks and I was highly disappointed by these. Their styrofoam texture was offset only by putrid tang of faux cheese powder. I'm pretty sure the only good Smart Fries flavor is salt and vinegar.

Last time I went to the store(Big Lots) I was just looking around for a moment and my mom spotted the Smart Fries, she knows that I am calorie conscious. She grabs the Smart Fries and tells me, "look these have 80% less fat". We bought the product of course, when we got home I was hungry and ate half the bag my mom ate the other half. They were delicious, crunchy, airy texture, also great flavor, low in fat and calories! I want to buy more.
My mom is not calorie conscious and loved the fries.

I really wanted to like these - reviews looked good.  But we just didn't like them, any of the flavors really.  I don't think it's the basic "fry", but rather the flavors, which just weren't right.  We'd be willing to revisit with revamped flavors.
$29.99 for a 12 pack if your order it on Amazon? Plus shipping? The local supermarket sells this for $1.99 each = $24

I was attracted by the packaging and the ingredient list. I mean 100% natural, potatoes, cracked pepper, sea salt... sounds like a winning combination!  Except that it isn't.  These things are worse than eating nothing, because they have calories but leave me unsatisfied, so I'll go eat something else 5 minutes later. A perfect example of why people think they don't like to eat healthy.  Yuck.

Not sure why but the texture bothered me with these, the smoothness of the straws is weird. And they have very little substance and taste. The upside is there are a lot in the bag so I guess if you eat them all, you feel like you had a snack. They're just not for me :(

Well, they're not the worst thing I've ever eaten, but I won't be reordering.  While the volume of the bag was very good for a snack, the flavor wasn't that great. Kind of "artificial".  This goes under the been-there-done-that list.

Not as tasty as Pop Chips.

They say they will ship you six kinds and you only get five flavors. They seemed to forget the cheese flavor.

All in all I will not buy again.
It's a great substitute for a crunchy high-fat snack if you're watching your weight!  All healthy--no garbage in it at all, and they are MADE IN THE USA!!! Buy AMERICAN!!!

Quite tasteless and they make you order so many. I am stuck with 12 bags of this tasteless stuff. I am not ordering large amounts of anything from Amazon again. So often I don't like it and I am stuck with so much on hand.

I really wanted these to be good, but they are very bland and taste nothing like potatoes. Actually they taste more like Rice Krispies cereal. If you want something that tastes more like a potato chip, bout low in calories, buy the Popchip.Popchips, Original, 0.8-Ounce Single Serve Bags (Pack of 24)

These classic fries have no flavor at all.  They are crisp but they are like crisp air.  I am sorry I am stuck with so many of them.  I don't even want to give them to my friends, they just aren't good at all.

Gourmet Basics indeed! I think the basics are to keep it simple and let the natural flavor of the food shine through. I am blown away that they have actually managed to make a "natural food" taste faker than Andy Capp Hot Fries, 3-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12). Rice cakes have a luxurious mouth-feel compared to these. I couldn't get past the fake flavor and horrible texture.

I just can't imagine what type of odd palate people must have to think that these abominations are tasty. Perhaps people who are on a restricted diet might find these a convenient snack food. Or parents tricking their kids into eating healthy. I can almost promise the parents that these snacks will go uneaten. I would have been more likely to eat the unsweetened Baker's Chocolate in the pantry before I'd eat these.
