The ingredients are Deboned Turkey, Chicken Meal, Salmon Meal, Oatmeal, Ground Brown Rice, Ground Barley, Rye Flour, Chicken Fat (preserved with mixed tocopherols, a natural source of Vitamin E), Menhaden Fish Meal, Tomato Pomace, Natural Chicken Flavor, Pea Fiber, Tomatoes, Salmon Oil, Ground Flaxseed, Carrots, Spinach, Sweet Potatoes, Apples, Blueberries, Potassium Chloride, Minerals [Zinc Sulfate, Zinc Proteinate, Iron Proteinate, Ferrous Sulfate, Copper Proteinate, Copper Sulfate, Manganese Proteinate, Manganese Sulfate, Sodium Selenite], Vitamins [Beta-Carotene, Vitamin E Supplement, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Vitamin A Supplement, Niacin, Calcium Pantothenate, Riboflavin, Vitamin D-3 Supplement, Pyridoxine Hydrochloride, Thiamine Mononitrate, Folic Acid, Biotin, Vitamin B-12 Supplement], Choline Chloride, Taurine, Mixed Tocopherols (a natural preservative), Chicory Root Extract, Yucca Schidigera Extract, Glucosamine Hydrochloride, Chondroitin Sulfate, Dried Lactobacillus plantarum, Enterococcus faecium, Lactobacillus casei, Lactobacillus acidophilus fermentation products.
Title says it all. Gave him loose stools, lost his appetite, would eat grass to settle his stomach. Not a good fit.

I went with Wellness because of the quality ingredients it offers unlike the run of the mill brands. I am pretty happy with the purchase and so is our dog. We have been feeding him this brand for the past 6 months and had no problems with it. Our dog's coat is also smooth and shiny.

After visiting the dog food analysis website, I decided long ago that my dogs would only get high quality organic dog food. Amazon offers great pricing and quick delivery, and subscribe & save means you'll never have to drive to the store at the last minute because Fido's out of food.
This food made my dog sick with vomiting and diarrhea for even two weeks after the transition from his other food. I've done my research, I think this is a complete kibble but too rich for Charlie.

This food may be very high in quality, but not all dogs can tolerate the high protein content. Our Schnauzer / Lasa Ahpso mix was drinking water all the time and urinating frequently. We looked on the bag and noticed the protein level was much higher than the old dog food (which was 21.5% protein, 13% fat) .

To be fair: this is one of the few dog foods that is made in the U.S. and they do have another version (purple bag) with less protein. We may try that some time.

I guess everyone has to do their own trial and error to see what works for their little fur friends. After researching alot about the best thing for dogs to eat, Wellness is one of the brands that has my respect... but...
it makes our little BOM (beagle/pomeranian) & our rough coated jack russell mix
THIRSTY, FARTY & WEEPY. (that sounds like a bad mix of creepy dwarf names)

To be fair, THEY LIKE IT... This small breed kibble is happily gobbled,then they insist on drinking aLOT! and then they fart a little bit, too....and it makes my terrier's eyes weepy, too... with those icky rust stains, and she NEVER has had that problem.

So, we are back to our other favorites, which is the rabbit kibble from Nature's Variety Instinct, and the frozen PawNaturaw beef medallions, and of course, their fav breakfast is
a Stella and Chewy's Dandy Lamb dehydrated steak. (those don't make the girls thirsty!)
These choices are a little closer to the raw diet which I prefer to feed when I can.

So, sorry, Wellness, we tried ya! We will finish the bag, but won't be buying any more...
I figure we got about a week of dog farts to suffer through yet.

The package had 2" cuts down the center of the bag. The bag was also wrinkly. When I purchase this dog food at local stores the bags never look in bad condition as this one did. Some kibble had come through the cuts and spilled in the amazon packaging box. Not pleased, who knows how sanitary the food is anymore with the bag broken. Love wellness brand dog food, but not the seller.
About wellness small breed- my toy poodle I was told was underweight even with free feed on eukanuba but know is a health weight due to the good taste and small kibble size. After disc surgery I soaked his food and he ate on own, big accomplishment for a picky eater who is in post surgery discomfort.

A couple of weeks after we transitioned my dog to this food, she became ill.  Very bad diarhea that just got worse and worse until she we getting up in the night and had blood in her feces.  Since this has happened, I have heard about this happening to other dogs.  Too big a risk, the ingredients are right, but the result is extremely bad.
I received these as a gift from a co-worker and was thrilled with them.  I recommend these as well as the clove cookies.

I enjoy this flavor the most of this brand of noodle. They have a nice light easy flavor. And when I want a little more flavor I just a splash of soy sauce. These are easy to store,prepare, & eat. Love them. Always have them in my cupboard. Got to get these.
I bought 12 boxes of Sugar Twin from Amazon. It was hard and clumpy where it had been exposed to moisture. The product is good but I would never order it from Amazon again.
This product has gotten to hot or something a big hard rock in box.  Not useable will never order again.  Amazon would not return money.

Great product compared to others in the same category.  Especially in price.  Groceries in my area no longer stock Sugar Twin.  They now favor pricier sugar alternatives that are not as good as Sugar Twin.  I would prefer buying in the 7.25 ounce packages though.

Thank you Amazon!  Sugar Twin is not carried by any retail stores in my area anymore, and iced tea just isn't the same without it.  It adds that sweet flavor than no other sugar substitute can duplicate; certainly not Splenda, yuck!
Very happpy to find that Amazon is making this product available. I consider it the best of the sugar substitutes but you can't find it in the stores anymore.
Was disappointed with product.  The sugar is all clumped up - will not order this product again.

We use this sweetener for baking and for drinks etc.  We love the way it measures like real sugar.  The only recommendation I would have for those who want to use it for baking - reduce or eliminate the salt in the recipe because Sugar Twin doesn't counteract the salt like real sugar does.

My wife and I have used Sugar Twin for many years after she was diagnosed with diabetes. It is sweeter than sugar or the new artificial sweetner made from sugar. And it is safe to use. In addition, the price is competitive. I costs less, you use less. Bingo.

Having used almost every sugar substitute on the market, I have to say this is the best!
Not only as sweet as sugar but so simple to bake with and gets great results. Measures just like sugar so no guess work needed. Price is good also but you have to want to have 12 boxes in your cupboard because that's the way it is sold. Does have a 2 year shelf life so that is no problem. Perfect for diabetics.
Hard to find Sugar Twin in stores.  This is a great resourse for the product as well as a great price to stock-up, especially with free shipping included.  Arrived in a reasonably fast delivery time.

I was not able to find this item in any of my stores locally.
I went on line and found it at Amazon, and was happy to see it and know were I could get more! I am a Diabetic, and I use this all the time.

I've been buying these carob chips for years. No other chips compare. These are just the right amount of sweetness & mimic chocolate! They're great for baking in place of choc chips but also good to at by themselves, out of the bag! Also, the customer service is great, the folks at Barry Farms are awesome!

I love the taste of these. I bought more at a local market and they do not taste as good. I have to wait until it is cooler to order more of these carob chips, because they did arrive with a few melted. This is noted in the sellers details.

I was fortunate to find this product at our local grocery store, it is only available once in a while. This is a must have seasoning and it is good to know it is available on amazon. If you travel to a major city such as Chicago, it is available in ethnic markets, especially in polish neighborhoods.

I wanted to try the Miracle Noodles after seeing them on the Dr. Oz show.  I looked for them in health food stores and went to some major grocery stores, no one sold them.  I found them on Amazon and took a chance and purchased a 24 pack.  I was a little concerned about all the reviews that said they had a fish smell and taste.  Also I was concerned about the texture, having read that they are rubbery. When they arrived I was surprised that the packages are so small. One pack will satisfy one person if it is meant as the main dish, however as a side it will be alright for two people.  I found that if you follow the directions on the package(which I did) there is no fishy taste or smell.  The product gets its flavor from the sauce you put on it.  As for the texture it is definitlty different.  It is a little rubbery and difficult to eat or seperate into servings unless I cut them into smaller sizes first.  It does fill you up as it is soluable fiber, it has no other nutritional benefits.  However I will continue to use this product as it is a great way to get additional fiber into the diet.  Also once you get use to the texture it is nice to be able to eat a bowl full with no worries about calories, fat, or cholesterol.  I just put a little spaghetti sauce on it.
I LOVE Shirataki noodles...but Miracle Noodles are SO overpriced. $ [...] bags! Asianfoodgrocer.com sells 24 bags of the same noodles (White Shirataki) for $[...]. Don't buy these, its a rip off!

Purchase them directly from the manufacturer and look for an online coupon.
Btw, I Love these. . . . maybe its because I lived in Japan for 3 years .. . the ones at the grocery are made from soy/tofu (not good for me) so they are not an option.

The customer service from this company is sterling. And the price is great for the 30 pack bought directly from them esp. with the online coupon.

These ZERO calorie noodles are the answer to every no-carb dieters prayer. The liquid they are packed in has a distinct fermented odour and they recommend rinsing them well. This doesn't really get rid of the smell but, after some experimentation, I found that drizzling vinegar over them and letting them sit for a minute, then rinsing again, removes all trace. After they are rinsed, fry them with a bit of cooking spray to dry them, this gives a better texture, then add your favorite sauce or just stirfry veggies, noodles and soy for an almost no-cal snack anytime.

I read the reviews before I bought so I prepared by purchasing a small fine strainer before they arrived.  I did notice the funky fishy smell when I opened the package and dumped the noodles into the strainer.  I rinsed them and gave it another sniff and couldn't smell it anymore.  I let them drain for a few while I made my sauce. Then I tossed the noodles in the sause to coat them and gave it a try.  I was suprised to say the least.  The noodles taste like nothing!  All I could taste was the sauce.  The texture isn't bad at all; I like rice noodles and these are similar in appearance and texture.  I am very pleased and will make these a regular ingredient in my meals.  To cut a bowl of pasta from 300-400 calories down to 30-60 is just awesome.  I usually eat Ancient Harvest Quinona products but will make the switch to the Miracle products.  They are ready to eat which makes them even more appealing.

The Miracle Noodles are great for avoiding gaining weight, no calories. They work great and take only a minute to make. I put some salt into the water for cooking and they taste great.Lisa Lirones likes them also.

Miracle noodles are the best alternatives for having noodles without the calories. Granted, it takes more than a minute to get used to that initial smell when you open them up. Just follow the instructions for rinsing and preparing for use.

The noodles are quick to absorb the flavor of whatever you choose to mix with it. For ZERO calories, it is the absolute ideal method for snacking on something that tastes great and working for you.

These noodles just arrived yesterday and I now know the secret of their weight loss properties: they will have you throwing up all night. I ate some of these for dinner last night and though I didn't really like them I thought I could at least tolerate them but I started feeling very full after I'd eaten a small ammount (which I thought was a good thing at the time) and ended up waking up at 2am this morning with intense stomach pain, nausea and vomiting. I have never had stomach pain this intense in my life and I have a very strong stomach so this was a horrible shock. I would NEVER buy or reccomend this to anyone ever.

15 second rinse, one minute blanch into boiling water. They taste like nothing, and are almost calorie free. I make my own random dressing concoctions to flavor them, eat two or three packages as on-the-go meal at work, and they are filling. The 24 pack is the most economic for sure! I plan to continue them into my diet and therefore replace as I run out.

Some people don't like these, but I found them to be very good. If you don't smell them before rinsing and blanching, you would never know they had an odd scent. One review said they were fishy smelling, but I thought it was closer to ammonia than fish. Either way, the smell disappears when they are prepared exactly as the package instructs. If you are looking for a wheat or grain pasta-type substitute, this is not it. But, if you like cellophane noodles and similar Japanese 'pastas' then this is your zero calorie version. They don't have any of their own flavor, so you will have to mix them with something obviously.

I was looking for a better quality food for my dog and I did a little research and tried this one. She actually eats the food when I put it in her dish rather than staring at it all day until the cat tries to eat it, then she would only eat it so the cat wouldn't. This food she really seems to like and it hasn't affected her digestion any that I have noticed. I would buy it again. Great price too!

Me and my 11 month old son could eat these all day. The only warning i will give you is that Freeze Dried Bananas Get Stuck in your Teeth!  If you  know this and you can look past it because you love freeze dried bananas as much as we do, then your'e in business. They melt on your tongue and have a great initial crunch.

I was looking for a low-fat snack that I could use to get in my fruits each day. I am a member of a well known weight loss organization and this snack fits in very well with that program. They are only 1 point per package, plus they are crunchy and tasty! And it doesn't contain any fat like the banana chips you find in many grocery stores.

I'm always on the lookout for portion controlled snacks and Brothers All Natural Banana Crisps fit the bill.  They are nothing but 100% freeze dried banana slices, with a delicate crunch and sweet banana taste.  Each single serving pouch is only about sixty-six calories.  It's great for throwing in a kid's lunchbox or for when you just want a little non-guilt inducing treat for yourself.  I recommend these and plan on trying their other flavors soon.

I am a subscriber on Amazon for this product. I get some every month! They're healthy - no additives, just bananas - and delicious! I wouldn't change a thing about them. They're great in cereal and oatmeal, or on their own. Great on the go too! Highly recommend them.
My kids love these banana chips, and I love the fact that they are easy to pack and take along in the car. I keep some in my car and in my diaper bag in case we need emergency snacks.

I found these chips very tasty and filling and would recommend them very highly.
They are light and crunchy and have a very good banana taste.

i had purchased some freeze dried strawberries and bananas (in same package) and determined that i did not enjoy freeze dried strawberries and found these bananas.

I just received them today and they taste perfect. 100% satisfied.
These are delicious! Good in oatmeal too! I love the portion control. Much better than banana chips if you're like me and need to watch what you eat.

These are not the fried banana chips from the grocery store- they are fresh bananas, sliced and freeze dried, so the flavor is like a fresh banana with a nice crispy texture.  No added sugar or fat- and very good.  I will definitely be ordering these again. I never go through bananas fast enough when I buy fresh- these are the perfect solution- and would be great on cereal!!  I like them out of the bag!

I purchased these for my adopted soldier serving in Iraq.  I've had other banana chips that have had additives, etc.  These are the best I've ever eaten!!  (yes, I had to try a package before mailing them off).  I'm going to look for other varieties for my next box.  These deserve more than 5 stars!

Delicious!  Great for lunches or an anytime snack.  Would definitely buy again.  All natural without the sugary, crunchy, artificial taste of normal banana chips.  Even my 2 year old grandson loves them!  Highly recommended!

As a general rule, I hesitate to order food products for my kids that are made in China. This, after the recent melamine-laced baby formula scandal in China.

When I received my two boxes of this item, I was surprised and dismayed to see "Product of China" printed on the box. When I tried to return, Amazon refused because according to Amazon policy, grocery items cannot be returned. The Amazon site for this item does not specify country of origin as China, or I would not have ordered it in the first place.

Don't get me wrong, I am not generally against products of China. These banana chips may end up being a very fine product (I did not open the box and even try it yet), and I will probably end up eating it myself.

But I cannot recommend it if you, like me, are concerned about Product of China food products for your kids, because it is from China, according to the box.

Terrible product. the bananas were brown and had an 'off' taste. when I looked at the ingredients it said product from china. well that answered it. threw them out. won't eat stuff from China. what a waste.

These are pricey, but make for a great gift because (1) they're beautifully packaged and (2) they are excellent chocolates. When I was in Brussels I sampled chocolates from many different chocolatiers, and I think Gudrun represents Belgian chocolate well: creamy & smooth, rich and distinct flavors, and good consistency. I wouldn't buy a box of these for myself because there are probably better values for comparable haut chocolat, but these are impressively packaged and would make a distinctive gift for a client or associate.

I received these chocolates as a gift and was very impressed by the packaging. The tasting experience was quite a bit different--the chocolate tasted waxy and lacked the rich flavor and creamy texture that I was looking forward to...
The choclates were delicious.  Each of them had special something in the center.  Gr8 to receive these as gift...I would never buy them personally because its not great value for money :-(
Got this brand as a gift and it tastes like it's sold door to door by elementary school children. It's cheap and gross. Great packaging--but don't be tricked. This is nasty low quality.

I had gotten this for a friend who loves waffle crisp and was commenting on how it's not sold anywhere.  They loved it.  Pretty expensive purchase for cereal, so I'll probably never buy it again, but whatever.

I am a big fan of Dave's Gourmet sauces and condiments, but not this one. If I was just rating it as a mustard alone I would give it 3 stars for taste, 1 for value. There are much better, brighter and fresher tasting mustards available at half the cost of this one.

However, this is a Dave's Gourmet product and as such I am looking for not just a good mustard but but one that makes a good use of a variety of heat producing, tongue scorching peppers, like Serrano or maybe even Habanero. What we get instead is a mediocre Dijon-style mustard spiced up with "hot pepper extract". This is a commercial additive of pure (or close to pure) capsicum, which is used for riot control and to add heat to an otherwise bland product. In my humble opinion hot pepper extract adds "hotness" without adding to the flavor. Dave's has some great products, I just don't think that this is one of them.

There was something wrong with the bag I got, the beans were visibly the wrong color for green decaf beans, and when roasted there was a bitter chemical smell and taste that wasn't even like coffee, much less drinkable.  I'll have to throw the whole bag away.  Probably it is just a bad batch or bag?  Food isn't returnable via Amazon, but they did refund me.  I've ordered green beans from Coffee Bean Direct before with no problem (both the regular-process Guatemalan and the CO2-process Columbian were fine), and I assume that the whole crop from Sumatra isn't spoiled, so maybe it was just a sacks worth of bags... ymmv but beware of this...
This decaf Sumatra coffee tastes good. I roast at 5.2 mins on a Fresh Roast SR300 and am satisfied. Before roasting I blend with 25% various regular caf. coffees with similar characteristics.

This product looked off for green beans they appeared brown,not returnable! DON'T BUY THIS PRODUCT
to give them a chance we roasted a quarter batch and the coffee tasted like DIRT to be polite...
We have bought many orders and have been happy with this brand in the past
for good decaf grean breans we bought from (...)

We have been buying the decaf sumatra unroasted beans from Coffee Direct for a few months now. Although the beans looked a bit different than the Sumatra we had been buying from Sweet Marias, they roasted and tasted fine. But I'm afraid that on the last order we had the same experience as "Thomas A. Oehser " , not once but twice. Received beans that appeared to have already been roasted except they had a bad strong chemical smell. Contacted Amazon's great customer service department and they immediately sent a replacement order via 1 day shipping. Received the replacement beans today but they had the exact same problem. Unusable. Contacted Amazon customer service and they immediately refunded our full purchase price plus shipping. We thern cancelled our subscription to Coffee Bean Direct for future orders. Apparently Coffee Bean Direct has significant quality control problems.

Is this the best, smoothest cup of coffee? No. Not by any means. However, it is better than nearly all the roasted decaf coffees you can buy in stores. If you're a home roaster and need decaf, this isn't a bad choice. But don't expect it to really wow you.
you will find this capellini the best you will ever eat. It takes two minutes to cook and it is finer than angel hair. with a lemon /shrimp sauce over it. OMGoodness!!!!!!!!!!!!

I eat DeCecco Capellini almost every day, but most supermarkets don't carry it even if they have other DeCecco products.  I got tired of looking for it so I was delighted to find it on Amazon for a reasonable price with no shipping on Prime.

I do not know why we can not get this pasta in our local stores, but when we found it on Amazon we purchased 18 boxes. The taste of this pasta is fantastic and the capellini is so thin is cooks quickly.
Great tasting pasta! The De Cecco Capellini is the best of thin pasta. It is my favorite of pasta's brands. This pasta type is hard to find and not sold everywhere.

(My very first review...)

What I got is different (but better) than the Reed's Ginger Candy picture. This yummy chews comes in a bulk-box of 20 small boxes, and each small box contain 10 candies making a total of 200 candies. Each candy / chew is wrap in an **edible** rice paper and then in a wax paper. I'm very impress with the whole packaging, and the edible rice paper is a nice surprise. I hate those inner-wrapper that comes with most candies making eating-candy a messy experience. The candies are very addictive. The only small complain I have is that the ginger-taste is too mild for me. If you are getting this for morning / motion sickness or migraine, this may not be a good choice. I would recommend crystallized ginger. Hopefully, the Reed's crystallized ginger candies are not this mild. My favor is W&M Ginger Glace but can't find it online.

Based on the reviews I tried these, and I LOVE them. I've tried the other ginger chews made by the ginger people, but these are far superior. I've had the ginger people chews for months and haven't come close to finishing the package. I've had the Reed's ginger candy for a couple of days and I've already finished my first pack. If you like ginger then you will really like these. I know it may be a splurge, but it's worth it. You get 20 packs with each package containing 10 individually wrapped candies. My only problem is going to be in pacing my consumption of this yummy treat.

I eat almost no sugar, but I have one of these after dinner, and they seem to settle my stomach. They can be very sticky and difficult to get out of the wrappers, but I solve this by keeping the box in the freezer. The candy pops right out and melts quickly when I put them in my mouth. I've been getting them at Kroger, and their price is about the same, but I may buy this 20 pack just for the convenience.

I ordered these, after they came, found that ginger is the 4th ingredient. Can't taste the ginger at all. I have purchased other brands, where the ginger is second ingredient, they were good. These were a real let down.
The vendor was very gracious and allowed me to return them for a full refund.
These are so good.  Don't try to talk while you eat one!  They're very chewy, so hold on to your dentures!  Very spicy.

My friend is undergoing chemo therapy and I heard about your product on WGN radio from Steve Cochran who is a fan of this product just for the taste..
It is supposed to also lessen the effects of nausea with chemo patients. I asked her if it was working and she confirmed that it took the edge off the nausea after her treatments.
If this is useful to others in chemo, I will be happy to have also suggested it.
my first order of this product was wonderful! I reordered the candy which was not chewy like the first order. I will no longer order this product.
Good product. It Was cheaper than what i found at local world market store. Would recommend. Great alternative for nausea treatment in place of medications.

This is definitely the best ginger candy outside of eating crystallized ginger root. It is not too sweet or too hard and packed with ginger, which is yummy all the time but especially good for nausea. I am buying more for my pregnant friend to get her through her first trimester.

These are superb.  I have to make weekly drop-offs at a cafe for work, and they have these... they're my guilty pleasure.  Actually, there's probably not much guilty about them, but the package looks like cigarettes, and I think it says something about these candies that it feel like it's a 'vice'.  Mmmm :)  I LOVE Reed's.  If you're into ginger, give it a try!

While on chemotherapy, most people experience some level of naseau, some greater than others. This ginger takes the naseau away almost immediately. It is like a wonder drug without filling your body wiith more drugs.
Amazing.
GREAT PRODUCT AND DELICIOUS GELATIN, THIS SUGAR FREE IS GREAT I DO NOT NOTICE ANY DIFFERENCE WITH THE SUAR ONES. IT IS MY FAVORITE FOR MANY REASON.

Came right on time. By far my favorite gum that ORBIT carries! I don't need any of this tropical banana split nonsense! Straight up Spearmint will do the trick for me!
It is a TINY BIT over priced... as I can get it at a store here for $10.99 a box... but hey, I love this gum so much that it doesn't bother me I paid an extra dollar per each box!

We had strangozzi pasta in Spoleto some time ago. This brand by a small farm and factory near Perugia is so good we keep needing more. This kind of pasta is unusual in that you're not supposed to stir it for the entire time it cooks in boiling water. We added it to a truffle sauce, but once we had it with a spicy tomato sauce. Either way, the pasta is so good you don't really need much to dress it up.  It's good even with just some olive oil and pecorino cheese or something like that. It's one of the best pastas we have ever had. Absolutely hands down delicious!

This was one of those afternoons when I was all alone and needed a quick afternoon lunch. So I opened a can of Amy's Organic Lentil and Vegetable Soup and added some crackers and a drink. It worked out well. The soup was thick and hearty and tasted rather well. If I had a complaint, I thought the soup to be a little bland. So I added a few squirts of Frank's Hot Sauce, one of my all-purpose brighteners, and that worked very well. It had a lot of fiber, was fairly low in sodium and sugars. The protein content was moderate. It made a good lunch, but not a great lunch.

Gary Peterson

The soup variety was tasty-Country Vegetable, Split pea/Carrot, Sweet potato Cinnamon and Squash Bisque. My daughter really seemed to enjoy it. The split pea and country vegetable varieties had nice soft pieces of carrot in there that my baby could chew. The sweet potato cinnamon bisque and squash bisque were thinner, but you can always add small pasta or cereal. Very convenient and flavorful for young palates!

Our son is now 11 months old and we've been using this brand since he started baby food. The taste is as close to the real thing as possibly. Other brands seem watered down compared to Earth's Best. The texture is smooth and flavorful. I like that they have a large variety of HEALTHY options that combine a whole variety of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and meats. In my opinion, there is no nutrition in mac and cheese so why bother giving it to them. They have different stages that seem to have been very appropriate for the eating abilities of my son. The soups served as a great transition to table food. It has bite size, soft pieces of vegetables and meats in a smooth baby food broth similar to consistency of regular babyfood.
I've become a Earth's Best mom due to the good deals I've found that its the best value for your money. I find the other brands doesn't offer the variety as Earth's Best. My son simply loves it.
we are big fans of earth's best food - but my daughter really hates all the flavors in this pack.  i tried them- and don't blame her!  :(
I like that it is organic and doesn't taste bad.  I recommend this food because Gerber just doesn't cut it for me- I like Earth's Best' food combinations.

My son has eaten the Earth's Best fruits and veggies in the past and loves them so I thought I'd try the soups.  Epic fail!  He generally will try anything and will even eat a few things he's not a total fan of.  I've never seen him actually spit food out and continue to spit to get the taste out of his mouth.  Once I realized what he was doing, I got him some water.  Needless to say, this happened with each of the soups we tried.

At first, I loved Earths Best and it was about all I would buy. They dont taste bad and I love that they are organic but for stage three they are just not textured enough! All they have is a few chunks of carrot here or there. I will say that for the price and the size of each jar, there is still a value here and I will most likely stick to EB for stage 2 fruits but other than that I prefer Sprout baby food. It may be twice the price but in a chicken dish the first ingredient is chicken and I can honestly say I think it tastes good!

I like the soups for my daughter, but as a stage 3 food I was hoping for a little more of a thicker consistency.  You can really use this in stage 2 if you wanted because it is pretty thin.  I love Earths best products though and would recommend them.

I really like Earth's Best Baby Foods and Amazon, but these jars were packaged so that glass touches glass... this may not be worth the good price.
The jars arrived all wrapped up in bubble wrap, but 2 of the 8 jars were broken inside. It was a big mess to clean up the broken glass and baby food. Also, per the amazon return policy, grocery items are not returnable.

My son really enjoys these flavors and the texture. Everytime I have ordered baby food it arrives very well packed in bubble wrap. Some of these combinations are hard to find and stores adn much more expensive.
I like that is't organic, good price here on amazon. The food should be thicker since it is stage 3, but it's kinda runny.

My 10 month old loves these they are his favorite. I wish I could find lasagne or spaghetti in Earths best, but no luck so far. The apple cinnamon oatmeal is what got him eating breakfast! I like the chunkiness too, he can't chew too much because he only has two little teeth, but this food disolves and chews up easy.
Recommend for anyone.

Since I live alone, a single grinder can last me six plus weeks, so a pack of six of these is roughly a nine month supply. For families or couples, or for those who entertain often, how long it lasts will vary.

The peppercorns are fresh and when ground they immediately burst into a wonderful aroma. The mechanism is relatively easy to turn, and unlike some grinders, does not stick of easily clog.

Do be aware that the grinding mechanism tends to produce very coarse pepper, so if you prefer yours to be finer, a dedicated grinder may better suit your needs. Another possible issue is when you have just a few peppercorns left in the container they may not "catch" in the grinding mechanism and grind. I've learned through experience that it's best to just dispose of the grinder and use a new one from the pack. It will save you frustration.

For me this is a convenient way to make sure that my guests and I have fresh ground pepper during meals, and I always have a few on hand.

I'm a big fan of peppercorn grinders. I love black peppercorn, and put it on just about all of my food. However, I had never tried a mixed peppercorn grinder, so I decided to give it a try. I was pleasantly surprised to not only taste something with robust flavor, but also something that has some good kick to it. This pepper conglomeration isn't red-hot like jalapenos, nor is it very mild or lifeless; it has just the right amount of kick to it. This grinder is great for salads, hamburgers, or anything that needs a little more flavor. Plus.....it lasts a long time (months, with regular use). So, spruce up your food with some mixed peppercorns, and enjoy.

Fuji Apple - most kid friendly. Strong and sweet apple taste, nice large pieces that look like apple slices. The package contains 1 1/2 apples and really would make a good substitute for potato chips in a lunch. In fact, most kids would consider it a treat. My sister's grand-kids raid her cupboard for these. (39 Calories)

Asian Pear - about the same sweetness of the Fuji apple but without the apple (or strong pear) taste. Once again, this contains 1 1/2 pears, so it really gets you going on your fruit requirements. (40 Calories)

The highest nutritional level is the Strawberry/Banana Combo since the strawberries are such a great source of vitamin C, but all of the packs are great choices.

Because these are freeze-dried instead of dehydrated, there is no sticky residue to worry about. They are perfect for carrying in the car, sitting at a desk, hiking, backpacking, wherever you want an easy-to-grab healthy fruit snack.

My children and I have had the Strawberry Banana Crisps and have loved them.  But after a while they started to pick out just the strawberry pieces.  So when I saw they had a plain strawberry option here I was thrilled.  When they arrived I was shocked to find out that unlike the strawberry banana variety, which are nicely sliced pieces, the strawberries were WHOLE strawberries.  And also unlike the strawberries in strawberry banana combination these strawberries were BITTER.  I mean inedible bitter.  Just a word of caution that Amazon does not take returns on grocery items.  I am now out $20.

While these are tasty snacks, there is virtually no nutritional value in them. A quick check of the label shows insignificant amounts of and vitamins, even vitamin C, in any of the varieties. By insignificant, I mean less than 10% RDA. That is far below what one might find in the claimed 1-1/2 apples or pears per package. I will add that under ingredients, the only thing listed is the freeze-dried fruit on the label; there appear to be no additives, not even sugar, of any kind. While they are not strictly bad for you, this snack certainly qualifies as empty calories. Frankly you get more vitamins from a bag of potato chips.

In addition, these are made in China, this is stated on each envelope. Draw your own conclusions.

Finally, the package counts are deceptive. The subtexts often says "24 count". Then in Amazon inset says "2 pack". This leads a reasonable person to believe they are getting 2 24 packs for a total of 48 individual snack envelopes. In fact these are sold in packs of 12 (TWELVE) and you get two of them for a total of 24. I find this deceptive, or at best, confusing.

[Update, May 2012: It appears that the description of the item has been changed to avoid the confusion as to how many you are actually getting.]

To conclude, these are tasty, the texture is good, there seems to be no odd ingredients, refined sugar or artificial stuff and the serving size is reasonable. However, the utter absence of any nutritional value tells me that the process used to "freeze-dry" these seems different from other freeze-dry methods in that it is particularly destructive to nutrients. I find the fact that they are made in China troubling. Finally, the deceptive package counts found here in the product descriptions lead me not to purchase this again. [Note my previous acknowledgement of the improved product count description.]

I've used them all - saccharine, Sweet 'n Low, Equal, and Splenda. None of these sweetners tasted like sugar, but with a family history of diabetes and obesity, I chose to make that trade-off. Some of the sweetners were acceptable; some just didn't sweeten enough (Equal), using only one packet, to be cost effective. Splenda has been my sweetner of choice for the past several years, but it still didn't taste like sugar.

One of the warehouse stores was demonstrating PureVia, so my spouse and I tried it. Imagine how surprised I was to find the taste and texture were as close to granulated sugar as I have encountered in a sweetner. Even my picky spouse thought he could use this on his cereal in the morning - instead of several tablespoons of sugar. I used PureVia in my coffee this morning. PureVia was truly as close to sugar as I have found - one packet was sufficient and the coffee tasted great! We did find that PureVia did not dissolve well in iced tea; again, it performed very much like sugar when that sweetner is put into cold tea.

If you use some type of artificial sweetner, then you should definitely consider PureVia. The per packet cost is higher than the other artificial sweetners when compared on a one-to-one basis. For example and in my opinion, one packet of PureVia sweetens as much as one packet of Sweet 'n Low, three packets of Equal, and two packets of Splenda. However, factoring in the requirement to use multiple packets of most of the other sweetners and the superior taste of PureVia, I think it is clearly the best sweetner available. I will be switching to PureVia as my sweetner of choice and recommend it to anyone who also uses sweetners instead of sugar.

I've never been a fan of stevia until they started mixing it with other natural sweeteners to make it more palatable. I've tried them all (I think) and I live the PureVia much better than the main competitor, Truvia.

I use it to make limonadas and on fresh fruit and find that it tastes quite like sugar. I used to use 100% erythritol, but it takes so much of that to sweeten anything that the cost is prohibitive. With 2-3 packets of Purevia (I like my beverages VERY sweet), I'm fine.

I bought 400 packets at Costco for under 10 bucks. Wish I hadn't. I"ve several brand of Stevia products like Truvia, Stevia in the Raw and Purevia. I'm a big tea drinker, hot tea that is. Well Purevia made my tea smell funny. Kind of like how cardboard smells. Truvia and Stevia in the Raw are far better tasting than Purevia and they do not make your beverage smell funny either.

I drink a lot of iced tea but not if it isn't sweet. I thought these individual packets would be good for adding to my tea and I'm glad to have something that won't spike my insulin levels. One packet is worth about two sugar packets so be careful how much you use. I think sugar tastes good, aspartame tastes good, sucralose (e.g. Splenda) tastes good, saccharin tastes good (when you don't overdo it) but this was just weird. It was sweet for sure, but it seems like most of the sweetness didn't register until a few seconds later. I also registered an almost bitter taste, but just for a split second with each sip. It's really hard for me to explain, but I'll just say I had no desire to finish the rest of my iced tea.

I tried it again later and did a few experiments with it. First, I poured a little on my finger and tasted it by itself. Again I thought it had kind of an odd taste and slightly bitter. I poured a slightly larger portion on my finger and tasted that. Yuck! Maybe it's like that because it's sweeter than sugar, but I got the same sensation when I mixed it in my tea. I also tried adding it gradually to my tea and the best I could do was a neutral flavor. Once it started to get sweet I could taste that same funny and slightly bitter taste. Another wasted glass.

This is the first stevia product I've tried so I can't say the sweetener itself tastes like this, they do add other ingredients. If you want to try this product you really need to get the cheapest/smallest that you can. I'll be throwing out about 95% of this stuff and I'm regretting that I ever used 5% of it.

I would, however, recommend agave nectar. It's a low-calorie sweetener with a low glycemic index and it's natural (usually organic). It has a smooth taste, a pleasant aftertaste [if any], and even when I use too much it doesn't taste terrible. I've tried two different brands and I have yet to be disappointed.
What can I say. The lack of calories is good. This is the latest fad on sweeteners.  Let's just hope it doesn't cause cancer down the line.

I'm trying to wean off Splenda and decided to give Truvia a shot. Perhaps Truvia is healthier and more natural, but the taste ruins my coffee. It has a slight saccharin taste which I can't stand. I'm going to try a few other Stevia-based sweeteners with the hopes of finding something without an aftertaste.

This coffee doesn't smell like butter toffee, it just smells like "flavored coffee" which to me all smells very similar no matter what it's supposed to smell like--pecan praline, blueberry cream, amaretto, even "Norseman Grog" which is a combination of vanilla, rum and caramel.  They all smell pretty much the same to me, even different brands.  I was hoping this one would be different because of the high reviews, but it isn't.  I gave it two stars because the coffee itself is good and not bitter like some.

This is a great flavor! First, my husband likes lots of cream & lots of sugar in his coffees. One day I saw this in the store & bought it because the name made it sound promising - my husband LOVED it. He barely puts any cream in his coffee because he says it tastes so smooth.
My neighbor also has a Keurig & we swap flavors to get more of a variety. I gave her some of this, and she was sold! This is all she drinks now, too!
Because this stuff is so great, we obviously buy in big quantities. This packaging is great! Just one box w/ a bunch of Kcups thrown in. We don't have to mess w/ the plastic over the two boxes, etc. etc.
Not only the taste is GREAT! My Son and I love how the aroma fills the house.
A good blend with the flavor of butter toffee - nice switch from hazelnut and vanilla. Served with whole milk or cream, a rich tasting brew that's smooth as "budda"

I never buy flavored coffee. I'm a cream, sugar and drizzle of caramel sauce type of coffee drinker. When I read the reviews about this toffee flavored coffee I decided to try it with high hopes.

As the coffee was brewing into the mug, I smelled a slight toffee scent. It, and the coffee smelled good. My hubs wanted a cup, just black. I brought him his and after he drank some, while I was brewing mine, I asked him how he liked the flavor. "What flavor?" he asked. "It tastes like coffee to me" he said. More questions to him and he said all he tasted was coffee, no flavor and the coffee was ok.

Now for my cup. I used about 1 inch of milk, one spoon of sugar and the Keurig on medium brewing setting. The same faint scent of toffee was there along with the coffee. I took my first sip and hardly tasted any toffee flavor. I looked at the k-cup and it said 'toffee' on it so it was the correct k-cups that were sent. It is such a mild, almost non-existent flavor that I wouldn't hesitate to serve this to those who don't like flavored coffee, I'm sure they would like it. I'm disappointed in the weak flavor of toffee but the coffee itself is good tasting so it's not a waste. I'm used to extra-bold, dark/french roasts so this is a much lighter roast for me. All in all I like it.
The Gloria Jean Butter Toffee K-cups satisfy several senses all at once from brewing to drinking to relaxing.  An enjojable cup of coffee.

I recently started drinking flavored coffees, since I preferred regular to hazelnut and french vanilla.  This coffee changed that. This coffee has a rich flavor and tastes great.  I have started keeping a supply on hand, and have had black coffee drinkers try this, and so far they have all said this is the only flavored coffee that they thought tasted good.  Try it you won't be disappointed.

I made the mistake of buying a 50 pack of these k cups when they were on sale. The first few were decent, but the more I drank them, the more I started to dislike the flavor. At this point, I'm pretty much forcing myself to get through them since I don't want to waste them. The best way I can describe the flavor is a mixture of watered down coffee and old, stale butterscotch candy. Ugh.

I got hooked on Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee when we purchased a variety pack and this flavor was included.  It is such a rich, creamy, medium roast coffee.  I enjoy it in the morning, but love a cup in the evening as I settle in for the night.  I have just placed a reorder for  more.  If you enjoy flavored coffees, you must try this flavor.
Buying coffee this way saves money . Everyone in the family likes this coffee. It is a medium blend with excellent flavor

We really enjoyed this coffee. Love buying in the bulk package. cut the top off the box and stow it away. Reach in and get a handful to put in our rack on the cabinet. The Butter Toffee flavor is so smooth. We have always enjoyed hazelnut but this is a step up in flavor. Just find a quiet corner and enjoy a cup to relax.

I love this coffee BUT the last box I got was some good some very bitter. I love this and have been buying for a long time but the last box was not as good.
One day i make a cup and it is so good smells wonderful next day I get a cup that is bitter with very little of the smell I love
Most of the Gloria Jean's flavors I am not a big fan of, but this one would be the exception. I really enjoyed the flavor and it was a nice change from my normal routine. Plus the price is very nice.

I like the 50-cup packs of coffee and I ordered Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee coffee because my first coffee choice could not ship for 2-4 weeks. I was a bit worried because the GJ Mudslide was a slight disappointment.

Butter Toffee is smooth with just the right amount of sweetness The butter toffee flavor was distinct and at the perfect depth of flavor.

This might be my new first choice in coffee! I would recommend this to others.

This butter toffee has become my favorite k-cup flavor. Though I usually prefer unflavored coffee in the morning, this is an exception. It has just a hint of flavor and makes getting up a bit more tolerable. My daughter-in-law introduced me to it and, when my gift box was gone, i was glad to be able to replace it at a reasonable price at Amazon.

I have tried MANY different coffee flavors since purchasing my Keuriq two years ago. Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee remains my favorite. It smells SO GOOD brewing and tastes even better! I buy it in bulk through Amazon and don't want to be without it!!! In fact, I think I'll purchase another box now!

There is something about this particular flavor that keeps me coming back for more.  I am not sure if it is the aroma, while it is brewing or the flavor, but of all of the different flavors that I have tried, this is my favorite.  I have it coming on the subscribe and save plan, so I know I will never be without it.

This is one of my favorite cups of coffee. I will definitely be purchasing more of this.  The flavor is a little weak on the biggest cup setting on my Keurig but the middle setting is perfect and you can really taste the Butter Toffee.  I love it!!  Try it on the smallest setting for a really sweet treat.

Overall I prefer a stronger coffee than Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee, but I tried this coffee when in an accountants office and really liked the flavor.  It is not a K-Cup that I drink every day, but it is definitely good for a change of pace.  If it were a little stronger I would rate it five stars.

My wife absolutely loves this version of k-cup coffee after trying 50+ different types.  It has a pleasant aroma and a subtle flavor.  We were pleased to find this on Amazon but are hoping that it is popular enough to end up in the "Subscribe and Save" program as we would sign up immediately for the convenience factor (and the extra savings)!
This coffee has such good flavor, i love it! It does not even need creamer! I will absolutely buy it again!

I love Gloria Jean's coffee's. But this is by far one of the best coffee's out there.  It tastes really good and not overpowering. It's the second time I'm purchasing this flavor and bought the 50 pack because everyone in the house is drinking my coffee. I highly recommend this flavored coffee.  Enjoy!!

The convenience and speed with the shipping of these k-cups makes you hardly notice you ever ran out. The cups are free from damage and easy to open and get to when received. Finally, for my taste the butter toffee is one of the most enjoyable flavors of coffee available from this product line.
I have ordered coffee many times and it was always great. this time, it is butter toffee, and it tastes like watered down junk. how do I exchange it?
I have ordered the coffees i enjoy most in packs of 50, the cost and taste of the Gloria Jean is my favorites so far.. They are a real bargain at a great price!!!
Don't brew on high setting if you drink breafast blends usually, you will find the flavor kind of weak other than that ok.
I expected it little bit different than it tasted. Stronger than I like my coffee to be. I would not recommend this to people who does not like strong coffee

I tend to drink flavored coffees, and use this one in the morning.  I add some creamer and artificial sweetener to mine.  The coffee is not too sweet and it's smooth on the palate.  All in all, I'd say this is a good coffee any time of day.
This is one of my favorite k-cup flavored coffees.  Not too light, it has this sweet, delicious aroma. Everytime I brew a cup someone will complement that coffee smells really good! :)

I really like the Gloria Jeans Butter Toffee Coffee for my Keurig it is one of my favorites.  I have bought this from Amazon several times and I always get a good price and great service.  Most certainly will order again.  Keep up the good work and service.

I'm thoroughly enjoying my Butter Toffee coffee in K-Cup form from Gloria Jean's. The coffee tastes great, and the package arrived perfectly - no damage at all. Often one or two K-Cups burst or crack during shipment, but this did not happen. I will order again.
Received quickly and was as advertised. Recommend this product to everyone that enjoys different coffee blend and use Keurig K-cups.

We've had this flavor on subscribe and save for a couple of years now, and despite trying many other K-cups, this one remains my wife's favorite.

I find it has a pleasant flavor, on the milder side, and while I prefer my coffee a little more feisty, I've never minded drinking this one when it was the only flavor we had left in the pantry.

I love this flavored coffee.  I do not like strong coffee, I was glad this is NOT a strong coffee.  I put cream in my coffee and this smells great while it is brewing and you are not disappointed in the flavor.  I had gotten a sample of this and was so glad to find it at such a great price!! To ensure that I don't waste your time, I want to begin this review by letting you know just what kind of coffee drinker I am. I drink coffee every day, sometimes up to 4 cups a day, depending on my mood. When I have coffee I use just a little sugar but a good bit of cream, usually flavored. International Delight French Vanilla has always been my old faithful, go-to creamer.

I recently received a Keurig Cup Coffee Brewer and drank the Dark Magic K-Cups that were gifted with it. I found the Dark Magic to be very rich, a little over-roasted, but very drinkable. After running through the 24 pack I was looking for something different.

I decided on the Butter Toffee K-Cup by Gloria Jean and was pleasantly surprised by the full, rich flavor delivered without any bitter aftertaste. The Butter Toffee is a medium roast blend with a very nice toffee flavor.

Now on to my little recommendation. I was in Wally World the other day and was going to pick up some more French Vanilla cream when something different caught my eye. Coffeehouse Inspirations - Caramel Macchiato by International Delight. (Just so you know, this was the dairy based version, not the non-dairy shelf-stable individual portions.) I was rather impatient during the drive home to say the least. Let me describe the experience with a formula.

Butter Toffee K-Cup + International Delight Caramel Macchiato = An amazing cup of coffee.

While I'm not going to say that I've never had a cup of coffee this good, I cannot recall one off the top of my head. Try it!
Gloria Jean's Coffees,Butter Toffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 50)Love love love this coffee!! Definitely a winner. I'm a coffee junkie and highly recommend this flavor~

I made 3 of these kits in the past and they came out very good for the price.  The last batch I made I did in a 5 gallon quanity in hopes there would be a little more body to it as some reviews said.  I found no change in the body from 6 to 5 gallons and ended up with 24 bottles instead of the 29 or 30 bottles I usually get from the 6 gallon instructions. At 4 months it wasn't so good. At 8 months it was a tasty wine.  I turned out to be a light to medium bodied wine.  Buy it and tweak it a bit.

I picked these up today and thought I would try them out for myself, since I don't have a baby.  They are pretty good, a lot of apple flavor with a nice texture.  I enjoyed them and plan to purchase more to use as a great snack.

These are very good. As an adult I use them as a fruit snack. I can't believe that someone is charging 49.99 for an 8 pack! That is over $6 a package! They are under $3 in the local grocery store.
If Amazon offers them in the future at a reasonable price I will order them but not from some outfit gouging people!
The tastiest and sweetest strawberry soda out there, I love this soda! Great with ice, reminds me of a snow cone.

The chicken pieces inside are not firm. Some of them have disintegrated into dust like residue and they line the bottom of the can. The other solid pieces are powdering slowly. Not at all appealing to watch when you open the can expecting chunk chicken. Still since this is a healthier option and maybe they are not using any preservatives to keep the firmness, i dont have much problem with this product.

I never used canned chicken before so cannot compare this to other brands. I buy this because even though it is not organic it is the healthiest canned chicken I can find anywhere. YES, it does fall apart and there are some teeny bits in the can as the other reviewer pointed out. However, it has a really nice rich flavor.

If you hate handling raw chicken as much as I do you will find these little cans to be just the right thing when you want to make white chicken chili or chicken noodle soup for 2, or when you want just a bit of meat to toss into a veggie stir fry right at the end. I use Imagine brand organic free range chicken broth. The combination of that broth and this chicken is very tasty indeed.

This tea is wonderfully light, smells so intriguing, nice and fresh and piney.  The leaves are absolutely perfect, not broken or squished!  Beautiful product inside and out.  Would highly recommend to every tea drinker who seriously loves certain types of tea.  This silver needle was superb, I even skipped using a dash of honey it was that good.  The price I felt was fair too. It comes with two tins which is perfect for gift giving, sharing, or just plain enjoying a few well brewed pots a day!

If you want to taste something different, and truly wonderful, buy this product. "Dulce de leche" is a typical Argentinian product, and one of my favorite temptations. In case you are not familiar with it, I must say that you are really losing something great...

Dulce de leche is a dessert that can be eaten alone or as a topping (for example, on waffles, bread or ice cream). It is also used a lot in cakes and other pastries, and its savor is sweet. It is made by blending hot milk, sugar, and vanilla, and as a result has some nutritional value. However, the most important thing is that it is mouthwateringly delicious :)

Even if this product is extraordinarily good, it is important to choose the right label, because a good one can be guarantee of excellence. In my opinion, "La Salamandra" is one of the few labels that allow you to be certain that what you are going to eat is not only tasty, but also made of superior quality raw ingredients. "La Salamandra" is very well-known in Argentina, but has also won some prizes in USA. For example, this product won the 2000 Fancy Food Show's Gold Trophy for spreads/sweet toppings.

All in all, I advise you to indulge yourself and give "La Salamandra"'s dulce de leche a try. The price isn't overly high, so you don't have much to lose, and all to win :)

Belen Alcat

This is a caramel flavored filling/topping that is very popular among people from Latin America. I grew up eating dulce the leche, as my parents were Cuban. My ex-husband is from Argentina, and he, too, grew up eating this mouth-watering, sweet dessert topping.

It is delicious with ice cream, with flan, and as pastry filling. I even know people who eat it as a spread on white bread. It is also delicious by itself, though one cannot eat all that much of it in one sitting as it is so sweet. When I discovered its availability on Amazon and saw that it was recommended by a fellow reviewer, I immediately bought three jars, even though the shipping was on the high side. Well, the actual product more than met my expectations, as it was absolutely delicious. I can certainly understand why it was the Gold Trophy winner in the spreads/sweet toppings category at the 2000 Fancy Food Show.

I am only sorry that I did not buy more than three jars of it, as I see that it is no longer available through Amazon, and I am plumb out of it. The good thing, however, is that I know how to make dulce de leche. I am, however, notoriously lazy about cooking. Maybe the fact that it is no longer available will galvanize me into whipping up a batch of this delicious taste treat. If not, I can only hope that it will become available.

Nothing that I have found compares to the quality of this product.  Unfortunately shipping is high because it is a food product.  Igourmet however is a class act that I'd purchase from again.  Excellent customer service...even over a weekend.

I was born in Argentina, so probably enough said.  It's the most versatile wonderful spread ever.  We ate it with croissants, filled crepes with it, filled cakes with it, and I and my brother (and now my children and grandchildren) ate it with a spoon.  It's great stuff!

I did not read the k-count carefully and was extremely disappointed to realize that I paid over $1 each per k-cup for these teas. In addition, it is packaged in a "gift box" which is just a plain white box that look like someone took their leftovers and sold them. I was expecting more quantity and something that looks store bought. I am very disappointed for the price.

This looks like it is meant for a store counter, not a gift or home purchase. The tins would make nice favors, hostess gifts, stocking stuffers, etc.
They don't mention it, but the bags are pods. Not that you can't use them as a bag, but still a surprise. I also didn't expect the tins to be as large as they are, I was thinking pocket size. The tin is about 3.5" square by 1.5". The eight bags are sealed in a foil package so you know it is fresh when you open it. The tin has a tight fit so they won't go stale right away after you open the package.

I am not a big tea drinker. I love the tea I get in Chinese restaurants, but I have never been able to duplicate the taste. I know it is good for me so I have experimented a lot this year.
So far I have only drank the pomegranate. It smells divine. I used one pod to make a small teapot of tea and it steeped quickly, has a rich color and a sweet and delicate aroma. I detect no bitterness to the tea itself. Success!
I am pleased with the Bentley brand and have given it as a gift to great acclaim.
I recommend it.

This was the first time I've purchased a product from Lana's Little House, and I will definitely be a regular customer in the future. I was searching for a good jasmine tea, but when I read the reviews for Paris I couldn't resist adding a tin to my shopping cart.  It has quickly become my "go-to" tea.  The flavor is smooth and lovely--I'm typically more a fan of green tea, but this black tea has become a favorite.  A perfect winter day is coming in from the slopes to enjoy an evening with a pot of Paris (just a touch of honey and lemon!), a good book, and my husband napping on the couch with the cat curled up on his chest.  The bonus is that the shop owner, Lana, provides excellent service.  I received my package in the mail very quickly, she included a sweet little handwritten note and free sample in the package, and when I had a question for her she answered promptly. Additionally, her prices are very competitive for a good tea.  Not only can you feel good about purchasing a high quality product, but you can feel great about supporting an excellent small business!

I first tasted this tea in a fine resaurant. I ordered it the next day from Amazon.

I never grow tired of the flavor. Paris tea constantly surprizes and delights me with its many layers and textures of taste.

I purchased this tea after seeing all of the great reviews, and I was not disappointed. Once it arrived, I immediately opened it and was delighted by the fragrance of the tea. I took several deep breaths before actually making the tea it smells so good. It is very comforting, and now one of my new favorites. If you like fragrant teas like I do (I'm also a huge fan of Jasmine tea), then you want this tea! I like how you can reuse the tea bags, although the second cup isn't quite as nice. It's nice plain, but I feel like the comfy aroma just begs to be complimented with a little milk and honey. I will definitely be ordering more of this tea and more from Harney and Sons, if only to get the adorable tins the tea comes in!
Not only is this a delicious tea, it smells wonder, too. This makes for a very tasty tea experience and one that brings comfort any time of day.

You haven't had a cup of tea until you've had a cup of Harney & Sons Paris tea.  Before I discovered Harney & Sons Paris, I didn't realize tea could taste so delicious, so elegant, so lovely.  It comes in a beautiful tin, love the silk bags, and it's difficult (if not impossible) to return to grocery store brands after trying this.  But for the price, why should you?  Harney & Sons has taken something as simple as tea and elevated it to a whole new level.  Highly recommended (makes a wonderful gift, too!).
After reading all the reviews I was somewhat disappointed.  I read on the Harney and Sons website that this tea had a vanilla caramel flavor..but it has more of a fruit flavor.

I bought this for my son. We sat at the counter in the kitchen and talked of tea, Shoguns, Japan, and many other things that interest him. Yes, the tea is superb, but more than that, two tea bags and 30 minutes made magic in my kitchen. It is not often that you get the chance to appreciate your child as an intelligent, thoughtful person. That is the real magic of the tea.

This is very similar in flavor to Kusmi St. Petersburg, although St. Petersburg is far superior in complexity of flavor. Ultimately, I find Paris to be a little boring.

I've noticed that the caffeine in Paris makes me feel jittery for some reason. I drink black tea every morning and don't have this problem with other brands. Not sure why Paris seems intensely caffeinated in comparison.

For those who'd like to try this tea without breaking the bank, I've found Paris and other selections at The Fresh Market for just $5.99. My local grocery store carries a few flavors as well, all for around $6. H&S Dragon Pearl Jasmine is my favorite from this line.

If you're willing to shell out $15-20 for a tea, try Kusmi instead.

I read the review and was wondering if the tea was as good as everyone said. Wow, it is even better!! Reminiscent of Earl Grey, but slightly different, and much better. My favorite tea in the world.

Perhaps it's expensive at 45 cents a satchel, but I get 2 cups out of each, and it's much cheaper than a Starbucks latte. And this is certainly NOT Lipton tea.
I just love this tea! I love vanilla tea, fruity tea, and black tea, and this has the perfect combination. I save it for the weekends when I have time to savor it. It does remind me of Paris....

Ordered this tea recently and their Hot Cinnamon tea also. I have to say both are exquisite but this Paris Tea is the best black tea I have ever had! It's a perfect blend of black with a touch of Earl Grey and a nice Vanilla note. It is suppose to be one of the most popular tea blends in Paris. I am getting 3 small tea cups brewed per sachet (bag). If you love tea you have to try this one! The tins are cool also!

This tea is outstanding! Tea use to give me side effects, so I gave up on it.

Not only is this product delicious, but I must say, "Viva Le France"!Harney and Sons Paris I use honey to sweeten.
This is my most favorite tea ever. Expensive but worth the splurge - I also think it makes a great gift.
I had this flavor tea while visiting a coastal coffee/tea house. I had truly enjoyed it and was thrilled to find it here. I still enjoy this as part of my tea rotation.

The sweet, floral notes of the Paris blend tea infuse a delicate balance of citrus and fruit flavor. Tea sachets are meshed for adequate steeping, though nothing can replace properly brewed loose-leaf tea. The bagged tea leaves are high quality, noticeably more natural then mashed contents of typical American tea bags. Texture of tea is highly smooth, leaving behind a pleasant, velvety taste. Wonderful with cream and sugar! Perfect for breakfast or an afternoon cup. Worthy of pinkie lifting, fine bone china, and a fresh made scone or two. Definitely recommended.

I adore "Paris" tea by Harney & Sons.  In fact, I love all H & S teas, but Paris is my fave!!!  It has a hint of bergamot among the blend of other palette-pleasing herbs and spices, which always seems to transport me to a pleasant and soothing place. I recommend it highly.
ordered this for my daughters paris tea birthday party, what a perfect fit, smells and tastes soooo good.
This is a very tasty tea. I served it at a bridal shower and it was one of the favorites. My husband loved it and took the remaining tea bags to work. We'll be ordering more!

This tea has the best flavor!  I've tried it in a local cafe and in a nice restaurant, where I order it every time.  It's delicious and I'm always sad when my cup is empty!  I can't wait to be able to make it for myself at home!
Treat yourself to top quality tea and feel like Parisian royalty. Steeping instructions included to ensure a top quality experience.

This tea is soo good.  This is the only flavor I've tried, so I will by more.  I wish you could find it for sale in shops, I noticed Starbucks has their basic mixes like black and green teas...but no other markets have it.  I think I saw some at Williams Sonoma, too.  But that's it.
...but man do I like this tea. It has a nice aroma and nice flavor. Of course... how do I better express this in a review. Oh! Put your nose up to the computer screen... Smell... Ah! Isn't that nice?

only $13.29 a case on the petco site (Oct 20, 2011) - not worth the .70 cents a can they're charging here.

My mother won't use any othe tea.  We spent years picking up boxes here and there until I decided to check Amazon on chance that it would have it, and it did.  Now my mom can order directly from Amazon.  My mother is Scottish and this is her first choice of tea.

I grew up in Scotland in the 1930's. The three daily meals were called breakfast,dinner, and tea, in that order. Yes,tea was so important that the last meal of the day was called tea.
I've lived in the USA for over 50 years. It's been great but finding an easy source of good tea has been a chalenge, until now. That is until I found London Cuppa and an easy and affordable source via Amazon.com. The taste is rich and very smooth; the best tea I've ever had.

I have been drinking London Cuppa tea for a few years, always getting the 80 or 40-bag boxes from tjmaxx.  However, I can't find them there anymore and luckily Amazon carries them.  I go through about 2 to 3 bags a day.  At 7 cents a tea bag, this is the best deal if you must have strong, unflavored black tea.  It is great drinking by itself, with cream, and/or sugar.  I can't recommand it enough to strong tea lovers!  Amazon has the best deal and at this price, you don't pay for shipping.

Strong English tea, no doubt about it.  No funky after taste, either.  Just bold and delicious and the best pick me up.  It's my preferred brand and I've been drinking English teas for a good 25 years now.  I've been known to clear the shelf at TJMaxx when the boxes of 40 and 80 pop up.  Imagine my surprise and delight when I discovered that I could get 440 bags from Amazon!!!  If you buy the 440 of London Cuppa, then please keep your tea in a tin, to preserve the flavour and don't ever store it in the freezer.  It will moisten and mold there.
Found this tea in my local Marshalls; and then it disappeared!  I was so happy to find it on Amazon I ordered the 440 bags of tea. Thanks to Amazon for always carrying what I want and need.

I was first introduced to good tea by a couple of expatriates from Britain. This is the tea they drank. The only place to find it was at TJMax, if you can believe it. The chance of actually finding it on the shelf was iffy at best, considering I was competeing with about a dozen serious tea drinkers who also knew about this stash. When you see a diet soda, it usually implies a funky taste.  However, sucralose sweetened beverages such as this Hansen's don't have such a problem.  As an added bonus, the ingredients in this soda have a quality taste to them.  A premium soda that doesn't sock you with a lot of calories that may come back to haunt you.  If you are a fan of root beer, try this one for sure!

This diet root beer has earned a rock-solid four stars. The only reason I'm withholding a star, is that I recall the authentic root beers of my youth [e.g., Hires], and reserve the ultimate rating for them. This beverage delivers a crisp, clear, and creamy sasparilla taste, and does it with no discernible aftershock. Try this stuff...you'll like it. Delivered to your door, at 75 cents a pop, you can't go too awfully wrong!
Tastes more like non-diet soda. No caffeine, no aspartame. Did not like the diet cherry soda. Also available from ShopRite, Genardi's and Trader Joe's. Try it, you'lll like it!
Ordered for Christmas dinner. Meat quality was not USDA prime.  I have bought select prime rib for half the price.  This was select quality not USDA prime.

This is my favorite of all the Zatarains products. You can make up a very flavorful dish in less than a half hour. For some reason, this mix is hard to find in stores so I was very happy to find this on Amazon.

Outstanding meal. Infact it's our favorite Zatarain's meal, and has oddly become hard to find. We didn't find this to be too salty, but neither are we on a low sodium diet. Very easy to fix with a can of tomatoes and some chicken, pork or shrimp.  The seasonings are flavorful and the rice cooks up nicely, unlike instant rice which has an odd extruded look and feel. My family loves Shepherd Herb Mix! We use it on a regular basis for seasoning chicken breasts and pork. There's a lot of spice packed into this re-usuable tin. Love it!

I have traveled quite a bit in Europe, and occasionally enjoy a taste of candy which is not available in the States. Of everything I have tried, Maynard's Wine Gums are by far my favorite. I have even tried the other brands, like Bassett's Wine Gums, but they simply do not compare. The flavors of Maynard's are more tart, and the gummy consistency is perfect. I received the shipment very quickly and the candy is very tasty.  I will definitely purchase again in the future.

i didn't know if i liked this taste or not. but a couple days later when i finished off the bag i decided that yes i really did like this snack. it doesn't have any slimey or greasey taste to it. my mouth does not get any weird slimey or greasey taste in it at all from this snack. it just tastes really good and it is fun to snack on. after i open the bag up i have to refrigerate it to keep them fresh. old wisconsin hard wood smoke sausage... it tastes really good. and i can see into the bag even before i opened it that there were no small chunks of grease or anything else in there. you can't go wrong with this product. i bought two more bags for snacking probably while i'm watching a movie. you might like this meaty snack. mine is delicious.

This cereal has just about everything: great crunch, lots of interesting "bits" (cranberries, nuts, etc.), and it's wonderfully filling. Two-thirds of a cup doesn't sound like a lot, but with this stuff and 1/2 C of skim milk, it's a decent serving.

If you're on Weight Watchers, this will fit right in: a serving with skim milk is only 4 points -- not bad for a nice filling breakfast. Add some fresh fruit, and you're set to go.

Amazon's price is quite good, too. This stuff is sky high in the supermarket if you can find it. Yes, you have to buy 5 packages, but a little goes a long way -- I have it 2-3 times a week, and I'm not getting tired of it at all.

All in all, a good value: healthy, filling, and great taste.

We are a Swiss household and we are used to Swiss muesli and this one is the one that I like most because of the crunch. Quite satisfying, not like the cardboard type you can buy here, and not super loaded with sugar like some store offerings.

Now it is available only through nutricity. Their availability status is wrong. I ordered on the 30th of Aug. Today is Sep 12th. Yesterday they said, they are back ordered. The first time I ordered it was filled by Amazon. As expected there were no problems with that order.
