An excellent tasting tomato puree, quite unusual as it is made from yellow and not red ones.  It had a wonderful sweet taste, less acidity than a red puree.  It made an outstanding sauce that was great on ravioli.  Additionally, I used it as the sauce for a lasagna, resulting in an unusual dish both by taste and visually.  I highly recommend this product it you want to stray from the mainstream of typical red sauces.

This is nice to keep on hand for a treat that's a little sweet, somewhat creamy, not bitter in the least, and tastes something like coffee. The manufacturers were smart to choose the name "memento" that could refer to memories of past times enjoying coffee with friends, or maybe remembering yourself back into any pleasing activity or environment by recalling it as you enjoyed this drink. Nescafé Memento in itself is neither distinguished nor memorable, but it's convenient and a quality product.

I never enjoyed coffee the way most people do. It just didn't taste good to me. This has turned me into a coffee drinker.

I got some samples of this recently, but waited to try them since I assumed they would be too sweet for my taste. The mocha was just ok, but the caramel flavor I loved. This one also is delicious.

I like the way this foams a bit on the top to add to the creaminess. I had tried Cappuccino once at Starbucks and didn't like it but this is delicious. It tastes like desert to me, or something to drink with desert. I appreciate the fact that this isn't overly sugary. And, unlike the mocha flavor, in this one I can taste the rich coffee flavor.

Nescafe has a winning product here. It's hard to imagine anyone not liking these. If they can turn even a non-coffee drinker into a fan, they have hit a home run with these beverages.

I tried this product at a recent conference expo hall (BlogHer in NYC) and I freaking love this stuff! I honest to goodness even Instagrammed and Tweeted out because I was out and so sad that I couldn't find more (was told it would be in stores next month though!)

The thing about this product is that it's meant to be a light, frothy drink - a little momento away (ha ha). It's not a hardcore coffee so if you want that - drink a cup of coffee. The Cappuccino flavor is by far and large my fav as it has the most coffee flavor. My friend tried the Mocha flavor and really loved it - I felt that it was not 'coffee' enough for me.

First, I had to get over my bias against instant coffee. Going in, I told myself that there are positives about instant coffee: (1) the packets are easy to carry & easy to mix (time saver), (2) the flavor has improved over the years, and (3) there are more varieties today (even Starbucks packages instant coffee).

What I was looking for in the Nescafe Memento Cappuccino was (1) a not so calorie laden coffee and (2) an afternoon or after dinner dessert coffee.

The Memento Cappuccino is not a coffeehouse cappuccino because it isn't as strong as the cappuccino that I purchase at my coffeehouse. However, it isn't bitter, so I do give it points for that since I can remember the days when instant coffee was very bitter. I followed the instructions & mixed the packets contents with 8oz of hot water in a 10oz cup. The ratio of milk to coffee was good & the mixed drink tasted like a cappuccino. The mix produced a slight foam that sat on top of the coffee for quite a while. The mix contains sugar, so I did not need to add more sugar (but those who like a sweeter coffee will want to add more sugar).

Verdict: Nescafe Memento is a decent, convenient coffee packet to have on hand for those times when you want a cappuccino but don't want to brew one or go to your coffeehouse to purchase one. With the individual packets, it is also easy to throw a few packets into your suitcase or backpack.

I received a sample of this product in the mail. I really like a good cup of coffee and brew a pot in the morning and often enjoy a mid-afternoon instant coffee.

I've bought Nescafe products in the past and been happy, but this particular flavor tastes off. It does have some weird foam at the top of the cup, but in no way does this coffee resemble anything you'd get at a good coffeehouse. I'd rather drink International Coffee than this. Definitely not worth the 100 calories.

Have been buying this a the local store... great product.

Currently on the Weight Watchers diet. Needed sweet, portable item to take with me that stops the craving. Tried so many others I can't even list them all. This is by far my favorite. Not too strong. The mint is definitely wintergreen, not peppermint or spearmint.

Each box contains a LOT of mints - compared to other mints its reasonable priced - a box lasts for about a week in my desk at work...depends on how often you eat one. Probably something like 100+ mints per box (smaller than a dime size, but not tiny).

Mint NOT filling or anything, just helps with giving you something in your mouth (if you don't chew / bit it, it could last for 15 minutes) and sweet tasting. Flavor lasts after mint for ~10 minutes.

I'm on auto delivery for this item. I enjoy sugar free mints and it is around 1.50 per can instead of the 1.99 at my local target.  That alone is reason to buy in bulk.  I keep a tin in my purse, in the car, at my desk at work, my husband carries one in his pocket.  In the workplace, I never want to "wonder" if my breath is offensive. I certainly recommend this product and will probably purchase these again.

I have been looking for this in my local stores for a long time but since I live in a rural area it wasn't available.  I was thrilled when Amazon offered it since my husband is diabetic and can't eat regular desserts. It is a good base for several desserts other than layer cakes too.
I made cupcakes with this mix and it was delicious! Tastes just like the real thing! I will definitely buy this again.

I bought this as an alternative to the regular version of Pillsbury cake mixes and while it tasted fine, I did suffer from horrible gas and stomach pains.  I ate only the recommended amount, but the problems last a couple of days.  I am not saying this will happen to everyone who tries this product, but my husband and myself won't dare eat this cake, nor the sugar-free frosting again!

This product is really great for those who are diabetic or have to monitor their sugar/carb intake. It's a great alternative to regular Pillsbury cake mix and frosting.  I made this and no one could tell the difference between the sugar free and the real cake mix/frosting. The cake mix held up well and remained very moist. I used the yellow cake mix and chocolate frosting. I used the 2 9 inch pans and made sure to follow directions for timing correctly. They do not take as long to bake or at as high of temp. I also used a metal knife to apply frosting and made to sure to run warm water over the knife when frosting the layers of cake. This helped to make sure that the frosting did not stick to the knife and cause the cake to tear. I did this several times and came out with even frosting on cake. My only problem was trying to not eat the whole jar of frosting when making the dessert!

Although the box warns that "excessive consumption may cause a laxative effect", I only had 2 cupcakes and got scary explosive diarrhea, loud exploding gas and I thought I was gonna die until I realized it was likely the sweetener!  I'm sure this sugar free version has way too much artificial sweetener to make it taste as sweet as it does. Maybe they should just have a low sugar version instead, or sweeten with a natural sweetener like stevia. These were my halloween cupcakes, maybe I shouldve pranked people with it but the diarrhea was so horrible I was afraid it might dehydrate someone!

This is the first time I have so much gas and fart after eating a cake. Two hours after the meal, it's almost guaranteed that I start to suffer and it lasts for the entire day. My wife has the same symptom and so it is certain. So uncomfortable.

It bakes up and tastes just like the real thing. I picked this up because I thought it had Splenda, which doesn't give me any problems. But then I found it had Maltitol--which brings down the wrath of god on your digestive system if you dare to ingest more than the recommended amount. I recommend trying a very small piece and then waiting a few hours to see if you have adverse effects.

So it's great for diabetics and gastric bypass people but--stick to the exact (or less) portion size recommended on the box. Not even gas-x, ginger, or tums can help you if you eat more than that. And I didn't even have it with frosting--this was one three by three inch square of plain yellow cake.

I'll stick to making my own mixes with a combination of Splenda and stevia from now on. But if the giant, indigestible molecules of Maltitol and other sugar alcohols (do not confuse with alcohol that you drink) do not affect you in any way---rock on!
Again, this is a great product and company. Other brands of this type do not come up to my standards, and this actually tastes good.

I grew up eating Starkist tuna. It was my favorite above any other brands I tried. This is not the same tuna it was before.

I noticed a decline in quality for some time. The tuna had a stronger smell. There was often nuclear-orange glowing color on top of the tuna. The size of the cans got smaller. One can used to yield a few sandwiches. Now you have to open at least two cans for two people. When you drain the liquid out, the lid goes so far down because there isn't as much tuna as there used to be. But that isn't the worst part.

I noticed this year that every can I've opened has had some sort of sludgy gel-like goo surrounding the tuna. I touched it to see what it was like and it feels like grimy slime. I wondered if this was a bad batch (we usually buy lots of cans at a time) or some sort of new way they are packing it. I looked it up and saw others were finding the same thing in their tuna. I tried eating some of it after getting most of the goo off. But it did not taste very good. I now regret eating it at all after reading the following.

Apparently the company was once owned by Del Monte, but was sold to a South Korean tuna company that was hoping to get into the American market. For what reason? To poison us? Seriously, I can't imagine what they put in these cans. I also read that they refused to provide records to the FDA when asked. That can't be good. Why is this stuff still on our store shelves? Why are American companies selling out to foreign ones all the time? Americans are finding it harder and harder to afford groceries. We don't want to spend our money on trash products. I will never buy Starkist again unless it one day makes its way back to American hands. There is obviously something wrong with it. Just look at it and smell it next time you open a can. It's no longer the tasty tuna of yesteryear. It is now tuna bits in slimy, tuna-flavored sludge water.

I have two Cavaliers. Chipper came from a breeder and Shea from a rescue organization.

Chipper was always a smelly dog. Cute, affectionate, STINKY. I had to bathe him every week just to stand keeping him inside. He also always had dark "tear stains" down his white face. We tried several high-quality foods from the pet supply store. Nothing seemed to make any difference.

Shea came to us at 6 years old with a wiry coat and itchy skin. If you are familiar with Cavaliers, a "wiry" coat is not appropriate. Their coats are soft and silky. He came to us on Science Diet Lamb & Rice.

We did some due diligence and found TOTW. It has made all of the difference! After about 3 months Shea's coat had become softer, and his itchy skin was much less irritated. We've fed it now for about 18 months, and Shea's coat is soft and beautiful. Better yet, Chipper isn't stinky any more! He can go three weeks without a bath. Plus, his face is WHITE, with no stains!

Both dogs are "middle aged" indoor-dogs, but active. We free-feed, and have no weight problems with them at all. We've tried several different flavors, with no real preference. I just buy whichever one is the most reasonably priced when the time comes. Lately that has been the Bison flavor.

This is the best dog food I have found. First there is the nutritional profile which is top notch. Then there is the fact that dogs love it. I even tested it with others giving my dogs an option of which they wanted. They always picked TOTW. Then lastly their systems handle TOTW best.

If you have not tried it yet and don't mind the money then you need to try it.

I switched over to TOTW from First Mate after FM increased their price and decreased their size. The recommended amount of TOTW is half of what I was feeding with Science diet so it is actually cheaper for me in the long run.

Also, he had soft, oily looking stools while eating this.  He is an active, very healthy, well-exercised, older dog.  He did seem to be more "chipper" and health-wise, he seemed to do fine, except for the softer stools and weight gain, but reluctantly, we had to stop feeding this, exclusively, as we were feeding less and less and he was still gaining weight AND seemed hungry all the time, looking for any other food to eat.  Since he loves the taste so much, we have decided to give him only a cup or so a day, in his Kong, with his other food or as training treats and have switched him to another food.  I'm not sure I agree with the "good for all life stages" philosophy either.  In the old days, that was what one did, but now that we know much more about nutrition, I believe that different life stages do require different nutrient levels.  Much as humans do.  Sadly, for our dog, this can not be the only food he eats, but it will remain a part of his daily diet, since he loves it and did well, except for the fat content.  Hope this helps!

I have a French Bulldog that has developed food allergies and is also a very picky eater. In our quest to find him a food that was good for him and he actually liked eating I stumbled on Taste of the Wild at a local specialty dog food store. I decided to give TotW a chance after trying Canidae and realizing that the protein content was too high for my Frenchie.

After switching to Taste of the Wild I immediately noticed an improvement in my pups stool - nice and firm and only 2-3 movements per day. Vice 5+ movements on Nutro and Canidae. My Frenchie's notorious gas was also cut way down. I supplement his dog food with all-natural unflavored yogurt too and this helps cut down on the gas greatly. After a few weeks I also noted that my dog's coat is soft and shines.

Another positive to Taste of the Wild is that their formulas are similar enough between Hi Prairie, Pacific Stream and Wetlands Canine that I can rotate the menu a bit and keep my pup happily chomping down on his food. Previously my dog would tire of the same dog food after only a few weeks.

For anyone with a dog with food allergies I highly recommend Taste of the Wild. Not only are their formulas grain free, but they also use unique sources of protein. For example duck instead of the more readily available chicken as a major protein source.

I was walking my dog and met some people with a boxer; when I pet their dog, I was wow, her coat is so soft while my dog was stiff and more brittle like; I asked them what they were feeding her and they said Taste of the Wild;  I switched my dog and her coat is just as soft now as the other dog; my dog is still suffering from some allergy itch so it didn't totally alleviate that but it has decreased and her coat is just amazing.

I thought I was doing the right thing by buying organic and thought Similac was a brand I could trust to be good for baby. That is, until I came across this NY Times article about the sugar they use... [...] Needless to say I'm switching to another brand.

From the article:

Parents may be buying [Similac Organic] because they believe that organic is healthier, but babies may have a reason of their own for preferring Similac Organic: it is significantly sweeter than other formulas. It is the only major brand of organic formula that is sweetened with cane sugar, or sucrose, which is much sweeter than sugars used in other formulas.

No health problems in babies have been associated with Similac Organic. But to pediatricians, there are risks in giving babies cane sugar: Sucrose can harm tooth enamel faster than other sugars; once babies get used to its sweeter taste, they might resist less sweet formulas or solid foods; and some studies suggest that they might overeat, leading to rapid weight gain in the first year, which is often a statistical predictor of childhood obesity.

The problem appeared to be fixed in the most recent reviews and I didn't believe they could sell a bad product for an extended period on Amazon and get away with it. I was wrong.  The couscous tastes rancid - if it's not stale it certainly is not appetizing.

Looking for an alternative to pasta and/or rice?  This whole wheat couscous is great, easy to make, and very, very healthy.  Unlike the couscous in many supermarkets, the grains are a bit larger and round.  Anyhow, the plastic jars keep the couscous nicely.

I've been drinking soy milk for many years and have tried a lot of different brands; Silk is the brand I buy most often. I like to choose organic wherever I can so this flavor gets points from me there. It's a good consistency, similar to whole milk if you've had that before to compare. As far as taste, it is creamy tasting yet very plain/neutral which is good on a number of levels: I can sweeten to taste - for instance with coffee or tea I prefer to use a little agave. In recipes that are savory calling for milk I don't have to worry about altering the flavor towards sweet.

These aseptic packages are handy to keep in the pantry so you never run out; they can keep for months at a time. To me, this tastes almost identical to the refrigerated version.

I can often find this locally for less so it's a good idea to compare prices.

Pleased with this product and recommended.

Silk is great stuff, and these aseptic packages are supposed to be good for a year.
That doesn't do much good when there is less than 2 months left on the product when received.
I stocked up for the winter in case we can't get to town to buy fresh.
Ordering Silk via Amazon is a bogus shopping experience; they can't be returned because 'technically' there is nothing wrong with the product.
5 stars if you're drinking it next week.
0 stars if you're stocking up for 6 months from now.

At 3 g carbs (excluding fiber) and 7 g protein per cup, this is a tasty and diabetic-friendly alternative to milk.  Price is not bad at $15 for 6 32-oz containers, but I've seen it advertised in grocery stores for significantly less.

Terrific, bold licorice flavor in a small, no calorie package.  These aren't intended to be eaten by the handful.  They're intended to be consumed as small lozenges that pack a lasting burst of all natural licorice flavor.

Pros: If you like strong licorice flavor, this has it.

Cons: If you want a chewy piece of strong licorice, this is NOT for you.

I was expecting pieces of licorice, but each piece is about the size of a Nerd candy. The whole box is about 1"x 1". I had thought the 0.4 oz was a typo on 4oz, but it is very accurate.

The taste is fine, and they are good to suck on, but not chew, and they aren't really a useful size as they are way to easy to swallow 1/2 way through.

They taste a lot like black licorice, especially the after taste. The texture is slightly harder than I anticipated. The boxes were very tiny, which was a surprise. But they were a nice little snack during my time on a strict diet that allowed no carbs and no sugar, almost made me feel like I was cheating.

Read the fine print before you buy this! I got it as a gift for a friend who is allergic to gluten but loves licorice. Turns out this is for 6 teeny tiny, barbie doll sized boxes of licorice. What look like juicy, chewy licorice bits in the photo are about the size of ice cream sprinkles in a tiny box. Plus they taste TERRIBLE and Amazon won't let you return food items, so now I'm stuck with a bunch of inedible tiny boxes of licorice! Yuck!

From the picture, it almost looks like a box the size of a small cereal box.  But in reality, it's a very tiny box, with tiny tiny little chunks of crunchy licorice.  I guess it tastes good but it's not quite my cup of tea.
This is the worst tasting product. I love black licorice & was hoping this would be a treat. It took brushing teeth & swishing mouthwash to get this taste out of my mouth. Do not recommend.
I wanted licorice not teeny, tiny, rock hard pellets. I tasted one and it was awful. I ended up throwing all the boxes in the bin. If you love licorice these are not for you.

Planters Walnuts are indeed delicious.  However, it is definitely not cost efficient to purchase them online.  The 7.25 ounce canisters are 5.97 each at WalMart... Three canisters would cost $17.91 plus tax.  And that is a heck of a lot cheaper than $39.95 plus shipping.
These nuts are delicious! I am so happy they are available in bulk too. I highly recommend them. Try these!

I utilized Amazon's "Subscribe and Save" option.  The first time I made the rice, it didn't taste the same as the store bought rice.  Since I have a fairly large family, I assumed that doubling the recipe contributed to the negative outcome.  Unfortunately, I tried the rice again and wasn't pleased. A few weeks later, my son discovered that the rice expired within 1-2 months of our purchase.  Since we've never had problems with "Rice A Roni" before, I'm contributing the problem to the expiration date.

These are adorable! I had a camping themed birthday party for my 3-year-old son, and gave these out for party favors and the kiddos were so excited! They LOVED them. This is a great deal for them too. I did a lot of shopping around to get the best deal, and this $25 for 24 packages was by far the best deal around! NOTE- I didn't actually taste the candy myself, but the kids sure loved them!
the 10 little pieces of gummy candy in each bag tastes cheap and chemically. The kids definitely were entertained by the light up tongs...for about 3 minutes that is. Not recommended.
I use this product with my students.  I am a school based Occupational Therapist and love the tweezers and "bugs".  It's a great fine motor activity and the kids never tire of it.

"Lightning Bugs" are basicly gummy candy bugs that "glow" when grabbed with the include tongs. One of the tong tips actually lights up (red) as they are closed around the gummy bug body, causing it glow very brightly. The tongs are packaged in it's own bag inside the bag of candy.

The flavor is good and what you would likely expect from gummy candy.

This is a cute novelty candy that my kids enjoyed. Recommended!

Nifty hot chocolate discs added to your warm milk or milk alternative is simply yum! Made in Ireland so you know the chocolate is high quality.

Ingredients for those that desire it (I think it should be a requirement on any listing):
Milk chocolate 29% (sugar, whole milk powder, cocoa butter, cocoa mass, emulsifier:soya lecithin, flavouring: natural
vanilla), Cocoa mass 25%, Invert sugar syrup, Sugar syrup, sugar, water, preservtive:sorbic acid), Sweetened condensed
milk (milk, sugar). Milk chocolate contains 32% cocoa, solids minimum, 20% milk solids minimum.

Shelf life is about 18 months.

Bellagio Sipping Chocolate, Original, 1-Ounce Packets (Pack of 25)

The directions for this beverage are to add one 1-ounce packet to 1/3 cup whole milk, and I'm sure this would be delicious. I, however, prefer to add the packet to one cup of 2% milk and find it makes great hot chocolate. I like dark chocolate and it may be a bit strong for those people who prefer milder chocolate.

I'm doing Weight Watchers and have made the change to skim milk only.  Was having trouble without chocolate and after discovering this product decided to attempt it as my substitute.  Wow!  Even with skim milk this stuff is great.  Now I get my 2 cups milk in, and each packet is only 1 WW points because if its high fiber content.  Very satisfying late night drink.

I bought these ostensibly for my husband, but after a particularly bad day I decided to tear into one. I bought four packets in different flavors: cherry, caramel, chocolate-mint and original. Don't worry, I will replace the ones that go into my husband's birthday gift but I couldn't resist.

I used them in an interesting application, which is to make 'frozen hot chocolate'. I took a packet of the original and blended it with ice and milk (actually I used So Delicious Coconut Milk Beverage because I eschew dairy). I like that it doesn't have powdered milk solids or anything else. It's a very pure mix that isn't muddled up by a ton of sugar or extra fanfare.

Great sipping chocolate! Exceeded my expectations. I tried three of the flavors. I am going to get more to replace the ones I pilfered...

Made as directed, this is a delicious drink. But it's also strong enough to extend: I tried it using 2/3 cup half-and-half and it was creamy and simply fantastic.

Even with the hot dairy, dissolving can be difficult. I find that a mini-whisk works wonders; lots of churn without a lot of sloshing.

I saw this type of sipping chocolate on QVC. They described it in such away that I just could not resist. I add sugar and a little more milk than recommended for the sipping recipe but it is also the best hot chocolate I have ever had. I buy new types of hot chocolate every time I see one but I will stick with this from now on. Try it just once!Bellagio Sipping Chocolate, Original, 1-Ounce Packets (Pack of 25)

Just as I would expect form a sipping chocolate, this came out chocolatey without the extra sugariness. I really liked it. The poweder is super fine, which can be a pain to work with when you're trying not to make a mess. The end result is tasty tho - just stir thoroughly.

I recommend following the 4 oz. directions for a rich, velvetey drink. I even tried this with soy! Would buy again, but wish it was less pricey.

Sipping Chocolate Dessert Beverage by Bellagio
This tops them all. A full dessert in only 3 oz.

I must say I was quite disappointed in this product and will not order it again.  I had purchased this product a few years ago and remembered it being so full bodied, flavorful and just perfect in every respect.  It was like drinking a perfect cup of hot chocolate.  But this product while bearing the same name, yet a much different packaging look did not measure up to that earlier experience.  I'm still searching for that best cup again.

I had mine first (a gift from someone) in 6 oz. milk. It was extremely rich and thick and fulfilling. Any lover of dark chocolate would adore this stuff. Part of the overall experience is the struggle to actually just sip it. After the first taste, the instinct is to gobble it up. Take it slow. Make it last. Every small sip is a flavor explosion, like a crumb of Maytag Blue Cheese.
I enjoy full-bodied chocolate so I thought I'd enjoy Bellagio's flavor. But it ended up being too strong, even with plenty of milk and sugar.

I am so impressed with this sipping chocolate. I thought it would be too sweet, judging from the sugar content listed in the nutrition facts, but it's just right. This tastes like sipping a melted bar of 80% dark chocolate, it's so rich and creamy. I drink one packet a day as a treat to myself and it's more than enough to keep me satisfied without sneaking other sweets. I will re-order when I run out!
bought this expecting a good rich chocolate flavor. terribley disappointed. tasted like chocolate flavored perfume. wouldn't recommend this to anyone. would rate this 0 if i could

These individual packets make a small cup of hot milk a wonderful treat.  The deep, dark chocolate flavor makes you feel like you are enjoying a stay at an expensive bed and breakfast. I recommend using whole milk to give rich mouth feel, although any way you make it will be good.

That is a cocoa powder of a really great quality, I'd say the best hot chocolate, but not a sipping chocolate. I love drinking chocolate. So may be it is just me being wrong by assuming that sipping chocolate means drinking chocolate.
You HAVE to try the VANILLA Tootsie Rolls!  The regular chocolate ones are good, but THESE are the BEST EVER!!
Slowed my dog down by about 3 seconds.  Now, I think it is actually esier for her to inhale her food since it is in the channel.

I absolutely feel like I got ripped off with this product. It only took my shiba about one minute to figure out how to go around the stupid bump and gobble down her food. So, it does not faze her one bit when it comes to eating. I'm kind of tired just watching her go all around the bowl. Plus like many other reviewers I find that's it's starting to come apart at the seam. I won't be contacting the company though because I don't want a replacement.
Tasted like a couple of pieces of toast.  Anyone who likes bagels should stay away from these.
The picture shows redskin peanuts with skin on.  What I got was some other type, looked blanched, with skin off.  Ridiculous!
like eating soft plastic . we pored them in a big pile in the back yard under the trees. the squeals wont eat them!
How in the world are you guys going to jump your price all the way up to 31.36 when they were just 22.97 a couple hours ago. This is insane. Makes me not want to shop through you guys at all smh.

If you trust quality in brand names, LAY'S products is a no brainer. Sent quickly,opened to a fresh aroma that brings you back to childhood. I recommend this box of snacks to people close to me and are a quick mover to those that make a buck selling candy, soda, chips, cupcakes etc.

Since receiving my Jolokia powder (with very fast shipping), it has quickly become my favorite spice. The flavor is very reminiscent of Cayenne pepper, except that the Jolokia powder has more flavor than the Cayenne. It also has a lot more kick (though I admit it is not as spicy as I expected, based on reputation - it made me sweat, but my head did not explode). If you find the Jolokia powder too spicy, I might suggest mixing it with some Cayenne powder, as the flavors are so similar. I've not tried this myself, but it should be good.

In short, if you like Cayenne powder but you want more kick, Jolokia powder is perfect for you. If Jalapenos make you sweat... well, let's just say you should look elsewhere.
The Ghost Pepper powder works great for making everything spicier. A little goes a long way, so for those of you who are worried about the price - keep that in mind. It is worth the price.

More. Please.

Finally, a solution to my problems! I can put this powder into a little pill container and place it in my purse for instant spice action. So awesome. Carrying hotsauce in my purse was just too burdensome and most of them should be refrigerated anyhow. Rock on.
This is a great powder.  It has a really good kick while maintaining a good flavor. I like to sprinkle it on pizza, eggs, even pop corn.  I am going to make sure I stay stocked up on this stuff.
Bought the ghost pepper powder as a gift.  This product is excellent quality -- Very,very hot & great to get 2 whole peppers too!  Delivery was timely.  Totally satisfied.

I've always liked hot stuff, but lately I've found I need more and more to get the same kick. I guess I've developed a tolerance? I'm not a fan of ground habanero, because it changes the flavor of the food too much, so my go-to spice has always been cayenne. But in order to get the heat level I want, I use so much that it flavors the food as well. I finally got around to ordering this, and I'm very pleased. I get just the right amount of heat without the flavor overpowering the food. It's no where near as hot as I was expecting, though. I've seen it on several TV shows where the chefs make a big deal about it with gas masks and gloves like it's DEFCON 1. I don't know if this has the heat that a ghost pepper SHOULD have, as I have never tried it before, but I would hazard a guess that this has about triple of what your average grocery store cayenne powder has.

P.S I give the seller 5 stars - Ordered late Saturday and received on a Wednesday!
I thought it was great. If your want hot, this is just for you. Just one word for this item  GREAT

I put between 20 and 25 grains of pepper powder into a bowl of chilli.  It put a very good flavor into my bowl of chilli.  I enjoyed the taste of the ghost pepper powder.  Now that said, 5 minutes later the burn in my mouth was still getting hotter.  It was not too hot but just the fact that it kept getting hotter minutes afterwards left me with a respect that I will keep in mind.  Yes it does have a good flavor but this pepper is hot and I am sure that using 50 to 55 grains would have made the hot part not very enjoyable.  I enjoy hot sauces and have made my own for years but you need to approach the ghost pepper with lots of respect.  I will use this powder to make my own hot sauce but it will be a sauce that you can can enjoy.
Three little specs on a bit size piece of chicken and my head is hot and sweating.  WOW!  And.... it taste really good!  Bhut Jolokia, You and I are going to get along just fine :)

I guess I have a high heat tolerance, because this only seemed maybe two or three times as hot as a grocery store habanero. (according to scoville rating, the weaker grocery store habaneros are about ten times less than this, the red savina which I have never tried is supposed to be three times hotter)
That isn't why I'm giving this only three stars though.

First off the taste - it was terrible. I haven't tried the peppers themselves yet, but the powder tastes awful I've tried it with soup and chips, and it worked slightly better with chips - and made my soup taste bad. It's a bit hard to describe - bitter and dry I guess would be the best way to describe it. Not sweet like I expected... I have heard ghost peppers have a somewhat similar sweet taste to the habanero. In this powder though I don't taste that at all.

Second this stuff is very... dust like.
you have to be very careful pouring it, because it is ground so fine that it gets into the air easier than anything I've ever seen. Fortunately when I breathe it in, it doesn't really burn - I guess it's just to small and insignificant of an amount to do that, but it does make me cough a lot.

I'll update the review a bit more once I try out the peppers themselves, even though they are a bonus.

Edit: I got around to trying the peppers themselves, and the taste was similar. Perhaps I just don't like the taste of these peppers. I definitely would not call them sweet tasting at all though.

As advertised, this powder is exceptionally powerful. A little bit...and I mean about two very gentle shakes of the container...into a pot of baked beans and franks overspiced the concoction even by my maniacal standards. Worse yet, it introduced a taste that I might describe as gunpowder but in any case was somewhere within the realm of acrid. I had hoped that, with more power, one could get the heat with almost no taste influence.

But the biggest problem was the container. There is no easy way to control delivery to a single portion. I bought this product because I couldn't find the one I love, whose name I no longer know, which is granular and comes in a container with a grinder.

I will have to throw this away before it destroys a meal or hurts someone.

well now i no longer have to wait for friends to send me arabic coffee from palestine, i can make it myself here in the US of A. i typically roast a handfull of cardamon and then mix it with the Arabic Yemini coffee -also from amazon- and grind it realy fine. this makes a perfect cup of coffee.

cardamon is also great on ground meat, i usualy add it to my burgers and they taste fabulous.

I bought this block of marzipan to make roses for my daughter's wedding cake in September. Came out beautifully!! I kept the rest for my sisters and I to wrap our traditional English Christmas fruitcakes. Well....not quite enough of the marzipan made it to the Thanksgiving weekend when the cakes were made. Instead,we decided to eat the rest with a spoon (actually, I was digging chunks out with a butter knife between September and Thanksgiving!) This is the real deal and you won't find a better price.

There are many grades of Marzipan and I would rate this one at cooking and pastry making grade, but not as a fine candy. It had a tiny bit of unmixed almond flour but this was one of the few marzipan products that was wheat (gluten) free so we loved it!

The Marzipan lasted 3 months in our frig without getting moldy or stale.

I have been a marzipan fanatic for over 55 years. While there are finer and fancier marzipans, in my opinion, for the money, this is a very nice, dependable product. I buy a 5 pound wedge every year, and make candy gifts for family and friends, and always get compliments and cheers. If you are a serious gourmet, you might not care for it, but for most people, for general use, it is quite nice.

I have been buying this marzipan regularly for the past few years. I use it in our weekly strudels (see strudel recipe and tutorial at [...]- [...] for pictures of this marzipan in use), and it is a joy to work with. It is always delivered quickly, fresh and delicious.

This product is kosher: It is supervised by the OU, and pareve.

I have tried ordering in larger amounts, but 5lbs stays fresh without getting dried out. 10lbs. dried out after a two months, despite being kept in an air-tight container. Smaller amounts weren't cost-effective, due to the price of shipping.

As a few others have mentioned, this is not a high grade marzipan. It doesn't taste or feel like the Odense marzipan I normally buy. This tastes more doughy or floury (like flour) (are those even words?) It does seem fresh, and while I do find occasional sections that aren't mixed very well (chunks of almond something - looks white, not an almond though) it does taste ok. If you were baking with it, it's probably good. I just wouldn't use it for making flowers or little edibles. It has a slight alcohol taste. Not bad, but not Odense either.

[Edit about a month later]

I ordered another batch from this company and this package tasted MUCH better. Still not quite top grade, but I'm changing my 3 stars to 4. I would buy this again.

This was the first time I'd ever used marzipan and it was for my friends wedding cake.  It was delivered a bit early which was great and was very pliable when I received.  The five pounds had to stretch pretty far to be rolled into a three tiered cake but it worked out and looked beautiful.  Great product and I'd definitely order it again.

I recived my shipment of Marzipan yesterday 9/13/07 and I opened the package to find that the Marzipan had pieces or what looks like food or dirt. I have been picking these pieces out of the Marzipan. I do not have time to reorder from another company so I am stuck using this MarzipanBiermann Marzipan 5 LB. Block. I am unhappy with the Quality and I would not recommend buying Marzipan form this company. I also feel the shipping is very pricey.
Although, I do not like too much mint tea, this one was quite good, as everything expected from Rishi house.

This is a good tea, with a nice minty flavor. The only reason is that it's not a 5 star product is that this is more finely ground (what I expect from teabags) than what I expect from Rishi. Small pieces inevitably end up through my filters and floating in my tea, although they're small enough not to be noticeable except by sight.

A very subtle taste with the health benefits of green tea and mint. I gave this tea to a friend with a sore throat and it actually helped with the inflammation. I use it when my mouth breaks out from stress and it has an immediate calming effect on the mouth sores. I find it to be amazingly calming and soothing, so I drink it literally everyday. But the taste is mild and may not be for everyone.
This tea is wonderful.  Even my children love it.  You can't beat organic and good tasting. I highly recommend this product.
I drink tea all day every day, and I'm constantly trying new ones. This is a lovely addition to my stash and the can keeps it fresh and fragrant.

This will give you the compromise you have been looking for, the health benefits of green tea, and the flavor of mint tea, in a perfect balance. I have been drinking this tea for a while now, and it has been consistently great!!

I really enjoy this blend of green tea with peppermint. I don't need any sweetener and the mint is very predominant. When I'm in a chocolate mood, I add a spoonful of fat-free, low sugar hot cocoa mix to my cup - even better!!
I absolutely love this tea.  It has a chocolate aroma, but a minty taste.  It only takes a small amount to brew a great cup of tea.
This tea is excellent, but make sure to brew it for no longer than a minute or two, and use cooler water than you would normally use for tea.

I do not like the flavor, minty and tea do not go well together, This is my opinion it taste strange to have a minty tea flavor, not the best flavor to get. Some people may like it. The quality is a great but I prefer the other flavors by rishi tea.

I bought this on Amazon a few years ago for my mother who doesn't eat wheat after reading its glowing reviews.  After hearing her rave about it, and getting tired of never seeming to find a fast-cooking, healthy meal, we tried it.  Fabulous!  I'd never know it wasn't regular pasta, and my husband, who is generally wary of my insistence on brown rice over white, was just as impressed.

This is the best gluten-free pasta I have ever purchased, HANDS DOWN.

It's firm and holds up to stirring with a spoon while it's cooking, and it's really delicious. I tastes like very high quality traditional pasta. My only complaint is that it's expensive. Compared to regular pasta, it's like 5 times more expensive. But if you have gluten senstivity, or if you prefer a brown rice pasta (healthier alternative) it is the BEST one on the market.

I bought this one and the curly pasta, and both were equally good. So I assume that all of the brown rice pasta by this company is going to be good.

It also takes a little longer to cook-- about 17 minutes. And you should stir it frequently so that it cooks evenly. But I don't see these as a drawback-- just an FYI. It really does taste very good.
After tasting several gluten free pastas over the course of four years, this is the best.  Also, it doesn't get mushy at all, even after reheating, it stays al dente.

I love Humbles!  I am a potato chip addict, and this product is a great substitute.  Humbles have less fat, fewer calories, and I love the taste.  I ordered the sea salt variety.  They are good plain or with salsa or dip. I ordered from Amazon and my snacks arrived quickly and in great condition.  I would definitely order them again.
Only 90 calories and no trans or saturated fat. I love these things, but I can't eat just one so watch out.
My husband and I love KUDOS.  It is our treat and only 100 calories.  We like the ones with the mini M&M's the best.  We keep them in the freezer.  They are good that way.

This tea is excellent, soothing and great if you are trying to enjoy your weight loss or any reason. I like the packaging too because you can reuse the container and there isn't plastic and staples on/in the tea bags.
Although I do not believe this helps with weight loss, it has a great flavor.  My husband, who does not normally drink hot tea, loves this.
A very unusual and flavorful tea.  It has helped with my weight loss.  It keeps me from snacking in between, and I usually grab for this rather than grabbing for chips or something sweet.

Hated Tea my whole life, UNTIL I FOUND (REPUBLIC OF TEA) I have about 15 flavors and I love them all, still trying new ones to see if I can find one I don't like. Got my kids, wife, dad, friends, loving it too!!!
All 5 Stars, good price, good packaging, good product and got here FAST!!
A friend left me some of this tea when she moved and it has become some of my favorite.  I wish I could find it locally, however I'm glad to have found it on Amazon.

I picked these up at a blue & yellow import store and found myself eating the entire package. These are fantastic. The texture of the cookie, vanilla top layer and bottom chocolate layer, is like a slightly denser Nabisco animal cracker. The center cream isn't all through the cookie like an oreo, but more of a center drop. It's not as thick as Nutella, very smooth and light, soft of the consistency of a slightly melted hershey kiss, but with a praline paste taste.
This product is PERFECT for baking, and for making dry rubs, it adds a great flavor to coffee and tea as well.  Just wish that it were a little cheaper.

This a great seasoning, exploding with flavor that has the right amount of heat. We use this on just about everything from our eggs to our fried squash and our meats. It compliments the garlic and the onion powder. The only Problem is the shiping, it is as much as the product so we will not be ordering it as much as we would like.

This sauce, used sparingly, is quite different from MAGGI WUERTZE sauce. It definitely has a "bite". Since it is used drop-size only, it is not ferociously "hot", but rather lends a very pleasant touch to anything needing a bit of spice, such as Rice, Noodles, Salads and potatoes.
After some SNAFUs Amazon was able to deliver this product. It was well worth the waiting.

I am so happy to have found a wonderful decaf tea for myself and guests. This tea is nice and full flavored and has a very smooth finish. I usually use the K-cup twice on xl setting and the tea remains true and delicious. The price is the best i have found anywhere

Twinings English Breakfast Decaffeinated Tea was exactly what I was looking for.  I loved the English Breakfast tea but needed to find a decaf version.  The taste is great, the price is right, and I'm sold!
Great tasting tea - in fact, much better then the bags of same. I'm an Decaf Irish Breakfast tea drinker but can't find that in K-Cups.  English Breakfast in K-cups tastes great!!

I have been drinking Twining's tea for years.  It used to be made in England but now they have a plant in North Carolina for the American trade.  The tea is excellent. I drink the decaf for health reasons and find that it is as tasty as the regular tea.
This is a pretty good cup of tea. I just wish PG Tips made pods for the Keurig brewer.  Maybe eventually!
i just purchased a kurig and this was one of the first k cups i bought i still use it  but if it was decaf would be better than id rate it five starts

great product, I use this product weekly and it really helps me alot, altho if your body doesnt absorb vitamin B12 well, its probably not going to do much for you. horrible price, find this product at dollar tree, and dollar general for $1 each, OR get it direct from the manufacturer's website at a cost of $9.99 for a carton of 12!

This stuff works great. Especially for those who don't drink coffee, but need a little caffeine boost. The B-12 is a great booster as well. Really overpriced here since Dollar Tree sells these for $1 each.

Grilled taste, skinless, can be added into numerous dishes and/or salads. We use it with Roland Grilled eggplants and a bit of fresh onions and optional tomatoes and that makes delicious Mediterranean salad. The ease of use makes it well worth the price. I will be ordering more, and I hope they are not discontinued.

When I ordered this product, I was too lazy to convert "3-4 mm" to inches and consequently discovered the "Coarse Grinder Salt" was almost 1/4" (1/6" to be exact), way too coarse for my salt grinder.  Shortly after receiving my order from Amazon, I received a courtesy email from the Spice Lab to make sure I was happy with my order.  I replied that actually I was not happy, but the fault was mine because I didn't convert the metric dimensions to English units and consequently didn't realize how coarse the salt would be, which was too coarse for my salt mill.  Two days later I received a package of smaller crystals, no charge.  That's amazing customer service!

This product seems to have replaced a similar previous product (Natural Himalayan Crystal Salt). The previous prodcut was a deeper pink color and the texture was better than what I was finding elsewhere. This new product (Himalayan Organic Natural Unprocessed Cooking Salt) is much more like what the competitors are selling. I've enjoyed all my products from The Spice Lab, but was disappointed with the replacent for this product.

Yes, I do use this product for salting some of my foods, but it also has another handy use. Because the grains of salt are much larger than normal, I use this salt to clean my cast iron grill and skillet. I pour one or two tablespoons of salt on the slightly warm grill or skillet, and rub the salt into the bottom and sides of the pans with a wadded up paper towel. This salt is so pink and taste like the ocean, I love it. Make sure to buy a grinder of some sort if you plan to use it on salads or sprinkle on cold dishes.

Himalaya salt has a very 'clean' taste--add at the end of cooking.

Great buy!  Fantastic taste and pleasing pink hue from the iron content.  I prefer a grinding salt, and this one is unprocessed for it's better for you.

this is a fine example of mineral-rich himalayan salt. The packaging also keeps it fresh. It comes in a zip-seal pouch.

If you liked Tazo Black Iced Tea in the past - you may not like it anymore.  My wife and I have been buying Tazo's Black Iced Tea for several years. My wife Googled and found on another web site that Tazo changed the formulation of its Black Iced Tea.  It is a flop in our opinion.

Since the formula change, this tea is nothing special.  For many years, I have been addicted to Starbucks Black Iced Tea.  I live in a little town in the midwest that doesn't even have a Starbucks, but I have a gold Starbucks card.  I would check every route when travelling to plan stops for this iced tea.  I have purchased the quart sized bags from Starbucks and Target when available and ordered the gallon bags when that was my only option to brew this tea daily.  I started noticing a change when I was in South Carolina in March, 2012.  I thought maybe southerners just have a different tea preference.  I then noticed it in Nashville over the summer.  Since I spend time regularly in Nashville, I knew a change was on the way.  The tea has lost its crispness and citrus finish.  It seems Starbucks has purchased Tazo from Steven Smith and decided to change it.  I hate to think it was to make more money with a cheaper blend, but I haven't been able to find another reason.  Given the fact that I was paying over $3.00 per Trenta, I can't imagine the mark up was unfair to them no matter what the cost of the original tea.  By buying Tazo, Starbucks cut out the middle man to make way for more profits, then made major change.  Couldn't it just have started its own tea brand?  It has lost a loyal customer in me (and many transfers from my bank account to the Starbucks card).  If you are loyal to taste rather than brand, start your search for a new tea.  I have started my search with the former owner of Tazo who has opened a new business.  Maybe the old formula will come back before we find something we like better.

It took a while to understand why none of the Starbucks stores could make a good glass anymore until I realized they changed the recipe. Now the mail order bags have also been changed and it is no longer that great Tazo tea anymore. So disappointed.

There are some products that make our lives better, and some that make us happy, and this does both for me. It's on my list of things that make me happy. Seriously.

First, understand I am a complete coffee fanatic...I even have several coffee plants growing in my home. I love a good cup of Jamaican Blue Mountain - I've actually visited the island and many of the plantations - and I'm willing to pay the high price for the best beans in the world. While these are okay, they aren't exactly the cream of the crop.

Still, I want to start by complimenting the shipper. They arrived quickly, and if I'm to believe the "Roasted On" date on the package, they were roasted the day before I received them. The packaging was also top notch and my beans arrived in great condition.

But that's about the end of the positives. For one thing, I always expect JBM to be somewhat large beans, uniformly dark and with a slightly glossy or oily appearance. The best tend to look almost "pampered". These beans weren't that...they looked like the small leftovers at the bottom of the barrel. The color was rather pale for JBM, and many of the individual beans were cracked and broken. I have to say, the beans just seemed unappealing in terms of appearance, and I've never seen that before from anything claiming to be pure JBM coffee.

As for the taste, I'd rate it fair to good overall, but only fair compared to better brands of Jamaican Blue Mountain. The taste was very mild and again, somewhat stale tasting, and with an unusual almost fruity taste I haven't experienced before from JBM coffees. Perhaps this vendor doesn't sell much JBM, and so the remnants sit in their facility for many months longer than optimum, or possibly there were other varieties accidentally mixed in.

To be clear, I wouldn't say they were terrible beans - certainly better than the JBM "blends" you see advertised, or anything you'll find at the local Starbucks. They're just not up to the standards I expect for a really fine Jamaican Blue Mountain coffee, especially considering they aren't exactly a bargain price.

I wish I could give a better review. On the positive, the delivery of the coffee was SUPER FAST and friendly, and the re-sealable package was top notch. However, the coffee did not live up to our expectations. We understand that JBM often has a "mild" flavor, but when we brewed it at a regular setting, it was very thin. We had to grind almost twice as many beans as normal to get a good taste; this used up our beans really fast.

While these arrived fresh, freshness isn't the only hallmark of a quality product. You can get the same results with a good food processor (i.e. a Kitchen Aid). This is NOT a fine, even grind. If I sift the product, I find a lot of chunks. I want a fine EVEN grind when using nut meal/flour (the terms are used interchangeably in the industry) as the main or only flour in my baked goods.

Since this brand is easy to find in many supermarkets, I do recommend it for some uses. It's good for folks who don't do mail order, those non-GF cooks looking to lower the carb count of their bread coatings, and those looking for an easy GF or a no-carb "breading" option, but only when a coarse coating is suitable. For instance I like fine coatings if I'm going to "pan fry" a white/light flesh fish fillet.

When used as the main or only flour for baking, the batter will look lumpy and the finished product will taste a bit gritty. It won't perform well in some recipes because the chunkier nature of the grind will affect the way the batter handles moisture, which could result in a dense rather than light texture. It could also yield products that fall severely upon cooling.

In order words, disappointing outcomes might not be the recipe or your culinary technique, it could be your choice in ingredients!

People who complain about the tea bag separating from the string are correct: the packaging quality is very poor, and surprising given how many decades Lipton has been making tea bags.

The way to avoid the problem is to hold the tea bag with index finger and thumb at the point where the the tag is affixed, then gently pull the tag from the bag. Next, when dunking the tea bag in the water, pull up on the tag gently, otherwise it will come off. Better yet, don't dunk the bag at all. Just let it steep by itself for a couple of minutes and then remove it. Enjoy. Rinse and repeat.
