I really like this tea.  Its really nice iced and hot, and has a sweet aroma as you open the packages.  My grandmother went to morrocco and really liked the tea there, and even she thought that this was good stuff.  The only thing I have to say that's negative would be the box design makes it difficult to grab the packets from the little like half circle opening, just open up the back otherwise they get all messed up and you have to push your fingers and root around trying to grab one of them and then pull them out etc.  Really good tea for a really nice price.  Even though I just bought 6 boxes, I would buy this again for sure (me and my family have already gone through three, and I gave one away as a gift).

I had read the reviews, but was not ready to order (6) boxes without trying it first. I found it available at Target for $2.13 box and I just love it! I have tried other mint teas and I thought they were too weak, I couldn't taste the mint, but this tea is just right! Do try for you are in for a treat!
This tea is very refreshing and I love the mint flavor.  I use it for ice tea.  I especially like this brand of tea.
Stash is my favorite tea, and by far the Moroccan Mint is my favorite flavor.  I love mint, and the mix of green tea and mint is just delcious.

I bought this tea wanting to try something new and was NOT dissapointed.
I drink it every morning.
I was so happy to find this tea.  It is our favorite and the price is better than anywhere!  We have completely quit drinking soda- this is cheaper and healthier!
I never liked plain  green tea.  I thought I  would try  this white/ green tea combo. I love it ! and the health benefits are great also. The more you drink of it the better  (also weight loss)

I like this better than the Bigelow that I was drinking before and the price is really good.  This is actually the first tea of any kind that I've been able to drink without adding artificial sweetener or honey.  It has a nice subtle flavor and, on a wholly superficial note, the beautiful green individual packages look lovely in a glass container on the counter.
I am very pleased with the Stash tea I purchased.  It was a VERY good deal & the quality is excellent

I didn't mind the taste of the Pure Natural Bars, Chocolate Almond, 1.7-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12), but I expected a lot more of the chocolate almond taste that the label promotes. I read the ingredients, which look reasonably healthy-a few more than a LaraBar, but nothing scary or unfamiliar. The texture is like a typical healthy bar-chewy and sticky-but these bars taste pretty good (if you are used to eating these type of bars). However, the taste of chocolate and almonds is lacking in this product. It doesn't taste bad, but it wasn't what I was expecting. This is NOT a candy bar, but it certainly has enough sugar. While the sugars in this bar come from dates and agave, this isn't a diet bar-17 grams of sugar just don't let it be something that can be eaten daily.

I would certainly choose these bars over a candy bar loaded with high fructose corn syrup and other unfamiliar ingredients. These is a reasonable amount of protein, potassium and fiber (5 grams!), so this bar makes my OKAY to eat on occasion or after a workout list, but just don't expect a candy bar taste.

First of all I have to say that I love dark chocolate and this product sounded like something that I would have liked.  But as it turns out, I really didn't like the way it tasted, as a matter of fact, I couldn't even finish the bar. I try to eat healthy and I think it's great that they came out with a healthier product, but unfortunately I feel that in doing that, they sacrificed the flavor and I just didn't care for it.

PURE NATURAL CHOCOLATE ALMOND BARS are the answer to those dieting, or those choosing health conscious treats. I didn't expect them to be so delicious; usually bars of this type taste more like cardboard. Not, PURE NATURAL CHOCOLATE ALMOND BARS. They are moist, crunchy with almonds and dates, sweetened with agave nectar and rich with dark cocoa. I love them. With only 180 calories per generous bar, they are perfect for those dieting or searching for only nutritious snacks for children and adults. I will buy more to settle that chocolate beast who arises in me hunkering for a candy bar that adds unwanted pounds.

PURE NATURAL CHOCOLATE ALMOND BARS impressed me and being the chocolate connoisseur that I am that is saying a mouthful!!!!

I am a vegetarian that would like to go vegan sometime soon.  I LOVE chocolate and was afraid that vegan chocolate would not be as good as milk chocolate.  After trying soy chocolate ice cream and Amy's chocolate cake, I was very happy that being vegan didn't mean having to give up good chocolate.  I ordered the Pure Natural Chocolate Almond bars because I wanted to try to some more vegan chocolate, and they were pretty good!  The texture is kind of like a brownie, and the chocolaty flavor did not disappoint.  They do have a lot of calories in them for such a small bar (190 a bar), but they also have 7 grams of protein, so that is a plus.  They are also gluten-free!  I would for sure recommend these!

After looking at the product wrapper, I expected a mass of nuts and chocolate when I ripped off the wrapper only to see a smooth, thin, sticky mass that somewhat resembles a chocolate brownie. There are no chocolate chunks to be seen, and the small bits of nuts can only be found within the pure natural chocolate almond bar which mostly consists of dates or a date puree.

That being said, I actually like the taste and texture of this bar quite a bit. The chocolate flavor dominates and only the label indicates to me the predominance of date content, certainly not the taste. There is some moderate crunch to the smooth texture, and the eater's fingers will get a little sticky while eating this soft bar.

The box of bars arrived at my house on a day of near 100 degree heat, a little warm but basically unharmed. The bar has 190 calories, 70 of which are from fat, so keep that in mind. Five grams of fiber and 7 grams of protein are an added bonus for these gluten free, vegan bars.

Love this product because it has a rich dark cocoa and not the standard overly sweet American chocolate most sweets have. Its 70% protein and 5g Fiber, and is gluten free and has the U kosher symbol. 190 calories means this is not something you want to eat more than once a day as part of a whole healthy diet.

Tastes like a French chocolate treat and I love how they made the dates and almonds blend into a delicious mini crunch. Not a heavy crunch but akin to a lovely moist grown up French brownie. Will be buying these to keep on hand.

I would have loved to love these bars but I just couldn't. Everything about them sounded delicious but something was just off. I love almonds, dark chocolate, and the two together are great. Somehow these just didn't come together.

I was expecting a chocolate tasting granola type of bar, and these are more like a super fudgy, soft chocolate brownie than anything. They have about twice as many calories as I allow for a snack though- 190 and I try to stick to 100. I felt like the bars were large, and could easily be halved and packaged seperately to fit with many weight loss programs. The thing I like the MOST about the bars though is the fact that they are gluten free and vegan. It is very difficult to find reasonable yummy snacks that fit in either of those catagories. It is especially hard to find gluten free baked goods that are tasty. So after I ate one, and my daughter ate one, and we liked them, my husband, who is NOT into health food at ALL, but is majorly into brownies, ate all the rest and loved them! So if they pleased him, that is saying a lot for the taste. Or perhaps I have just not baked him anything in far too long!

I will start off this review by stating that this product is gluten free, kosher and vegan.  For my unhealthy eat bagged and processed junk ways this little bar surprisingly hit all the right notes.  When you first open it, you will see that it is a smidgen smaller than a Snickers bar.  Yes... Yes... I do see the irony of including an unhealthy candybar in my review of a good for you alternative.  Now onto the flavor:  It is laced with crushed almonds throughout and has a very strong molasses taste. The bar is a tad sweet but in a natural way.  It isn't the same as diet products in respect to the flavor.  The chocolate almond flavor is very dark and looks like a tight moist brownie.  The smell is very reminiscent of a dark coffee.  From it's wrapper claims it is chock full of protein and a healthy alternative to all those other bars filled with preservatives and filler.  At the end of the day I not only loved the bar but so did my family.  The box was gone in 2 days.  No one else complained about the molasses flavored sweetness that would have me reaching for a drink after 3 bites.  The sweetness does satisfy a sweet tooth though!  Highly recommend to families and individuals that are looking for that healthy alternative that is PURE.. awesome find for those that have dietary restrictions.  For us I find them to be a bit steep in price considering our house of five goes through them at lightening speed.

The Pure Natural Chocolate Almond bars were average. They were dense and chewy like an undercooked brownie but with a fruity aftertaste. When I need nutrition on the go it serves the purpose quite well. I don't find myself craving them or having to hold myself back from attacking the box in the pantry however. As far carrying them around in the purse or in the backpace, they do that quite well as the dense texture keeps them in one piece and from getting banged up and broken. I don't like taking out the granola bar I packed in the morning to find it in a million pieces and having to shake the package into my mouth to eat it.

I'm not sure I'll buy these in the future, but I won't have any issues finishing what I already have. They serve the purpose of a traveling snack pretty well with a middle of the road taste. I like the chocolate, not so much the fruity note. The almonds were good and a bit sparse.

I'm giving this product three stars by grading on a sort of curve. Or maybe it's more of an averaging. I hated these bars. Truly hated them. I don't think I've ever stopped eating something with chocolate in it before but I only managed to eat half of one bar.

On the other hand, the two people who tried them with me loved them. They said that the bar was moist and chewy and delicious. I agree they are moist and chewy. I think if this had been advertised as a protein bar or a healthy product I may not have had such high hopes and been disappointed so severely.

So, try them but don't think chocolate while you do. Think vitamins, think good for you...

First note that the bars themselves do not resemble what you see on the box or package -- that image is of chocolate and large almonds. The bars themselves reminded me of no-bake cookies formed a rectangle with a deep, black color. The almonds are pieces within the dense and surprisingly moist bar itself.

While nutritionally this is good, in terms of taste the best I can say is that the cocoa is strong. Beyond that this reminds me very much of the "natural" or "sugar free" bars and cookies that were just coming out two decades ago. This does not have that sickly sweet taste nor the unmistakable prune taste -- if I wanted prunes, I'd eat them -- but it is also not much of an improvement for two decades of development in the food industry. Thus I could only honestly give this 3 out of 5 stars.

You do however get 12 bars in a pack and compared to many granola or cereal bars out there, this is a lot for your money. My best advice is to try one before you buy an entire box.

This company makes several bars and the textures of them varies greatly. This one is like a cake brownie with a few almonds in it and it's delicious. I've got these on auto-delivery because it's a healthy snack I can use when I don't have time for a meal.

Disclaimer: A free sample of these bars were received from Amazon Vine in exchange for an honest review.

The Pure Natural bars are gluten free protein snack bars. I sampled the Chocolate Almond flavor. I did not really care for the first bar but have since eaten a couple more and have raised my opinion to "okay." I don't eat protein bars generally, finding the ones that taste decent to be high in carbs or sugar or both-- if I'm going to eat something with that much carb or sugar I might as well "sin lustfully" and grab a Hershey bar.

That being said, these bars are chewy with a fruity flavor. They do not taste very chocolatey, nor can you really taste, or even find, the almonds. However, they also do not have a strong bran or "dog food" taste as I find with many other protein bars.

I wouldn't buy these on my own, and I'm not even sure if I will finish the package, but if you have gluten problems and you like protein bars, you may find you like these.

I was pretty happy with the taste of the cereal bar considering that it is so healthy and the fact that it uses natural ingredients. Most of the other cereal bars that taste good are pretty much loaded with sugar and not very good for your body. This is a great and healthy alternative when you have the afternoon snack craving at office or after you get back home.

This did not taste like a chocolate bar at all. I can't describe how it tastes as I haven't encountered something like this before. I know that is is suppose to be better for you and it's all natural but honestly, I've had slim fast bars that tasted better than this. I'm glad I didn't have to pay for this as it went into the garbage.

I was looking for a less-unhealthy-than-usual breakfast or snack that I could carry with me and eat on the go or at my desk, and so I gave these a try. I have nothing to compare them to as far as similar bars are concerned. I am not a health fanatic - - the words "chocolate" and "almonds" appeal to me much more than any health claims. I want the good stuff, and I want it now. I like rich tasting foods, but dislike sweet foods. As you've probably guessed by now, I will not be reviewing these bars based on grams of this or that or energy levels or any such, just taste.

Before I ate my first Pure Naturals bar, I had no idea what to expect. I found the dense texture a little surprising and the taste okay, nothing great but certainly not bad -- definitely not sweet. Then the next day, I ate a bar for breakfast with a cup of tea. After that I started craving them and have had one most mornings since then. I find them a good alternative to other on-the-go breakfasts and very satisfying. I really enjoy them now and would recommend that people give them a chance.

I might add that I find a full bar good for a light breakfast, but a full bar is too much for an afternoon snack at my desk. I cut them in half for a snack and save the second half for the next day.

Over the years I have eaten MANY "health" bars, fiber bars, protein bars, etc. I usually eat a protein bar a day, and I am very used to the chalky texture and taste of protein bars and have learned to overcome them. The Pure Natural Chocolate Almond bar is not a protein bar, but tastes almost as bad as that. Correction, it tastes, worse than a protein bar. There is no real chocolate taste to it at all, and the protein chunks that are in it taste like these cheap almond pieces they used to shove into candy bars 30 years ago, way too small to offer any real taste. Actually, they taste just like the nuts you get in brownies. I love almonds, but hated the taste of these. I forced myself to eat three of these bars so I could give them an accurate review, and that was extremely difficult.

The selling point of Pure Bars are that they are made with natural, whole ingredients and are vegetarian and gluten-free. As someone who is trying to avoid High Fructose Corn Syrup and added sugar, I like that, however it doesn't do me any good if I can't enjoy the product enough to consume it. I know some reviews have claimed that these are "health bars" and that they have too much sugar, but they are not marketed as a "health bar." Too many people confuse the ideas of "whole" and "natural" foods as "health" foods, which is entirely not the case. The idea is that these bars are for people who don't want additives and a lot of over-processing in their food, it's just unfortunately that they taste so bad. If you're looking for a better-tasting alternative, I'd suggestion the - Kashi Go Lean Crunchy Variety Bars (All Natural) - 24 ct. (meal Replacement Bars) or maybe the Clif Builders Bars.

I received this product through the vine program. I generally consume one or two protein bars per day, so I was excited to try ths product. The excitement ended after the first bite. It was dry, chalky, and not very chocolatey, not mention that I didn't detect any almonds in the bar. It wasn't terrible, but also just wasn't very good. If these bars were just stacked with proteins and vitamins, I might buy more. However, there are better tasting alternatives out there that have superior nutritional value.

I would pass on these.

I think this is one of those types of food products where you will either really like it or not care for it.

I am a chocolate fan and I love chocolate and almonds, so I figured this was a natural fit for me.

Upon opening the first bar it seems like any other bar of it's type. However, once that first bite was in my mouth it's evident it was not. The chocolate in these bards over powers the taste of anything else. Like I said, I'm a chocolate fan but this was just too potent of chocolate for my tastes.

Since there were a dozen in the box I decided to let a few others try them. It was a mixed bag of results there too. One person took one bite and would have no more. One said they were okay with coffee. One person ate an entire bar before deeming it "not very good". The last person really liked them and said he would buy them in a store. So, basically 1 out of 5 people in my highly unscientific research liked them.

I guess if you are a dark chocolate person these may be something you'll like. But if you're not stay clear of these.

I really like that these Pure Natural Bars are vegan and gluten free. They have a good chocolate flavor and seven grams of protein.

I'm currently pregnant and need to take snacks with me to keep my blood sugar steady and these work great for throwing in my purse. They wouldn't hold up well in the car right now though with the heat we've been having. The box that I received was a bit banged up and it was clear that some of the bars had melted a bit in transit.

The only negative for me is the texture wasn't quite what I was expecting. I thought the bars would have a candy bar type texture or maybe even a granola bar type texture but these are a bit more like a brownie bar. I'm not crazy about the texture but overall these are a good snack to have on hand.

The choco/almond Pure Natural Bar is a good energy alternative for times when one can't sit down for a real meal. I work from 8am-3pm at one job then ride my bike to my second job, 3:30-8pm. These bars are perfect to toss in my bag and eat at 5 or 6pm. The taste is perfectly ok, although I wouldn't be sorry if it had an even more chocolatey flavor. It's nice and moist, which my old standby, powerbars are not... Each bar is filling and satisfies hunger pangs. I wish a single bar wasn't so calorie dense, but that's probably due to all the nutty goodness, which is what provides the sustaining energy. So as long as one doesn't eat them by twos and threes, it's probably all good.

As I unwrapped the wrapper to this bar, I was a bit surprised. The description of these bars describe them as "rich, dark cocoa with heart-healthy, crunchy almonds," and the packaging has images of almonds and chocolate. A look at the bar also reveals fruit, specifically dates.

Having said that, I found the bars to be quite good. The dates added a nice touch to the chocolate and almonds, and as the bar is less than 200 calories and gluten free, one can't complain too much. While these probably aren't the best bars in the market, they are definitely worth trying, just don't let the marketing of the bar fool you into expecting a decadent alternative to a candy bar. These bars have a healthy feel to them, which I found to be tasty.

Pure Natural Bars Chocolate Almond is a nice snack tat's perfect for those who are into eating healthy.  Others need not apply.  I thought the bars tasted okay but they definitely are missing something.  I can't quite place it but it's pretty bland.  If you're a health food nut then you'll probably go gaga over them and find it utterly "divine".  I found them to be okay.

I have tried most of energy bars and natural bars available in the US. And, this "Pure Natural Bars - Chocolate Almond" has one of the better taste in this category.
It's not too sweet and has natural, yet complex taste.

The biggest problem is the picture on the package. It gives you a wrong expectation of this bar. When I saw the photo, I expected Pure Natural Bars to be similar to my favorite Kind bars such as KIND PLUS, Cranberry Almond + Antioxidants, Gluten Free Bars (Pack of 12). While you can enjoy crunchiness of whole almonds and real chocolate to taste with Kind bars, you don't recognize individual taste of Almonds or chocolate with Pure Natural Bars. Pure Natural Bars are rather similar to Larabars such as [Larabar Fruit & Nut Food Bar, Lemon Bar, 1.8-Ounce Bars (Pack of 16), which I also quite like (not as much as Kind bars, though).

As long as you know what you are getting, you'd like this bar.

I expected this bar to taste more chocolaty and not so bitter, although I sometimes indulge in high percentage dark chocolate. This bar is dense, like a brownie but is definately for the healthy, vegan chocolate lovers.

The taste leaves nothing to be desired although the chocolate could be richer so why am I not giving this a full five stars? I didn't expect the soft `mealiness' of that first bite, it's like eating a very dense oatmeal when I'd expected a crunchier texture.
Understand that this doesn't take away from the experience though and in the one place where it counts, cutting down on hunger and getting you to your next meal, it fits the bill.
Recommended.
[Update: I have to upgrade this to five stars. I've just finished the last bar in the box and I have to say it's delicious, filling, and even the mealiness I pointed out before simply becomes unnoticeable. One of the things that's changed my mind is how much my 20-month-old son loves eating this bar. It contains nothing that'll cause him grief and being as picky an eater as he is, the fact he munches down entire bars says something for the quality and taste of the Pure bars. Upgraded to Five Stars.]

I wanted to like these bars, I really did. It's nice that they're vegan, kosher and have lots of fiber, but the sad, sad thing is, I just don't like them and can't imagine myself eating them. If I had to eat them, I would. You know, if I was little and my mother made me, like parents used to make their kids swallow cod liver oil all those years ago. Well, these bars aren't that bad, but they don't taste very good, to me anyway. I see others have liked them and I suppose taste is subjective, so please take this review with a grain of salt.

Since airplane meals are monopoly priced with a 90% probability of nasty, these 'energy' bars have become something akin to an MRE for the coach traveler. The varieties are endless and variably convenient and satisfying. These are quite good by comparison. Far more chocolaty then most, they are a bit disturbing in appearance resulting in the 4 stars but certainly a good choice. If the child that might sit beside you were to ask "what are eating?" the answer could determine the balance of the flight because the child will have a predictable child-like perspective.

I've tried a variety of healthy snack bars such as Clif Nectars & Larabar. I felt this was was very tasty and filling (contains 5 grams of fiber). I like that it also has 7 grams of protein in each bar, no gluten, natural ingredients (some organic). These are also kosher (OU dairy) & vegan. I like the texture of the small pieces of almond and find the dates give it a sweetness without being too overpowering. I've used these as a quick breakfast or snack while traveling and felt energized for a while. Highly recommend for the gym bag, eating at home, or as a quick pick-me-up on the go.
Update: I finished up the box (had to hide them from others in the house I enjoyed them so much) but a little disappointed they are so pricey compared to other bars on the market. Big difference between these and others is how much more healthy & filling these are, so it seems worth it, but wish they were a bit less per bar.

Pure Natural Chocolate Almond bars take some getting used to. It is a heavy bar. Small but dense. It actually looks like a fudge bar but has more of a brownie texture. It isn't sweet but it isn't bland either but you can really taste the protein in it.

The first two bars that I ate, I could not finish them. Eating half was filling enough. I wasn't sold on it from those first two bars.

But by the third bar (if taken with tea), I actually started to like the bars. I had to get used to the texture mostly because the taste itself was something that I like (not overly sweet) and with the tea, it made a nice combo and it made a good snack to tide me over for dinner.

After a week of eating a bar a day, I can comfortably give it 4-stars.

I love Lara Bars so I thought this would be a slam dunk for me. While I did appreciate the large chunks of almonds, the bar itself was too dense and chewy for my liking. The chocolate is also slightly bitter tasting. I had to make myself finish the whole bar. Not a winner in my book, but not the worst I've tried either. Definitely not something I'd go out of my way to purchase.

I received these Pure Naturals Bars free, as part of Amazon.com Vine program, to generate reviews for new products. I have been looking for a bar that is completely natural, no fructose, no chemicals and no fake chemical sugar sweeteners. These fit all of what I was looking for, the taste is good, the bars are a good size 1.7 ounces, and they are all natural. for vegetarians and Vegans; theses Bars are Vegan. These are definitely going to be my choice for a good carb protean Bar. They are 7 grams of protean, and have 5 grams of fiber. I Highly recommend Them.

These bars are branded as "Chocolate Almond" but the first ingredient is dates. I'm not terribly fond of dates, so that was disappointing. I found the bar to be "okay" ~ I'd eat it if I were starving or needed food, but I wouldn't purchase this product.

My son took one small bite and won't eat any more because they're not chocolatey enough. His mom also didn't feel they were chocolatey enough. The chocolate is more like an aftertaste than a primary flavor.

I would have given these bars a 2, but because they truly are very healthy I couldn't in good conscious rate them any lower. Summary: Less dates, more chocolate.

Don't believe the "Chocolate Almond" brand... think of them more like "Healthy Date Almond With A Hint Of Chocolate."

Brownie texture with dark chocolate taste.

I liked this and my wife did not.
I like dark bittersweet chocolate nibbles. I Usually buy 65% cacao.
Dark chocolates are healthier than sweet.

She likes sweet chocolate. A sweet chocolate person may be disappointed.
Brownie texture but does not taste as good as a brownie. It's not a Brownie.
Tastes fine for a healthy snack. 190 calories is in line for this type of 1.7 oz snack.
The word delicious can't be used to describe this type of snack. The word fine is meant as a positive. Better than most health snacks I have tried.

Very healthy ingredients. Dates, Almonds, Organic Agave Nectar, Organic Rice, Dark Coco, Natural Flavors. Gluten free, Vegan.
There is no added sugar, nor high fructose syrup.

No Trans fat . Sat fat 1 G.

A solid 4 star.

These bars are high in calories which is a good thing when hiking or performing some other strenuous exercise.  But they are not very high in flavor which is not such a good thing when eating them.  The bars are soft and have a brownie like texture.  The chocolate flavor is not pronounced, it is a dry cocoa flavor and texture.  Almond slivers are in the bars, there is a crunch every couple of bites, but the almond flavor is overpowered by the cocoa.  These are similar to other "health" bars in that they impart a chalky, dry texture.  No, my chocolate prayers were not answered by these bars.  The thing I liked about these is that they are not overly gooey and sweet.

Length:: 1:45 Mins

Despite being called "Chocolate Almond Bars," one of the main ingredient in these bars by Pure is rice, and you can taste it -- the rice flavor overwhelms the chocolate.

But these bars claim to be health food, so looks look at the nutrition facts.

Each 48g bar has 190 calories with 70 calories from fat. The strikes me as a lot of calories for such a tiny bar. Let's compare it to another health food, Greek yogurt, specifically Chobani yogurt.

A single 170g cup of Chobani non-fat Greek yogurt only has 140 calories, and no calories from fat. So the Pure bar has three times as many calories per gram than the yogurt. But wait, there's more!

Pure touts that the bars contain 7g of protein. Compared to Chobani, it again comes up short -- the single serving of Chobani has 14g of protein (28% of your Daily Value). The Chobani also has 20% of your daily calcium value. And if you thought a benefit of the Pure bar is that it is gluten-free, so is the Chobani.

I know that this review seems like it has morphed into a pitch for Chobani, but my point is to illustrate that there are healthier, lower caloric snack foods out there. And the Chobani tastes a heck of a lot better.

I received these Bars as a part of the Amazon Vine Program.

Here is what is GREAT about these Bars!

1). No Soy. Thank you! Every Bar out there has soy. I cannot eat soy, these have no soy.

2). They taste great. The chocolate is Cocoa. Great for you... and they have a nice softness to them that make them a terrific mid-day snack.

3). 7 Grams of Protein. Nuf said.

4). Simple Ingredients. The Ingredients are: Dates, Almonds, Organic Agave Nectar, Organice Rice Protein Concentrate, Cocoa (Dutched), Chia Seeds, Organic Agave fiber, Natural Flavors. Tired of Bars filled with Junk? Then these are for you.

6). OH, and the price?...... The price is right. $16.98 for 12 Bars. Do the math. These are a really great deal..

For those who really know nutrition, protein bars are a nightmare. Often filled with multiple sugar sources and nasty additives, protein bars run the gamut from truly healthy to downright bad for you. "Pure Naturals" Chocolate Almond Bar lands squarely in the second tier: Simple, semi-organic, some nutrition and reasonably tasty.

NUTRITION: If you're looking for a lot of any one thing this ain't the bar for you. There's 7 grams of protein (albeit from organic rice protein instead of chemically extracted), which is nothing too spectacular but decent. 5 grams of fiber, again not bad. 10% of your iron and 320 mg of potassium but negligible on other nutrients. Sugars are 17 grams a bar; I've seen much worse. Chia seeds will give you a small amount of healthy fats and organic agave is the only sweetener. Downsides? The first two ingredients are not organic and they make up most of the bar. "Natural flavors" are used, never a good thing, and the cocoa is dutch processed which eliminates some antioxidant content. Other than that no real complaints. Nutrition grade: B

ALLERGENS: Made on shared equipment but labeled as gluten-free. No soy-derived ingredients that I could spot (watch out for those "natural flavors"). Obviously if you have a nut allergy you'll have to skip this line, but other than that the ingredient list is pretty straight-forward and clean.

TASTE: This is easily the best tasting of the "Pure Naturals" series. It tastes like a gluten-free brownie, let's put it that way. Heat it up with a little coconut milk ice cream and you got a decent dessert. Not as yummy as the Zing Chocolate Coconut Bar, but better than a lot of the Larabars. Taste Grade: B/B-

There you have it, hope that helps those of you desperate for a new bar that will work for your diet. Overall not bad tasting and decent ingredients. Happy snacking!

FINAL GRADE: B/B-

This has a smooth, moist, almost brownie-like taste and texture, not at all like other vegan bars, which are too often dry and gritty. The Pure Natural has a light chocolate center without an overly sweet, sugary taste. After my first bar, I immediately wanted to have another. My granddaughter should love this bar -- she requires a gluten-free diet -- but even if the gluten issue isn't relevant for you, Pure Natural is a good choice. I didn't give it 5 stars only because I'm not a big fan of almonds in my food (they're fine eaten separately), but I realize this won't matter to most people.

The first thing I noticed about these chocolate almond bars is they arrived on a 90+ degree day and weren't melted! That answered any questions I had as to how well they would travel.

The second thing I noticed was the ingredients list: Dates, almonds, organic agave nectar, organic rice protein concentrate, cocoa (dutched), chia seeds, organic agave fiber, and natural flavors.

I was impressed. In case you don't know, agave is a sweetener that's low on the glycemic index (although dates may be pretty high -- sources differ). And chia seeds are high in EFAs. Each 1.7 oz. bar has 190 calories, with 7 grams of protein and 8 grams of fat, much of which is healthy fat from the almonds and chia seeds.

What's most impressive is the taste and texture. They're chewy, but pleasantly so -- not tough like some protein bars tend to be. And the flavor and overall texture is like a really, really good chocolate brownie.

In other words, these bars are great!

It is what it is. It's not a "chocolate bar" as the average American might think of. It is not a brownie. It is not a granola bar. It is a chewy bar composed of finely chopped almonds, dates, Dutch cocoa (which you can taste), Chia seeds, Fiber and sweetened with Agave Nectar.

At 190 calories a bar, 8 grams of total fat, 25 grams of carbs, and 7 grams of protein, it makes for a healthful snack (or even breakfast). The fats are good ones, though.

Our family was mixed in their reviews. My husband said he has tasted better bars at Sam's Club, I thought it was decent (though I wouldn't eat them regularly), my seven-year-old son loved them and was excited he would be eating the remaining ten bars, and my two-year-old daughter liked the bar as well.

They are vegan (though we are not), and gluten-free. My son has a gluten sensitivity, so it is nice to have a snack he loves that would not aggrevate his body.

Apparently these were founded by a lady who has a six-year-old vegetarian.

Overall, they were good, but I don't know that they answer the claim on the box which reads, "Your chocolate prayers have been answered."

My first few bites were a bit chewy and dry. I didn't enjoy it so much. I suppose I was expecting more flavor.

But ...

After a few minutes and a drink of water later, I quite liked these bars. They're a bit dense so I found they were filling when paired with a fruit. Also, the chocolate in question is like a brownie and basically cocoa in flavor, not rich chocolate, which is what I was expecting. As a result, the chocolate flavor is subtle, and I liked that because it makes this feel like a healthy option and it is not overpowering. The almonds could have been more pronounced instead of being just sort of present here or there. For a sweet tooth, not the option I'd go with, but if you like a bit of cocoa flavor and a snack option that's not going to kill your diet and is organic, this is a decent option. Just make sure you have something to drink with it because it is chewy and a little dry.
Sorry, but Pure Naturals Chocolate Almond Bar did NOT answer my chocolate prayers. It was like eating 190 calories of cocoa, period. Thankfully, I had some leftover coffee in my mug to wash it down.

These are supposed to be healthy vegan nutrition chocolate bars. If they tasted really good then I would ignore the calories and fat content. But they taste mediocre at best with a gritty texture which I suspect are the ground up fiber or almonds. The box shows whole almonds but there are no whole almonds in these bars. They also don't really have that rich dark chocolate taste either. I usually eat Kellog's Fiber Plus bars which actually taste quite good and definitely taste better than these Pure Naturals bars.

When comparing Calories, Fat, Protein, Fiber and Vitamins, it is about a draw between the Pure Naturals and the Kellog's Fiber Plus. The Kellog's Fiber Plus bar has fewer calories per bar 130 vs 190, fewer fat calories 35 vs 70, more fiber 9g vs 5g and more Vitamin E and Zinc. But the Kellog's Fiber Plus also has more Saturated fat 3g vs 1g and fewer Proteins 2g vs 7g.

Another problem is that the Pure Natural bars are promoted as Gluten-Free, Vegan and Natural Ingredients. I'll give them the Natural but they are processed in a plant that also processes Wheat, Peanuts, Soy, Sesame so that negates the Gluten-Free statement. The only plus I can find to these bars is that they use only natural or organic ingredients.

I definitely would not call either bar healthy but if you have to have a chocolate bar then they are better for you than your typical chocolate bar. I would recommend trying the Kellog's Fiber Plus first and if not to your liking then try the Pure Naturals bars. Will I eat them, sure but will I buy the Pure Natural bars, not likely as they are very costly compared to the Kellog's Fiber Plus.

This noodle dish is delicious, just a tiny bit spicy.  For a taste of Thai cooking, add a couple tablespoons of peanut butter to the sauce, blend well before adding to the noodles.  Great with chicken!
Received item, but noticed that it one box within the package was a different variety than I ordered.  No big deal, just an observation
We loved the Soy Ginger Saba Noodles. Absolutely not too spicy...not hot at all. Our two year old gobbled them up.

I've tried several of these Annie Chun noodle dishes and soups with noodles. I don't find any of them very good as compared with 'real' Asian food. Some aren't too bad when doctored with some soy sauce, hot sauce, or other sauce. And some aren't too bad for ease of preparation.

This one isn't easily doctored, nor is it that fast/simple to make. Therefore I don't see any reason to keep in the pantry. If I don't feel like spending 20-30 minutes to make my own Asian food from scratch, I'll stick with better/easier ready-made products to keep on hand.

I bought this and a few other Annie Chun products on the recomendation of a Trader Joe's worker.  Annie's signature Soba noodles can be cooked to either an unappealing glue or still hard inside.  The sauce has an unpleasent odor, my fiancee would not even try it.  I went ahead and tried it but couldn't finish it.  I think I'm being generous with 2 Stars, seeing as how my dogs wouldn't eat it either.

We used to eat these pancakes every week with fruit instead of syrup. We have introduced our friends to these. Amazing that such health and flavor could come from a complete pancake mix.

Unfortunately it seems that Kellog's now owns Krusteaz and they changed the recipe approximately in Fall 2011. Here are some of the changes:

- Sugar almost doubled.
- Fat up by 33%.
- Salt up by 8%.

Hmm, so much for my tasty healthy alternative. Seems like there were plenty of to-sweet pancakes available on the market that appeal to children.

The new recipe mix currently says "Improved Taste" on the package. I wish I could find a source for the old recipe and buy enough to last to the use-by date. There does not seem to be any way to ask Amazon sellers details like this about what they are selling.

The new recipe is still the best tasting pancake mix that we can find, but how can you want that much sugar in something you are going to pour syrup over? We are looking for an alternative.

This is a really great pancake mix. It was fresh and pefectly packaged. It arrived intact and was shipped very quickly.

I mix this with Krusteaz Blueberry Pancake Mix for a really super breakfast! It's a really tasty pancake mix that's also very healthy.

I think this coffee is an absolutely delicious eye opener.

It fills the room with a mixed blend of fragrances of pumpkin, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves.It's ingredients are all organic and a wonderful combination.

It doesn't smell as wonderful in the bag as it does when heated. This is a savory way to start the day. Not just great for the holidays, but especially nice anytime during the cold weather. Highly recommended.

I almost never buy flavored coffees but took a chance because it was on sale. A really excellent well balenced holiday blend. As expected, I do not taste pumpkin, but I taste the nutmeg, cinamon and hint of cloves that make a great pumpkin pie. The coffee is a medium dark roast (not Starbucks dark) that is a great match to the spices. The pumpkin does not overpower the coffee, it compliments it.

That said, coffee is a personal thing. The reviewer who rated this 1 star rates K-cup instant coffee and tea 5 stars....I can't drink that awful stuff. I agree with the majority here. Really exceptional!

This is the second brand of pumpkin spice coffee that I've purchased and it is out of this world.  I feel like I'm having a warm piece of pumpkin pie. It's very rich and smooth and tastes the same cup after cup.

Just tried this Pumkin Spice Coffee. Spouse said it left an after taste. I couldn't taste the Pumkin -- the only reason to buy Pumkin Spice coffee. Label says its Low Acidic -- that's a plus if the coffee was better. Bean Coffee Engineer's have some work to do on this Pumkin Blend.

PROBLEM: We got use to GODAVIA, Pumkin Spice Coffee which is the VERY VERY BEST! Unfortunately it is also $$$$$ VERY Pricey.

If you like medium or dark roast, this is not for you. Only slight pumpkin spice flavoring and weak coffee taste.
I will have to double up the scoops to achieve the flavor I want. It is less acidic which is easier on a sensitive stomach.
I am so disappointed. I don't taste anything at all. I have to put my own spices in. I will stick w/ Green Mountain from now on.

I have been looking for pumpkin spice coffee that really has a good flavor to it and bought this because of the reviews. I opened the bag and was surprised to find no smell that hinted the presence of anything other than normal coffee. I made a pot of coffee and still, nothing in the flavor or smell to suggest it is anything other than normal coffee.

The coffee itself is ok, but the product isn't at all as described. Given the reviews, I find myself wondering if a mistake of some kind happened during the busy holiday season, and I was sent plain coffee with a pumpkin spice sticker on it.
A subtle and smooth pumpkin taste!!  Very good coffee at a decent price. I recommend this coffee if you like a good seasonal flavor!!

The Bean Company has to be by far the best Pumpkin Spice coffee I have ever tried.. I have tried Gloria Jean's and others. Until now I thought Gloria Jean's was the best. This one tastes so much better.
Hardly any "pumkin pie" type taste.  It does have the flavor of some of the seasonings, lots of nutmeg.  Tastes very acidic.  I do not recommend. I'd return it if I could.
This one of the best flavored coffees I have ever had. Excellent with a little cocoa powder mixed in during the brew.

I was really surprised how good this coffee is. I bought it on a whim, then brewed a pot of it at work. It really has a delicious flavor. The pumkin spice flavor is really well balanced with the coffee. It's perfect for the holiday season!

BAD smell when I opened the bag and even worse smell when brewing the stuff.  Not sure what the flavor is..some bad spice or chemical taste..family did not like it nor did our friends... all turned up noses..wish I  could return but...green mountain has an awesome pumpkin coffee, this was no comparison.

I had heard a little about this product from the local pet store, then tried a small bag for our 2 cats of about 3 and 6 years respectively. The female, younger one took to it right away, and the older male, who was unfortunately weaned on the junk cat food with all the corn meal and etc... in it, and would usually refuse a diet change, actually liked it too. The older male is overweight and we were trying to switch him to soft food on the doctor's request, but he totally refused it. He is a posh cat after all. He still consumes too many calories, the fatty, but at least I know he's eating good food. Of course, I know this product seems to cost more than most other feline food on the market, but I just can't see feeding our animals the lousy alternatives that are out there, marketed as being healthy. Why do commercials show cats eating a vegetarian diet which is mostly corn meal? Is that right? I'll stay with this for now, but stay tuned.

I'm updating this review after 9 months of using this cat food for our two cats. I upgraded the stars from 4 to 5 as it really has been a good food for the two of them. Garfield still eats a little too much, but he's just a big cat who doesn't exercise much, let's face it. Our female cat will be 4 years old in a couple months and she's so healthy. She's tiny, but happy and agile. I tried the chicken version of Holistic Select, but Garfield seemd to miss this sardine version so we went back to this one. I've ordered the duck version and will update this once they try it.

I started buying this after I noticed my 1 year old cat was already starting to lose his "spunk" so I decided it was time to start buying him "real" cat food...not the garbage in the super markets. I found this at the pet store out of the other million choices, and I'm sure there are other brands that are just as good but this is the one I went with to try first and it was a great purchase. My cat has been on this for the past 8 months and he's now just has active as he was when he was a kitten and his coat has became sooo soft. Mainly, he loved the taste even more! I highly recommend this brand to all my friends and family for their animals!

I have a 4 year old male cat who has chronic urinary tract infections.  I feed him this dry food in combination with wet food (with water added to it) and Uri Ease. This is a double brownie.  The single brownie is too dinkie to satisfy me.  Then I slather the rest of the yogurt over the brownie.  The creamy yogurt mixes through the chewy brownie and is my hands down favorite send my belly to bed happy nighttime snack.  5 weight watchers points with the double serving and yogurt.

Trader Joe's has been carrying the No Pudge Brownie mixes for over a decade and it's not unusual to see customers buying them by the case.  At the current price of $15.55 for 6 that makes them $2.59 a pack if you have Amazon prime or use Super Saver Free shipping and that's not a bad deal.  What mnakes these brownies so popular is that all you have to add is yogurt.  I add Vanilla Nonfat yogurt and sometimes I'll toss in two tablespoons of instant coffee of espresso powder to jazz them up.  You don't need butter or eggs - just the yogurt. I always keep a couple packages in the pantry to whip up for unexpected company or for whenever that chocolate craving hits you out of nowhere.  The best thing about No Pudge Fudge Brownies is that they are easy to mix, quick to cook and they always come out to be the same good and fudgey brownie you are longing for. Keep some on hand at all times!
These are by far the best fat-free desert out there! I am a pleased to say we order these cases two at a time! My kids love to make them,and take them to school. No pudge rocks!!

These brownies really taste like brownies and they dont wreck your diet if you dont eat the whole box at a sitting! Brownies are my favorite chocolate snack food and these are very sweet, chewy and satisfy my chocolate cravings.

I felt that this would help combat the extra mix and guarentee this was not adding any extra calories or fat that the yogurt sometimes has, and more importantly, no extra sugar. Part of dieting means treating yourself, and while I have this sometimes a few days a week, I never noticed a weight gain while consuming this.  This stuff is wonderful!!

Here's a review by someone who is not fat, not on a diet, and who has not ruined his palate with fat free confections:

Maybe OK for a boston butt, but as a general purpose rub I find it too heavy on the salt. But looking at the nutrition info on the label, the sodium content in this rub is substantially higher than most other commercial rubs/seasons I've tried. So just be forewarned that if your salt preference is more on the conservative side, this may not be the product for you.

I bought this product due to all the good reviews. I bbq using a weber smokey mountain often. I usually make my own rubs. I thought this might be a good product to keep on hand in case I didn't feel like making a rub.

Most good bbq rubs have a base of salt and brown sugar. This rub does not contain any sugar. It is however very heavy on the salt. I am used to using a large amount of rub when bbq to get a nice bark. I made some ribs using this rub and they were so salty they were almost inedible. I tasted the rub before hand and cut it with some brown sugar but clearly not enough.

I have used this rub on other foods and had better results. A little is very delicious on french fries or corn on the cob where I use this in place of salt.

If you intend on using this rub heavily for low and slow cooking plan on cutting it heavily with brown sugar. I prefer a salty spicy rub over an overly sweet rub but this is too much on its own. I just wish they used more of the other ingrediantes and less salt as the spice is very tasty.

If you plan on using this to spice up other foods in place of salt you may be very happy with this.

This is the best rub i have found or even made. No need to drive yourself crazy trying to perfect your own rub, they have done it for you.
With butts and whole chickens/turkeys it is great. On ribs go very sparingly, it can overwhelm them! I also like to melt this in water/applejuice/vinegar/butter and inject it directly into the butts (10 to 12LBS typically). I like the keep the butts in the "shrinkwrap" they come in from BJ's overnite then put the rub on at least 4-6 hours prior letting the meat come up to room temp in a bag till it is soaked in then i add another sprinkling. I got a "pizza" shaker type metal shaker that makes the application easy and it works out great. I slow smoke often and 1 gallon of this lasts me right around a year but I use it for everything! Really is worth the money, you will not regret it, just go easy on the ribs as it is a bit salty ad full flavored.

I grill and barbeque a lot and use "rubs" that I make and a very few commercial products, mainly because most commercial rubs aren't all that good. Byron's, however is the real deal: since buying this stuff, I have used it on ribs, pork butt roast, steaks and turkey. It produces consistantly great results on grilled food, low & slow barbeque and even on oven roasted meats. It adds a nice zip to soups, salads and veggies too. I will be seasoning the Thanksgiving turkey with it at the request of my SO.

I concur with the reviewer who urged potential customers to get the big size: it gets used up real fast!!
Learn about this Rub from one of the BBQ sites I visit. I've tried it on Tri-Tip and Chicken and the Family loved it. I will buy this again when I run out.

The only problem with this rub is that I thought I was getting the jar, not the large size container.

This stuff is amazing. It's like everything that tastes good on charred, dead animal flesh got together and conspired to bring the world a delicious alternative to salt and BBQ Sauce. I strongly suggest liberally coating on chicken, pork, beef, and anything else you can get your hands one. I spilled some on eggs once. Those eggs came to life, fried themselves, found some bacon to pair up with, and plated themselves while pouring me a glass of delicious orange-mango-pineapple juice.

I love this more than Penzey's seasoned sea salt, johnny's sea salt, penzey's barbecue dust, and puppies. If you knew how much I love puppies, this last sentence would cause you to gasp in amazement.

My girlfriend told me about this seasoning, and every since then, Curtains!  I Swear, I try to put this seasoning on Everything. Lol. This blend is simply AMAZING!!! I SOO Wish I could put more stars here for this. Because I definitely would.

My whole family loved this rub. We have used it on steak,chicken,ribs,brisket,in fact everything we have smoked or grilled. If you are looking for a great stand out rub that enhances every type of meat then buy this one. You won't be disappointed.
Bought this rub because of the great reviews.  Not bad just ok.  I like  "Bone Suckin Rub" much better.

I have watched hundreds of shows on BBQ,, I saw Bad byrons on one show and thought i'll give it a try !! sooooooooo tasty,, just the right amount of twang !

Almost out,, will be ordering a bigger batch this time!

My husband and I use this on basically everything we throw on the grill or smoker. It's a good seasoning "go to" when you need something quick too. My husband is an avid BBQ eater, viewer, wanna be judge, and quite honestly, I prefer his creations over anything we've eaten at a restaurant. I digress from my review to give you that facet of our history in order to say other than a rub that we make to test, this is what we use now and for as long as we've had a grill. Usually the rubs we have made pass by the way side b/c we prefer this to anything else we've tried.
This is a great product.  Tastes wonderful on steak, prime rib, and chicken.  Give it a shot, I think you will enjoy it.
good rub, great taste, a little salty but over all nice for presentation and ease of use, highly recommend to others to use this product as well.

I was sent a multipage e-mail from Amazon a couple of years ago on barbecue accessories,spices, sauces and rubs. That's when I first tried  Bad Byron's Butt Rub. It is the only seasoning I put on my steaks & chops now. My friends have noticed it when I have had them over for a barbecue. I've turned several of them onto it also. It's True , every thing goes better with a little Butt Rub.

A friend of mine gave me my first bottle and I was hooked. I take chicken tenders and stick a folk in they several times rub Byron's on the meat. Put these, I do 6 to a pack, in ziplock bags and wait 45 minted put on grill or mini kitchen grill Wow great

I Love It... I Have Been Using This Stuff For 3 Years And Ever Never Ever Had A Better Seasoning For Pork!!!

Really Good On Grilled Pineapple Too!

I use this rub on everything including chicken, ribs, turkey and the obvious Pork shoulders. The seasonings come together to create a spicy bold flavor that just adds to the already present flavorful meat your are cooking. Great with sides also.
So far, used the rub on pork chops and it turned out great.  Can't wait until summer for BBQ ribs.
This stuff is great on everything.  This is the best spice blend I've used.  I even use it on weird stuff like mac & cheese and popcorn.

I bought this along with Pappy's and Stubb's rub to taste test them all. Overall Byron's was the best tasting/flavor. I like the smokiness of this rub on the skirt steak that we grilled. I went back for 2nds and 3rds. :) As with all rubs, there is a lot of salt. So you have to be careful how much you rub on. Overall the best tasting.. Very pleased.

Butt Rub is by far one of the best rubs you can buy. I normally make my own dry rubs (especially for some things like ribs and pork butt) but this stuff is delicious! It has the perfect amount of twang. I've tried tried it on steaks, burgers, pork chops, country style ribs, etc. and all with great results. But I find it is especially fantastic on grilled chicken and is almost the only thing I season my chicken with now. For those that say it is too salty, this is not a sweet rub nor is it meant to be, and there is a such thing as using too much!  Don't listen to them though, buy some and you definitely will not be disappointed!
We've been using this on almost everything we cook. It was so good that I started sharing samples with friends. Now, I'm running low. I should try to get some samples from my friends...LOL!!

I recently began a diet and was looking for something to spice up hard-boiled eggs, raw vegies, and plain baked potatos.  This rub adds a nice flavor and heat without the calories. The service was impeccable. I ordered this product on a Friday and it was delivered and on my front porch the following Monday!

I was watching a food network cook-off, and one of the teams was called "[...]" and I just had to type it in and see what came up. Luckily, it was this delectable spice mix and not something funny :)

Butt Rub is awesome on just about anything! If you go on the actual website, you can see the never ending list of possible culinary creations. I recommend getting the big jar, we already ran out which is why I'm on this page tonight. And just in time for fathers day! It makes a great gift for a Dad that loves to bbq.

The main ingredient of this rub must be salt, because it overpowers everything else in it.  It pretty much ruined some perfectly good ribs I bar-b-qued, and I certainly won't be using it again.  I recommend Corky's dry rub instead of this.

East of Paris is Meaux and environs.  This is the ancient home of true brie.  This is one of the two or three best.  It is not expensive, even when you add another third for shipping.  This is a big six pounder wheel.  You are paying for proper storage.  You can even cut it in quarters and freeze three for up to six months if you wrap tightly in a double freezer wrap paper.  Stored properly, this cool ripening takes two months to fully develop.  Muscular, but never sharp, this 45% minimum FBD (yep, FAT) will make you forget all others. My little girl jammed her shoulder and her physical therapist recommended this.  She loves the little medicated treats.  As a human, they really smell awful but it does not matter to the dogs.  I only give it a 4 rating because it is a bit pricey.

I have heard that this product is excellent for maintaining or improving canine joints. My dog who loves all other treats would not eat this chew. I cannot rate its effectiveness since my dog did not like it. In terms of flavor, I guess it receives a poor rating!

This is the best basic habanero sauce I've tried with a nice flavor and a lot of heat. 2nd only to Tabasco Habanero sauce but that is a jamacian sause and this is a more vanilla flavor.
Works great in recipes. But I tried them in my coffee and it has a bit of a funny artificial taste. Will buy some flavours in the large size to continue to bake with.

When I made this purchase it was under the suggestion of others. I was a bit hesitant, as I had not heard of stevia - liquid or otherwise. I am so pleasantly pleased with how little you have to use for sweetness and flavoring. I have used in coffee, tea, on fruits and in plain water. AMAZING!
I love these flavors and use them in everything from my coffee to vodka and soda water and deserts as well. It's nice to have a variety!

First, I definitely should have paid more attention to the size, because these are tiny, and for the price, I assumed I'd have more product, but never mind that, it was my mistake, I should have paid more attention.  On to the flavor.  I have been a fan of the vanilla for a year or so, and figured I'd give the rest a try... I was a little disappointed.  I mix these with plain water or sparkling water, so maybe for a different use, they would be good.  I felt like I had to add so much to catch the actual flavor of the chocolate raspberry, lemon, and orange, that it was waaaaay too sweet.  I'll just stick to vanilla cream from no on

I'm on a no-sugar diet right now and this stuff is a life saver.  I add about 10 drops to a bottle of water and it gives me the sweetness I need.  No bitter taste here.  Love that I was able to try out 4 flavors at once.

I really love all the different flavors, however, I have found that the Stevia liquid is only good if you use just a few drops in your cold beverages, for example, I add the Chcolate Rasberry to my sugar- free, morning protein shakes, and they taste wonderful. But for my loose leaf teas, I use the powder packets.

I can not taste any flavoring in these, I put many drops into the water, increasing by increments and all it did was make the water sweet, there is no flavor here. I don't understand how others have tasted any flavoring at all because I sure didn't, I so wanted something all natural that would taste good but this is just drinking sugar water so now I have to find something to add some flavor to the water. I HAVE BOUGHT THREE BOTTLES OF THIS PRODUCT. I HAVE NOT FELT ANY BETTER; MOST OF THE TIME, I HAVE FELT MUCH WORSE. I WAS UNDER THE IMPRESSION THAT THIS PRODUCT WOULD CURE ME OF HEMORRHOIDS. I normally get this tea at Teavana stores in the mall or their website, so was excited to see it on Amazon (as I have tons of gift cards here). It seemed to take a little longer then other products to arrive but came in great shape and came with a free sample just like my other orders from the Teavana site have (which makes sense since they're partnered with Amazon). I drink the White Ayurvedic Chai with the Samurai Chai Mate and they taste fantastic together. They're supposed to be full of caffeine but for me they're my anytime tea. I have to steep a little longer then recommended time as I like my tea strong (with a bit of sugar or honey :) but it tastes great. Not to sickly sweet like some fruity teas.
It is sweeter then some of their other teas, so if you don't like sweet then you may want to try out some of their others. I recommend going into the stores and sampling their array of teas they usually have set out to find your favorite. The blend they normally have of this one is good but not always what comes out at home though so don't just go by that one. They use German rock sugar (which they sell) and that costs a little more. Most people will use normal table sugar, honey, or artificial sweetener which will affect the tastes. Anyway, go try the tea, find your tea and drink happy.
This is a sweet tasting and delicious tea. It has dried fruit and seems to have some sugar. If it does have sugar, it is not calorie free. It is very tasty and makes a good iced tea also.

See my review on the Samurai Chai Mate. The two combined is fabulous.

One more thing -- we have found that you can use the loose leaves (we just leave them in the tea basket) for several cups of tea with the same effect. So while it's a pit pricey, it's well worth it, particularly if you reuse the leaves.
Great Tea, arrived on time, and in air tight tea package to preserve flavor. Also mixes well with other tea.

I am looking for a good tasting coffee that can also kick my day off in the morning. This coffee tastes OK but leaves me sleepy still after two cups plus an acid burning sensation in my stomach. There is nothing very impressive about this coffee to me, all the bitterness and sourness are there and mild coffee taste in there. Disappointed.

Caribou Coffee is a rarity in NY/NJ area. I have been missing it since I left Minneapolis about 6 years back but now I can get it on Amazon. The price is great and the coffee always arrives fresh. Just love it!!!!

I'm all about good coffee. I try different kinds from time to time, but I always return to Caribou. My local grocery store will only carry the ground blend, so I have to rely on Amazon or drive 2 hours for the good stuff. The price is right and I appreciate the prime shipping every 20 days or so.

The Caribou Coffee, Caribou Blend is probably the best coffee I have ever had, and better yet I can brew it at home. The taste is smooth and flavorful. I drink it black or sometimes with coffee creamers that make it taste like something you might pay $4 or $5 per cup at retail.

This coffee is dreamy. I just recently started drinking coffee and I started with Eight O'Clock Colombian. It was ok, but it had a very watery taste to it. Just tried this and I have to say the flavor blows the other away! Give it a try and I'm sure you'll agree. BTW, I am using the Aerobie AeroPress Coffee and Espresso Maker to make my coffee and I highly recommend it also.

In Texas, you can't get this unless you have a Keruig single brew machine.  When I go to Minnesota to visit family I load up my suitcase with Caribou coffee. I was so excited to see Amazon sells it for a great price.  Excellent coffee and great flavor.  My husband who never had Caribou until he meet me now loves this coffee!  I highly recommend it!
Caribou Coffee is a rarity on the west side of the country so I love being able to buy from Amazon.  The price is great and the coffee always arrives fresh.
I found this to be bland and lacking of flavor. If you like weak, mild coffee this one might be for you. Just didn't do it for me.

My work colleagues and I have had a couple of bizarrely negative and expensive experiences at local Caribou Coffee shops.
We were blown off by store management so we attempted to convey our concerns with Caribou's corporate customer service.
