Just like they made it back home. Help!  I am hooked....  I finally found what I was looking for for a while

I think of all the Carr's crackers, the poppy and sesame are the best. Watch out, they're addicting, you can munch on them as if they're potato chips. I love these with my nut butters, cheese, you name it. Amazon had a terrific deal on them for awhile, at something like $17.00 for twelve boxes, but now they've raised it to the same price as the other Carr flavors, $30.00, so they're no longer such a terrific bargain.

Bummer.

But I'm still buying them, not as frequently.

These are my all time favorite crackers. They're so delicious that they can actually be addictive. After you have eaten 2 or 3 a strong very good flavor starts to accumulate on your tongue. And you start to crave more of that great flavor. And then, the more crackers you eat, the more you crave another. -

The bad part is that these can be difficult to find. I first discovered these at local supermarkets about 10 years ago. But then, after a few years .They disappeared from all of my local stores. Then, about a year after they disappeared from local stores, Amazon started to carry them. But Amazon is often out of stock on these. Including a recent period when Amazon didn't have any for over a year. So if you want any. You have to grab them as soon as you see that any are available. -

I was pleasantly surprised when Amazon recently made them available thru Subscribe and Save. Aside from the lower price and free delivery. Maybe that's an indication that Amazon now expects to always have these in stock. -

Cheeze-It the creamy and mild Mozzarella baked snack crackers are wonderful and full of amazing flavor.  Very nice snack and is full of flavor that is so very satisfying. I would highly recommend this new flavor to anyone.

I have been a fan of Cheez-It crackers for a long time. We almost always have the cheddar in our pantry and most recently the white cheddar which is very good as well. I was excited to try the mozzarella and I was not dissapointed! They have the same great crunch as the orginal but with a yummy mozzarella taste. I can't wait to see what they come out with next!

I'm sorry to say that I just did not enjoy these mozzarella cheese Cheez-It's. I like actual mozzarella cheese but the flavor powder on these crackers was just way too much for me. I could only eat two. The aftertaste was worse. I had to pop a peppermint to get the taste out of my mouth. A couple other people tried the crackers and weren't too impressed either.

I like regular cheddar Cheez-It's, so I think I'll stick to those.

Cheez-IT crackers have been around since 1921, and I dare say that they have been a favorite of children ever since. I didn't know what to expect when I picked up this "new" Cheez-Its, mozzarella, but once I dug into them I found that I loved them. They are indeed quite smooth and delicious.

If you like Cheez-IT crackers, then you will like these new mozzarella ones. I think that they are delicious!

These were good. I didn't have "regular" cheeze-its around to compare them too but if memory serves then these were "cheesier" and better. There are definitely some better flavors of cheez-its out nowadays but I can't imagine myself turning these things down at a party (or anywhere else).

I have never been a big fan of the original Cheez-Its although others in my household seem to love them. I really enjoyed this Mozzarella variety much more than the original flavor, although it was a bit strong and overwhelming.  For the general public, I would give these 4 stars. However, I changed my way of eating over 6 months ago and no longer eat foods with additives, preservatives, trans fat and other non-healthy ingredients (basically, most processed foods). If you fall into the category of being one who watches for this stuff as well, be aware these have enriched flour and a number of additives and ingredients you probably do not want in your snacks. I am happy to report there is no trans fat or high fructose corn syrup, which seems to be overwhelmingly prevalent in many processed foods today. Overall, I would eat these if I had to or really needed a snack and other options were not available.
It's hard to rate and review a Cheez-It.  If you like the white cheddar or monterey jack kind, then you'll like this one too.  These are just a little bit milder.

When I first opened up the box, I was chagrined to find that about half of the contents were broken crackers. Still, I'd ordered crackers through the postal service and some breakage is to be expected, right?

The whole crackers were near the top, so I nabbed one gently between forefinger and middle finger and lifted it out of the box. Before my fingers cleared the packaging, the cracker had snapped in two.

They're delicious - somehow creamy, despite having the pleasantly mealy texture of a good Cheez-It - but exceptionally fragile, making them unsuitable as a snack in a child's lunch or, frankly, the lunch of a fully grown adult with an unpadded lunch box. They're nice to eat out of hand and make a fantastic substitute for breadcrumbs when grilling up chicken or pork.

I love Cheez-ITs and have been eating them for as long as I can remember. White cheddar is a favorite of mine, and when I was on a diet, the Reduced Fat ones were just as tasty. Now for their latest flavor; mozzarella, I would have to say it is just okay. The flavor is mild and almost bland. Not to my liking and I would probably not purchase them.

I found these to have a good Mozzarella taste but they still retained that distinctive cheese-it cracker taste underneath which I liked. Everyone is going to have a different opinion on them so why not get a box and see for yourself? I did notice that MSG is listed in the ingredients. I don't believe that original cheese-its have it so that is something to keep in mind. Overall a good product that I like and will purchase in the future.

I'd also like to note that mine were shipped smart post and I wouldn't recommend picking the cheapest shipping option when ordering. By the time the cheese-its got to me I'd say that only 1/3 of the box was whole crackers. The rest were broken down into a fine crumb mess. The box didn't look badly beat up, so I don't know what the post office does but it is definitely detrimental to the cheese-its.

I'm a fan of Cheez-Its. However, I do prefer certain flavors over others. For example, I personally don't like Baby Swiss flavor, but I do like this Mozzarella.

First cracker, I found the taste of these Mozzarella Cheez-Its to be very mild. It reminded me a little of the Baby Swiss, not in taste comparison but in that it's a very subtle cheese taste at first. However, the more Mozzarella Cheez-Its I consumed, the more I tasted the Mozzarella flavor. After a handful, I was in Mozzarella heaven. It leaves a good after taste, too (unlike Baby Swiss).

So, if you like Cheez-Its, and want to try a flavor that's not spicy, not tangy, and not 'in your face', then I recommend trying the milder, mellower Mozzarella cheese flavor.

I was never a fan of Cheez-Its. However, the Mozzarella Cheese Cheez-Its are an exception.
I found these snacks to be very good. They're very tasty and most importantly they're
not very salty which was my main problem with the original Cheeze-It favor. While I
wouldn't buy the traditional flavor, I would definitely get these.

I'm not a huge fan of the original cheez-its, but these mozzarella cheez-its are wonderful. They're made with both mozzarella and cheddar cheese, and you can definitely taste the cheddar. But the mozzarella gives them a milder, butterier taste than a normal cheddar cracker. They are also not too salty, which is often a problem with cheese crackers.

At 150 calories for 25 crackers (a few handfuls), this is a great snack. They take the edge of your hunger without filling you up with empty calories.

They are a little greasy, so you'll want to have a napkin or a sink hand when you eat them. The crackers in my box were almost all broken, which made it a little harder to eat them. But those are relatively minor drawbacks, and this is certainly a product that I'll eat again.

Kellogg's Sunshine Cheez-IT Mozzarella Cheese, 13.7-Ounce (Pack of 4)

I sent for Kellogg's Sunshine Cheez-IT Mozzarella Cheese through my Vine offerings for review from Amazon. However, since the ingredients were not visible, I was unaware that the product contained MSG (monosodium glutamate) to which my entire family, me included, is allergic. So, I asked my neighbor if any of his household was allergic or sensitive to MSG-monosodium glutamate and he said no. So, they became my test group for the CHEEZ-IT with Mozzarella. Three boys high school and college age and their father, they reported as follows:
21 year old: "Excellent Mozzarella flavoring. I liked it with ham added as a cracker snack."
19 Year old: "Wow! Pete thanks, we all liked it and like my older bro I too made cracker and ham sandwiches of it!"
12 year old: "it was good but a little too salty for me, so my brothers and dad ate most of it."
Dad: "It was good and I joined the boys only I added an Italian ham to it, the spicy Capicola and it was great."

There you have it, only one hitch, a suggestion to Kelloggs, RE: I read said that, more than 27% of people are sensitive to or allergic to MSG (monosodium glutamate), so any company or restaurant that uses it is automatically shutting off a sizable segment of their market.

I agree, why cut out ANY of your market just to use a cheap substitute for spices'? I give it 3.5 stars which rounds out to four stars above, I took off 1.5 stars for the MSG added because it limits the marketability of the product and because we could not eat it.

We're a household of Cheez-It fans, so everyone was excited to try the new mozzarella flavor.  First of all, we were disappointed because many crackers had broken during shipping, so there were lots of crumbled bits scattered throughout the box.  However, the ones that remained were tangy and tasty.  They don't have quite the same texture as the regular cheddar flavor and do crumble a bit more easily.  However, this is a nice blend of salty and cheesy.  If you like the regular flavor and want to try something new, give these a try.

The CHEEZ-IT Mozzarella Cheese snack is totally yummy. My entire family loved these. We're also fans of the regular CHEEZ-IT's so I wasn't sure we'd like this new flavor. WE DID!!! They are mild but tasty. The CHEEZ-IT Mozzarella Cheese flavor is the only other flavor besides the original cheese our family will eat. GET THESE!!!

I have long been a fan of regular Cheeze-it's, and these are every bit as good, only with a wonderful cheesy mozzarella flavor. All the crunch and flavor you expect! I have to limit myself to a handful, then hide the box from myself so I don't eat the entire box!

I really haven't found a cheez-it cracker that I do not like and the Mozzarella one's are no different. They are mild in flavor and kind of a little creamery tasting than most of the other cheez-its that I have tried. They are bursting with flavor as usual but without being overpowering. If you like Mozzarella cheese and you like cheez-its then I think you'll love this product.

I've always liked Cheez-Its, but the original cheddar version was always a bit sharp for me. This new Mozzarella brand has a smoother and ultimately more enjoyable flavor. Overall, I love it. I could eat a whole box of these in one sitting. I only wish they were healthier!

These Mozzarella Cheese-it's could be better

Sure, They are cheesy, but they are not mozzarella cheesy. at least not to me. They tasted more like a white Cheddar and that was a major disappointment

Second, they left a really bad aftertaste that reminded me of drinking diet soda and that was really unpleasant.

I'd just stick with regular Cheezit's or the Hot & Spicy ones. These need improvement

The ingredients show cheddar cheese as the primary cheese in these crackers, and mozzarella is less than 2%. Therefore they taste more cheddar than anything else. Having said that, they were crunchy, cheesy, and every bit as good as other flavors. Friends and family members were equally impressed. Another hit for CHEEZ-IT.

My family loves Cheez-Its in general, so I was excited about the prospect of the mozzarella version. We were definitely not disappointed!

The quality definitely fits with the Cheez-It brand name. It is a rich cracker with a good amount of flavor. The texture is the same as original Cheez-Its. My family enjoys these for both snacking purposes and cooking purposes.

As for the mozzarella flavor - well, it does work. I'm not sure that I'd automatically think mozzarella if I were blind-folded and asked to identify the cheese. But, when I use it for cooking with a dish that works well with mozzarella but not some other cheese flavors, this product fits the flavor well.

While I'm not sure that these are the snack crackers I'll automatically keep in the pantry, they are some that I will buy for specific cooking or snacking purposes. All in all, a pretty enjoyable product.

When I first tasted these I could only muster up an "okay".  Then I had a couple more and they tasted better.  After I had about 20 or so I realized that I really like them.  They are a completely different beast from the cheddar cheez-it's.  But they are quite good.  The taste is very light and it's a not an "in your face" kind of flavor.  If I hadn't tried the chedder jack flavor first I might even go so far as to say that they are my favorite next to the original flavor.  If they ever get on my Safeway's shelves I'll pick some up.

Cheez-It crackers are a favorite in this house. Everyone was eager to try the new Mozzarella flavor, so the box was open the minute it came in the door! They did not disappoint, everyone likes them just as well as the other varieties we have tried.

I will say, though, that this is where I find myself holding back from saying they are amazing. They tasted pretty much like the other white varieties we've had, I couldn't taste any special difference in these being made with Mozzarella. If I had been given a handful without seeing the box, I never would have known what flavor they were. I prefer the original cheddar, that's my favorite.

Still, my kids had to be limited to one serving, they love Cheez-It crackers in every variety!

the mozzarella taste is mild but I can taste it. It still tastes like a cheez-it mostly and that is why I gave it five stars...because cheez-its are awesome. orginial is of course the best but this is still pretty good. If you like original cheez-its you will like this because of how much like an original cheez-it it tastes. They make a great alternative to the white cheez-its if white cheez-its are your bag.

Well being a junk food junkie this is an easy one to rate.  I loved this full flavor snack with real mozzarella taste.  This product didn't feel artificial like some other orange food.  I felt a little less guilty since it is not fried, but it was too easy to eat more than my fair share!

I really love Cheez-ITs. I can sit down in front of the tv with a box and before I know it, it's half gone. But these were different. I don't know why, but I expected just a little more from this box, and yet it seemed to fall just short of hitting the nail directly on the head. Don't get me wrong, I still enjoyed them, but they left an odd after-taste in my mouth that I honestly wasn't that crazy about.
Not much else to say, but I do hope that this review helped you in one way or the other.
Enjoy.

Like with every other flavor of Cheez-Its (or cheese crackers in general), I'm addicted. These are really tasty. Everyone in our house (including our 3yo son) liked them. The only problem was that half the box was crumbs, I assume from being tossed around during shipping...so that was a bummer.

This is a very mild and surprisingly flavorful selection from Cheez-It. I had this with a sandwich and they also go great with Tuna.Since the flavor is less 'cheesy' than the cheddar varieties, for instance these make perfect accompaniments for more flavorful foods. Still a healthy way to snack, and a 'different' approach to crackers with the mild flavor. Really enjoyed these!

I have to say I was pleasantly surprised by the new Mozzrella Cheez-its. I had become rather tired of the old flavor, finding them to be a little on the dry side. But the new flavor is definitely worth trying - a product I would certainly purchase the next time I'm at the grocery store.

The new mozzarella flavor is bold and distinct, and I found myself eating them with a glass of wine, something I would not have thought to do with the old flavor. And they went very well with a glass of white wine, though I'm sure they'd be every bit as good with red.

My only disappointment was when I received the box of crackers - mostly crumbs. I'm not sure Amazon is used to dealing with fragile food items in their shipping, but hopefully Kellogg won't have the same issue when shipping to stores.

This is definitely a product I would recommend. It's on my grocery list already and I can't wait to introduce it to my next book club.

I like the MOZZARELLA flavored CHEEZ-ITS, but I can't really tell the difference between this flavor and the Cheez-It Baked Snack Crackers, White Cheddar, 13.7-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4) one.

These seem to have a saltier flavor than the regular CHEEZ-IT, which is what I like, and there's a slight powdery texture to the squares. Also, they do have a somewhat milder cheese taste than the original. You can eat them with a sandwich or soup, or just out of the box by themselves.

And since these are baked, they make a better alternative to chips, a serving size being 25 crackers, which I would estimate to be about one and one-half medium-sized hands full.

I love the taste of Original Cheez-It's and find they make a nice tasty snack. I like the fact that they aren't messy when you eat them - there is no need to wipe your fingers after each piece. Before now I've not tried any other flavors of Cheez-It's and was curious about how the Mozzarella flavored Cheez-It's would taste especially since I like Mozzarella (and Cheez-It's!) I found them to be a bit of an acquired taste - good but not as good as the original flavor. I wasn't sure I'd like them when I tasted the first one, but once I got used to the taste I enjoyed them. The mozzarella flavor is good - subtle and not overwhelming. It is good but in the end I prefer the taste of original Cheez-It's.

Mozzarella Flavored Cheez-It's taste good but I'm not sure I'd buy them.

These are good, but not as good as I'd hoped. My daughter liked them quite a bit. Even better than regular Cheez-Its. She likes the mild mozzarella flavor, and, though, this may not be what Kellogg was going for, she felt that the milder flavor didn't make her breath stink as much as regular Cheez-Its.

As for me, I didn't like the initial smell and taste. Kind of...I don't know...sour? Or too sharp or pungent. Once I ate them, the taste was very mild, and not at all like what they smelled like, so, that was a plus. But while these were a nice change, I find I still like Cheddar Cheez-It's best.

I was really looking forward to a nice mozzarella cheese taste. Instead I got a very bland tasting cracker that did not even have a hint of a mozzarella flavor in it. Then I looked at the list of ingredients to see if mozzarella cheese was even listed. It was--but so far down that the amount in these crackers is negligible, and certainly not enough to affect the taste.

Bottom line: These crackers do not have an unpleasant taste, just a very bland nondescript taste. These are not something that I would recommend.

I am a serious cheese cracker eater - all brands, all flavors...this is a cheese household. These new Cheez-It Mozzarella flavor crackers are pretty good. They have a faint flavor at first, very light, almost no cheese flavor initially. The after taste as you swallow the crackers packs more of a flavor punch. I could discern the mozzarella flavor and it's very smooth, no bite like with the Cheddar version of Cheez-Its. We'll probably buy these again, but the better flavor is still the original.

Cheez-It Mozzarella has a lighter taste than the regular Cheez-It. It's pretty good, but it doesn't really remind me of "Mozzarella" as I know it from Pizza and Sting Cheese.

It is nothing special, but it is not bad either. Come to think of it, that is the way I feel about regular Cheez-Its too.

When I'm next in the mood for Cheez-Its again, I will probably get the regular version.

There is no doubt that Cheez-It has made some really classic crackers for all to enjoy. They have had a winning formula for the past several generation with great cheddar crackers that seemed timeless. When I heard they were going to make a mozzarella cheese cracker, I was very skeptical, and it didn't feel like anything that seemed like it was anything that extraordinary. I was right. The first taste of the new mozzarella Cheez-It crackers, reminded me of just how much they tasted like the classic Cheez-It crackers, and I was right. These Cheez-It crackers, taste like the classic cheddar taste of the classic crackers they have been known for definitely. In fact, they are actually made with a mixture of white cheddar cheese into the crackers. Not all mozzarella cheese. They taste alright, but not anything that was a wow factor. If you've loved Cheez-It crackers over the years, I suggest you give their new mozzarella cheese a try.

Price: C+

Taste: C+

Overall: C+

These are delicious! I opened the box a little weary, not knowing if these would be good or not, ate one and did not stop eating them until I had made quite a dent in the box. They are so hard to put down! The box says they are creamy and mild and that is a perfect description for these. The cheese flavor is not as strong as the original which can be a nice change.

I gave them 4 stars instead of 5 because I believe no matter how good any of these cheez-it flavors are, nothing will beat the original.

I was excited when this product came in the mail. I love the original Cheez-it. It is dangerous for me to buy them because my snacking can easily get out of control with them.

A 13.7 ounce box of Cheez-It was much bigger than I expected.

The little crackers are crunchy and after you chew for a while they taste creamy but then very salty too. I checked the box, it only has 180mg of salt so why does it taste so salty. I checked the salt in the regular Cheez-it and it is 340 mg. I can't figure out. Why does a craker with much less sodium taste saltier than one that doesn't. I have to watch my sodium intake and sure enough, the next day my fingers were swollen and it was difficult to take off my ring.

I had my husband taste it too and he thought the crackers tasted salty and sour.

Occaisonally, I will brush off the salt all off the top of a cracker and offer it to my cockatiels. They tasted it and spit it out. Wise birds.

Also, even though the box was packed with big air pillows, there was a lot crumbling in the last 1/3 of the box. Down there it was mostly crumbs.

I would not buy it, I just don't like them.

I found the Cheez-It Mozzarella Cheese crackers nothing special and just okay in flavor. For me they tasted somewhat sour, with a hint of cheese and the bare whisper of salt. My daughter says she likes them as she liked the crackers as they tasted a bit cheesy and salty.

So there you have it: My taste buds were not awed by the flavor while my daughter loved the flavor.

Recommend with caveats given.

I have always been a fan of CHEEZ-IT crackers.  The white cheddar has always been my favorite, especially the low fat ones, but these new mozzarella cheese crackers are really tasty too.  My husband likes to take these in his lunch, and he likes the kind with the jalepeno pepper flavor.  This is a great product and a new flavor that most all people enjoy.  Lets face it, if you like pizza, you like mozzarella chees.  We both would highly recommend them.

The good thing about a cheese like cheddar is that is packs a lot of flavor in it. This translates well to secondary products like crackers. Mozzarella - not so much. Mozzarella is so mild that when you try to put it into a product like a cracker, it will inherently have a too mild flavor, so you'll need to enhance this somehow. The easy thing would be to add salt, but Kellogg decided to use spices. This makes the product taste closer to "Ranch dressing" more than cheese.

The product is also marked as "Creamy & Mild". True enough but just what the heck do they use to make a cracker taste "creamy"??? It is kind of weird to me.

I'll stick with the original.

The new Cheez-It Mozzarella flavored crackers are great tasting. The crunch was transformed into a creamy cheese flavor as I greedily shoveled them into my mouth. I had to shovel them, because the crackers were broken into crumbs when I received them. This however in no way detracted from the flavor or deterred me from the swift completion of my appointed task. Wait, I think I missed one. Mmmmm

I love cheez-Its from the get go but these mozzarella cheese ones are truly scrumptious.  They claim they are creamy...... and they really are creamy tasting.  From the first cracker in your mouth you think 'creamy'.  Sooo DELICIOUS!  There is 180 mg of sodium per each of 13 servings/box at 25 crackers per serving.  They do have 7 grams of fat/serving but no trans fats.  From a diabetic point of view, the 19 grams of carbohydrates and 150 calories/serving is a lot even with zero sugars and 3 grams of protein per serving.  I try to restrict my consumption to one or two serving each time I grab the box for a snack but I have to admit this is really hard to do.  They just taste so darn great!  If I have a complaint, the only one I have is that this product contains monosodium glutamate, MSG.  I am highly allergic to this well known neurotoxin and MUST be very careful with my intake of this dangerous chemical.  It is on the very bottom of the ingredients list so hopefully there is not a hugh amount of it in these crackers.  Since I just ate them, I'll know if there is too much MSG if I develop a headache and lock jaw type symptoms tomorrow.  Makes me wonder WHY put it into this delicious snack in the first place?  I do highly recommend this scrumptious treat if you can tolerate the MSG.  I'll have to limit my intake due to the MSG.

My OLD favorite, was the "Original" flavor Cheeze-It, which had a strong cheddar flavor, and lots of crunch.

My NEW favorite is the Mozzarella flavor Cheese-it, because it has a true mozzarella cheese taste, as well as that old time crunch that everybody in my family loves.

We generally eat the Original flavor as a snack right out of the box, or along with soup (tomato soup, in particular).

The Mozzarella flavor as a plain snack, right out of the box, was good, but we still prefer the original, (thus the 4 stars) but I used them in the following ways as well:

--topped a caesar salad with a few crackers (in place of croutons, and that worked great, taste-wise.

-- topped off some tomato soup with a few crackers at the dinner table, and that didn't work quite as well, taste wise.

--crushed approx. 2/3 cup of these and used them as a bread crumb coating for a baked chicken breast parmesan, topped with tomato sauce. Very good, since the mozzarella flavor really came through.

Nutritionally, and calorically, they are about the same as the original flavor.

All in all, I'd say if you like the old, original Cheeze-It flavor, you'll enjoy the new mozzarella flavor too.

I have always been a fan of Cheez-It so I was really excited to try out the new Mozzarella Cheese flavor and I have to say how happy that I have. It definitely has that cheese taste that is all baked into a tiny little cracker, which is one of my favorite qualities of Cheez-It's. But the mozzarella flavor has a smoother and more subtle yet creamier taste then the normal cheddar flavor and I can honestly see myself using this in salads and soups since it would compliment my food better then the normal crackers. But it also satisfies my snack factor so give it a try!

It seems to me that Cheez-It has always gone for bold flavors. These are not that at all. These aren't horrible; they taste like pretty mild-flavored Cheez-Its. I'm not sure exactly what they were going for here in choosing Mozzarella for their newest flavor. Such a mild cheese would be hard to impart into a cracker. And I don't think they've been successful here. While these taste good, they do not taste anything like Mozzarella. The mild taste might be an appeal to some who just want a slightly-cheesy cracker. But I think most Cheez-It fans will be underwhelmed and prefer the bolder flavors Cheez-It is known for.

I like Cheez-Its. I mean, I reeeaaaaally like them, so I never buy them because I don't actually need to eat any Cheez-Its. Seriously. They are a snack food that does not repay the calorie cost with sufficient nutrition, so I probably only eat them twice a year.

But free Cheez-its, sent to me for review? This I had to try.

I like crackers and I chowed through a few of these in search of an answer to the only question that matters, which is, do these taste like mozzarella? Well, if mozzarella were dry, crispy, and charged with a faint chemical aftertaste, then I would say, sure. Kinda. I guess. But no, they do not taste like mozzarella in the way that regular Cheez-its taste like cheddar. I think this is because cheddar at its best is dry, sharp, and a little grainy. Mozzarella doesn't translate well into a cracker, as it's a melting cheese.

I received a cardboard box from Amazon that rattled. They sent the Cheez-ITs with no padding in the box! Upon opening the package, I saw crumbles with a few whole Cheez-ITs.

They taste like salt, fat, sugar and mild cheese flavoring. Mozzarella cheese doesn't have much flavor, so it is logical that the Cheez-ITS don't have much flavor. So, why did my husband and I eat the whole box? Because they're salty, crunchy and loaded with fat. They don't taste great but they taste good. However, I think the original Cheez-ITS are superior in taste. I'd buy them over the Mozzarella flavor any day.

First of all I have to say I have yet to meet a Cheez-It cracker I did not like.

The new Mozzarella Cheese flavor is no different. The Sunshine bakers manage to get

the flavor listed on the box into their crackers, and as usual they taste great.

These crackers serve me as double duty. First of all as a satisfying snack, and also

as a replacment when I am out of croutons for a salad. It does not matter what

flavor you use, the crackers are just the right size for salads. Or to float in a

bowl of tomato soup. The new mozzarella flavor crackers are perfect for this.

I received a box of these via the Amazon Vine Program.

I'll start by saying that I've always liked Cheez-It crackers, especially partial to the White Cheddar and to the Original.
This Mozzarella flavor was not so good and frankly the crackers seemed stale. They were not as crunchy as I expect Cheez-It crackers to be and there were a lot of broken bits - at least 1/4 of the total weight was broken bits and crumbs.

I certainly would not buy this flavor.

How can you say anything bad about something that tastes so good? I've always had a taste for the "classic" Cheez-ITs, but these are a nice switch. Salty, crispy, cheesy -- doesn't that define one of our basic food groups?

I have been eating Cheese Its for over 30 years and I usually stick to the original flavor kind.  I wasn't to keen on a mozzerella flavored chip but I figured someone in the house would eat them.  lol. I was surprised by the flavor of these.  I don't think it truely tastes like mozzerella cheese but I really like the taste of these.  I will be switching back and forth between these and the original flavor everyone has grown up on.  If you like Cheese Its....I suggest you try these because I was pleasantly surprised by the taste.  : )

The flavor of these mozzarella flavored Cheez-Its is more subtle than the regular Cheddar flavor. So if you're looking for a milder flavored cracker, these may be what you've been looking for. They still have the snap and crunch of the original, just a milder taste.

I have always enjoyed these mini bite sized snacks and along comes a new delicious Mozzarella cheese flavor. The box did not last long and was devoured quite quickly by (the four of us)we already buy one or two boxes a week of Four Cheese and Cheddar Jack and will add this flavor to my list.
A quick peek on their web-site reveals several other flavors not carried in our local supermarkets (too bad!)
I did take away one star because the snacks were quite broken up but that could have been due to the shipping, however this is a great tasting product, finger licking addictive snack that I will buy again!

In our household, we often purchase Cheez-It baked snack crackers and we often like to purchase various cheese flavors.

My son absolutely loves Cheez-It's and often, we purchase the White Cheddar or original versions, but we noticed there was a new Mozzarella "Creamy & Mild" version that is available and is made with 100% real cheese.

And for anyone who loves Mozzarella, the taste of these crackers are flavorful and as our 9-year-old would say "very yummy"!

For those who are wondering about the nutrition facts, for 25 crackers, it's about 150 calories, cholesterol is 0mg and 0% and total fat is 11% with saturated fat at 8%. Ingredients contains wheat, milk and soy.

Now, purchasing Cheez-It are typically affordable but surprisingly a four-pack of a 13.7 ounce goes for nearly $30 and for a single box, they cost nearly $12. For me, that is just insane...unless it's specially imported from Italy or if it was some huge family-sized package as big as family-sized cereal box, I can easily see how $12 is justified but for this small 13.7 ounce version to cost around $12 and a 4-pack for $30 just doesn't make sense (I am assuming that these third party sellers are factoring in huge shipping costs).

JUDGMENT CALL:

Sunshine's Cheez-It's are delicious and like other various flavors, next to our favorite of White Cheddar, Mozzarrella "Creamy & Mild" is going to be the version we will most likely purchase... but as long as you can purchase Cheez-It's for under $5, it's hard to justify these being sold for $12 or $30 for four 13.7 oz. boxes, these are costing more than Crunchmasters and other crackers that are sold at Trader Joes and even speciality crackers that I have purchased in Tokyo.

Overall, Sunshine's Mozzarella Cheez-It's are wonderful! Too bad I can't say so much about the price!

I had my doubts about a single serving cake bowl but this is the most ingenious dessert idea for people on the go. It is awsome because it is so easy to make. You just need a microwave. I bring them to work for a quick and hot sweet treat. But the greatest thing is that you don't have to worry about finishing off an entire pan of brownies. Just one satisfies my sweet tooth and I don't have all of the guilt from overeating. Unless of course you keep a cabinet full of these bowls...

I fell in love with these wonderful hot caramel-ly chocolate desserts the first time I ever made them. However, my local stores only carry this flavor in the mini size. Waaay too small to enjoy, so I was thrilled to find them on Amazon! They are yummy, yummy, yummy!!!

These are a nice treat, but are very sweet. One for just me is a lot to handle. By the end of it, I am sick with sweet.

That said, not bad for a microwave cake.

Both the cake and the caramel had a boxed, fake flavor.  We tried the lemon ones and thought they were awesome...this one not so much.  I think we still have one out in the garage a month later and I have several sugar-loving teenagers living here.  Unless you get this for $1 a piece like I did...I don't recommend.
I would not buy them again, but if you are desperate for a dessert and don't have anything else prepared, it would probably satisfy your cravings.  Don't plan to serve it to guests though.

The Pelindaba organic lavender Rooibos tea is a delicious caffein free tea. It is a natural source of health promoting minerals,  has a high level of antioxidants AND it is low in tannins. If you have not tried Rooibos (South African "red bush") I suggest you try this tea. The hint of lavender infusion is delightful. You can also make a wash of the tea for acne problems.

The pet food industry can be one of the most infuriating as you start doing research and discovering what trash manufacturers (and the vets who get paid off by the manufacturers) push onto the unsuspecting public. For reference, don't ask your vet - do some Internet research at sites like, for example, [...]. What you'll find is that even the supposed "high-end" lines from basically every major supermarket label are horrible for your fuzzy friends. People who trust the marketing or trust their vets overpay and feed their cats foods that are full of carcinogens, cheap ingredients that are inappropriate for a cat's digestive system, and byproducts that provide nothing of value and are basically a way to make cheap profit off of literal garbage. It's a tragedy, as these same cats end up with shorter lifespans, kidney problems, UTIs, cancer, and a host of other issues, all of which could have been avoided by a high quality food.

This is an A-Grade food. What you'll find here is very high protein content, many meats high on the list, flaxseed, good vitamins and antioxidants, and no grains, which is great as a cat is not an omnivore, it's a carnivore, and it simply does not need grains.

What you will NOT find here is the kind of junk you'll see in things like Purina One and Science Diet - byproducts (aka beaks, feathers, bird feet), brewers rice (aka the waste product from making beer), wheat flour (a leading cause of pet allergies), corn gluten (a cheap waste of space), and things like "liver flavor" (because they don't want to pay for the real thing). I didn't just pull those ingredients out of the air - I was reading the ingredients list of Purina One. It's pathetic.

Don't feed your cats trash. Pay a little more to feed them good food now, and they'll lead longer, healthier, more satisfied lives as a result. It's worth it.

My nine cats love Wellness Turkey and Salmon canned cat food. It is so moist and I feel like I am giving them something that is good for them. (one has had a UTI problem). I feel that the natural ingredients in it will be good for all of them and hopefully avoid any more UTI attacks. They love the taste. I haven't been using it that long, but I would recommend it to other cat owners.

I switched to this cat food after our eldest cat was diagnosed with diabetes and required a change in diet to maintain his health. We got a serious crash course in cat nutrition and realized that cats should be fed this stuff all the time, not just when they're sick.

This product is very low carbohydrate and high animal protein; perfect for a cat's required nutrient needs. I enjoy buying the Wellness brand as they hold high standards for what they put in their products and I feel comfortable supporting their company with my purchase.

This can will last three days in a house with three cats. We feed this as a snack, more than a meal, but everyone seems satisfied with their share. All the cats are also fed dry food during the day, so if you only feed wet food this will not last you as long.

My two kitties love this stuff and buying it by the case makes the cost reasonable to feed high quality food.

My older girl sometimes needs it heated in the microwave or some extra water added so that she can eat it. I also sometimes add a few pieces of kibble to the mix to give her more traction to lick it up. This would happen with any wet food.

I gave 4 stars because my latest purchase had many dented cans. I hope this isn't a trend on amazon's part, but I thought it warranted noting.

First, let me say that I watched my previous two cats die early on a diet of dry cat food - one from diabetes, one from kidney failure. I decided to do a lot of research I came to the conclusion that dry cat food keeps a cat in a constant state of dehydration. I own a pet sitting business and have displeased many cat owners with this information - feed only dry food and you can't get them enough water to prevent UTI, kidney/liver damage, diabetes and pre-mature death.

I have raised my next cats on a diet of Wellness grain-free canned and the results have been amazing in all areas - their coat, their weight, their energy and their overall health. There is one caveat: A diet of the best wet cat food doesn't do much to keep their teeth clean. I recommend a tablespoon of a dry dental food each day to combat tartar.

We bought this because we have two cats and were trying to save some money.  Problem is, this is not the same as the 5.5 oz cans - this stuff is much more wet.  The cats didn't like it.  It is almost soupy.  We tried four of the cans and they were all the same.  We ended up taking it back to a Petco store and there was no problem with the return.  Otherwise we love the Wellness cat food OUR cats just don't like the consistency of the large cans.
The best cat food out there for your cat. A little more expensive than most, but the best. Cats seem to enjoy this food.
My cat loves other flavors, but not this one. I don't know why.  My daughter says her cats won't eat this flavor either.

Prior purchases were darker and had a lot more flavor.  My two Shih Tzu's just chewed on them for hours.  This purchase was bland and had no flavor.  Appears manufacturer was saving money by providing less color and flavor.  The final test was when the dogs looked, smelled and walked away.  Opened several more but the test was the same.

We have tried several different "chewables" for our dog, and we have found that she either eats them too quickly, or loses interest (as another reviewer mentioned). We tried her ont he Purina Chewnola, but she just started chewing off the granola layer and then hiding the rawhide part under furniture!

With the heartyhides, she has YET to not finish one in a sitting, and will happily trot off with one in her mouth to work on for 10 minutes or so. Such a great treat to keep her busy, and it's basted in chicken flavor so that tail keeps wagging!

Definitely recommended!

I bought these for the kids to eat whilst on their summer vacation.  They are ideal for putting in lunch boxes and taking along as snacks.  Ideal for playdates too as the chocolate in the chips isn't messy.

Our entire family enjoy the gripz chips deluxe.  It is a good size snack bag that can easily be split between two toddlers.  They have a nice crunchy texture and right amount of sweetness without being too hard or too sugary tasting.  Even in warm weather we haven't had these get messy.  These should still be considered a treat, the packets are .9 ounces (25g), 120 calories and 5g fat.
I really love Daifuku, but I didn't know where I could get it nearby, so I ordered it online. The service is really efficient, and I got my order within a few days.

I wasn't sure what to expect.  They're a little like gummy cakes.  The flavor is very good.  They make a good addition to an a meal as a dessert especially when you want something on the lighter side.  They're not too sweet either.
I bought these and they were not the smarties brand, they actually do not say smarties anywhere on the box or the wrappers. Do not buy they are gross and not the real product they describe.

Dingo EZ Mini Bones are easy on my 12 year old Maltese's mouth and teeth.  He begs for one every night at 8:30-9:00 and eats the whole thing.  With regular Dingo mini bones he leaves half of the bone and they take a day or two and sometimes cause his mouth to bleed.  Max does not beg for them.  We used to buy these at Walmart but they no longer carry them and we could not find them locally so Amazon is the way to go for these.
Pops nice but can never get it to taste like movie theater popcorn. Doesn't even come close. Gave it a 2 star for popping not taste.
We've been using this in the popper at the office and I liked it enough to buy a jug for home too.

The school where I work has a "popcorn day" one Friday per month. The popcorn is popped in a theater-type popper. They use the Act II Buttery flavored oil and the Act II butter flavored salt. I don't know how others who gave such poor reviews are popping their corn, but our popcorn is fabulous! It is a huge hit at school, both with the kids and the adult staff. We have families who buy enough for every member of the family for a movie and popcorn night. Maybe others are not measuring it correctly, or are not using the right popper. I don't know. All I can say is I love this stuff!! I smell it being popped all day and can't wait to eat it!! It takes all my willpower to keep from eating a bag of it for lunch!

If you use the Act II salt with the oil, be careful not to use too much of the salt. It seems to be concentrated. It doesn't take as much as you might think.

If I could have these people send me their supply that they obviously don't know how to use, I'd be in heaven!

I'm buying myself a theater-style popper for Christmas, just so I can have this popcorn more often than once a month!
This product has absolutely no taste whatsoever.  Makes the popcorn greasy and that's about it. Would rate it zero stars if I could.
The word "buttery" on the label is as close as this gets to flavoring popcorn. It is orange and gelatinous when cold. It heats up well and pops the corn nicely, but adds no discernable flavor.
Great popping oil.  The best.  I've used this for a years.  No other popcorn oil beats this. I would highly recommend.

I am not a tea connoisseur. I just started drinking herbal

teas about a month ago. However, since then I have tried many and this is one of my favorite. At first I did not like the medicinal smell. But, the tea taste great. It is a spicy cinnamon licorice flavor, more than sarsaparilla. If you don't like anise(black licorice)taste, do not buy this tea. Instead try the Yogi tea Cocoa Spice. It is sweet and delicious. It's my favorite. The reason I drink Detox is because it does seem to have some detoxing benefits. Also, I feel extremely relaxed after drinking this tea. It really calms me, without making me tired. I am not sure what herb is doing this...but it is almost as good as a glass of wine! So far, I like Yogi tea better than any I have tried. It is worth the extra cost for a great tea.

The taste of this tea will take some getting used to - it's a bit peppery and warm, and you can taste a tiny bit of licorice in it. Sounds disgusting, I know, but it isn't bad - just...odd. I've heard that it helps with recovery from colds and mild illnesses, though I haven't tried it for that purpose myself. As for the "detox" effects, they're extremely mild and you likely won't notice any physical difference (except for increased energy, perhaps).
I put these in the freezer and they taste just like the girls scoots  thin mints. Their cheap and you can by they all year round.

Although Sugar Floss is not recommended for use in the Nostalgia Electrics Hard Candy/Sugar free Cotton Candy machine, we didn't find out until both were already purchased. We tried using it anyway, and if you let the machine heat up well before using it, it will make delicious amusement park style cotton candy. We used one teaspoon at a time, so the sugar will last us years, but it is yummy!
THE KIDS LUV IT!!! THE KIDS MAKE COTTON CANDY WHEN THERE FRIENDS COME OVER AND ITS FAST AND EZ GREAT BUY!!!
Dark chocolate and pomegranate seeds. Exactly what I was looking for. I heard both are good for you so together makes a perfect snack. Very good.

This is the best cat food that I've found. It's made of whole chunks (not that yucky pate style), so that you actually can SEE what's in it! Our cat LOVES it. It has pretty much what it says in the title - there is no 'hidden' beef in every can, unless it says so on the front (we don't feed beef, only seafood or poultry, which are more natural to animals this size, and in protest to the treatment of cows). There is also a full list of vitamins and minerals (meets the AAFCO requirements). Overall, THIS IS IT! :)

I opened a can of this for my cats dinner and was totally disgusted.  I expected big chunks of sardines with shrimp and crab like the label says.  What I got was some sardines in a thick jelly with one shrimp.  I did not see any crab meat at all.  One cat ate most of it and one would have very little to do with it.  Not worth keeping at all.  This will go in the trash.
This cat food was not appealing in texture or smell to my cats.Ended up giving it to our outdoor cats! would not recommend

I have 3 indoor cats and 2 of them liked it, the other one wouldn't even taste it. The 2 outdoor cats eat anything I feed them. Of course it's mostly sardine but you can see the crab meat and bits of shrimp. This flavor does have a strong scent, likely the reason the one cat wouldn't try it. Still you are getting a lot of meat as the filler is only a small amount of a gelatin substance to hold it all together. All of my cats like the other flavors of this brand so I may stick w/ the flavors that do not contain sardines. I still think this brand is a great value compared w/ the ingredients in other canned cat food.

In principle I like lard. It's rich in mono-unsaturated fat, and the dangers of saturated fat have been greatly overstated and over-hyped -- it may not in fact be harmful at all. This comes in a neat, tidy package and doesn't need refrigeration, but the problem is that it's been hydrogenated in order to have a nice, firm, even consistency, and hydrogenation can't help but add some trans-fats -- something nobody should be eating at all (barring a few found naturally in fat from ruminant animals, which are very different in structure from those found in hydrogenated fats, and seem to be beneficial to eat).

I suspect that the levels of trans-fats here aren't way high -- the hydrogenation is probably just enough to make a firm, consistent product -- but I'd rather avoid them entirely.

I ordered this candy for my grandson, we were unable to find it in any store, he swears that this is the best candy ever made.

I really wanted to love Illy Issimo caffe expresso style drink. However, I simply did not. The expresso used in the product is strong, but still does not have the richness of an expresso received fresh at a cafe. The smell of the expresso is overwhelming. I also did not like the taste of this expresso.

I guess it is a good product if you want expresso, but cannot leave your home or office. It is only 50 calories per cup, so it is excellent for dieters. Hoever, I will not drink this product ever again.

I have tried different illy brand products and have always enjoyed their products. The new illy brand "issimo" line which translates loosely to "extremely" or "remarkably" pretty much lives up to it's moniker. At 6.8 oz. and only 45 calories, it is a nice pick me up in the AM. I only enjoy cold coffee products in the summertime when it's hot so I wouldn't be a year round drinker of issimo but I liked the flavor and especially the sweetness of the product. It isn't at all sweet, thick and doesn't have an overly "canned" quality to it which I found nice. I still preferred the cann cappucinno over the caffe, however.  Issimo is a light product that doesn't leave you feeling bloated or heavy. At just under $2.00 a can, it's not the cheapest coffee beverage out there but it's certainly more cost effective than your local, upscale coffee shop.

Although it has a bit of added sugar, this canned espresso is quite bitter. I tried it over ice and it definitely gave me that espresso jolt. Not as good as a fresh-brewed iced espresso -- even one from Starbucks -- but a decent substitute if you're in a hurry and need that coffee hit.

I love my coffee--in any way shape or form. I especially love to add espresso shots to a regular cup of coffee. But one thing I've never done is have espresso over ice.

This product had sugar added (beet sugar) so it is NOT made for purists and a web search did not give me the info I wanted as to how much caffeine this product has.

What it does have is an excellent flavor that was unexpected from a canned product and a convenience that I find gratifying.

Take the warning on the back of the can seriously--do NOT shake this product before using, it actually isn't necessary (I shook it a little to see why there was a warning and it frothed all over the place when I opened it).
- if you don't have issues other than not wanting milk in your iced espresso have no fear, if there was milk in it I couldn't tell.

Delicious, flavorful, not overly bitter -just enough to give a kick, convenient.

I will definitely buy more of this product! At a 1.92 per nearly a 7oz can - and with a 20% off coupon when you buy from Amazon, this is a pretty good deal for the convenience of it all!

This coffee was delicious! When I got it out of the fridge I had the urge to shake it as with other canned coffees, but this one says to not shake it so I just popped it open and took a delicious sip. The can is the perfect size and was very portable. The coffee had a sharp taste to it that really gave me a jolt of energy. I will be stocking these in my fridge from now on. Well worth the cost for the convenience and taste.

The illy issimo Coffee Drink is simple and delicious.  The taste is bold and flavorful, although perhaps not as strong as Starbucks.  Note that the Caffè drink comes in sugar-free (unsweetened) for those on low-carb diets, but the "Beet" sweetener in here is medium, not too sugary, and does not overpower the drink.

As a devout drinker of good, fresh roasted/ground/drip brewed, strong coffee, I approached this can of ILLYissimo espresso with much skepticism and profoundly low expectations. The experience of drinking it caught me by complete surprise as it is entirely acceptable as a cold/cool glass of coffee on the run!

Described by another reviewer as "muddy water in a can", I can only infer that strong coffee is not to that person's liking. This IS a strong formulation and does not suffer from the burnt taste or bitter aftertaste that many other canned coffee beverages have. It is sweetened, but mildly so and used beet sugar to do this. Too many other canned coffee beverages are overly sweetened thereby destroying any vestige of honest coffee flavor.

Made in Denmark and distributed by Coca-Cola, it is a pleasure to find an alternative to either sickeningly sweet or simply bad coffee in cans or bottles.

Rich, satisfying and easily portable, I plan to have a pack of these in my desk drawer (or in the refrigerator) at work for those days when brewing hot coffee isn't right - but a smooth and satisfying 6.8 ounces of the 'real thing' chilled would really hit the spot.

It's not bad.  I had this on my way into work.  Great way to get some caffiene in ya before work!  It only has 4 ingredients: Coffee, sugar, and the other two I assume are preservatives or something.  It tasted almost creamy, although there is no cream in it!  It was sweeter - more sweet than anything else.  The coffee flavor is on the watery side.  It tasted like one of those cold Starbucks drinks you can buy, only not as creamy.  I thought it was good enough - but I'd never buy them.  My preference for a cold coffee-style drink is those excellent Starbucks bottle things!!!

I'm a big coffee drinker, and I loved illy issimo Cappuccino.  However, I did not enjoy this coffee drink.  It taste bitter, and is not refreshing.  I prefer Starbucks coffee cans better.  This one did not do it for me.  I still rate the cappuccino version highly.

I don't mind straight coffee on occasion but this tasted like a strong americano to me but a little more bitter. I wasn't a fan. I prefer my coffee to have some sweetness and cream. I also think the price is on the high side. You can get the large starbucks cans on sale for 1.50 a can at your local grocery store.

This drink barely passes for a coffee drink. It is very light in flavor with minimal coffee essence, despite the first ingredient being coffee. It has very little flavor and still less of what I would call espresso. It also has a somewhat odd after taste, sort of bitter and seltzer-like. It left me more thirsty than when I finished it.

Overall not very good.

Let's face it, espresso is not for the casual coffee drinker.  It's highly concentrated, and generally tastes terribly bitter.  But I thought I'd give this illy drink a whirl anyway. It does seem a bit tame for espresso -- which is a good thing if you're not an aficionado; but for those who love espresso, this will likely be too dilute. I think illy's canned cappuccino drink tastes much better.  But I guess if you're a serious coffee drinker, having an espresso on the go like this would be a good thing.  I think the price is relatively fair considering the cost of packaging, manufacturing, distribution, et al, but at the end of the day, I still think it's far too steep a price for canned coffee.  Overall, it's just ok.

While the Illy ssimo Coffee drink does taste like espresso, it feels blurred by an aftertaste, perhaps from the beet sugar, its minimal other ingredients, or just the long time it spends in a can on its way from Denmark.  I'm glad I tried it and it at least tastes like a coffee product compared to their cappuccino in a can, it won't replace iced coffee for me, when I want coffee on a hot day.

I can understand a latte in a can or even a flavored coffee drink in a can but just coffee and sweetner in can? There just does not seem to be a good reason for this product. It's not hard to make coffee and if you like it sweetened (which I don't), then there is sugar or sweetner.

People might say it's for "on the go" or travel but see above for the first, and if I were camping I would used instant or concentrated coffee. I just don't get the purpose of this?

As for taste, just okay and of course I hate that it is sweetened.

But my daughter is and she said 'well it's not great, but it's coffee in a can so what can you expect'.  I took a sip and it's really a meh! product...not as bad as it could be but also not as good as it could be either.

okay here is my disclaimer -

I like my coffee sweet and with cream --

my first taste yuck!
but I said I would review this so took a second sip

Bitter taste
slight powdery feel
light carbination

A strong coffee aroma

I was hoping for something better

What can you expect from coffee in a can? I certainly did not have very high expectations. However, when I first tasted this illy coffee, I was surprised by its strong coffee flavor. I do like my coffee strong. Unlike some other reviewers, I did not find the taste bitter. Generally, I do not put sugar in my coffee, or anything else for that matter. So I did notice the sugary taste.

After trying the illy at room temperature, I decided that it would be fair to compare it with my usual hot coffee, so I poured the remaining liquid into a coffee cup and plopped it into the microwave. When heated, it was better than at room temperature. Good coffee taste, but still too sweet.

This coffee drink has 10 grams of sugar per can. That is almost as much sugar as there is in a tablespoon of granulated sugar, which comes in at 13 grams. I would never put that much sugar in a single cup of coffee. Some people may like it though.

I got one can of Illy issimo coffee drink free from the Amazon Vine program, in exchange for writing a review about it.

I like strong, dark coffee, but avoid most canned coffee beverages because of the sugar and carbs. We drink French roast coffee at home, brewed very strong, so most coffees at restaurants and in cans taste weak to me.

This little can of espresso was a pleasant surprise - it only contains 50 calories and 12 carbs. It had a strong coffee flavor but I didn't detect any bitterness or aftertaste like some reviewers reported. It also had a nice little caffeine kick, probably because the coffee is strong.

Of all the canned coffee beverages I've tried, this one is my favorite.

Not exactly the highest possible praise, but as something of a coffee snob, I was surprised to find this so palatable. And really, if you need a caffeine hit, isn't it better to down something that didn't have to be formulated inside of a lab? Five Hour Energy Drinks, I'm talking to *you*.

What's in the can? Coffee, beet sugar, potassium carbonate and potassium citrate. Those last two you can buy in the vitamin/supplement aisle of your drugstore, and they do have natural antacid properties - I don't think they are used here as preservatives, but rather to tone down coffee's natural acidity. I get good balance in the flavor of the coffee, so it's easy to enjoy without the addition of milk - great for me as a lactose-intolerant coffee drinker. If you happen to already cold-brew in the fridge at home for lower acid, you'll appreciate the difference. On the other hand, if you're a huge fan of bright, acid-y Central American coffees as opposed to the deeper Sumatrans and Suwalesis, then for you this might be a deficit.

I'd keep this around in warm weather to offer iced to guests. It's true that you can probably brew a better cup, if you start with good beans, but I think the convenience here is worth the price, particularly if you don't normally brew much coffee. Roasted beans kept in storage go stale - FAST.

For decades, Illy has enjoyed a reputation for reliable, if not exceptional quality, and I'd sooner have one of these than a Starbucks canned or a McCafe any day. (Even if they did partner with Coca Cola for this latest Issimo line, says the coffee snob.)

Illy Caffe is a lot like the premade iced tea, it's okay but not special.
The taste is fine, it's coffee and sugar, pour it over ice and you have iced coffee. I get coffee drinks, the cappuccino by Illy is really good, or the starbucks, but this is very plain and at roughly two dollars a can it's not any cheaper than a small coffee out somewhere. The can is small, the calorie count is 50, the taste really standard. Anyone with some instant coffee, sugar, and ice could make this easily. I don't even see it as being a matter of giving up taste for convenience, as it's not a "fancy" drink.

I don't pretend to have the most discerning palate in the world when it comes to coffee. I might even have to admit that I don't know what's good. I do, however, know what's bad. And this is bad. The flavor is way too strong and overpowering, is very bitter has a strong stale quality to it, and doesn't really have any kind of dynamism or complexity. It's kind of like the dregs of a pot of Folger's that's been sitting out all day, and I'm not saying that because I drank it cold.

I quite liked the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), I wouldn't mind recommending it. But this was awful. Oh well. Nothing ventured, nothing gained, right?

Very deep and tasty Caffe drink. It's got just a hint of sweetness and a hint of chocolate taste. Not too much fat and less sugar than most drinks of this type. Even my husband who doesn't like coffee likes it. It reminds me of a Starbucks double shot, but less sweet and it has less cream. I'd definitely buy these and try them again.

This drink is really good. It contains no cream. Just coffee and a touch of sugar. It isn't overly sweetened at all. It is perfect. The coffee flavor is bold with a slight acidity. At only 50 calories, this coffee drink could easily be a daily habit.

I only gave it 4 out of 5 stars because it seemed weird to me drinking coffee from a can. I'm not so much a can person. And these cans are pretty small.

As I sit here and taste this for the first time I wonder what it is that I like so much and what it is that makes me not like it. The coffee flavor is really there, so it can hold up to the ice you will no doubt use to make this truly iced coffee.
It is a bit bitter, it needs to be smoothed with some milk or non dairy milk product to give it the nice smooth flavor of iced coffee. The sugar content is fairly low for this kind of product so is the calorie count, 50 cals. per 6.8 fluid ounces. The only thing "for me" is the caffeine is a little high, and is openly stated on the back label, to be: 155 mg/per 6.8 fl. oz.
I do like this product as long as I can add some "milk" to smooth it out a little.
As far as I can see, this is a pure product and is made well.
I would drink this again.

I enjoy my coffee but I normally add only a touch of sugar, if any at all to my coffee. When I do add sugar, I would put no more than a 1/2 teaspoon of sugar in my cup of coffee. I also will generally choose a dark roast coffee, like French Roast or Sumatra.

This illy Caffe coffee drink is an Italian Roast coffee. It has a decent taste in my opinion. I was expecting some sort of "canned" taste but didn't sense that at all while I was drinking it. But I did experience an aftertaste that I can only describe as somewhat metallic.

I usually drink the dark roast coffees but was surprised to find that this had a really nicely balanced coffee taste without the pronounced bitterness usually associated with the bigger, bolder dark roasts to which I'm accustomed.

It was the added sugar that I don't really care for. The serving size is 6.8 fluid ounces and that contains 10g of sugar. A teaspoon of sugar is approximately 4 g which means this 6.8 oz can of coffee has the equivalent of 2.5 teaspoons of sugar. Even if I did put sugar in a cup of coffee, I'd only put in a single teaspoon. So for me it was way too sweet. Knowing that many people do sweeten their coffee, I'd say that many people would not find this as overly sweet as I did. You'd probably like it if you sweeten your coffee.

I find it convenient to be able to have with you on trips or travels, a good quality cup of coffee. This tastes much better to me than your typical gas station swill that is passed on as coffee. So for trips or commutes it would be a great choice. Just be careful if you are diabetic or have sugar restrictions because there is quite a bit of sugar in a serving. Other than that it tastes pretty good to me.

Through the years, I've tried just about every pre-made coffee beverage imaginable. I am a coffee lover and enthusiast, so I'm married to the idea of buying a can or bottle of a delicious coffee based product that I'll live happily ever after with. My experiences, however, have yet to yield bliss. Some are just fine, but nothing has ever made me say "Wow! I'd like to drink this all the time!" I had heard some positive things about the illy issimo brand, so given the opportunity--I sampled both their Caffe and their Cappuccino.

Caffe (2 1/2 stars) is, in their own words, an Italian Espresso Style Coffee Drink. At first, I thought this drink had a strong and pronounced coffee flavor. But something is slightly off. The more I drank, it seemed too sweet and too bitter at once, which is a strange and not altogether pleasant combination. As it is essentially comparable to drinking an iced espresso, it may not be as palatable as some of their other creations. But, it's not really something that I would sample again. And at an approximate cost of $2.00 per can (only 6.8 ounce), this serves more as a caffeine boost than a refreshing beverage. Made with real Arabica coffee, I was also intrigued by the "Do Not Shake" warning which left me with the unappetizing visual of the particulate matter that must still be in the liquid drink (fine for Turkish coffee, not so appealing for something in a can).

Cappucino (3 1/2 stars) is, in their own words, an Espresso Style Coffee Drink with Lowfat Milk and Cocoa. So, at 8.45 ounces this is a slightly bigger drink. As some of the harshness is buffered by the milk and cocoa combination, this one easily had a more pleasant taste. Still, a bit sweet for my liking but better overall. I'm still not blown away and I won't be a regular purchaser of this, or any illi issimo brand drinks, but I didn't dislike this one. Nice enough once in a while, but not inspiring enough to purchase a case. I guess I'll remain a fresh made kind of coffee drinker! KGHarris, 6/12.

The Illy Issimo Caffe drink is dark, rich and smooth.  If you love your coffee beans dark, or drink your coffee black you will adore this drink. A wonderful cold 6.8 oz Caffe Italian espresso drink that is made from All natural with 100% percent Arabica coffee and sweetened with beet sugar. This is an acquired taste, and only for those who enjoy the darker, richer side of coffee.

My impression of this coffee is it is probably of very high quality and also very strong.  I was surprised to see sugar had been added to the product and that the can contained 50 calories as I had assumed it was almost pure coffee.  I had to add a bit of skimmed milk with the ice cubes to make an enjoyable iced coffee for my taste buds.

Seriously, there's a 'do not shake' warning on the can and it's there for good reason - the contents are under pressure so... you shake it at your own risk.

As a coffee drinker, I can't say that I'm impressed by this canned Espresso to the point that I'd stop making my own but I suppose that's not the point of the 'illy'. No canned coffee can challenge the flavor and aroma of a freshly brewed cup but when that is not possible, here comes the 'illy' and... it's passable.

If comparing canned coffees to canned coffees, the 'illy' espresso is okay as in 'decent' and probably preferable to most other canned brands but to call it 'espresso' is a bit of a stretch. It's got 'sugar' for starters, 50 calories worth of it and I don't know too many espresso drinkers that would tolerate sugar in their espresso drink. And it's not espresso-strong. It's a little stronger than the normally bland canned coffee but maybe only half-way between regular coffee and espresso. As for the taste, this is supposed to be made of 'Arabica' and maybe it is but it tastes more like instant coffee to me. Maybe Arabica-based, cold instant coffee.

So... if stranded on an island or anywhere a decent cup of real coffee is not an option or you aren't in the mood or don't have the time to make your own, the 'illy espresso' is an option and at least as good, possibly better than alternative canned or bottled coffees. In other words, "It's Okay" (3 stars) if used as directed and your expectations are reasonably low.

________________________________

Note: Should this be chilled before use? Ice espresso is an abomination but, again, just because it says 'espresso' on the can it doesn't necessarily make it so.

Length:: 1:50 Mins

I thought that a video review of this beverage might but fun. I liked the drink but it really didn't have that strong, rich, coffee flavor that I was looking for. The ingredients were pretty simple: coffee; sugar; potassium bicarbonate; and potassium citrate. I am not sure if I would buy this on my own but it is something different and I liked the taste.

I've tried Illy cappuccino and it was tasty, creamy and a bit sweet. Having Illy espresso in the fridge to try I was ready for refreshment and some kick in taste and energy. This coffee drink went down the drain after 2-3 sips. I love lattes and I could drink hot fresh espresso, but this was just unbearable. VERY bitter, despite of having sugar it (and I don't sweeten tea and coffe). Also there is 50 calories in the can, not 45 (small difference), but fot many that count calories might matter.

Anyway I wouldn't recommend Issimo espresso, unless you love very very bitter coffee.

After having and loving the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappucino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), I expected to like this. However, it tastes like mediocre, slightly bitter espresso that was watered down and poured into a can. It says it was sweetened with beet sugar, but I didn't taste any sweetness to it, nor did my husband. I couldn't even finish one can, and then I offered it to my husband; he couldn't finish it either.

We love fresh brewed coffee, and we've become coffee snobs recently, not caring for Starbucks and other chain coffees like we used to. I expected this brand to measure up to those expectations, especially after the cappuccino did, but it fell miserably short.

Illy issimo caffè Italian espresso style coffee drink is a 6.8 fl. oz. (200 ml) blast of sweetened caffeine in a can.

1930s Italy under the rule of Mussolini greatly contributed to the development of modern coffee culture, improved coffee-making, and new types of coffee-making equipment. The Horn of Africa (where coffee originated) was under Italian colonization and companies such as illy and Bialetti were founded.

In that tradition, this drink is now made in Denmark under the issimo brand from illy and distributed in the U.S. by Coca-Cola.

This canned cappuccino has a slightly bitter dark roast coffee taste with the right amount of sugar and a pleasant mouthfeel. It's not as good as freshly made espresso but it's not bad at all. I do prefer the illy issimo cappucino as a treat.

I tried both the illy issimo Caffe drink and the cappucino drink. I loved the cappucino and would gladly buy it any day. However, I was very disappointed in the caffe drink. I found it too strong, with a bitter edge. The level of sweetness seemed just right, but it couldn't cut the bitterness. The ingredients are simple, containing coffee and sugar, along with ingredients that I think are supposed to take the bitterness off - potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate - but they don't seem to work well enough.

I tasted it three times (yes, Mom!) but poured the rest down the drain. I would not reach for this again, but I love their cappucino and I would gladly try other products by illy.

This little can packs a lot of flavor; it is strong and just enough taste of bitterness in it. You can smell a bit of aroma even if it is cold. You can enjoy it direct from the can or chill it with ice. It has 155 grams of caffein and gives me a shorst burst of energy when I need it. Product of Denmark.

Only 10 grams of sugar. But then again, it is just an itsy bitsy can.

I had heard of this brand of coffees, but had never tried one, until now. I did not know what to expect, but I think I thought it would be like one of those iced coffee drinks.

It's not, at least not to me. First of all, on the can it says not to shake it. Iam not sure why. I had put the can in my refrigerator to chill it for several hours.

Each can is 6.8 fl ounces, which is one serving, has 50 calories, total carbs-12 grams, sugars-10 grams, and 155 milligrams of caffeine. On the caffeine scale I have no idea how high that caffeine level is on a scale from low to high, but by my taste buds I would say it ranges on the higher side due to the STRONG coffee taste that this has, at least to me.

I did not find this Caffe Italian Expresso Style Coffee Drink to be sweet at all. All I tasted was a STRONG coffee flavor, no other flavor was pronounced.

That may be because it's an expresso type drink. Expresso is always a stronger coffee.

I do know this, and that is I couldn't drink more than a few sips of this drink out of the can, just the way it is.

It's just way too strong for me, but I think if I put it into a taller glass, add some ice and some flavored liquid creamer, it would taste much better to me.

For those of you who love STRONG coffee beverages, you may just love this one!

To me it packs a real coffee punch for a can of this size!

I usually have very low expectations for these kind of canned coffee, but this one was better than I thought. It has a sweet coffee taste, reminding of real espresso. However, it felt more like americano than espresso (meaning it is more diluted with water than necessary). It still packs enough caffeine, and if you do not want to go the "5 hour energy" route in urgent needs (like driving early in the morning), it would be a good alternative.

I would recommend it cold, so keeping in the car might not be an option. Nevertheless, it's good enough for the product category (canned coffee).

My wife ran across this specific brand in Japan last year and said it was every bit as good as the canned Starbucks Espresso competitor and a lot cheaper (check prices). I refrigerated my sample and split it with my wife, and as daily AM quadruple espresso drinkers, this hit the spot. She usually has her espresso with sweetener, and I like mine bitter and black. We found this to be a pleasant in-between sweetness that we both liked. Neither of us added anything. Cold, unshaken, right out of the can.

My rule when I get free stuff to review: Would I buy this with my own money? My answer: yes. We're going on an upcoming vacation in the wilds of Northern Wisconsin and I'm getting a case of this, as well as a case of illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino which I've also reviewed. This product and the Illy cappuccino are spot on for a couple of espresso caffeine addicts.

I like to have a few cold canned coffee beverages on hand, as I prefer them to most energy drinks. Unfortunately finding one that isn't filled with sweeteners has become very difficult. Living in the Seattle area I was already familiar with illy for their coffee beans that are used in some of my favorite coffee houses. So being given the chance to try some of their canned coffee beverages was something I was looking forward to.

After spending the night in the fridge, I opened the illy issimo Caffè without shaking it as noted on the can and poured it into a glass. (*See customer images) The color was very nice, it looked like a strong cup of coffee. The smell was good too and although I knew it was sweetened it wasn't coming across too much. The coffee was strong, very smooth and thankfully not too sweet. I was able to enjoy the entire can in one sitting.

Overall illy issimo has a great product and for once I've found one that isn't too sweet for me to enjoy. Plus now that I have been introduced to their canned coffee line I am looking forward to trying this one next: illy issimo Caffè (No Sugar)

I have tried a variety of chilled coffee/espresso drinks, and while I like them individually, I have yet to find any drink that I would go out of my way to try repeatedly. Maybe this didn't amaze me, but I liked that it was an adult coffee drink.

I drink black coffee with no sugar - and I drink a lot of it. The good thing about this brand is, like another reviewer said, the coffee is the star. I tried it right after a cup of my normal hot coffee, and it did not pale in comparison.

I drank the Caffe chilled and it was not bitter or over-sweet like so many of these drinks. I normally drink high-end coffee, and this tasted pretty legit in comparison. So I think quality ingredients were used.

It's a little stronger than my normal coffee - which it should be, since it's an espresso drink.

Another review thought the sugar overwhelmed the flavor. It's funny - I didn't get that at all. It IS a little sweet (and sugar is the second listed ingredient), but it wasn't something I noticed that much.

Bottom line - good ingredients + adult taste = solid quality.

If you're a black/hot coffee fan like me this probably won't change your habits, but for a hot day this might be a good switch.
