If you generally prefer black coffee (as I do), you will probably find that the sugar (10g) overwhelms the rich espresso coffee flavor of this ILLY ISSIMO "Caffè" drink. That's too bad, because the coffee itself tastes delicious. Apparently this canned espresso drink is designed to deliver a quick caffeine/sugar "pick me up" jolt.

I think that the product is intended to be consumed straight from the can, at room temperature. The can includes a "do not shake" warning, but has no instructions for chilling or warming the contents. Because I don't care for iced coffee, I tried the product only (1) at room temperature straight from the aluminum can, and (2) after warming in a microwave-safe cup. It tasted about the same both ways.

This "Italian espresso-style coffee drink" certainly did not convert me to canned coffee drinks, especially ones with 50 calories in each 6.8 fl. oz. can. I drink a lot of coffee, and prefer to brew it myself from freshly ground whole coffee beans. However, because ILLY ISSIMO "Caffè" tastes like it's made with high-quality coffee, I award it 3.5 stars, rounded up to 4 stars.

I love coffee, and this drink didn't disappoint. Just pour over ice for a nice, refreshing Americano-style coffee drink.

This is not an unsweetened drink; one can contains the equivalent of about 2 1/2 tsp. sugar, which is not too excessive in this day and age of sugar addiction.

Recommended for a quick, refreshing coffee pick-up. Would be 5 stars if they'd used Splenda or Stevia instead of sugar.

I use decaf illy coffee for my morning cup of coffee and love it. It costs a little more, but is very worth it. As far as the espresso drink...not for me. I tend to like lattes or cappuccinos--something with more milk/cream. This was too strong for me. My son tried it however, and loved it. If you like espresso in general, then I think you will love this product.

I like strong coffee - have a Keurig for my daily brews, and stop by Starbucks every couple of days. So I thought I'd give this a try - I'm tired of the generic energy drink taste. This tastes like a medium roast Espresso, with the same after-taste. It has only 50 calories, although I'd prefer no calories. I did not pour over ice - drank from the can right out of the fridge. That's plenty cold, easier to carry, and I can keep a can in my pack when on the road. You can also keep the can in the freezer for about a couple of hour before sticking in a backpack, so it will be ice cold several hours later.

At 6.8 oz, the can is thicker than a Red Bull can (8.4 oz), and a tad bit shorter. Definitely worth a try!

Wow, a little 50 calorie can of espresso and sugar. Serve cold and this is a delicious little shot of espresso. It does have sugar in it, but it is not overly sweet and the sugar helps offset the taste of the espresso. This Caffe is not too bitter or too sweet. It tastes good and really gave my afternoon a kick in the pants.

If you really liked coffee or want an alternative for a hot day, this is it. Refrigerate it and/or pour over ice and it is ideal for that hot day relaxing. It is sweetened, but me personally like a bit more sugar. It tastes just like coffee and is not overly strong. I like the fact that it is a single seving can, so I don't have to make an entire pot off coffee. It is easy enough to put in the refrigerator and grab when needed, or take to go while on the run.

This illy issimo Caffe Coffee Drink has a strong coffee flavor that would normally be a plus since I like "bold" coffee, but the very bitter aftertaste is too much to make this enjoyable. Just to be sure it wasn't me, my coffee loving daughter also tried it and while she liked it more than I did, she said it is not a drink she would seek out again.

This just misses the mark for us.

CFH

I found this coffee really tasty.  It is difficult to catch a good Italian espresso that doesn't have an aftertaste, and for me, this coffee was rich and smooth with no burned taste.  It only has 10 grams of sugar which is a little over 2 teaspoons, not bad compared to other high calorie coffees.  The description in this page says it has 45 calories, but the can clearly says 50 calories.  I personally enjoyed it and found it pleasant to my taste buds.

The illy issimo Coffee Caffè drink had a nice, clean, rich flavor, both at room temperature and poured over ice. I liked it over ice the best. There is just the right balance of coffee and enough sugar to make it appealing but not so much that it overpowers the drink or leaves an aftertaste. The convenience of popping open a can for a great tasting caffeine fix is appealing. And a good jolt of caffeine it is: 155 mg. per 6.8 ounce serving. (The size of the can.) Compare that to 48 mg. per 16.9 ounces of caffeine in Coke Zero.

The ingredient list is pretty simple: Coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, potassium citrate.

If you're looking for a quick, bold, full-bodied, Italian espresso-style coffee drink, look no further. This is a good one.

I always expect these cans of coffee to be very creamy and sugary no matter what is written on the label; a contrast to how I drink my hot coffee.

Instead, this one is cold black coffee lightly sweetened - they did a pretty good job on the sugar level.

It is worlds better than most of the other cold coffees without cream that I have had, most of which have been out of 2 liter plastic bottles in Japan, which are always extremely disappointing. I can't give it a 5 because I don't love it, but I suspect that it is the best of its type one can get; you can sense that the quality is there. It doesn't suffer too much from being cold because it doesn't seem watered down, like most usually do.

I poured me a can of this drink into a glass to enjoy the flavor. My first reaction was its bitterness (it's espresso afterall) followed by a sweet but not too sweet aftertaste. There's a suble creama left in the glass like an espresso would have, but lacking any grittiness.

This drink defintely provides a jolt of 155 mg of caffeine for those on the run. Its contents contain coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, and potassium citrate. Each small can has around 50 calories.

I prefer a coffee drink with a slightly less bitter taste. But for someone who needs a fast caffeine fix, this should fit the bill.
We I saw this online i had to get it. the taste is just right not to sweet or bitter. the only thing better then this is to go to a illy barista in the morning.

I really wanted to like this product but the coffee tasted "thin" and there was a funny, somewhat sour aftertaste.  The coffee is lightly sweetened, which is fine, but other than that it was not a pleasant drink.  I do like Starbucks shelf-stable bottled drinks, so it's not that I don't like this type of product in general, I just didn't like this one.  I will not be buying this in the future.

This is very different than any coffee drink I have had, it is more like soda/coffee.  I chilled mine, and did like it, there is a little soda "fizz" but not much and the coffee flavor is very good and robust.  I didn't find it overly sweet like the other reviewers.  I didn't love this drink, but did like it okay.

I have come to expect Illy coffee to symbolize good and consistent quality. I do prefer other brands of espresso, but Illy's consistency is great since it is to be found in many restaurants around the globe.

So it is with some sadness that I write a negative review. First off - please note that this is actually a coffee flavored energy beverage made and packaged by Coca Cola. Illy has partnered in order to take proceeds by allowing their name to be used. There might be a some of their coffee used, but it would be processed coffee extract, and so there wouldn't be much reason to use expensive Arabica coffee when extract from lower quality Robusto would work.

This canned beverage seems to taste pleasant enough at first, but then it starts to turn metallic. The coffee flavor really is a 'coffee flavor'. There is just something artificial and chemical tasting about this drink. Granted, it's only 45 calories, most coming from the beet extract sweetener. And don't be fooled by beet sweetener, it's really no different than any other unbleached sugar. It is regularly used to Chaptalize wine in fact. Don't be lured in by the low calorie claim: fresh brewed iced coffee without sweetener? Zero calories. Yes. Zero. (okay, actually 0.01 calories! sorry!) So it's not like they're really doing anything crazy by offering this at 45 calories. It's just less sugar added than the super sweet beverages. Really it seems the sweetener was added to try and mask the artificial and metallic flavor.

There are better iced coffees on the market. I hope we really start to see some more variety and availability soon. Other countries like Japan have a huge market for bottled and canned unsweetened tea and coffee, so hopefully we can get on the bandwagon soon. Hopefully with better tasting results.

I drink my coffee in much the same way a 12 year old probably would...very light and very sweet. I found this coffee drink to be extremely bitter and not nearly sweet enough. I noticed some people here saying this was too sweet, but I just did NOT find that to be the case. It also left a very strong and not-so-pleasant after taste. If you like your coffee strong and black, then you'll probably really like this. However if you're a cream and sugar kinda person, this will most likely be too bitter for you.

I made the mistake of taking my first sip of this coffee after tasting something sweet. It's bitter! But tasting it later I came to appreciate the flavor.

Unlike a lot of canned/bottled coffee drinks, to me this tasted like real coffee. Nice and strong, not too sweet. If you put a lot of sweet-and-white in your coffee, you will find this drink unbearably bitter, in that case I recommend the Cappucino version of the same brand.

Nutrition facts: 50 calories in the can, 20mg sodium, 12 carbs (10g sugars, 1g fiber) -- which isn't bad. Caffeine content is 155 mg in the 6.8 fl oz. The ingredients list coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, and potassium citrate. No milk, which is healthier, and I prefer that because I'm lactose intolerant. It also means it lasts longer -- the best-by date on my sample can is Sept. '12 (received April).

The can lists this nice coffee as a Product of Denmark. I've tasted coffee in Denmark, and I can't dispute that, though I can tell you this method is a whole lot cheaper.

I drank it cold and I really enjoyed this coffee. I would really like to get more... but it is a bit pricy. If you are on the go a lot this is an easy solution.

illy cafe is the original portable coffee drink. It is plain coffee without milk, cream, or any sweetener. It's It may therefore, be more to the liking of coffee purists. illy drinks are available only in the cans (not in glass). While I might prefer glass, these cans are the only option for illy. They are available in 12 packs through Amazon. With a larger order you can get them with no charge for shipping making for a competitive price. They do not need to be refrigerated at all. However, they do taste better if refrigerated prior to consumption.

Even though I hate sugar in any coffee beverage, this is pretty good. At 45 calories a can, there are probably 3 teaspoons of sugar. That's kinda hefty, but it doesn't taste that sweet. While it has a pretty strong flavor, it certainly doesn't have the robust, fresh ground flavor one may expect from Illy. And, it tastes like it's been sitting in a can, because it has. Maybe  they'll ship in glass and solve the metal aftertaste issue?

This coffee drink has a much stronger coffee taste than most -- and I like that.  I don't drink a lot of coffee products, but when I do I want something that is definitely coffee and not a confusing combination of flavors and sweeteners.  In addition to the strong coffee taste, there is a hint of bitterness but it's not unpleasant.  This is not a beverage I would drink daily -- I think it would lose some of its excitement and get a bit boring -- but it's nice to have a few cans in the refrigerator.  By the way, I tried heating a serving... don't bother, this drink is absolutely at its best served well chilled.

My husband and I thought the coffee had a nice flavor, but my brother thought it tasted like the can. It was better served in a glass over ice, and we will probably buy it again, especially since the price went down.

I drink a good bit of coffee, most of it iced, so I was expecting something decent with the illy issimo Coffee drink. To my dismay, I didn't like it...at all. It's basically an iced, sweetened coffee drink around espresso strength. The drink had that stale, "I've been sitting for a while" coffee taste that is best poured down a drain. The sweetness is about right (not cloying or overpowering) and it definitely tastes like espresso, but it just doesn't taste like fresh brewed (maybe yesterday). I know it comes in a can and technically can't be fresh, but I've tasted similar coffee drinks that didn't have that stale, skunky taste. It gets two stars for giving a decent energy/caffeine boost, but the taste makes it impossible to recommend.

It surprised me how tasty this drink actually is for being a canned coffee. It was actually really delicious! This is especially handy to have on a road trip. The coffee pots in motel rooms are shown to be anything but sanitary as one can imagine...it's not as though they have a dishwasher on that maid cart and sanitize those things. That said, I'm not one to go without my morning coffee either and I hardly feel like driving around looking for a Starbucks in the morning (or even wanting to spend that on coffee if I found one.)

Not that this couldn't be used for a daily coffee fix at home, but it's especially handy for the road; rather that be the road to work for easy car sipping, or--especially--the long road away from your home brewer.

It's good to have a pack on hand for me for that reason alone. While I'm happy with my home coffee, this adds a nice twist to change things up or to keep your caffeine buzz away from home as well.

This coffee is really great cold--like an iced espresso. We don't have an ice machine at work, but do have a fridge. This makes a nice alternative for a morning break. It's also nice poured over ice with a dash of creamer or evaporated milk, which has a lot less calories and sugar than a frozen coffee shop drink and is just as refreshing.

I love my coffee in the morning and often enjoy a cup in the afternoon too, but it makes me hot so in summer doesn't feel as good.  That's where the Illy Issimo Coffee Drink comes in.  I get that coffee taste but it is cold and refreshing rather than just making me feel hotter.  It has a little sugar but is not too sweet.  Will buy it again.

Delicious!  While I normally like a flavor with my coffee, i.e. chocolate, I found the coffee flavor to be agreeable.  I've tried many brands of canned/bottled coffee drinks, and this one was very good.  This drink is a wonderful afternoon pick me up.  Per the instructions, I did not shake the can.  I would recommend this drink to any iced coffee drinker.

This coffee drink is so strong that it dried up all the spit in my mouth for a week.  Not really, but you get the idea.  My daughter happily took it from me and finished it off and thinks it was amazing.  Of course, she really likes Starbucks too.  So, if you love expresso and strong coffee, this IS your drink.  If you are a coffee wimp like me though, look for a lightly flavored cappucino instead!

I really like coffee, but overall I would rate this as "okay" tasting - it is very strong, and has a bit of a bite in the flavoring that made me get a piece of gum to get the taste out of my mouth. After a couple of sips, I was done and would rate it a 3 out of 5 stars.

I opened this can up in the office, and passed around small sampler cups to my co-workers to get their thoughts as I work with several coffee connoisseurs. Three women and one man said they thought it was good, and the three women would rate it a 4 on a 5 scale while the man said he would rate it a 3..

Another man who typically buys and enjoys the Starbucks canned beverages said he would rate it a 3 out of 5 stars.

Including myself, none of the test subjects hated it but everyone said the same thing - while they thought it was good, none of them believed it was "good enough" to make them want to go out and purchase some. When I asked why, they had the same impression I had in that the coffee place downstairs was better none of us were really compelled to add this to our regular routines and shopping lists.

One thing to note is there is a lot of sugar in this 6.4 ounce can: 10g! The sugar and the caffeine combined should give you a little kick in the afternoon if that is what you are seeking.
Strong, a little bitter.  Enough sweetness to make it drinkable.  But there was nothing to savor here.  If you like strong black coffee you might really enjoy this.  I don't and I didn't.

I was pleasantly surprised when I took my first sip of "illy issimo caffe: Italian Espresso Style Coffee Drink." I'm not sure what I expected, but it certainly wasn't the wonderful taste of real espresso coffee from a can. I'm a skeptic and proud of it! My only quibble, and this is a matter of personal taste, I found this Coffee Drink to be very sweet. I am not a sweet guy, no matter what my wife says. I simply don't drink my coffee with sugar (real or artificial), nor do I put milk/cream in it. I love the raw jolt of plain espresso in the morning. This drink definitely has what I like...except for the 10g of sugar. The next time I try illy's caffe, I'll get the one with No Sugar added.

O...as an aside, I poured the 6.8FL OZ (200ml) of illy's chilled espresso in a glass and held it up to the light. It was so dark, that no light, not even a ray of sunlight, shone through it. The color reminded me of Guinness Stout. 4 Stars (I had to take a star away because it was too sweet for me.)

because I love coffee, but I don't like overly sweet coffee. I expected this to be very sweet, but it wasn't. I like a strong coffee taste, and this didn't disappoint. Why not five stars? Because I didn't know if I was supposed to drink this chilled or not. It didn't say on the can or the website what temperature is should be served at. Aside from that, I loved this!
I love drinking illy coffee and it's great that they offer it in can form. For me, it's too dark and bitter, but it is still a great and bold flavor for those who prefer it.

I liked this product as it is a quick cold express coffee drink for early morning.  The sweetness is just right and I definitely get the energy after drinking in the morning.  I will definitely buy this product in the future.

I'm a big fan of coffee, so this beverage piqued my interest. I have tried Starbucks drinks both at Starbucks coffee shops and from the supermarket. I like them. This drink is not as sweet. It seems there's just enough sugar to take the bitter edge off. When ice is added it makes a refreshing enough warm weather beverage, though I have tasted better. What the product has going for it is convenience. The 6.8-ounce cans are easy to store in the refrigerator and can be taken out and drunk quickly. No process of first making iced coffee. That's a definite plus. It is not as satisfying at room temperature.

The flavor, apart from being strong, is harsh to the taste and does not provide the satisfaction that a Starbucks or other espresso drinks in a can/bottle do. As a pick-me-up, the drink is appropriate, since its hefty dose of caffeine will give the drinker an infusion of energy. Compared to other similar drinks on the market, sugar content is low (which accounts for its bitterness).

For those averse to caffeine or those who have trouble sleeping if they drink too much brewed coffee, this beverage is a no-no. These days, many folks have cut down on caffeine intake, so this product might be counterproductive to weaning oneself from addictive caffeine.

This isn't bad. It's very strong and slightly bitter with a touch of sweetness taste. I wouldn't compare to to Starbucks doubleshot since this is a lot less sugary. It is a nice pick me up and if you love a good strong coffee taste you'd probably love this. I'm more of a wimp and liked the illy issimo Cappuccino Coffee Drink, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) which is weaker, has milk and is a bit sweeter. Both are very low in calories and a nice coffee flavor. Depends on your preference I would think. Nice product either way.

I had recently tried the illy Cappuccino which had a slightly flat taste.  The Caffe flavor was a big improvement to me, with more sweetness and a richer coffee taste.  It wasn't the same flavor as I am used to from Starbucks but I liked the easy serving size which can be transported to drink anywhere.  The sweetness of this drink is just right, especially for those who don't drink coffee unsweetened.  I found the caffeine in the illy Caffe wasn't excessive and didn't make me too "wired" throughout the day.

This coffee beverage tasted pretty good...it was strong but slightly bitter so I couldn't see myself drinking it every day.  The caffeine gave me a nice morning boost.  The calories aren't too bad for this kind of drink.

This review is based on a single can received from the Amazon Vine program.

I'm a coffee guy. I drink it almost every day. My coffee brewing method of choice is a French Press, and I like a rich full bodied coffee. I do like iced coffee, and I like sweets, so this thing seemed like a good fit.

I couldn't see anywhere on the can a recommendation on how to drink it, so I went with room temperature. Big mistake. This is definitely an iced coffee in a can, so keep that in mind.

The coffee flavor was fine, but this was really sweet. I drink sugary coffee with milk, but this doesn't have any milk or cream, so I didn't like it too much. Your mileage may vary.

If you like cold sweet coffee, without milk, you might want to give this a try.

I like a good strong coffee, but I did not enjoy this.
The flavor was strong and bitter, yet not very aromatic. It's acidic, a little sour to the tongue. The only way I can enjoy this is adding a lot of milk to it to mellow it out. Perhaps over a cup of ice.
On the bright side, it is not sweet, so you can customize your own sweetness.
I enjoyed the cappuccino flavor a lot more.

I like iced coffee on hot summer days but since those times are still a couple of months away, I poured the illy Caffe into my favorite coffee mug and microwaved it until it was just the right temperature for me. The can doesn't specify whether this is supposed to be a cold drink or a hot one, so I see no problem with doing this.

I also must admit to being someone who only occasionally has espresso coffee, so keep that in mind when you evaluate my review.

I liked it.

The illy Caffe had a nice, strong coffee flavor. It was just a tad too sweet for me, but that could be a result of heating it rather than consuming it cold. We perceive sweetness differently depending upon temperature and as a cold drink the sweetness might be right. That seems to be the prevailing opinion in the other reviews here, so I'll defer to their judgement.

I've tried another illy canned coffee drink, the Cappuccino, and I detected an under-taste of some sort in that one but that's not the case here. It has a nice espresso flavor with no off-flavor notes.

The 6.8 ounce can contains 50 calories and 155 milligrams of caffeine.

I found myself in a situation where I had to be in three places at once, and I needed a flavorful boost without the hassle and cleanup of making my own espresso or the wait and expense of getting one at my local barrista. Right there in front of me was a can of illy issimp Caffe coffee drink. I popped the lid and took a sip. This brew is dark, bold and bitter. I added a packet of stevia-based sweetener and it was much more palatable. My wife took a sip and we both agreed that we should order another pack of these.

Bottom line - an enjoyable, high quality coffee drink. It is not as sweet or decadent as a "double shot" can, but it taste more authentic.

For the record I'm not much of a coffee drinker. When I go to Starbucks or McDonald's I prefer to get a mocha (especially a mocha frappe) because it's more like cocoa than coffee.

So I guess what disappoints me about this product is that it's pretty much just a cup of coffee. Despite that sugar is the second ingredient in it, the product really has a lot of that coffee bitterness in it. If you're someone like me who doesn't like that, then this product certainly isn't for you.

That is all.

"Don't shake" it says on the small bullet cans.
No need to. And no need to run out to Starbucks and pay $2.50 for their little double espresso shot cans.
This stuff is strong, and .50cents cheaper per can, for your afternoon "human reboot".

Strong flavor but not bitter. You should enjoy a strong coffee taste if you're going to enjoy this. I do. A nice little 12 pack fits under your desk, or in your desk drawer at the office.

I have had the illy issimo coffee before and liked it so I was excited to try this iced coffee drink. If you like a strong coffee taste you will like this. I prefer and more smooth coffee taste so this is not for me. The quality of this brand is great though so that is why I am giving it three stars.

This Illy "Italian Espresso Style" drink is one of an entire series of coffee-in-a-can style beverages. This particular product has 6.8 fl oz and contains 155 mg of caffeine. That's pretty typical of a regular cup of coffee.

The taste was pretty basic. In fact, it really just tastes like chilled coffee. It has that bitter coffee bite, somewhat toned down by sugar. It isn't too strong, but if you're looking for a smooth, milky taste then you won't like this drink. Overall, it was okay but certainly not my favorite. It'll do in a pinch as an iced coffee substitute, but I wouldn't go out of my way to find it.

I tend to shy away from cold coffee drinks. I think this is mostly because I resisted coffee until I had to wake up in the morning at the Renaissance Festival and the caffeine was only so successful in waking me. I needed the heat to fully send me into an alert status (and it also became essential in the later weeks when there was frost on the ground and my teeth were rattling). I don't necessarily like the taste of coffee anymore than I like the taste of beer or scotch. I have developed a taste, but that is not the same as having a predisposed desire for it. It's a means to an end and if I am not warmed up in the first sip, that end is less forthcoming.

I can honestly say that I enjoyed this beverage. It is just sweet enough to mitigate the coffee bitterness, but not so sweet that you don't know what it is. There is a smooth taste that belies the harshness of the coffee grounds. Furthermore, it is highly caffeinated to the point where my eyes were open wide and I was ready for work.

I definitely will buy more.
The illy issimo Cappuccino Coffee Drink, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) does taste much better than this one in my opinion. This flavor tastes a bit like instant coffee that was just brewed strong.

This coffee is great, unlike most cold coffee drinks in a can, this one actually tastes like coffee. It is closer to a black coffee than a sweetened coffee, so if you like them light and sweet, try the Cappuccino flavored one.

I enjoyed this coffee drink.  It is flavorful straight out of the can, with a robust taste somewhere between Dunkin Donuts and Starbucks in intensity.  Moderately sweetened but without any dairy additives, everyone in my family "cut" theirs with half and half to take the edge off the flavor.  If you like your coffee strong and black but don't have access to a pot, thermos or a vendor, this may be the product to put in your lunchbox.  Another solid product from illy issimo!

I guess if you are out and about and want a cold coffee, this would do the trick. Make sure you like your coffee strong and sweet because this drink has sugar in it. Also, mind the fact that you are not supposed to shake the can!

I like iced coffee, but I like to make it myself and compared to mine, this is average. The strong flavor is nice but it is a little too sweet for my taste.

If you like your Italian espresso to be very dark and bold in taste, then you can't miss with Illy Issimo Caffe . Like its "cousin", Illy Issimo Cappucino, this is an exceedingly rich Italian espresso style coffee drink, but it isn't nearly as rich as the cappuccino, which I have tried recently. However, I thought the coffee flavor was still rich and decided that it needed some improvement by diluting it 50% with fresh milk. I am surprised that a drink as rich as this one is has only 50 calories per can; it's also low sodium too with only 20 milligrams per can. Anyone who is diet conscious will appreciate both salient facts. While I can recommend this to anyone who wants an imported Italian espresso drink from Europe (Denmark), those seeking freshly ground beans, will find Starbucks' version a far more delicious coffee drinking experience.

I love espresso, so I was looking forward to tasting this new espresso drink from illy which is made for Coca-Cola. I refrigerated it so it would be really cold and then I drink it.  I was not disappointed...it tasted fresh and was delicious. I wanted more.  I will recommend this to my friends and I will look in the grocery store for this product. We travelled extensively in Europe over the years and acquired a taste for special coffee blends and espresso.  This was the real deal and was exceptionally tasty.

This coffee drink had a very nice coffee taste that took a few minutes to develop. I am a strong coffee drinker...hot coffee, that is. I usually limit my coffee/caffeine intake to the early morning, so I don't know if I would drink this after my morning jolt. It had a distinct coffee flavor, but somehow I just couldn't get into enjoying it cold. This is a 6.8 oz can that contains 12 grams of carbs, 10 grams of sugar, 50 calories and 155 mg of caffeine. If you enjoy strong, iced coffee, you will no doubt like this drink. It should work well for an energy boost in the PM.

I love espresso. When I heard about this product I felt like I had to try it, even though part of me wondered (and still wonders) whether there is really a market for espresso in a can. It tastes really good, rich and full-bodied, with just enough sweetness. If you ever feel like a shot of iced espresso would go down good right now, this would be the product for you.

This is a Coca Cola product. I was one of the 5 people who thought Coca Cola Black (coffee flavored Coke) was a great product back in the 2000's. Apparently Coke hasn't given up on capturing a portion of the coffee-lovers market. The ingredient list is short and sweet and consists of what the illy issimo website calls "ingredients of natural origin" - primarily coffee and sugar. Although it tastes really good, I just can't imagine getting addicted to this stuff, mainly because when I think espresso, I think of a hot drink. It just seems like people's mind sets would need to undergo a radical change in order for this product to be successful.

This coffee drink is made in Denmark and imported to be sold by Coca-Cola. Its ingredient list is short and pretty non-offensive, coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate. The can is labeled as "no preservatives," so I'm not sure of the reason for the last ingredient.

The taste is like a sweet high quality coffee. IT claims to be an "Italian espresso style coffee" and I suppose it is- although I'm not an expert. That's about it- no milk or cream taste, but good coffee. If you like cold, sweet coffee you should like it.

The drink contains 155 mg of caffeine, so it's about as strong as your average energy drink or high end cup of coffee. It contains 50 calories, so it's fairly light in that department, being that it doesn't use artificial sweeteners.

great for those who enjoy chilled coffee drinks. Especially if you like rich, strong espresso type of coffee. This only has 50 calories, so if you are on a diet, this will fit in with your goals.

Tastes great- convenient, small cans. Perfect to take to work with you, or as you travel in your car.

I will defintely buy this product again.
I love iced coffee so I poured my Illy issimo caffe over ice.  Tasty and smooth.  I would definitely buy this product.

This would be a good coffee drink to have on hand.  I did chill it in the refrigerator, and since I don't drink espresso with sugar, I placed this in a cup and added a bit of milk, and liked it better that way.  The milk softened the sugar taste a bit and the bitterness of the espresso.  All in all, a nice beverage.

illy issimo Caffe Coffee is a wonderful drink. If you are tired of the same old Starbucks routine grab a little taste of Rome with this great concoction. I pour mine over ice and love it. This is for the coffee drinker. If you are not a big fan of coffee I would skip this product.

Generally, I'm a fan of canned coffee drinks - so I'm predisposed to liking most of the ones I try. That being said, the most common weakness of canned coffee drinks is too many of them can be much too sweet so as not to be enjoyable. Illy does a good job of making a light, refreshing coffee drink that is lightly sweetened. There is only 50 calories per can so it isn't too sinful if you are trying to watch your calorie intake.

My only quibble is that while the coffee flavor is good, it isn't very strong - this is more like a Dunkin Donut's style coffee than a Starbucks style coffee. If I saw this can available in a store, I'd definitely get it again.

While I did enjoy illy's issimo caffe coffee drink, I do have mixed feelings about it. The good, from my perspective, is that it's less sweet than all of the other alternative canned/bottled coffee drinks I've had, so it tastes more like slightly sweetened, strong coffee rather than very sweet milk with a little coffee flavor mixed in. That being said, the product is labeled that it's "espresso style" and I think that's probably an overstatement. Yes, this product has a strong coffee flavor, but it tastes more like a very strong brewed coffee versus a well pulled espresso shot.

Given that I generally drink my coffee unsweetened, whether hold or cold, I don't think I would purchase this product regularly. If you do like strong, cold coffee that's slightly sweetened, this product might be more to your liking than mine. I'm still rating it 4 ("I like it") versus 3 ("It's okay") stars because I think the product is better than okay and is certainly good for what it is. If a half star were possible, my personal rating would certainly be 3.5 stars.

It's dark and bold like others have said, but that's to be expected from espresso in a can. What I didn't expect, was for it to taste pretty good for what it is. In all fairness, I'm not a big coffee drinker. I don't normally drink plain black coffee or espresso, and tend to prefer a cappuccino or mochaccino or, barring that, a cup of coffee with a healthy dose of cream and sugar. This isn't exactly a drink for me, but even for me this wasn't unpleasant by any means. It has a rich flavor to it--what I'd expect from quality coffee--with a subtle hint of sugar that works really well. I have no doubt espresso lovers will enjoy this and I'm impressed enough by this that I'm confident I'll really enjoy illy issimo's other coffee drinks, such as the mochaccino (which is probably a better fit for a coffee drinker like me).

This little can (6.8 oz.)of coffee drink has the flavor of espresso with a not-too-sweet note. There is nothing artificial-tasting about it, as is often found in other energy boost drinks. With 155 mg. of caffeine, it contains almost double the jolt in a 7 oz. brewed cup of coffee. This one's not for sissies.

Please note that, with 10 grams of sugar and 12 grams of carbohydrate, it may not be for those on sugar/carbohydrate restricted intake. Other than that, it contains nothing to deem it unhealthy. It even has no preservatives. (I wonder what this drink might taste like if it were artificially sweetened and have no carbohydrates.)

I enjoyed it ice cold straight from the can. This tastes every bit as good as the Starbucks bottled coffee drinks. I would not hesitate to choose the Illy brand over the other one.

Coca Cola produces it in Atlanta, Georgia under a licensing agreement and it is a product of Denmark.

illy issimo is Coca Cola's attempt to break into the canned coffee drink market. The Caffe flavor is not bad and it works in terms of offering energy and caffeine. Having said that, there is little to differentiate this product from other ones on the market. On the plus side, it has only 50 calories.

1. I am purposely writing this review blind of the other reviews. If I am the only 1 star then consider I must have got a bad can. That or <1% of the population has a gene incompatible with this recipe :-)

2. Is "worst thing" hyperbolic.. maybe. I remember when I was five I tried tasting some strawberry air freshener, that was pretty bad. Among intended foodstuffs, this does indeed rank up there with worst

3. The ingredients are coffee, sugar, and preservative, so I am not sure how it has gone wrong. For one thing it tastes slightly carbonated/citric... likely the preservative. And the sweetness is just way off. Too high and totally unbalanced with the coffee. The coffee has a weird mouth-feel. Ever accidentally sipped form a cup of coffee on your desk only to realize it was from 3 days ago? Sort of like that.

If it helpful to know, I am a coffee drinker. My general drinks of choice are double-short-americano or triple-tall-cappucino

Very flavor of this canned expresso. Better than the starbucks one.
Thus, the Calories should be only 50 instead of 100 in this product description. I will say great item for expresso lover

I love espresso, the stronger the better.  I was pleasantly surprised at the rich taste and strong flavor that this Illy drink possesses.  It is not like the usual bottled or canned coffee drink.  It tastes like it just came out of the espresso machine.  There's a slight sweetness, but just a touch so as to make the drink not bitter.  If you can't get to a real espresso stand, then I highly recommend this drink as a good substitution.

I bought this coffee to venture off of the Starbucks double shot drinks...which are still my favorite, but these are great when you don't want as sweet of taste and need more caffeine in your system.

It has a very dark and bold taste with a hint of sugar and does the job very well.

I would definitely recommend this product to coffee drinkers and those who like pure espresso

I enjoy just about any coffee, and I liked the illy issimo caffe Italian Espresso Style Coffee Drink too. It does have a bit of a bitter taste, even though the ingredients include sugar. So it's not a real sweet drink. I liked the strong, somewhat bitter taste of it, even though my favorite coffee drinks are mocha style beverages (both hot and cold).

I refrigerated the can before drinking, and it was a nice quick cold coffee beverage. However, I am used to drinking large cups of coffee, so the small 6.8 oz. can seemed too small, and I finished it off pretty quick. The nice thing about the small can is you can take these with you just about anywhere. So they are very convenient.

I'd recommend to people who like iced espresso style coffee drinks that have a bit of sweetness, but remain a bit bitter and who want very convenient small servings that can be taken just about anywhere.

This is my second Illy coffee product and I guess I just don't like them. They are too strong and bitter-tasting for me. I'm not a lover of overly strong coffee flavors, I like them mild and unobtrusive. However, my husband has loved ever Illy product that I've given him to try, and he IS a coffee drinker. He likes anything coffee. So I'll give this a 3; my rating would have been a 1 but his would be a 5 so we'll split the difference.

I do like how convenient the drinks are, they would fit nicely into my husband's lunchbox for work.

We love illy issimo coffees. They're not expensive and they usually hit the spot. I was excited to try the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè.

It was very disappointing. I found it, while sweetened, to be bitter and watery. (Yes, I know that, scientifically, bitter is not the opposite of sweet, but we know that sweetener changes the flavor of coffee.) I passed the can to my Gentleman Caller, who is more of a coffee aficionado than I am. He drinks fine espresso as well as old coffee from the bottom of the pot if that's what there is. He agreed that this was bitter.

illy disappointed us.

I wouldn't buy this if it were offered again. I'd rather buy a soda.

The Illy Issimo Cappuccino Espresso Coffee Drink is far more to my liking.

I got this illy issimo Coffee Drink Caffe for my husband who loves coffee. To make sure he was super grateful, I brought it camping with us to surpise him in a moment of caffeine desperation. I was sure he was going to love it because everything tastes better in the woods.

"Mediocre, not as good as I'd thought it would be," was what he told me.

I won't be buying this again.

I usually really like coffee drinks, but I have never tasted anything this horrible in my life.  I have had a variety of other brands and this was the worst flavor I have had.  I would not recommend this one based on its flavor.  Maybe if this brand has other flavored ones it would be better, but the plain coffee one is horrible.  I do not recommend.

I couldn't drink the full cup. It was sweet, and somewhat off, maybe like coffee that had sat in your cup all day, and you don't notice that, and take a big swallow of it. Not awful, but not great. I normally like illy espresso and am willing to add a touch of sugar to that. Perhaps it's another person's idea of a "touch" that makes it not palatable to me.
I found the sugar taste wasn't blended in with the drink well, it tasted like someone had put table sugar in terrible tasting cold coffee.  Not good and expensive.

This is the second illy issimo coffee drink that I've tried, and both of them have had a great bold taste. Both were also full of sugar. I don't really enjoy my coffee with sugar in it, but I think if illy issimo would come out with a full-bodied espresso drink that has no sweetener whatsoever in it, suitable for using in place of pulled espresso shots for making one's own lattes or for splitting a can in espresso cups, that would be a hit and would be something I might buy to have on hand to serve to guests.

This expresso is very tasty.  I drank it cold from the refrigerator.  It is very sweet.  I liked that. It is not a creamy drink.  Just expresso and sugar, with 2 other ingredients.  It's good to note that you do not shake these cans.  I had a coffee aftertaste.  I think that is normal.  This drink really tastes Italian.  I will buy it again, but I prefer their creamier flavors.

Other than the benefit of caffeine, this really is not a very good drink. If you compare it to other competitors (namely the at-home Starbucks drinks), it's vastly inferior in just about every category. The taste is mediocre and not pleasant. The smell keeps its metallic odor even after pouring it into a different glass. The value isn't there, either.

Overall, it's a very disappointing drink.

Having visited Europe many times, one of the things I miss is good espressos. I have a couple of coffee machines at home but I'm always too lazy to make cold espressos! This "illy issimo" espresso-in-a-can tastes good to me. It's not too strong yet has enough espresso bitterness to make it flavorful. Each can has 50 calories, including 1g of fiber and 10g of sugar. The drink is made in Denmark and tastes high-quality. I really liked the one sample can I received from the Amazon Vine program, so I'm going to order more! I do wish it were cheaper since each can is small!

I usually am not a big fan of iced coffee drinks, but this one was not bad. It was not sickly sweet, and had a decent flavor.

My only complaint was the size of the can/amount of product. In my opinion, it was too small.

I had never tried this type of product before and got it because I was curious after reading the reviews.  I am not an Expresso drinker and I think I was in for a bit of a shock with the taste.  It had a 'pop' to it, but I found it to be bitter for my tastebuds.  I tried it room temperature and chilled, but neither one really appealed to me.  I would not say it was distasteful by any means, and for the person who enjoys this type of drink, it most probably would be quite good.  I did not experience an unpleasant aftertaste, but I did experience a lingering one.  For me, a person who enjoys a mild cup of coffee with raw brown sugar and cream, no :)

This beverage comes in an 6.8 Fluid Ounce serving.

It has 50 Calories per can.

It consists of Italian Espresso style Arabica coffee and sugar drink, with caffeine content of 155mg. It's a Coca Cola product.

The drink is lightly sugared, and tastes great. I put my can in the refrigerator and drank it cold. Tasted like Ice Coffee...

The can has a date on the bottom that indicates when the product expires (this one was 9/7/2012)

I liked it and would buy more. If you like coffee, you will probably like this drink.

This is a great espresso with just a hint of sweetness. If you are an espresso drinker this is for you. If you like lattes, cappucinos, and such, look elsewhere, this has no milk or flavorings, it's just pure, smooth espresso.

My preference for anything other than my morning coffee from my Keurig is hot in the winter and ice cold in the summer. Today's temperature touched 100 so ice cold was the order of the day. I have a special fast chill compartment in my refrigerator that cools items quickly to 34 degrees and after 4 hours in there I put the can in the freezer for 5 minutes. It was icy cold the way I like it. THe espresso is strong and bold without bitterness. I liked the slight hint of sweetness as I find many coffee drinks to be too sweet for my taste but the Illy Issimo was spot on. Compared to a Starbucks Double Shot the Illy has a better, more well-rounded flavor.

Ok, I raved about the product so why only 4 stars? The price! In this age of Starbucks, etc., we are getting used to paying astronomical prices for coffee. Folks, this is good espresso and convenient in the can but it is still coffee. I guess we like to pay for convenience. I could make Illy espresso in my Gaggia Baby for pennies a shot but sticking a can in the fridge is more convenient. Bottom line, it's still coffee, a very nice espresso, but still coffee.

Illy Issimo Coffee drink in a can was a pleasant surprise. I love coffee but prior to trying this beverage was less than impressed by the chillded coffee-in-a-can that was available. Starbucks Doubleshots and similar drinks by Seattle's Best and Others had been what I had tried. Those were all too weak and had a bit of a funny aftertaste. Illy managed to make a smooth, strong, good tasting chilled coffee with no funny aftertaste.

This drink is basically a quick, good-tasting coffee that's ready to go. You must like coffee to like this drink; it's not one of those creamy, foo-foo drinks that are popular but are basically full of fat and void of coffee. It's not as good as fresh made espresso, but when I'm in a hurry and want some good tasting caffeine quick I now have a new go-to drink. Sorry Doubleshot.

I tried this illy issimo Caffè Italian Espresso Style coffee drink for a quick energy lift after lunch. The drink is made in Denmark (not Italy) and distributed by the Coca-Cola Co.

Likes:
>The AL can chilled quickly (1.5 hrs) in the fridge OR pour in a glass and heat it up in the microwave.
>Richer taste of Arabica coffee than illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) without the fat and cholesterol (from lowfat milk).
>Per 6.8oz. can: 10g sugar, 0mg cholesterol & fat, and only 50 calories.

Dislikes:
>Each 6.8oz. can contains: 155mg caffeine and 20mg sodium. Not bad but for those who are very sensitive to caffeine, even 155mg could cause an extra hour or two of insomnia (happened to me, drank it around 2PM, stayed up until 2AM).
>Easy to exceed the maximum daily intake of 500mg caffeine (as recommended by physicians) with just three to four cans.
>Competitively priced at $2.01 per 6.8oz can (12-pack) but costs can add up quickly for heavy coffee drinkers.

Bottom Line:
Tasty drink for an occasional energy boost but not recommended for people sensitive to or trying to minimize caffeine intake. Give it a try, some may enjoy the flavor and couldn't care less about the 155mg caffeine; make your own informed decision!

I really like this stuff.  In fact, it has now become my go to store store bought ice coffee.  It has a nice strong and real coffee taste not masked by sweeteners or other tastes meant to soften the flavors of real coffee.  My only complaint is that I wish the can were larger.  For those that enjoy there coffee black with no sugar and no cream, I highly recommend you give this a try.

If you like espresso, then you will probably like this coffee. The taste is strong and bold. It is mildly sweetened. One can (6.8 ounces) contains 50 calories and 155 mg of caffeine.Yikes! That's a lot of caffeine! I like coffee, but not this strong so I won't be drinking it again. And just FYI, it is a product of Denmark.

I drink my coffee black and normally make it myself. But if I want iced coffee, a lot of times it is faster just to buy something canned or in a bottle. However, I have yet to really fall in love with any of the available products.

illy issimo's Caffe flavored coffee drink has a nice, bold flavor. There's a touch more sweetness than I like, but it's less than most premade drinks. I do wish I'd decanted it. Every once in awhile I would get a strong chemical taste, but I think that was due to the can rather than the coffee itself. One can contains double the caffeine of a Red Bull, but I didn't feel much effect after finishing. I felt less tired than usual, but there was no jolt of energy.

I enjoyed trying this product and feel that it's better than many of its competitors, but I don't think I'm going to go out and buy any. The periodic aftertaste really bothered me after awhile.

I liked this, very smooth tasting with no aftertaste from being sweetened
and left in a can...amazing. I added some 1/2-n-1/2 to thin it for this
American palette and still enjoyed it a lot. If you purchase this, note
it says do not shake...unlike the Starbucks products you better shake or
leave 1/2 of the product at the bottom.

For some reason, I had it in my head that this was iced coffee similar to a iced cafe mocha than a Coke that lost its carbonation. I really don't know where I got that idea because the description is clear "Coffee Drink, Caffe".

Still, it was a surprise when I poured it into a small cup with ice that it was dark like (you guessed it) coffee.

But instead of being disappointed at my unfounded assumption, I went ahead and took a sip and whoa, it was good.

Mind you, I'm not a coffee drinker unless one considers a bit of coffee with cream and sugar to be coffee. My expectations were low and yet, this drink was good. Light, not too sweet, but not bitter either. At 6.8 oz, it was also the right size that it wasn't too much either. It was the perfect pick-me-up post-lunch in fact.

I probably won't have this too much but I'll try to have it now and again. At 50 calories, it is a much better option for a post-lunch treat than the iced white mocha that I get from a well known coffee chain.

So while this drink was different from what I expected, it was a good surprise and I will definitely buy again.

The pain in the butt that is ice cold coffee that retains the depth of flavor when iced is a constant problem. Especially if, like me, you don't want to make a giant pitcher of iced coffee, just one every-so-often.

This was made much easier for me when trying out Illy issimo Coffee Drink. The can was small enough that after I chilled it, opened and poured over ice, there was enough room for flavored creamer! This created a lovely, hazelnutty ice coffee drink without losing the strong, vibrant coffee flavor.

Unlike Starbucks iced coffee drinks, I was able to go sugar free with my creamer. While I am not a black coffee drinker, the flavor of this before adding anything was pleasing and not bitter or have an aftertaste. Personal preferences just dictate creamer for me.

If the world ever runs out of coffee I am in trouble. I'd probably count as addicted if they had a test for it. Which means I am always trying new coffee beverages and such to feed my need.

This one actually was really yucky when I first opened it. I figured it would be better chilled since it's in a can but that actually made it awful! I let it sit until it was room temp and then it was really delicious. Funny how that works eh? I'd probably gravitate more toward the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Latte Macchiato, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) or illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) if I were looking for more but I think I'll stick with the similar canned coffee beverage I've had in the past.

I'd recommend this to the coffee drinker looking for something with sweetness but no cream/dairy.

I really enjoyed this coffee drink.  It has a dark, rich espresso flavor perfect for a hot summer's day, but what I really appreciated the most is that it's not too sweet like many coffee drinks out there. It has just enough sugar to make it tasty and refreshing.  The servings are small in a 6.8 fl oz can so it disappears quickly, but makes for the perfect iced drink and caffeinated pick me up.

After trying both the Illy and Starbucks canned coffees several times I have to say that I much prefer Illy. It's not the taste so much as the smell of the canned/bottled drink itself. While neither packaged coffee drink smells as pleasant as fresh brewed, I prefer the plainer scent of Illy over Starbucks which always smells faintly of "gym bag" to me. (though I'm at a loss of how to explain this)

That said: the Caffe drink is not too bitter or tinny for coffee out of a can. Though it's not difficult to get a coffee on the go, these little cans are convenient for around town or packing on picnics or trips. I've had this straight from the can, over ice, and with a little milk added. It's not too sweet and is a nice pick-me-up.

Normally words like "coffee in a can" would make me want to punch a kitten in the mouth but this had a truly nice effect. It made me feel calmer, less shaky, more like my normal, coffee-needing self. Happier. Granted, i would need a box of them to get through a day but I guess that is splitting hairs because the product has a nice taste, pleasant even, and it is easy to store and hide from my friends who would take and drink it - and then no review. all this combined for an experience that said I was really happy, surprised even, by just how good it tasted.
no kittens were harmed by end of the review.

My workplace doesn't have a coffee maker, and I need my coffee sometimes, so canned coffee has become a staple.

This is probably the best iteration of canned coffee I've ever found. I love whatever they are doing to make the liquid a little thicker. It's subtle, but it makes a big difference. I think the quantity is just right, and it produces a nice energy kick. It's not sugary and it's not full of carbs.

I don't personally prefer this flavor (like another flavor of this product better), but it's a nice, strong, bold espresso flavor. I found it enjoyable, and if that's your favorite flavor, you will be delighted with this. This if for someone who just wants a good strong coffee as opposed to something that tastes like a frappe with whipped cream and sugar.

I think the price for twelve of these is a little steep, so I'll drop a single star, but it is a high quality beverage.

I have to admit that I am not a big fan of coffee, but if it's the right product, I usually love it. Like others who have reviewed this product, I really like the Starbucks bottled frappacinos you can buy in stores, and I figured that I would like this product due to the similarities. This product isn't terrible, but it's not really good either. It had a strong coffee flavor, a little stronger than I like, but there was also a weird aftertaste. I'd have to describe it was sour and bitter, but it wasn't the kind of sour/bitter aftertaste you get sometimes with "bargain" coffee brands; it had a unique bad aftertase all its own. I did like the jolt of energy that it had, but I could get the same amount of energy from tastier drinks. It seems like a lot of people like it, so I don't want to put it down entirely, but for me personally, it wasn't something that I enjoyed.

Usually I like my coffee hot. Part of the ritual of waking up was that aroma of freshly brewing coffee. But the work schedule has changed to mostly nights , and since the wife and I are now only opposite schedules , making a whole pot in the morning is wasteful.
But I still need a boost in the afternoon , and a coworker suggested this. Glad she did. Turns out cold coffee is just as satisfying as hot coffee. The 6.8 oz size seems like just the right amount , and with no significant aftertaste , I can see this as fast becoming part of my afternoon ritual of staying awake !

I love Illy coffee and thought I would enjoy this canned beverage as much as their lovely fresh brewed coffees.
WRONG!!!
There is absolutely no resemblence between Illy's coffee and this "drink." It is bitter, and leaves a very strange "off" taste/feel in your mouth after consumption.

I got this for my husband, who is a coffee addict. His thoughts...

"It had a flowery, bitter taste. I don't want to drink it again."

I enjoyed the illy issimo Coffee Drink. While it is not equal to a freshly made iced coffee, it had a nice, rich coffee flavor and did not taste like the can. For a quick iced coffee drink, it is worth the price, but it is a rather small serving and you will find it gone rather quickly. I would prefer to have it in a larger container.

I do recommend this product.

I'm so glad I discovered this illy product. I dislike canned coffee with milk--and this is basically just espresso and sugar. And good quality espresso to boot. I highly recommend this product if you like espresso and want a can of it to go.

I prefer coffee with only a teaspoon of sugar and hot milk in the morning instead of the highly sweetened foufou drinks. Illy issimo makes a Cappuccino in a can that is too sweet for my taste. This Caffe drink suits me better. The Cappuccino drink I had to tweak with hot frothed milk. This Caffe was good straight from the can, but is a nice morning cup if warmed with the hot frothed milk.

I love coffee and I love espresso, but I've found that I prefer my `shot of espresso' to be accompanied (or to `accompany') something else.  Alone, left unfiltered, the strength of the espresso can be overwhelming.  For me, this illy issimo caffe drink is a tad too concentrated for my taste.  It has a very strong flavor, which many have praised saying that it is very close to the flavor of an espresso, but for me there is a bitter aftertaste that I can't ignore.  The colder you drink this, the stronger the aftertaste and so I found that letting it get closer to room temperature (slightly cooler, but not much) helped make this a more satisfying `sip'.  Still, I'm not as fond of this particular flavor.  I definitely liked the cappuccino flavor more.

Let me first start by saying: I don't drink hot coffee unless forced. I like coffee but I don't like hot drinks. I go for iced, or cold, or cold drinks like this product. I tried both the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)and far prefer this product.

The taste is bold, smooth, and doesn't have the gritty texture that some canned coffees can bring with them. The taste is good, the feeling is good, and the aftertaste is just like the coffee, not a strange variation of it.

I had a little issue with the cappuccino version becuase it had a bit of an emulsified oily feel on the tongue, but this one is good to go. And at only 50 calories, I would always choose this option. The can is very small and would easily fit in a pocket, purse or bag if you wanted to take it to work or on a trip with you.

Enjoyed and recommended.

I have liked other illy issimo products, but not this one.  It's too bitter!  I didn't taste any sweetness.  In fact, to me, it tasted like 2 day old coffee mixed with tap water.  The first taste was not so bad - it was ok'ish, but the bitterness and feeling that it was just old stale coffee kept getting stronger and stronger.  It's nothing like the real thing over ice, even though I drank it well chilled.  I don't think I could have drank it at all any other way.  I'm giving it 2 stars though because it was a very effective pick up - the caffeine content gets a star by itself.

Nice flavor- I would have preferred it slightly sweeter, but as some other reviewers have said it's too sweet, that's clearly a personal preference.

While the convenience is great, for the price, I'd rather get an iced coffee (with actual ice!) from the local coffee place. The serving size is fairly small (basically the same size as half a can of soda- not much at all if you like coffee), as well. But the portability is pretty great- it'd be good for grabbing on a hurry or if you're headed out to a picnic or some sort of day out somewhere and need to bring coffee with you.

I found the illy issimo Caffe Espresso flavored coffee drink to be drinkable but it is not a drink I plan to consume on any sort of a regular basis.

While the drink does have an espresso-like taste, it is too bitter and watery to be worth over $2 for a 6.8 oz can. Further, its espresso flavor is just acceptable, nothing special. In addition to my considering this product to be just an average, at best, drink, I found it gave me such a strong caffeine jolt that for over an hour after finishing it I had a bit of a pressure headache.

If I made my usual morning coffee in my coffee maker (I like it a little on the strong side), added a bit of sweetener and then put it in the refrigerator to cool down for about 24 hours, I would have this drink. Pretty much exactly this drink. The first thing I thought of when I took my initial swallow was that it tasted just like cold coffee. The sweetness was just about where I like it - not too sweet, but not bitter either. I can see where buying these small, 6.8 fluid oz. cans would be much easier and more convenient than making your own cold, black coffee if you tend to like it cold and take it with you in a hurry. I'd down about 3 of these every morning if I could afford them.

It tastes fine, really does. I prefer cream with my coffee but I still thought this tasted pretty good - again, just like cold, black, slightly sweetened coffee. I found it smooth and easy to drink. I like ice-coffee and usually make it later in the day from the morning's left-over sitting in the pot. It has 155 mg of caffeine per can so I would assume it could be used as an energy booster for that lag time during the day around 2:00 - 4:00 pm. The reason for 3 stars is though it tastes just like cold coffee, there is really nothing to distinguish it as something unusually wonderful and unique.

And though I did not see it until after I had done it, at the very top of the can it says, "Do not shake". Why, I don't know. I shook it good and hard before opening. I guess they just want to keep bubbles from forming but I don't think the shaking altered the taste or texture whatsoever.

For a canned coffee drink this is pretty tasty. Its not overpowering in its strength, nor is it overly sugary either. Its a nice balance and definitely tastes like coffee.

I would like the cans to be a bit bigger, but what could I expect for a 45 calorie drink? Even if you downed two or three, you'd still be making a much better nutritional choice than a regular iced coffee with cream from the 'bucks (which I truly love but do not for a second pretend is low calorie in any way).

This is rather like the illy cappuccino in a can.  Kind of bland, vaguely metal.  I'm not sure if this was supposed to be refrigerated or at room temperature, but then I'm not sure it would matter.  I wouldn't call myself a connoisseur of coffee, but still, this just didn't interest me.
This particular flavor is not my favorite, it's strong and very bitter.  I prefer the cappuchinno flavor to this.

I was sent this illy issimo Caffe Coffee Drink by Amazon Vine for review. Here's my take on it.

I love good strong coffee, espressos, lattes and cappuccino. I did not love this drink. I was looking for a strong coffee taste. Instead I got a diluted drink with a noticeable low-fat taste and a somewhat unusual aftertaste. The coffee flavor was non-existent, the low-fat milk flavor overpowering. Perhaps chilled over ice would improve the drinking experience, but I'm not interested enough to try another can.

On the good side: the beverage contains only 50 calories.

Illy Issimo is a 6.8-ounce coffee treat in a can. I chilled mine in the refrigerator and drank it as a pick-me-up at work. Illy issimo coffee drink is smooth (there is no bitterness that is sometimes associated with iced coffee). Illy issimo is slightly sweet as well. It's a bit sweeter than simply one lump in a cup of coffee, but less sweet than a Cafe Cubana (espresso with sugar).

Illy issimo is a tasty coffee treat: it has the smooth bold taste of an espresso coffee sweetened with the right amount of sugar. Tastes great and very refreshing served chilled. A lot fewer calories and a lot more satisfying than a soda, I will stock illy issimo in my office fridge.

A few notes about the product:

50 Calories per can
Sodium 20mg
Total carb 12g
*Fiber 1g
*Sugars 10g
Caffeine 155mg

Ingredients: Coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, potassium citrate, "may contain trace amounts of milk"

In a nutshell: Strong coffee with low sugar and no cream. Nice energy drink alternative.

What it is: Coca-Cola's foray into canned coffee market (there was one?) in America. This is Caffe version, which they say is "Italian espresso style coffee drink." In actuality, it's a simple drink with 4 ingredients: coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, and potassium citrate (latter two as preservative, probably--although the can says it has no preservatives). If you count the water and milk (as the can warns that it "may contain traces of milk"), 6 ingredients. The can notes that it has 155mg of caffeine per can--roughly double that of Red Bull. Only have 50 calories per can--which is a plus, and impressive given that it has no artificial sweetner.

How it is: Strong without being acidic, with a hint of sugar. It's pretty smooth, but does have a noticeable bitter signature. I could not chug this thing. Note: the can says "do not shake." I'm not sure if you should drink it as is, though; wouldn't coffee need to be mixed? Anyway, if you plan on shaking it, let it sit for a while after doing so; it squirts coffee all over the place when I tried to open it right after shaking. Lesson learned. The kick from the caffeine is very much noticeable. Definitely a good thing to have for a quick pick-me-up.

In conclusion: You don't have to drink Red Bull for caffeine. And you don't have to pick up a Starbucks Doubleshot (choke full of sugar and cream) as an alternative, either. I think it's a nice product.

Caveat: Groceries will sell these for much cheaper.
I love this coffee.  This little can pops you in the mouth.  Nice bitter punch on the palate and kicks you in the gut.  The way I like my coffee.

I like coffee. I do. Particularly iced. Now full disclaimer here: my norm is a cold brewed coffee so I am used to a very different coffee, but I also partake in the the weekly coffeehouse drink or rare canned drink like the type I am reviewing here. When I saw on its page that it was claiming to be "bold" and an "espresso-style coffee drink with a touch of sweetness" at only 45 calories? Well sign me up! I figured worse case scenario well I'd dump it into a cup o' milk. How wrong I was. It was just bitter and nasty and wrong. I never did figure out if it was the coffee itself or that "touch of sweetness" but something in this tiny little can was not right and no amount of milk made it right. I finally gave up, dumping it out, wasting a perfectly good cup o' milk.

Shame, I had high hopes for it.

A few weeks ago, I tried the illy issimo Cappuccino coffee drink, and didn't care for it. Part of it's probably because I rarely drink coffee, but I wasn't too thrilled about drinking what looked like brown water in a can. The Caffe flavor here doesn't fare any better, and I literally spit it out upon taking the first sip.

Normally I'd go into the pros and cons about the product, like I do with my other reviews, but I can't think of anything to say other than I didn't like it. The flavor was an insult to my taste buds, it's still a gross-looking clear brown color, and while it might not be that bad for you as far as nutrition goes, you can still do better.

I'm going to leave this one to coffee regulars who are used to this kind of taste.

I love illy coffee. I think it is among the finest in the world. I even enjoy illy iced coffee in the can--but not this version. It tasted like bland epresso mixed with nonsparkling seltzer. Only 50 calories but I wIsh they added more calories if it meant this would be tastier. Not sweet at all. Sorry illy. It is a miss.

It definitely tastes like espresso...bitter and strong. It doesn't necessarily translate to a chilled drink that well, in my opinion. It's good, just not great. If you're really looking for that espresso flavor in chilled form, this is recommended. Otherwise, stick with their cappuccino version...it tastes much better.

I liked the Issimo cappucino drink, so I thought I would give this a try...the taste is horrible! I've had other expresso drinks (both hot and cold), so I thought I knew what to expect, but this tasted so vile that I could barely finish it. The only good thing I can say is that it definitely gives a boost to the afternoon lag.

This was a really unsatisfactory beverage in taste and aftereffects. I'm not a huge fan of coffee in a can or jar, having partaken of two widely nationally available brands and found them lacking for a coffee fanatic such as myself (consuming an average of 4-6 cups a day). I was hoping that the Italians (via Denmark, where this product is made) would get it right. Sadly, the Illy Espresso company has failed abysmally with this product. The weird thing was that it tasted fine for the first sip: a nice, bracing bittersweet espresso flavor. The second sip, it seemed a little tinny. Then it was salty. But I was committed to finishing this drink to the full, 6.8 fluid ounce end. The bitter end. Because while I got a faint coffee buzz, I also got major heartburn and a stomachache within a half hour of consumption. I'm guessing as an amateur chemist that adding baking soda (potassium bicarbonate, 20 mg sodium per serving in the drink) with an alkaline Ph interacts negatively with coffee's more acid Ph.  Well, I've popped an antacid, and I will say that this product has convinced me that there are no shortcuts in life. If you want decent coffee, make it yourself. This product contains 156 mg of caffeine per serving. If that's what you're looking for, there are other options that won't feel like you drank battery acid.

I am a coffee freak; I probably need to find a support group. Coffee is one of my pleasures that I fully embrace and I have no problem admitting it. However, I am a standard coffee guy. I don't like the coffee drinks that aren't really coffee, those mixtures that have tons of cream, flavor, sugar, syrup, whip cream, flavor shots and one drop of coffee. I am a standard coffee drink with a touch of cream and sugar. Oh and it should be noted I love my coffee HOT. I am not really a fan of iced coffee.

This brings us to this canned coffee beverage that is served cool. I will confess, I have had a couple of ice coffee drinks that didn't taste bad, if mixed properly and having the right balance of cream and sugar. Yet this isn't my preferred method of consumption. Notwithstanding, I decided to give this can of espresso a chance. After I chilled it over night I gave it a taste. I must confess the flavor is very nice and smooth. There is no cream in this beverage, just a hint of sweetness. I found this to promote a nice balance. I could tell by the taste a high end blend of coffee was use to make this product.

Overall, I am still a guy who will always grab his hot coffee before an ice coffee. Yet this little can really has a good flavor. Perhaps it is the fact that the star of this drink is the coffee itself. There are no flavors or syrups that distract from the coffee, which makes this drink very enjoyable. In addition, the drink isn't all that big, under 7oz and at 50 calories this beverage is better for the waist than some of the fluffy faux coffee beverages out there. So coming from a real coffee drinker, I would recommend this drink if I decided that I wanted to venture towards a cooler cup of coffee.

I like coffee, and although I don't really drink it every day, sometimes I just really crave the flavor. I might tackle that craving with a regular cup of coffee, some coffee flavored ice cream or a cold coffee drink.

I occasionally like a latte or espresso drink, but usually have them hot. I was interested in the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè flavor when I saw it and decided I had to try it.

While I like a nice hot espresso, I have to say I don't much care for this drink. It definitely does remind me of a cold espresso, but apparently I don't much like my espresso cold.

I don't think this is a fault of the way the drink is made - more likely it just doesn't suit my taste. I should mention that I have also tried illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) and liked it better than this Caffè flavor.

While I don't necessarily care for it, I think it may appeal to others. If you like strong coffee drinks that aren't sweet and think the flavor sounds good to you, I'd recommend giving it a try. If you prefer a milder coffee drink that is sweeter, you will find the cappuccino flavor more to your liking.

That is the third ingredient. Potassium citrate is the fourth.

Is potassium bicarbonate a "natural" ingredient, since it is found rarely in nature? I drink coffee every day and have never added these two chemicals to my cup of coffee.

I have read that potassium citrate is used as a diuretic, particularly in veterinary treatments. Was it really necessary to add these two chemicals to the "Espresso Style" coffee mix? If it had been nothing but plain black coffee of typical good illy quality, then it would have rated a 5. I will not be buying it.

This is the first canned coffee drink that I have tried, and I have to admit it's not for me. The flavor was strong and too bitter for my preferences.

If that's what you are looking for, though, this is right up your alley. I'll keep my coffee hot and in a mug.

I love coffee. I love iced coffee. I do not like this. It's not good. I am pretty tolerant of tastes being a little off, but this is way off. It has a stange consistency too. Almost like it is carbonated a little. I couldn't even finish this and I did give it a chance. I studied business in Italy for several months and love a good espresso and even like it chilled. This is not even close to being something I would crave. This is one of the few 'do not buy this' reviews, but I can't recommend this product.

EDIT: I love coffee, but to me, this drink is just strong coffee grounds mixed with water. It has a potent aftertaste and a grainy texture. Hours after I drank a few sips (couldn't handle much after a few) and brushed my teeth, I could still taste this! Very unappealing. This product is definitely not for me.

If you've read any of my other reviews regarding coffee, you know I'm a coffee lover... and I like it strong!  The illy issimo caffé Italian espresso style coffee drink met my expectations.  I divided my 6.8 fl oz can into 3 portions, so that I could try it in different ways.  I had it in a mug after warming it in the microwave and then warmed with some milk, as well as in a glass over ice.  Since it is a little sweet, I preferred it with milk or over ice.  However, it's not bad alone, and would probably be good chilled straight out of the can.  It is made primarily with natural Arabica beans and sugar, with 50 calories and 12g carb per serving.  It also has 20 mg of sodium and 155 mg of caffeine.  I like it!

The history of illy issimo coffee dates back to 1933 in Trieste, Italy. With decades of experience and accomplishments the brand has become a favorite of chefs and barristas in Italy and around the world.
This 6.8-ounce can of illy issimo Italian espresso-style coffee with 155 mg caffeine has a strong flavorful full-bodied taste with a touch of sweetness. I found it a big energizer. The ingredients are a blend of 100% Arabica coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate. There are only 45 calories per can. The label says illy issimo's bold, full-bodied, Italian espresso-style coffee is made with the finest natural ingredients and will "awaken the senses while you're on-the-go." I can vouch for that.

I was very disappointed when I found this coffed drink contained sugar. I drink my coffee & expresso black, and I find soft drinks to be too sweet and thick. I dilute diet colas with sparkling water.

So it was really nice to try this coffee drink, and find that the bitterness and the sweetness were in a nice balance, to my taste. And the thickness than many sugared soft drinks have was not present in this drink.

I'd still prefer an unsweetened version, but this was a nice surprise.

The great thing about Illy Issimo Coffee Drink for me was that fact that I could sip on it in my office and actually feel it giving me that added boost that I needed.

Hot coffee in the a.m. is a normal thing for me, but to have something cool, refreshing and energizing in the middle of the day is a welcome experience. Not to be gulped down for sure. This is one of those drinks you will want to take your time and enjoy.

Nice coffee break and only 50 calories. I am not a huge coffee drinker and prefer my coffee hot, but I still thought this product was pretty good. Now my husband is much more of a coffee drinker and he really liked this product.
It definitely provides full-bodied coffee flavor and the fact that this only chalks up 50 claories is a huge plus. I also think the size is just right--although my first impression was that is was a bit small.

I found this cold coffee beverage to be pleasant. It has a full-bodied coffee aroma, and a nice smooth coffee flavor. There are fifty calories worth of sweetener in it, meaning it is a sweetened coffee, but only mildly so. I enjoyed it over ice. As it comes in the can, it is a straight sweetened coffee beverage with no cream. It is enjoyable as it is, though I enjoyed it most with a bit of milk added and over ice.
