It contains 155 mg of caffeine (a can of Mountain Dew contains 54 mg and Red Bull contains 80 mg, by comparison), so it could serve as an "energy drink." It's not fresh-brewed coffee, but if you have a taste for chilled coffee beverages and are turned off by the overly sweetened varieties that are usually available cold, this one may be worth a try. It is expensive, though, and it seems overpriced for what you get. Though the flavor is good, I think I will settle for a cheaper alternative. It doesn't live up to a good cold-press coffee in my estimation.

This Illy product is the first one to actually capture true espresso flavor in a can. Sweetened the way one needs to bring out the full caramel complexity of the bean. If you like dark coffee, and want a can without dairy (or prefer to add your own milk) this is a very nice option.

"illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè" packs a potent coffee hit in a small package with only 50 calories. Of course, because the coffee flavor was so rich, after a few sips I took the opportunity to make a fabulous dessert drink. I poured the "illy issimo" coffe drink into a large, tall glass, and added a big spoonful of sugar and some whole milk (cream would be even better). I stirred it well and added some ice, and the rest is history. Yum, yum, yum! How convenient to have such coffee richness in a small, portable package. Perfect on its own, but full of possibilities!

This illy issimo Coffee Drink Caffè from Coca~Cola / Coke - is really strong, just like a Caffè or Cafè Expresso should be: whereas frankly I am surprised it lacks a surname of "Expresso" added on to it! It packs a lot of punch into it, so if you are a Caffè or Cafè Expresso lover - YOU WILL LOVE THIS no doubts about it. ONLY 50 CALORIES IN A CAN! However the name of Expresso is in tiny print on the back of the can pertaining to the history; but I feel it still should be up front and just under the label. EXPRESSO LOVERS - THIS ONE'S FOR YOU!

I received both the Caffe and Cappuccino versions and did a side-by-side taste comparison to see which of the two I might prefer over the other.

First I tried the Caffe version and was surprised to discover it was just black coffee. I prefer cream in my coffee, so I was hesitant to taste it as it was. But I tasted it and found it to have a nice medium coffee strength with a bit of sweetness to it. In my everyday coffee I don't add sugar, but on occasion it's nice to have a special coffee drink, and since it's been hot here lately, I had poured it over ice as well. I added cream and found it to be quite enjoyable. It's one of those conveniences that one could easily become addicted to.

Next I tried the Cappuccino which had a similar taste and flavor as the Caffe, but was milder. I prefer my coffee stronger, so my preference was for the Caffe and still I would have liked it stronger (perhaps this is offered in another version). But the Cappuccino was also good and I had poured it over ice as well. I was concerned about both coffees being packaged in cans as I don't like my drinks to have a metallic tinge to them, but I did not notice anything out of the ordinary. I had, however, poured the drinks over ice into a glass, so that may have helped. Regardless, it was really nice to have sitting out on my deck on a warm day. Hot coffee just does not sit well with me in hot weather.

All-in-all, if you're looking for a mild, sweet coffee drink that's quick and easy to take with you on the go or to pour into a glass at home, this is a good choice. It's small and convenient to slip into a purse or briefcase. While the coffee is mild, it still gives a quick pick-me-up in the morning, or in the middle of the day if need be.

I have tried the cappuccino version of this drink (which is great), and was excited to try this drink, following the instructions I did not shake. I opened the drink and took a sip, the coffee is strong and has a full body, and has a good taste (for canned coffee), however (I am not sure if this is from transport, or what), the coffee is very watered down and I feel like I am tasting mostly a watered down coffee (like iced coffee where the ice has melted). The watered down taste of the coffee sticks with you, so be prepared to need something to clean your palate afterwards.

I do not know if the one I got went through some sort of shock or excess moisture phase during shipping to fridge, but I found it to taste watered down (not sure if it was just mine or all), the coffee is very strong and has a bold taste, but due to the watering down it takes a way from the flavor and makes it tough to drink.

Calories 50
Total Fat 0g
Sodium 20mg

Fiber 1g
Sugars 10g
Protein 0g

Ingredients: Coffee, Sugar, Potassium Bicarbonate, Potassium Citrate

I am not a hot coffee drinker, but I occasionally enjoy some of the iced coffee varities and I wanted to give this a try. It is not a drink for me. I could not take more than two sips of this. It has a VERY strong coffee taste and to me is very bitter. If you love the taste of coffee, you will probably enjoy this.

This coffee drink was surprisingly much better than expected considering the other reviews I read. Its a cold Espresso drink. Upon its arrival I stuck the can in the fridge for a couple days for it to chill. I took it out, opened it and poured into a glass. It has a rich coffee flavor without any bitterness reported by the other reviewers and it wasn't sweet to me. The can states not to shake, and I think the wording means > No Need to Shake.
I think the secret to this little caffe on the go is to make sure its good and cold.

If you find yourself out on the road past your bedtime, you may be looking for something to keep you awake. There are endless concoctions available: colas, 'energy drinks', tablets. Here's another. This little can packs a fairly potent wallop that comes on in just a few minutes. It has a sweetened coffee-like taste that isn't bad--but that's not the point.

It's called espresso, but it really isn't. There are none of the aromatics that make the experience of espresso what it is. At home, I'll take the time to grind the beans and brew a real cup. But if you're looking for that teeth-gritting buzz that keeps you between the median line and the shoulder of the road, this might do it.
i like illy in general and this makes a very drink.  a little bit more bitter than illy cappuccino and just the right size.

To me the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffe had a very bitter taste to it. I was not smooth as I expected it to be. It also has an after taste which I did not like. It is strong like Coffee and Expresso sould be, but I don't think it should it be bitter.

Illy Issimo's Coffee Drink is slightly sweetened with sugar and contains 155mg of caffeine.  The taste is mild and their is little aroma.  The aftertaste is unpleasant and otherwise the drink tastes like coffee that has sat out for a while.

Recently I tried Illy's Cappucino product and I loved it. I decided ti give it a try with Caffe, Italian Espresso style coffee drink. Drink comes is a small 6.8 oz can that is easy to pack and carry. I drank my coffee cold. One cannot go wrong with drinking it on room temperature either. Can does not require shaking; drink contains 50 calories and no fat. This drink is stronger than cappucino and a little bit bitter. There is disticnt flavor and strenght in each drink. I liked both, but my preference in the morning is coffee with some milk in it. For that reason, I would recommend Caffe as afternon "pick me up" type of drink.

This product is made in Italy and it is distributed in USA by Coca-Cola company. This fine Arabica bean coffee will give you Italian espresso experience. There is nothing better than an old world coffee drink (in my opinion).

For those who are going on a hike, a run, or basically anywhere else you can't get a decent coffee, Illy Issimo Coffee Drink isn't a bad idea. I didn't think it was overly sweet, and when cold, it tasted okay for a canned coffee. However, if given the choice between making my own iced coffee and putting it into a travel cup, or grabbing one of Illy Issimo canned coffee, I would opt for the travel mug iced coffee. Two main reasons - 1) one less can to go into the trash (or recycling, if lucky) and 2) homemade iced coffee tastes a LOT better. In fact, here is a recipe that's easy AND stores well: [...]

That aside, Illy Issimo isn't too bad. It may not appeal to all however (my husband thought it tasted awful), so I would definitely try before you buy it in bulk.

I'm a fan of coffee, but I like it sweet. I want to taste the flavor of the coffee, but the sweetness adds depth and richness to it. This little coffee in a can was good, but not as sweet as I prefer.

This is my second Illy coffee drink to try and review- Again I wasn't disappointed. It had a nice strong coffee flavor, not too sugary.. Gave me the perfect coffee fix!! The perfect on the go drink when I don't have time to brew my own. I will be purchasing more of Illy coffee drinks in the future- Love my Starbucks but their drinks have gotten more sugary for me!

I'm a coffee drinker, and an energy drink drinker as well.  This product was a decent, but not incredible mix between the two.  The Caffe tasted like a cold shot of expresso, with lots of sugary sweetness added to it.  I did notice a little pick me up for a couple hours before it wore off.  For the price it isn't bad, it works at keeping you awake, but I probably would just drink a cup of hot coffee instead of this next time.  If you're a cold coffee drinker, you may be more inclined to like it.

Well, reviews for this drink are all over the place, so I can't say my review is definitive. Anyway, this drink met with negative results, here - too sweet and rich, but, it would be best to judge for yourself or look at several reviews. For me, not being a regular coffee drinker, I prefer a cold Coca Cola or iced tea, rather than any iced coffee drink anytime. Plus, at about $2 for a can, too expensive for me - but I'm a cheapskate, so keep that in mind.

I sampled the caffe flavor. illy issimo comes in five flavors: caffe, caffe no sugar, cappuccino, mochaccino, and latte macchiato.

Unless you like iced coffee to begin with, and then iced espresso to boot, you probably won't like this product. This has no dairy type ingredients, so you will either need to drink this "black" or add something to it. I tried it straight out of the can into a glass, chilled. It was really strong, as in very bitter.

I softened it a bit by adding some skim milk and sugar. Even though this is sweetened with beet sugar, the bitterness far overpowers any hint of sweetness. I added about 3 teaspoons of sugar, and then used about two ounces of milk mixed with this 6.8 ounce can. That made it more palatable. I then added some crushed ice and poured some over the ice. Better yet.

All in all I would say this is for only hard core iced coffee drinkers. If you lean more toward a sweet coffee with lots of sugar, this probably isn't going to be up your alley.

But if you are an iced coffee drinker and like the bold taste of espresso, you might want to give this a whirl.

I personally preferred the cappuccino, but I am not exactly a "real" coffee drinker. For people who enjoy a stronger flavor, this is the drink! It has a bold flavor with minimal bitterness (considering its strength) and only a hint of milk and sugar. The size is smaller than the cappuccino drink, yet it has much more caffeine and fewer calories, so in terms of bang for your buck, this drink is an excellent way to start the day, especially during the summer. Here are some numbers relating to the content of this drink, as well as info on the Illy Cappucino 8.45-Ounce Cans, in case you wanted to compare:

Illy Caffè, 6.8-Ounce Cans (THIS product)
50 calories, 155mg caffeine, 0g fat, 10g sugars, 0g protein

Illy Cappucino 8.45-Ounce Cans (The other one I tried and reviewed, which is milder and sweeter)
100 calories, 81mg caffeine, 1.5g fat, 18g sugars, 4g protein
Sludgy, thick, burnt coffee grounds is what comes to mind after one swallow of this concoction.  If you can finish the rest, more power to you.

Yes, I'm a coffee junkie. I really liked this drink. Smooth and just sweet enough. It's not really that strong so unless you like really weak coffee, I dont recommend putting it over ice.

The only problem I had with this drink is the 6.8oz can wasn't big enough.

Thank you.
MEF

Generally, I love coffee. I prefer hot coffee made from fresh ground beans and I drink it black. I've tried many of both iced coffee beverages and coffees with espresso shots from the big chain, and I've found them completely delightful, though expensive. Unfortunately, this canned, low-calorie Italian espresso style coffee drink is a no-go for me.

I'm assuming this is to be served cool from the refrigerator, although I'm certain my reaction wouldn't be any different had I drank it at room temperature. The texture is unsatisfactorily grainy. The flavor is unpleasantly off, either from beans that aren't bold enough or from a mixture of ingredients that ruins the flavor of a good bean - either way, I didn't enjoy it.

It's a 50 calorie beverage; with a low 20mg sodium and 12g in carbs, so it balances out nutritionally for a coffee drink. The beet sugar is where it gets its 4g of fiber, its 10g of sugars and likely the peculiar graininess.

This is a convenient on-the-go option for someone who likes coffee, but I like coffee, and I do not like this.

I sampled this product and was not impressed. It took me several sittings to make it through this can. It's metallic, bitter and not a pleasant caffeine beverage. Although NOT a coffee connoisseur, I suspect one would better appreciate the bold bite this beverage delivers. I'm not sure if this was the only coffee available I'd choose it again. There are better tasting options available and also at better price-points.

This is the first canned coffee I've tried. I found it to be a major disappointment. It was very bitter. I know other reviewers have said it was sweet. I certainly could not taste any sweetness at all. There was a definite metallic edge that I did not enjoy. We poured it into several glasses and had a panel of judges try it, all of whom love their coffee. Not one person finished it. "Ick!" was the overwhelming response.

The ingredients in this product are: coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate. It has 10 grams of sugar. Note this does not have a dairy product ingredient in it.

This is a thin consistency drink with a bold bitter coffee taste. I detect no sweetness at all, although it has 10 grams of sugar.

I like the taste of bold coffee with french roast or cofee and chickory New Orleans style or Vietnamese style coffee drinks. This was bold and strong but a thin consistency and bitter despite the sugar added.

This drink did nothing for me. I prefer a real cup of hot coffee with half and half to give it a creamy consistency, or I like a strong coffee iced coffee drink or I like an espresso based coffee drink or a frozen Frappuccino type of drink. I love strong coffee that's bold. I usually only use one sugar in a large coffee so I don't like it super-sweet by any means. This is just bitter and I rate it 2 stars = I Don't Like It.

There are other iced canned or iced bottled prepared coffee drinks, milk or no milk products that I prefer the taste of such as the ones made by Starbucks (i.e. glass bottled Frappuccino) or the little aluminum cans of espresso drinks such as Starbucks DoubleShot.

The world changed for the me the first time I tried a bottle of Starbucks Mocha Frappucino about 10 years ago. The product tasted better than the one you get in store, and the convenience of being able to grab a bottle of a Frappucino and take it to the office was great. Illy's Issimo Caffè "Coffee Drink" comes in a sharp-looking six-ounce can, so there's no disputing the convenience of the product. However, the taste was another matter - flat, bland, and underwhelming. In fact, if I had to rate the flavor of all the packaged coffee drinks I've tried over the years, this would be close to the bottom of the list. Perhaps their other drinks pack more of a flavor punch, but Issimo Caffè Coffee Drink was a disappointment.

If your idea of a cold, bottled coffee drink is something on the order of a Starbuck's Frappucino, you're going to be disappointed with the illy issimo coffee drink. Don't get me wrong, I'm a fan of the Starbuck's frap, but you don't have to read the ingredients list to realize that both sugar and milk probably come before coffee. Although the illy issimo contains a touch of sugar, it leaves you with no doubt that the main ingredient is coffee: strong, espresso-type coffee.

I enjoyed the illy issimo caffé, and if you're a veteran coffee drinker who likes espresso, you'll probably like it, too. No, it doesn't compare to freshly brewed espresso, but what does? I drank this cold, straight up, but it has enough flavor to hold its own over ice, too. The small can is reminiscent of the small size of espresso cups. I don't buy ready-made coffee drinks very often, partly because I own the Mr. Coffee Frappe Maker (Mr. Coffee BVMC-FM1 20-Ounce Frappe Maker) and can whip up a fresh coffee drink quickly and easily, but when I'm out and about, the illy issimo caffé will be high on my list of choices.

I have not had very many espresso drinks so I do not have the palate to determine if it is a traditional flavor or not.  I found the taste pleasant.  Not too strong and not overly sweet.  My husband had a sip and hence the title of my review.  I would gladly purchase this product to keep in the house or to have on trips.  Do not think I will find it in grocery aisle at my local store.

I am a routine coffee drinker (Starbucks) but not a connoisseur by any measure. I also understand everyone's taste is different so keep that in mind as you read this review.

This product has a very strong taste so much so that I was somewhat surprised. The packaging indicates it is made with 100% Arabica coffee and only natural ingredients at 45 calories. I found it very a little creamy, strong, dark, lightly sweet, with a strong kick. Some may want to add sweetener to it in an effort to balance the flavor. I personally found the coffee tastes much better over ice with added sweetener. I suspect coffee connoisseur's will appreciate the taste more than I do however. It's distinct advantage is that it is ready made and easily pack-able.

Ultimately, I will not be buying this product because it does not suit me personally.

Illy's ready-made coffee is the perfect espresso-style drink for someone on the go, with no time to brew a cup. Made with a distinct blend of 100% Arabica coffee, this bold beverage has a fresh coffee taste that's both cool and refreshing.

It's flavored with just enough sweetness to make it enjoyable, but not so much that it's no longer coffee. It has an authentic European flavor to it and contains only natural ingredients. The 6.8 oz. can has only 45 calories. It tastes good either cold or warmed.

For reference, my "morning coffee" is a doubleshot of espresso, hot and very lightly sweetened with brown sugar in the winter, unsweetened over ice in the summer.

This morning, I had this, first on its own (ick), and then over ice (slightly better). There is no part of me that's tempted to replace my morning routing with a can of this, easy as it might be.

Really, it wasn't horrible. It tasted an awful lot like the other big brand's version of this, which, unfortunately (and I know this sounds horrible), tastes to me like, well, like coffee smells when it's exiting the body. Maybe this is just me, but it's something of a turn-off, and is true for both that other brand and for this one.

I didn't really enjoy the texture of this drink, either -- kind of syrupy and thick, when it seems like without cream it should be pretty watery. It was also waaaay sweeter than I would ever want my coffee to be, but given that I generally prefer an unsweetened cold coffee, I'm not sure how much stock you want to put in that.

Overall, if you like that other brand's version of this product, I don't see why you wouldn't like this, but if you're hoping for something better -- I don't think this is it.

This coffee Drink was amazing!  I loved how easy it was to just grab out of the fridge and drink!  It was especially delicious poured into a cup filled with ice!  I enjoyed every sip and felt ready to start the day after drinking it!  One of my new favorites that I'll keep on drinking!  I would have liked the can to have a screw lid rather than the pop can type of opening style, as then I wouldn't have needed to drink it right away without worrying about it spilling all over.  Other than that, I really enjoyed this product!

Tastes like an iced coffee with a little sugar added.  It's a little thin, like a traditional ice coffee where the ice has melted to water it down a bit.  The coffee flavor is probably a little light for most people who like dark bold coffee, and probably a little dark for people who like light coffee.  It's right in the middle.  It's not exceptional, but tastes fine.

Illy coffee beans make amazing, if very expensive, coffee. I consider it a special treat, since I can't afford it regularly. It seems almost wrong to put it in a can, but the flavor profile does hold up overall. This is primarily because unlike other canned drinks, this coffee is not super sweet or filled with strange ingredients. It has a very small amount of sugar and that is about it.

If you are a fan of iced coffee that tastes like coffee rather than a cup of sugar and cream, you will likely enjoy this brand. It is only surprising in how unsurprising it is.

I really love the intense coffee taste to this drink. It's like an ice cold Italian espresso with a little cream and sugar. The ingredients are all natural (no preservatives) and the 155 mg. of caffeine is a nice energy boost. One can is only 50 calories. Love it!
This coffee is drinkable, but do not expect it to be anything extraordinary. Not too sweet. Not much aroma or taste, but not too bad either. I liked the cappuccino variety of the drink a bit better.

At 45 calories per 6.8 ounce can, I guess this drink is an okay mid-day boost, if you like chilled coffee and/or you can't get a freshly brewed cup.  I  love coffee, but wasn't impressed with this chilled espresso drink.  I wouldn't buy it.

I love coffee but usually drink it hot with milk and sugar. While I liked how this one made me feel I found the taste to be bitter and too strong.

I let my partner have a sip, and she loved it. So this is definitely for people who enjoy stronger iced coffee.

illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cafe, is exactly what it promises to be: strong, black, sweet Italian espresso.

At 45 calories a can, it's sweeter than I would personally choose, but not too sweet to enjoy.
I drink mine cold and straight from the can in an attempt to wake up and greet the day.

The can warns, 'do not shake,' and that's not because it's carbonated or fizzy; it's a full can and shaking causes enough expansion for the drink to spew (think Mt. Etna).

Coffee preference is a very personal issue; we each have our favorite brands and brews. For me Illy is at the top of the list. So, if you like Peet's Italian Roast or Starbucks Cafe Verona, this may be a brew for you.

Drink it cold from the can and pry those eyes open!

I had this after trying their Cappucino flavor, which was also good.  I personally liked this one even more than that though.  My only complaint is that the 6.8 ounce can is smaller than I want.  9 or 12 ounces is my preferred size for a drink like this.

Well, I'm not sure what I can really say about this - it's literally JUST coffee in a can with a tiny bit of sugar. I DO appreciate that there isn't much sugar, i really hate super-sweet canned coffee drinks. But i guess I'm a light-weight when it comes to coffee because i just couldn't drink this from the can, i had to pour it in a glass and add milk to it. The coffee is very strong and very bitter. But i guess if you like drinking cold black coffee with a dash of sugar, then this is the drink for you!

I did like this drink. It provides good and real coffee taste without a lot of sweetness and no dairy ( or fake dairy) .
I like this better than any of the canned starbucks drinks.

The drawbacks are the price and small can size. Due to the price I will probably not buy this regularly, but it is convenient and fairly healthy.

This is a great product for those that enjoy iced coffee, and strong. I prefer strong coffee with milk, so this one was a bit strong for me. This one is definitely a power shot for if you're on the go and looking for a jolt. It has a very rich flavor, but was a bit strong for my taste. I think I would enjoy a selection that had milk and perhaps, flavored, with this kind of strength. Not for me, but definitely a rich, bold flavor.

A hot cup of coffee (preferably with creamer or foamed milk) is my preferred way to start the day, but I thought I'd try out one of the cold coffee drinks just to see what I'd been missing. The product description uses the phrase "Full-bodied," which is definitely an understatement; despite the high sugar content, a can of illy issimo's Caffe has an extremely bitter flavor that's almost biting.

The first sip almost stopped me cold in my tracks because it was rather unpleasant at first, but like coffee in general, it takes a little while to start to really appreciate the flavor. There's a bit of a sweet aftertaste from the sugar, and the coffee itself will appeal to anyone who likes a darker roast. On the energy front, you will get a serious caffeine jolt just from one can.

I still prefer a cup of hot coffee with creamer, but this isn't a bad on-the-go choice for anyone who likes a darker, more bitter flavor and doesn't mind iced versions of coffee.

This is a canned espresso drink. So, it does not have any milk or cream, but it does have sugar.

I don't normally take sugar or sweetener in my coffee, so this product was a little on the sweet side for my taste. However, for someone who does sweeten their coffee, this would probably be just right.

The can did not list any serving suggestions. So, as and experiment, I tried some cold and some heated in the microwave. I definitely preferred this drink cold. In my opinion, heating the product seemed to lessen the flavor.

All in all I liked this product. But, given a choice, I would rather have freshly made espresso. That being said, I would buy this drink again for convenience, perhaps when travelling.

Though this is more bitter than expected, it does deliver a nice espresso flavor without an excessive amount of sugar, and with no fat!  This 50-calorie drink gives a nice caffeine lift.  (I think it said 155 mg per serving?)  I may keep a few in my fridge for those days when I have to get on the run so fast that I don't have time to brew coffee, since going without caffeine entirely would be too hard on me and on the world!

This little can was definitely full of energy! It had that thick, bold espresso taste to it, which I find essential to the enjoyment. But alas, like every other pre-packaged drink these days, it was far too sugary. I am one to put a quarter teaspoon of raw sugar in my little 1.75 oz espresso. This drink, while not frappaccino levels, was just too much for me. I was able to finish it though. I have been told it is best to enjoy these drinks cold, but I drank mine at room temp, and it was just fine. Perhaps if it were cold, I would have liked the sweetness a bit more? The size was good too; not a whole big drink, but not one of those piddling little five-hour energies either.

I've had the Cappuccino flavor of this drink and I absolutely loved it. I'm not huge on this flavor. It's very strong and I don't taste much sweetness. It was a bit overpowering for my tastes.

The Cappuccino flavored can was 8.45 oz which I thought was a bit small but this flavor is even smaller at 6.8 oz.

Although I like the simpleness of have a ready-made coffee drink, I think I'll stick to the Cappuccino ones.

Coffee drinks aren't carbonated, so it's odd that I would describe this drink as being "flat." But that's how it tasted, like a "flat" carbonated drink. Probably one of the worst coffee drinks I've ever had in my life. I will definitely NOT be drinking more of this.

Found this to be very strong and bitter tasting. Also I'm not used to drinking espresso as a cold drink so it was a strange experience for me. Can't really recommend this as I didn't finish the can. On the good side it's marked as being only 50 calories.

Perhaps it's just something about the area I live in, but our convenience stores sell many brands of coffee "shot" drinks and all of them have some sort of cream in them to cut the bitter taste of pure espresso. That being said, I was unpleasantly surprised when I took a sip of illy issimo Caffe. It was pure, undiluted cold coffee. And unlike some other reviewers, I couldn't taste the sweetener at all.

This is the first quickie cold coffee drink that I haven't completely enjoyed. I just couldn't drink it, but my reasons for disliking it are probably the exact reasons black coffee and straight espresso drinkers will love it. Those who like their iced coffees light and sweet and their Frappuchinos heavy on the extras should steer clear of illy issimo Caffe.

Apparently illy issimo is a well-known brand of coffee in Italy.  I don't know if they had a hard time turning their product into a canned drink, but color me unimpressed by illy.  I chilled the product because I felt that it would be better than drinking it lukewarm.  I don't think it would have mattered as all I tasted was a cold cup of your standard cheap grocery store brand coffee.  Even my wife who drinks much more coffee than I disliked it.  It wasn't that it had a rich, strong capuccino taste which I actually like - the coffee tasted bitter, had a strange after taste, and would have needed ALOT of sweetener for it to be even marginally palatable.  I drank about half of the can and then had to pour the rest out (and drink a big glass of water to wash the taste out of my mouth).  An overall unpleasant experience...

I like Coffee but this espresso coffee drink was too strong for me.  It was sweet and the label said it could contain milk but it was so strong it definitely didn't taste like it was diluted with milk... I didn't make through a 1/4 of the pretty small can.

If you're in a situation where you wanted to bring coffee with you, but were somehow prevented from bringing a thermos or Starbucks cup, I suppose you could do worse than this canned coffee. That's basically all it is: lightly sweetened canned coffee. The can is small enough to fit in a bag or purse, and there's just enough here for "one cup of coffee," as it were. It's meant to be drank cold, but for me coffee drinks are better served hot unless they've got lots of flavor and sugar in them. This one is just canned coffee, and it's good enough as that, but not much more.

If you like espresso with a side of sweet, try the 100 cans of illy issimo Cappuccino. If you like something bolder, try this. Only fifty calories and you get a full hit of caffeine and intense, coffee flavor. The cans are so small, they'll fit nicely in your mini-fridge at the office. Have a cool sip at low tide (that's 2:00 p.m. for me) and you're recharged for the rest of the work day.

This stuff tastes OK, and must be fairly strong in the caffeine department. I drank the small can at about 8:00 PM and had slight trouble getting to sleep around midnight. But then I limit my caffeine intake normally. But under normal circumstances you are not going to catch me spending $1.65 or more per can of this drink. I got better things to do with my money, and it must be a sign of how affluent a country the USA is, even in these supposedly hard times, that people buy products such as this or delivered pizza with enough frequency to keep the companies supplying them afloat. We ought to be paying off our national debt, that burden we show every sign of irresponsibly passing on to our kids and grandkids, instead of buying these luxury products.

I tried this cold - right out of the can.

Nice start: Not too sweet. Not too strong. No bitterness.

Poor finish: A non-coffee aftertaste with a remote "chemical" influence.

This one's not for me.
If you like your coffee strong (expresso like) with some sugar but no milk you might want to give it a shot.  It will give you your caffeine jolt with a pleasant Arabica bean coffee.

Illy issimo Caffee Coffee drink by the Coca Cola company is a refreshing espresso coffee beverage that will perk up your day. It is very smooth with a deep espresso flavor. Not too sweet. Not too bitter. It is only 50 Calories.

I drink a can when I start to slow down in the morning and it provides an immediate jolt of energy without the aftertaste of an energy drink. I especially like it chilled.

It contains 155 mg of caffeine per 6.8 fl ounces which is comparable to other such drinks. The website is [...].

If you need a jolt in the morning and dislike having to run to the corner Starbucks, take a can of illy issimo to work with you.

These are convenient, tasty and potent.  Not too sweet, not high calorie and tastes like real coffee.  I see these all the time on sale at the grocery store at a dollar each.  So you could get a 12 pack for 12 bucks, about 7 dollars cheaper than the current list price here.

Unlike illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), which I enjoyed, this "coffee drink" was terrible. It had a very strong bitter taste like the coffee at the bottom of the pot that had cooled hours ago.

The Cappuccino flavor was great, this one I couldn't finish.

I love coffee of all kinds and flavors, but this was a dissapointment. I expected it ti have a stronger richer flavor, but it jsut tasted like regualr old coffee with a little sugar.  If that is what you want go for it.

I drank it on the way to work instead of having regular coffee. The flavor, while it did taste like coffee had a terrible after taste like burnt Diet Pepsi. It was not what I would have expected from the other drinks I have had from this brand. Not sure if I just happened to get a bad one or what but the one I had was not good and I am not sure if I would give it a second try.

The illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè, 6.8-oz is a little too bitter for my taste and frankly, not what I expected of a chilled coffee. Even with 10mg of sugar in it, the bitter after taste still lingers. To taper it down, I actually added a bit more cream and sugar to it and that made it more bearable. This being a canned variety, it is obviously geared for on-the-go people and for those who just plainly love espresso. It is also on the pricey side and this is not something I would be drinking on a daily basis.

I don't really know who Illy's marketing group was targeting when they came up with the idea for this drink, but I know one thing: It wasn't me. This miniature can contains a coffee that Illy should feel ashamed to put its name on. Taste is subpar and artificial, and it's pre-sweetened -- a lot. Pass.

Excellent flavor and just the right medium-to-dark strength.  I prefer this little can to other bottled coffee drinks.  If you like to have a stash of quality, flavorful coffee in the fridge, this is a very good choice.

This little can of "Americano" (espresso with a little water) tastes like it just came out of an espresso bar -- great smoothness, no bitterness, balanced flavor. There's a little sweetener to balance the bitterness, and it tastes great poured over ice with a little creamer for a refreshing summer drink.

I am a confirmed black coffee drinker -- or so I thought, but the light sugar in this canned coffee is just the thing for drinking in the car. I hadn't realized that it would be pre-sugared, but it is quite nice. No bitter taste, no tinned taste either, so I'm a happy camper and will be buying this to take with me on road trips.

Thanks, Illy Issimo!

The color is deep brown; almost black as it should be with espresso-type coffee. It taste like a good cup of strong coffee and not as acidic or bitter as I expect espresso to taste. The flavor is very smooth. Each 6.8 ounce serving is 50 calories. There are only four ingredients - coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, and potassium citrate. Each serving has 155 mg of caffeine which is about the same as is in a cup of drip coffee (115 - 175 mg).

My boyfriend really loved this drink (he shared it with me) and would rate it 5 stars because it has a strong flavor and a good caffeine content; although he does consider this expensive.

I liked illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) very much, so I expected to like this product just as well. I was wrong. It is way too bitter--I couldn't taste even a hint of sweetness, though there is sugar in it. And there's a strong aftertaste, as well. It does pack quite the caffeine punch, though, so I have to give it props for that. Still, there is no chance I'll be purchasing this product.

I have never been a really big coffee drinker, not much for hot liquids so I thought I would give one of these cold coffees a try. I drank it in the late afternoon just before a charity event I was working, wow this kept me going all night long. I didn't get home till one in the morning with enough energy still to read a bit.

The taste was a lot better than I thought it would be. I have looked for it stores and have not found it yet.

This drink is pretty good.  It has a strong coffee flavor.  It is not sweet and does not have much of a milk flavor either.  It is a smooth and creamy but strong coffee/espresso flavored drink.  At only 45 calories, it's not bad.  I also tried the Cappuccino by Illy and much preferred this product.  I wish they sold a version with this much coffee flavor and just a tad more sweetness, but that's personal preference.  If you like strong coffee flavors and are looking for a convenient product, this is a good choice.

At 6.8 ounces this drink size is a tad on the small size. It's a very thin coffee drink that to me is "just okay". At about $2 each it also seems a tad on the expensive side. The flavor is good, so it's worth a try to see if it "hits the spot" for you.
I honestly do not understand the raving reviews for this product. It was just horribly bitter. Downright nasty bitter.  I would not waste my money on this. No smooth flavor at all.

I tried half the can over ice, the other half, hot. Not as strong as a true espresso, especially after the ice starts melting. Also not as strong as a real espresso heated with no ice. When heated, the coffee became bitter and metallic-tasting. Not worth spending 50 calories and 12 carbs (10 grams sugar) over a bad-tasting coffee drink. I couldn't finish this, I tossed it down the drain. If I'm drinking coffee away from home, I'd rather have a non-fat McCafe Mocha from McDonalds.

I enjoy trying new drinks, and I also like coffee and espresso drinks.  So I was curious about the Caffe coffee drink from Illy Issimo.  However, I was a little disappointed in the result.  The taste started sweet, transitioned to citrus, and finished bitter.  I found that the added sugar masked any potential nuance from the coffee without providing any real desirable flavor of its own.  While not necessarily bad, the Caffe (6.8 oz, 50 calories, 155 mg caffeine) does not compare favorably with a tall Starbucks Iced Coffee (12 oz, 60 calories, 120 mg caffeine).  If you are looking for a compact shot of caffeine, this might be what you want.  However, don't expect much in the taste department.  I am hoping that the Cappuccino fares better.

This coffee is very bitter with a strong bold taste. Heating it up (if you like your drink warm) makes it more bitter.

It has a strong coffee aroma, and its not too sweet. I could only take a couple of sips of it, and this 1 can lasted me 2-3 days because I wasn't enamored with the flavor. If you like tasty coffee, illy Cappuccino is a lot better. I felt this product has more of a caffeine punch that the Starbucks double shot cans.

I didn't find anything special with this drink (and to be perfectly honest, it made me kind of nauseous on a empty stomach). It also increase my acid reflux just a bit. Will not be ordering in the future.

Illy is a top coffee brand in Italy, so I was very interested in trying their pre-packaged espresso. This drink is also pre-sweetened. It was quite a disappointment to take a sip and find that there was absolutely no flavor of coffee at all. And espresso's supposed to be pretty strong. The only taste was that of the sweetener, of which there was far too much. I'll continue to make expresso at home, grinding the beans and using my little stove top pot.

My wife is a coffee drinker, I am not so I got this for her to try and her immediate impressions, it was terrible. She tried another of the illy issimo drinks and felt that tasted watered down, this however was strong but the taste was terrible. Now taste is all subjective so while she hated it you may like it. That being said she does love the starbucks drinks you can buy and this was not on-par with the taste of those according to her. I believe if she wants canned coffee in the future we'll be staying away from this brand.

This is some really nasty tasting stuff. I just tried this one "illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappucino, 8.45-Ounce Cans" before trying this one. Of the two, this is definitely the worst. But saying the other one was better isn't really saying much because it was really nasty tasting too.

The closest thing I can compare the flavor of this to is a pot of coffee that was left cooking on a hot plate till there was only a cup left in the pot. Then sat for 2 days. It has a nasty burnt coffee flavor with a strong metallic twang to it like it has boiled for hours in a aluminum sauce pan. It left a bitter burnt after taste stuck in the back of my throat and a foul metallic yuck coating my tongue. And neither one wants to go away. It might supposed to have a espresso flavor and I'm not real sure what that is since I haven't had one in several years. But, if real espresso taste's like this stuff, then espresso certainly wouldn't be as popular as it is. Except as a tar remover or something like that.
On the can it says "DO NOT SHAKE" and that made me wonder why? After trying to drink it I'd have to say its probably because it still has a bunch of coffee grounds settled in the bottom of it. And if I shook it up then I would have the chew it instead of drink it. I thought about cutting the top off of the can and see what's in it, but decided that I really didn't want to know. I used to call bad strong coffee battery acid, I think this could actually be used for that.

The only plus I could say about this is,,,mmmm. There's only 6.8 oz. of it to drink!

Well I'm mystified. I received a can of illy issimo Cappuccino Coffee Drink to review and loved it. Good expresso flavor with a hint of cocoa and not too sweet. BUT the plain Illy Issimo caffe drink... yuck. It had a metallic taste and I couldn't even finish half of it.

You would think quality would be more consistent across lines, but I'll be buying the Cappuccino and avoiding this product.
Pam T~

I took three swallows and could not drink anymore to me it tasted like motor oil!  And the aftertaste was the worst!  I brushed my teeth three times and could still not get the stench out!  Skip at all costs!

At 155 mg caffeine, this has about the kick of a 12 ounce cup of coffee in a six ounce can. It has a smooth, slightly bitter coffee flavor with a little sweetness -- not quite as bitter as brewed espresso, but it's definitely a coffee drink first and an energy drink second.

I'm a black coffee drinker by nature and liked it quite a bit. The flavors were well balanced and complex, but if you like your coffee with a lot of sugar or with cream, then this probably is the wrong drink for you. On the other hand, if you like the flavor of good black coffee with a hint of sweet, then I recommend giving it a try.

I have never tried these kind of coffee products like this before. I was really pleased with the overall flavor and the aroma . I did get a boost of energy and it is quite good. Overall I have to say I will be picking up more of these. They are great for on the go, and I can put them in my cooler to take with me as well. Best served ice cold.

I had tried the cappuccino version of this brand, and it was not delicious.  This product is more just coffee and sugar with fewer chemical additives.  It was strong and dark out of the can, and after two minutes in the microwave along with some milk, it was quite drinkable.  I'm not a super fan of cold coffee, so I can't comment on how well it would work as that.  It did have a European coffee flair.

I found this drink to be bitter, sharp, and almost flavorless. I was very surprised after really liking another flavor in this brand (Maybe I got a bad can?). I even had my husband try it to share his thoughts and he like I was not a fan either. It's a shame because of all the nutritional benefits and convenience of taking along this drink with you.

This illy coffee drink tastes like a somewhat sweetened European roast coffee.  It isn't bad for flavor.  However, the company mixes in some ingredients that apparently are supposed to give the drink a smooth consistency.  These leave me with an odd mouthfeel and aftertaste that I never get from drinking coffee.  That detracts significantly from the experience.  I can't see spending this much on these drinks in light of that odd texture/consistency and aftertaste.  For the price, stick with real coffee or espresso.

I've had worse coffee in a can but this is just average coffee sweetened up. I like espresso & strong coffee but never with sugar. This was way too sweet for me.

-Too sweet - 10g sugar in a 6.8 fluid ounce can.
-Flat taste almost stale.
-Musty flavor
-It looks really dark & rich but doesn't taste dark & rich.
-Leaves a slight bitter aftertaste.
-Taste improves with a bit of cream; knocks down the off flavors.

Ingredients: Coffee, Sugar, Potassium Bicarbonate, Potassium Citrate

I am sure there is a market for this canned coffee drink, but I am not part of the market! It tasted very bitter to me, and I could not detect any sweetness, even though the information on the can stated that it contained sugar. I am not sure why the instructions say not to shake the can before opening, but I decided for once to follow instructions...just in case, you know. My guess is that this product is popular among those who already enjoy espresso rather than just accept a cup when it is pressed upon them. One can drink it at room temperature or cold -- I drank my half a can at room temperature before disposing of it,  but upon reflection I probably should have chilled the rest to see if that improved the flavor.

I have never tried an illy product before but I love coffee and was excited to try this product. I like the taste of this espresso flavored drink for the most part but it has a slightly artificial taste to it. Each 6.8 fluid ounce can has 50 calories. They display it on the can in a way that leads you to believe that should be good but straight espresso doesn't have any calories so 50 calories worth of sweetener seems like a lot to me. The size of the can is quite small as well. For the cost of this product I would think that they could be a little more generous with the size of the drink. It's nice and convenient while on the go and I like the energy boost from the caffeine.

I wasnt as fond of this flavor as compared to the capuccino. This is more bitter than sweet, and far less creamy.  The flavor is very strong. It makes sense since the caffeine content is almost double that compared to the capuccino (155 mg in the cafe flavor).  The serving size is smaller but it packs a punch, much like an energy drink. I guess the reason for 3 stars is that I just overall didnt care for the flavor. This particular flavor is geared more toward the hard core coffee drinker, so if thats you, then you should try it.

I've tried this one and also the illy cappachino mocha version (which is a slightly larger can). I thought the mocha version seemed to mask the taste of the illy coffee and make it a bit generic. However this one seemed to be be much closer to espresso taste. Quite strong (albeit not bitter) espresso taste, which prevents you from chugging the small 6.8oz can, and instead savoring it in smaller sips.

Overall I think these are quite a bit of money for what you get, but the cans are small, they taste good, and much cheaper/better than the equivalent starbucks version.

If you like iced coffee, you will probably prefer to continue drinking your favorite iced brand.  While I found this a bit too strong, it does have a better, less bitter flavor than most canned coffees, and the metallic taste I often notice in canned coffees is very light here.  For the money, I would not purchase it in this manner.  It's rather expensive for the small sized cans.  For someone who just likes an occassional iced coffee treat at home, it may be a good choice.

This coffee is way too bitter. It also has sugar, which I despise sugar in my coffee. When I saw it had sugar it in, I chilled it (got it really ice-cold) before I tried it, so that I could give it a shadow of a chance. But even though it was chilled, it was still too bitter and sweet.

Perhaps if there were no sugar in it, I might could have gotten over the bitterness and gave it a few more stars, even if I couldn't have given it 5 stars.

But it was absolutely horrible. Never again. (And I do love coffee.)

I had high hopes for this drink despite the fact that I prefer unsweetened drinks.  I poured it in the glass and was unhappy with how dark it was.  I took a sip and choked.  This drink is bitter and to me undrinkable.  It was like drinking the bottom of a burned pot of coffee.  I tried adding milk to the cup but it didn't lighten the color at all.  Even with the milk I couldn't drink it and down the drain it went.  Awful!

Keep in mind your getting just shy of 7 ounces here and for me that was about 3 gulps before the thrill was gone, but it left me with a bitter taste and even worse aftertaste.

What really would me bother me though is the wallet shock from having to pay $2 per can for this when my local retail stores sell their brand for $1 and the Starbucks variety for $1.50 per can.

Guess Coke (the actual producers of this product) needed to bolster the old bank accounts.

This illy issimo caffee coffee came from Amazon and I was certainly disappointed in the taste. With all the coffes available on the market now this is the very last one I would choose if buying.illy issimo Caffe Coffee Drink, 6.8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)

I was impressed by the illy iced coffee in a can. It's got a nice coffee flavor to it (it's not fresh brewed...) and when you pour it over ice it has the perfect sweetness. The real draw to these is the ability to grab one out of the fridge when you are in a rush. It's perfect for those I'm not leaving the house days or the "I'm running 30min late!!!!" days. They won't replace your favorite coffee stop on the way when you have the time...

This is a small can of espresso but more than enough to satisfy my coffee craving. It's not an iced frappicino type drink. There is no cream or milk and only barely enough sweetness. But the coffee is rich and STRONG. It is bitter but adding about 1/2 teaspoon sugar fixed that. I guess you could heat it for a hot espresso but iced it was awesome.

1.  This is one of those difficult reviews.  Yes, I'm a 100% coffee person and I like to think I know my coffee;  brew my french press every day.  With that being said, this is a high quality brew (cold) and definitely not one of those overly sugary Starbucks blended drinks (if you like those, no problems).  The thing is, is this something so special that folks are going to go out and put down their cash for?  If you like iced coffee that's actually fairly potent and not made for a teenager (again no offense), then this is for you.  If you like iced coffee but money is important to you, just brew some at home etc...
This product exceeded all of my expectations. I never thought you could get great coffee out of a can! So refreshing and light. Just what I was looking for...

I tried a small sample chilled (straight from the refrigerator).  First impression:  No taste.  Then, the after-taste kicked in, and I did not like it.  It gave a very "tinny" taste in my mouth, like a tin lining taste that made it taste like a canned coffee drink.  Personally, I'd rather drink day-old coffee because at least it tastes like coffee.  This is the second illy product I tasted, both of which completely underwhelmed my senses.  Just meh.

It's rare for a prepared coffee drink to actually taste like a proper espresso - dark, bold, and rich. But this one does. It's lightly sweetened (lightly being the operative word) and has no cream. I tried it two ways - first, I dumped a shot over vanilla ice cream. The bitter boldness went great with the smooth sweetness of the ice cream. Next, I tried it straight, then added cream to taste. It was excellent.

If you're tired of all the corn syrup and icky creamers in so many of the packaged coffee drinks out there, give this one a "shot". It's just the right size for enjoying and it is great for coffee fans who are tired of the way Starbucks and others have turned coffee into a sickly-sweet milkshake-like experience.

Personally I enjoy coffee drinks from local stores and even canned drinks. So when I ordered this one I had high hopes. Sadly I wasn't as excited about it as I thought I would be. The drink is ok and in a pinch will satisfy a craving but overall if I had other choices I would not choose this one.

If you like strong coffee that isn't watered down with cream and sugar this probably will be more to your taste. I prefer the Starbucks little expresso drinks myself though, this is too strong for me.

This drink is real good especially when it is real cold. I prefer cold coffee drinks over hot ones. The can is pretty small like a red bull can. It is easy to stash any where in your bag. The taste is pretty good and straight forward. It is bold with a hint of sweetness. It is not that sweet to me compared to other drinks from Starbucks or Monster. It does give you an after taste of coffee. Not that bad but it feels like you have coffee breath. Calories are low compared to other comparable drinks. It gives me a good quick boost that I need to begin the day.

I did not like the taste of this canned coffee.  It had a very strong, bitter bite.  I took two sips and could not drink anymore.  My husband (who loves about anything coffee) said that he didn't really like it either, but then he polished off the can.  This is definitely a personal taste item.

Right up front: I like this drink, even though I usually don't want my coffee tampered with: No sugar, No milk or cream, No frothing, No cinnamon, No nonsense.

This has a definite espresso flavor and is very sweet. The potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate effectively cut the bitterness that one would expect. I poured the drink into a glass, and there was no aluminum can taste.

Actually, since it is based on espresso, I found that half the can was enough for me. At another time I might enjoy a whole can (which is still less than 7 oz.) Even though was cold, I drank it like espresso--one sip at a time.

My energy level usually slumps in the middle of the afternoon. I found that by taking a short break and _slowly_ drinking the illy issimo coffee drink, I was refreshed and ready to go on with my day. (Could they have found a more awkward name than: illy issimo Caffe Italian espresso style coffee drink?)

But now the true test: Will I actually buy it? Yeah, the next time I go to my local supermarket I will check it out. If it is no more expensive than Amazon, I will probably buy some to have occasionally. (If you are not really out in the boonies, it just seems strange to buy food from Amazon--and I have bought a lot of different stuff from Amazon.)

Notes: -->I noticed some other reviewers were drinking it (and it was suggested) when they were commuting or in a hurry. Drink brewed coffee then. Don't rush through espresso--that is just disrespectful. -->Also, on the can, the promise seems to be that the coffee itself is natural, not necessarily the whole product. -->Yes, I know that the energy boost was from relaxing, enjoying the drink, and the sugar, because it takes an hour for caffeine to actually kick in.

illy issimo Coffee Drink Caffe is an okay canned coffee drink (if you're into such a thing). Drinking coffee out of a can is an acquired taste, you either like it or hate it. I happen to enjoy drinking coffee-on-the-go and its not that bad. That saying, I wouldn't go out of my way to purchase a can. But, if you enjoy drinking canned coffee then you'll want to buy some to try it out. Please, do not shake the can before drinking or freeze it. I would drink it at room temperature (I dislike the taste of cold coffee).

I would recommend it for those who already enjoy coffee-in-the-can.

My wife and I shared a can of illy issimo Coffee Drink. I am not a great fan of cold coffee so I included my wife's opinion in this review, since she drinks iced coffee daily. The illy was too strong for both of us, but was not bitter. If it had been hot I probably would have liked sipping it, it seems to be close to the strength of espresso. My wife added ice and a lot of flavored half and half and found it very good. Doing as she did, rather defeats the purpose of a can of coffee that one opens and drinks on the go. I would recommend this drink to those who like cold espresso.

I really enjoy this illy issimo Coffee Drink. A lot. It's the perfect espresso treat for the hard core coffee drinkers who cringe and run away at the sight of a blonde or medium roast coffee.

This is a smooth, perfectly sweetened espresso coffee drink that is a very satisfying chilled beverage to enjoy on a hot summer day. I found it to be of a much better quality than the canned and bottled coffee beverages sold by that coffee company you see on every corner and have kiosks inside more and more stores.

It is also very refreshing to find a canned beverage that is sweetened with beet sugar, NOT high fructose corn syrup.

I'm anxious to try more illy coffee drinks!

This is a pretty typical sweetened packaged espresso drink. It's adequately strong, could always be stronger, since odds are pretty good you'll be drinking it iced. For my taste, it could be a bit less sweet, but it's not cloying against the coffee, and it's a nice sugary sweetness.

I tried it straight and iced, with and without milk, and liked it all 4 ways.

During the summer, I try to brew a big strong pot every few days and keep it in the fridge for iced coffee, but I like this as an option to keep on hand in the fridge for days I run out and don't want to wait for my usual stuff to cool. It would also be a convenient take-along booster if you're traveling somewhere with questionable coffee or visiting family members who brew theirs like a weak tea. The flavor and strength is much better than the starbucks instant packets, which are also a decent take-along booster.

With 155mg caffeine (about 1.5x an average shot of espresso, similar to a good cup of strong brewed coffee), this has a nice pick-me-up with a low pee factor.

For my money, it's a bit too pricy for what it is for everyday use. I'm too cheap for coffee at home at $2 a pop.

Maybe I'm not their target customer since I don't generally drink iced coffee but frankly I thought this was kinda gross.  Drinking yesterday's coffee left in the pot without reheating it would be equally satisfying as  this canned beverage.  Didn't enjoy the flavor nor did I find it refreshing in any way.  I'm glad my Vine sample was only one can!

I was excited to get this coffee drink, but once I tried it, I was a bit put off by its bitter taste. I expected the taste to be strong, but not bitter - I could not get past that to the actual flavor. I would not try this drink again.

This was a tasty little drink, but not beyond special. I'm comparing this to the "stellar" chain out there. As far as a cold/iced coffee goes it is strong, but a little too sweet for my taste. Sort of like when you buy a sweetened tea and think- is there tea in this, it's like drinking sugar. I added a bit of milk and it helped smooth it out a bit. Not a bad little drink of you like cold, sweetened coffee.

The can of illy issimo Coffee Drink claims "100% natural Arabica coffee and the finest ingredients". There are in fact only four ingredients, the first two of which are coffee and sugar. Note - no High Fructose Corn Syrup here. The other two ingredients aren't what you'd typically put in for yourself, potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate, often added to drinks to regulate acidity.

The taste is pretty good for a canned product - nice strong coffee flavor, the way I like it. Perhaps a bit more sugar than I would normally use, but less than I find in most commercial drinks. There is a hint of chemical in the taste, but it isn't obnoxious. I found it quite refreshing. One can is 50 calories, about 2/3 what you'd find in the equivalent amount of soda. Caffeine content is 155mg per can, about on par for brewed coffee and maybe twice what a typical can of an "energy drink" contains.

I tried the cappuccino one as well, and I like that one better. This one is good, but tastes more like iced black coffee with no sugar/cream. So if that's your preference (you prefer it black or like to add your own sweetener/cream), then this is for you.

I could still drink it, but definitely prefer it with a little extra cream in there.

I didn't like this. It was so strong and after watering it down by half it was still strong. I thought espresso was suppose to have a lot of caffiene so I expected an energy boost but instead I took a nap 2 hours later..... I guess if you like espresso and that strong taste you'll like this but I didn't and I tried it on ice and hot.

Ok, for me, this needs to be sweetened and mixed with milk (vanilla soymilk or dark chocolate almond milk are awesome), but it's actually not a bad thing having a serving of good (strong but not bitter or burnt-tasting) coffee in the refrigerator ready to grab. I mixed it with the amount and type of milk I wanted, sweetened it as I pleased, and yumminess happened, my way; I like that. There is a lot of coffee out there that tastes nasty to me, but this is the good stuff.

I just don't really see the market for these things at this price.  This is bad cold iced coffee with a somewhat synthetic chemical like taste.  Provides caffeine if that's what you are looking for but the taste is somewhat horrible.

Coffee preferences seem very personal and heated debates can erupt over the subject. For me, this coffee is very good. It's not too sweet -- just the right amount of sugar. The taste was rich with no strange or bitter aftertaste. There was also no 'burnt taste' that I've experiences with other brands. Regarding other reviewers who complain about a strange acidic or a citrus taste, I couldn't taste anything funny like that. Be aware that the product contains a preservative named potassium citrate, an odorless but not a tasteless chemical. The vast majority of people have no problem with the chemical but there are a few where it hits the taste buds in an unpleasant way. You'd probably know by now if you were in that minority because this preservative is common.

Note that I like cold coffee so I poured the room temperature can into a glass with ice. Thus I was tasting something slightly diluted, and yet it still tasted great. I also should say that I am not a huge coffee drinker, but I do like coffee candy and coffee ice cream.

BOTTOM LINE: if I was in a store or on Amazon and wanted to buy some espresso style cans of this size, I would either pick this brand or Starbuck's brand depending on which one was cheaper. They both taste very good. If the prices were equal, I would probably go with this brand just to give myself more long term taste test with the product.

If you have read many of the reviews for this product, you would notice they are all over the place. Canned coffee drinks - particularly espresso drinks - are definitely not for everyone. This drink is rather sweet for such a product but very strong. In fact, I would expect most people to be put off by the strong flavor after a sip or two and, judging by the reviews, that seems to be the case. In other words, those who like their coffee weak of heavily diluted with cream should stay away from this one.

Now for the rest of us. The flavor is quite clear and strong but it surprised me by its sweetness. This would not be a problem per se but the mixture does not seem to go together well and leaves a bit of an aftertaste. Overall, a refreshing drink on a hot day but I can't give it a clear thumbs up.

I let the can chill a few days and when it got to be 103 outside I thought now it is the time. I filled a glass with ice and poured it over. Looked good until I tasted the first sip. I don't even know how to describe it. Strong for sure and like a bit a sweet was hiding in the background. So I tried adding some splenda to see if that would help, mmmm, just a tad. So I tried some soy milk which I like the taste of, nope not an improvement.

Overall it seemed acidic to me and mostly unpleasant. I was unable to drink more than a few sips. Maybe the latte variety would be more to my taste, this not so much.

I have to say that I did read some of the other reviews before trying this drink.

I'm a coffee drinker but I like my coffee creamy and light. So I thought this would be super strong. I refrigerated it (not sure if that was right or not) and was surprised to find it okay. It wasn't great, it wasn't spit out horrible, it was drinkable and okay.

I found it to be smooth and very sweet (not wicked sweet but probably a little too much). I drank it all but probably wouldn't buy it. I guess I prefer an iced coffee over the strength of this.

My husband, who is more of a strong coffee drinker than me, didn't like it.

There is something very odd with the sweetener in this drink, I think. It tastes at first like strong black coffee, almost burnt, with some sugar and no cream added to it. Quickly, however, a really strange acidity overwhelms the rest of the taste. It's a little like that cheap liquid "diet" sweetener from the 1970s, which tasted like chemicals if you had it by itself. It would probably be okay in this coffee if the coffee itself didn't taste burned, or if it balanced with more cream-type taste. In fact, I finished the rest of the can I had by mixing it in with about 2 ounces of pre-made iced coffee in a carton, and that made a huge difference.

I drink coffee daily and really enjoy other illy issimo products. This one just is not that good.

I should start with a disclaimer that I am a real coffee lover and a habitual consumer of strong brewed Arabica cut with nonfat milk but no sugar. I learned to love iced coffee at my mother's knee - she too loved coffee but in summer when hot brew was intolerable, made her cold glass of joe with whole milk, sugar and then ice cubes.

This illy issimo caffe Italian espresso style coffee drink struck me as really strong although reasonably smooth but with some kind of a taste of - perhaps - citric acid. Something "chemical". Something that stays on the tongue when you'd think it wouldn't.

I waited for a nice hot day to have this; had it chilled down in the fridge, waiting. It did give me the fog-clearing of caffeine but when I found it a bit strong, I tried cutting it with my nonfat milk. Whoa - the color didn't even alter, this is STRONG stuff. When I got to half milk, it began to have a lighter look, and the taste became more what I like. I kept sipping it and getting a reaction that it tastes somewhat chemical compared to my usual brew. I wanted to like it but don't completely but that may be just me, and partially the effect of it having the sugar that I am no longer used to.

If you prefer your coffee without sweetener as I do, please note the manufacturer does produce an unsweetened version.

I was expecting more like a starbucks iced coffee; sweet with milk/cream.  However, this is rather light on sugar and cream. A little too bold for me. Bold to a point of bitterness. Anyways, if you like bold taste of coffee without and sugar and cream, this is it for you.

I drink coffee for the flavor - I typically drink decaf and since abandoning artificial sweeteners 7 months ago, I use real sugar, sometimes cream. Since I'm unused to this volume of caffeine, it was unwise for me to consume this can late in the evening. I was wide awake all night long, unable to sleep more than a few minutes here and there.  It's unusual to get a product in a can that only has 4 ingredients as this illy issimo Caffé coffee. While it contains sugar, it was not sweet enough for me by any stretch - but I like it sweeeeet. Still, it was fully satisfying. My husband is a champion drinker of coffee. If coffee drinking were an Olympic sport, he would medal in it daily... so I let him sample this drink to get his feedback. He said he doesn't like cream in his coffee. I informed him that it didn't have any, but he insisted he could detect cream. I personally think he was thrown off by the temperature - he prefers piping hot, and I had just pulled this can out of the fridge. That being said, if you cannot tolerate cold coffee, you will not be in the market for this product. Personally, I like it at any temperature.

"How can something with sugar as the second ingredient be so incredibly bitter?" said my husband after his first taste. I couldn't answer, my mouth was puckered like an old lady at a lemon eating contest.

Hubby reached for the Hazelnut creamer, poured a little in, and we both agreed it made a huge improvement.

I realize there are plenty of manly men out there who like their coffee black and their women strong, or something like that, but no one in our family resembles that description. However, for people who like cold black coffee, this is probably a very refreshing drink. For a generation brought up on super-sweet flavored and whip-cream-topped coffee concoctions, I doubt this will be a hit. Unless they use it as a challenge, like eating a teaspoon of cinnamon, or drinking Sriracha sauce straight from the bottle.

I recently tried illy issimo's Cappuccino (8.45 ounce can) and really enjoyed it. I decided to try their slightly smaller (6.8 ounce) Caffe coffee drink as well, and I came away largely disappointed. Obviously, there is less here to enjoy. After a few generous sips, I found the can nearly drained. I appreciate the fact that the entire drink clocks in at only 45 calories, making it perhaps the healthiest of all the commercially available cold coffee drinks. I was also pleased to see that it uses beet sugar as a natural sweetener as opposed to corn syrup, and of course, all illy issimo drinks uses 100% Arabica coffee. So, there's no denying the quality.

But in short, this was not nearly as tasty or as satisfying as the Cappuccino I previously tried. The Caffe was intense, slightly creamy, and just about as sweet as I would want it. But it left me with a bitter, unpleasant aftertaste that lingered far too long. You should not feel the sudden urge to brush your teeth or drink cold water after enjoying espresso, but that is exactly how I felt after finishing this. Therefore, despite the quality ingredients, the initial taste, and the impressive low-calorie count, I cannot recommend this. I'd rather double up on the calories and enjoy a larger can of their superior Cappuccino.

At only 45 calories per can, it is in a class by itself; at more than $1.91 per can, it faces a lot of competition for my morning pick-me-up, including Green Mountain Coffee Lake & Lodge and SToK Caffeinated Black Coffee Shots.

My wife didn't care for this blend's full-bodied flavor but I preferred this over illy issimo Cappuccino, which we also tested for free through Amazon's Vine program. My wife prefers coffee hot and with milk and sugar. My preference is to drink house blends, espresso and Americano black (hot) or over ice.

This sweetened, bold ice coffee is best enjoyed over crushed ice. Straight out of the can is a bit harsh (see picture) but this blend mellows nicely over ice. My best advice is that you purchase a single can of illy issimo Caffè before committing to buy a pack of 12.

Rating: Three stars.

* 100% natural Arabica coffee
* No preservatives
* OU-D Kosher
* Sweetened with beet sugar
* Offers a RTD coffee option for lactose intolerant consumers
* 6.8 fluid ounces (200 milliliters) per can

Nutritional Information:
* 45 calories
* 0 grams of fat
* 10 grams of sugar
* 155 milligrams of caffeine

I'm an avid coffee drinker. I drink it black, cold, in a frap... Illy happens to be one of my favorite brands for making lattes and cappuccinos, so I felt pretty confident that this drink would be good. I was half right. This may be one of the oddest things I've drunk yet.

At the first sip, it tasted like lightly sweetened, fairly strong espresso, but there was something off. I took another sip, trying to figure out what it was, but I couldn't quite put my finger on it.

I decided to try pouring it into a glass to see if this alleviated the strangeness. I took another sip and, yep, still strange. It took me a while to realize that the strangeness was that it seemed almost like it was carbonated, yet it didn't fizz. This made no sense to me, so I checked the label to find that potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate are two of the ingredients. Bingo. My guess is these ingredients are conspiring to give this coffee a strange, difficult to describe aftertaste.

Ultimately, this ruined the beverage for me. Even though I liked the taste of the coffee and thought it had just the right level of sweetness, I couldn't get past that weird tang and vaguely fizzy feeling. I won't be coming back for more of this.

The illy issimo Coffe Drink (Caffe version), is 6.8 fluid ounces of 100% natural arabica coffee, sugar, potassium, bicarbonate and potassium citrate. With 50 calories, 12g carbs and 10g of sugar, it's a decent "health" profile (only 20mg sodium, which is low). It contains No Preservatives (according to the label), but the taste is just strange: I drank it cold straight from the fridge, and found it to be both too bitter AND too sweet at the same time (I don't know how they accomplished that).

It's ok, but not something I would probably drink again unless I had to. I drink coffee with cream (and sometimes a touch of sugar) every morning, and often a non fat latte as another choice: I love espresso (but with cream, not straight), so maybe that was the deal here: I missed my cream. I think this drink might have benefited from a bit of cream and a bit less sugar.

I think the price is pretty steep, especially considering the size of the can, which is only 6.8 fluid ounces.It is very small.

Hydrolyzed corn gluten is a fancy name for MSG It also has 480 mg of salt in each serving - each package having 3+ servings.

I like my tea to look like coffee once I've added milk and this wasn't strong enough for me so I had to try again, this time blending the rose petal tea with a stronger unflavored black tea. It was in this way that I settled on an absolutely fantastic afternoon tea - one cup of water, one teaspoon of China Rose Petal, and a bag of P.G. Tips.

If you aren't as hung up on strong tea as I am you will likely appreciate subtleties that I miss doing it my way. Either way, if you are interested enough in rose petal tea to read reviews on Amazon then I can only imagine that you will get your money's worth from Taylors of Harrogate China Rose Petal.

Thick and disgusting.  Not even particularly spicy. I poured the remainder of the bottle down the drain.  You're better off making your own Bloody Mary from scratch or for mixers, Mr. and Mrs. T's is still the best and most reliable.

Russell Stover Sugar Free Jelly Beans are a good substitute for Jelly Bellies. Many flavors taste the same as the more expensive Jelly Bellies.  I enjoy the variety of flavors.  Unlike some sugar free products, where all flavors taste the same, Russel Stover Sugar Free Jelly Beans have distinctive flavors that run true to what you expect. These jelly beans taste as if they are full of sugar, but they are not. I must say the flavors were excellent!!  The only problem that any of us had was if we consumed more than a handful, we had very bad stomach problems.

I love Russell Stover.  These jelly beans are not too sweet for me, have a nice fruity flavor and no after taste.  But you have to be careful with portion size.  You may want to eat as many as Russell Stover says that you can, but don't.  Stomach rumblings will occurr.  You can have about 10 jelly beans to get a flavorful sugar rush without offending friends and family.
These jelly beans taste fantastic. I loved eating them, but the problem came afterwards. I saw the warnings about not eating too much, but even just a few made me incredibly ill.

There is a disclamer on this product, stating that excess consumption may cause gastric distress.
They are wrong........ a SMALL serving caused me to have gas, a regular serving (1/4th of a bag) caused me 4 hrs of diarrhea.

This product should be removed from from your stock and not be sold....It contains MALTITOL which definately cause stomach distress
cramps and serious diarrea . It is used as a sweetener. A fine company like Russell Stover can certainly find a better sweetener. I'm sure
this review will not be seen by anybody but please research MALTITOL. I now have half a dozen of these bags of sugarless jelly beans I have to throw away, because just a handful will send me rushing to the bathroom! Since Amazon is selling this product dispite my review, I
will no longer purchase anything from Amazon.
