While I have written lots of reviews on amazon.com I very rarely review grocery items. But when I find a product that I can enthusiastically endorse I enjoy passing on the information to my fellow Amazon members. Such is the case with Krusteaz Honey Raisin Bran Muffin Mix. This product was formerly marketed under the Sun-Maid brand and has been around for about ten years now. My wife and I count ourselves very big fans.

Prior to the introduction of Krusteaz Honey Raisin Bran Muffin Mix I had never really seen a bran muffin mix at the grocery store. You could either make them from scratch using the recipe on a box of Kellogg's All-Bran or buy them at a bakery on donut shop. Since we never had the All-Bran on hand we always opted for the latter option. Happily, Krusteaz solved that problem with the introduction of this fantastic mix. You can whip a batch of these muffins in just a few short minutes and within an hour you will have hot tasty bran muffins emerging from your oven.

With Krusteaz Honey Raisin Bran Muffin Mix you get tasty bran muffins that are crispy on the outside and soft and moist on the inside. Best of all they are packed with juicy and delicious Sun-Maid baking raisins. Bran muffins just don't get any better than this. I would take these muffins over any other bran muffins I have ever had. They are that good! We generally find that we can make 6 good size muffins from this 18.25 oz package. Krusteaz Honey Raisin Bran Muffin Mix generally sells for about $3.00 per box and is rarely on sale. Also, I have found that not all supermarket chains carry this item. Just to be sure we don't get caught short we generally keep 4 or 5 boxes on hand. I was pleased to discover that this product is now available through Amazon. If you love bran muffins like I do and have never tried this product I urge you to do so. Very highly recommended!

After reading several recipes for homemade brownies, I decided to play it lazy and go with a box. I used to make Betty Crocker like it was my job, but my husband came home with these instead.

I could not allow them to cool before eating half the pan. I was guilt-ridden but it didn't stop me from having one for breakfast the next day. They have chocolate chips, for goodness sake! And they are so, so, dreamily chocolatey and rich. Perrrfect. I don't like bleached flour as an ingredient, I just don't get it, but they tasted good, which is ultimately the point of brownies if you ask me. If you're looking for a healthier option, don't stop here.

FYI, i'm shocked at the price here...check your local Walmart, they carry them for $1.87 per box! Way better deal.

Ghirardelli chocolate is absolutely the best. (It's even a valid reason for going to San Francisco for a weekend -- especially to their Pier 39 shop. But I digress.)
- I am a very healthy, conscientious eater who happens to luuvvve good dark chocolate -- which is, after all, from a natural plant, full of antioxidants, and it keeps your hair silky & shiny, not to mention the theobromine and phenethylamine releasing the feel-good seratonin from your brain...you with me? - So, in order to satisfy both sides of my Gemini nature I decided to alter the suggested additions to this Ghirardelli Brownie Mix as follows: instead of l/2 cup oil, I used 1/4 cup of organic virgin coconut oil, slightly nuked just to melt it (you can read about why it's the best oil for you), and an additional 1/4 cup of water to balance the scoop of chocolate whey isolate protein powder I add to the batter, to establish a better protein/carbohydrate balance, which slows down the 'sugar rush' to your bloodstream. Traditional Medicinals Echinacea Plus is an herbal remedy in tea form designed to support the immune system. Echinacea is a Native American herb and is one of the most commonly used herbal medicines in the US and Europe. This tea delivers the immune boosting properties of organic Echinacea in a pleasant tasting blend of organic West Indian lemongrass leaf and organic spearmint. Echinacea Plus has a serene and subtle lemon-mint flavor that is exceptionally comforting for colds, and soothing to scratchy raw throats. Echinacea provides a slight tingle on the tongue due to the presence of alkylamides.

Traditional Medicinals recommends drinking 5-6 cups a days as soon as symptoms appear and then gradually reducing the dosage as symptoms improve.

Numerous clinical studies have examined the effects of Echinacea. Echinacea stimulates activity of cells that fight infection in our bodies and increases the number of these cells such as the white blood cells and lymphocytes. These immune cells attack bacteria, viruses and abnormal cells, including cancer. Echinacea has a positive effect on wound healing, lessens symptoms and speeds recovery from viruses.

Echinacea also has anti-inflammatory properites which aids recovery from psoriasis and eczema and may help arthritis. It also may increase resistance to candida, bronchitis and herpes and other infectious conditions. Echinacea should not be used continually for any longer than 5-8 weeks.

Why do you want 12 ounces of coffee in one shot? 8 ounces twice, a half-hour apart will be a much better experience. Like many, I have drank tea for many years, decades, actually, and have had the opportunity to sample everything from the standard bagged teas available everywhere to some of the most expensive hand-made teas developed in Europe using traditional processes. I won't try to pretend this St Dalfour tea is the equivalent of these highly esoteric (and incredibly expensive) teas, but what I can say is that this is a truly great tea for the bagged varieties, and, due to its unfamiliarity, would certainly qualify as a "sleeper" find. I can recommend this particular brand and variety as one of the best I've had.

What makes this so good? First, the ingredients are all natural, with no artificial flavors or fillers (check your labels carefully and be surprised to see how many flavored teas rely on artificial flavors). To take it a step further, the ingredients here are all organic (see the information on the boxes and on the website to read about this), with no pesticides, artificial colors, or flavors added. At first blush, one might not be immediately attracted to a "black cherry" tea, but the manner in which St Dalfour blends this results in a flavorful tea that contains a subtle flavoring and aroma of black cherry that is really wonderful.

If you prepare the tea correctly, you'll end up with a very smooth and delightfully flavored tea that may become your favorite. One secret for this, or any, tea is to not steep the tea more than 60-90 seconds MAX, and then remove the bag. It might seem like too short of a time at first, but if you force yourself to keep to this time, with a few dunks at the end, you should begin to see how tea can really taste if it isn't over-steeped and allowed to turn bitter. (Everyone has a strength preference and so you'll have to experiment at first, but if you can keep it to no longer than 90 seconds, that should be ideal.) Further, if you have a water boiler that allows you to select temperature, if you use a water temperature right below the boiling point, that smoothness can be extended further.

An easy recommend to the tea lover, this tea is one of my favorites. Five stars.

Dry Desert Lime is an unusual premium Numi tea. It is herbal tea (caffeine-free) containing solely dried lime---that's all---not lime and green/black tea, not artificial lime flavor, but real lime---alone---a truly remarkable feat. It is certified organic, and is kosher. It has the most amazing tart and lovely taste. If you like lime, you'll love this tea. If you don't like lime, definitely pass, as it is a very intense "lime experience". I love it!

On the box, the manufacturer lyrically writes: "From the far reaches of the Arabian Desert, this rare lime has been enjoyed for thousands of years, both as a spice in Middle Eastern cuisine and as a teasan. Traditionally harvested and dried in the hot desert sun, this oasis of Vitamin C has been drunk to soothe just about everything. The first taste brings a distant yet familiar impression, leaving the trace of a fleeting memory on the tip of your tongue. We find that its clean, bracing, and reviving citrus pleasure, nicely balanced with a touch of sugar, lifts the blues. Try it, you'll fall in love with it!"

The price is perfect, a big savings over single boxes. If you like Numi teas and enjoy lime, get it---you won't be sorry. If you are new to Numi but love lime, or are curious to try it from the description, I do not think you could find a better source than Numi. In fact, I have never heard of anyone else making this tea. I enjoy serving it to company, but even more, just for me.

*****

This tea is exclusively dried lime peels, so it's an unusal flavor.  It's not a fresh lime juice-y flavor, but a somewhat bitter & concentrated taste.  It is not terribly tart; I only add a little honey.  There is a bitterness to it, though - think of the pungent, bitter flavor of any citrus zest.  It will certainly not be a tea for everyone, but I could see myself acquiring a taste for it (I look forward to trying it iced!).  It's definitely an intriguing addition to my tea repertoire, if nothing else.  If you're not sure you want to purchase a whole box, try a Numi sampler - it includes two bags of each flavor, including Desert Lime.

This is a premium tea, on the high end in quality and in price.  It is good both hot and cold or even at room temperature.  Two bags will make an entire pot of tea. I've been drinking tea for 30 years and I honestly have to say, among the worst I've tasted. There is a also a fishy smell to the tea.
I absolutely LOVED this drink when we were in London this summer. I am so glad that I can get it through Amazon here in the US.

I've tried many brands of canned cat food. This one was the winner! All 10 cats gobble this up, and I have seen an amazing improvement in their vitality. They are more playful, their coats are so soft and shiny. I like that it is natural, the texture is smooth and moist, and the ingredients are nutritious. Unlike some other canned foods, this one seems easily digested as not one cat has vomited after eating it. The price I paid with free prime shipping was just 68-cents per can. The food does not have a strong odor. They don't have 'cat breath' after eating this food either! I hope that Amazon gets this back in stock, and puts it on subscribe-and-save!
good cat food my cat really likes this, just wish Amazon stocked more of the natural value pate'

When I serve Natural Value, I only use the pate varieties because they don't contain the synthetic form of vitamin K, menedione sodium bisulfate.  My 2 girls love the turkey, but this one has to be their favorite.  They like the chicken one too, but when they get this, even my little pokie eater chows it down with much relish!

Let me start this off by saying that this is definitely a step up from your standard grocery store cat food. If that is what your cat is currently eating and you're looking for a budget friendly but more wholesome alternative, then give this food a shot.

This is a downgrade from 100% grain free cat food, but I was looking for something better than the cheap stuff at the grocery store while recovering from some unexpected financial setbacks. I did notice my two kitties eat a lot more of this food than they do the grain free stuff, and their coats are less glossy and they are experiencing slightly more shedding, but it isn't anywhere near as bad as corn-filled budget food. They cut costs in the labeling, marketing, and their website design and invested their money into a solid budget friendly cat food.

I rated it 3-stars because, based on what I am seeing in their coats, this food has a high filler content... a little more than I expected. It isn't a terrible natural food, but there are better ones out there.

First things first:this is NOT an espresso roast coffee and the word espresso doesn't appear anywhere on the packaging. It's somewhere between city and full city roast and makes an excellent, full-bodied cup of drip coffee without a hint of any charred/burnt taste. This is Lavazza's premier quality coffee and never fails to elicit admiring inquiries when served to guests.

This is real Italian espresso ,the best you can find on the market. If you have an espresso machine and know how to use it then you got it made...Rich flavor and sweet at the same time ...I've known this product all my life growing in italy ...Excellent ...The very best.
I normally like a much darker and oilier bean but this has a great, mellow(in my book), almost chocolaty flavor...

This is my usual, day-to-day, coffee and there's really not much I can write about it other then "its great", "the best I've tried and I've tried most all" and "its worth its price!".... blah blah blah.. its coffee! ... if you like it, then its good - if you dont, then it's not... Just like wine - dont let anyone tell you what to like.

Here's what I *can* say though - this is the best price... especially when you setup a subscription through Amazon. My only wish is that they would carry the larger bags but given the price, I'm good with the smaller ones too... Each bag fills up my espresso machien (Jura Capresso E8) in full and carries me through a week of coffees (I have friends who come over frequently, so its not just my habit ;-).

I setup a subscription for 2 X 4 bags every two months. When I need more, I just login and have my shipment sent out sooner... simple as pie.

Enjoy!
Lavazza Oro is the smoothest, most mellow espresso we've tried.  It's now our "gold standard" (get it?  ha!) by which all other espresso is measured.

Lavazza Qualita Oro (Gold Quality) USED to be better, more authentic, more robust, more pronounced, more reliable as one of the traditional Italian roasts from Italy.

In both a classic espresso, and when making a latte or a cappuccino, this label was an old reliable. I found my recent purchase to be a huge disappointment, lacking in aroma but more so, a weak, flat and downright dull cup of coffee. I do not know what has been done to lessen the quality, but I now regret not spending a few more dollars and getting something much more enjoyable, such as Illy.

Be aware that as a grocery item, Amazon will not accept a purchase such as this for returns.

Very disappointing.

smelled nice, color was a very light tan/brown. I did a course grind for a french press and it was very weak and not drinkable in my opinion. I am not sure if I got a bad one, or if it's just not meant for a french press.
This makes excellent lattes in our DeLonghi espresso machine.  We really like Lavazza.  It is good quality and reasonably priced.  We have been buying Lavazza for several years now.
I have been using the Lavazza Qualita Oro beens since October of last year.  They are great. Very smooth (non-bitter) taste

I have bought this coffee before, both from amazon and in store and have been extremely satisfied. However, the order I received in JAn 2012 has a different packaging than the one I was used to and the coffee tastes horrible. Will not buy again from here.

This coffee tastes weak and old. Cream is very thin. I don't know the roast date, but it still had about year and half to expiration date. This is strange by itself- top quality coffee is good for about 1 month after the roast. It can survive longer, when beans are packed in a nitrogen filled sealed container, but this coffee came in a regular valved bag. The beans are well roasted, not burned, maybe they'd tasted better when fresh.
Gave it 2 stars because it is still better than a cheap coffee from a supermarket, which I consider 1 star benchmark.

This was my first time with Lavazza. The coffee was weak, light, flavor was OK but not what I was expecting from an Italian coffee. With the milk (cappuccino) it was barely present as taste.
I drink cappuccinos every day and I use a very good espresso machine and I can change the type of grind, and the strength and all that. No matter what combination I used it was just barely Ok.
If I could I would have returned the coffee.

This is really good stuff. This coffee has a creamy chocolatiness about it that always makes me want some when I wake up in the morning. I make mine in a 8 cup French press. 5 heaping scoops with a couple of spins in a $10 krups ginder and 3 minutes in filtered freshly boiled water and I am in Heaven. My mother tells me that this is even good without milk or sugar, which should say something.

I should note that some people give this coffee bad reviews because they believe it is espresso. It is not. Repeat: THIS IS NOT ESPRESSO. Look at the picture or read the packaging if you find it in a store. It is not espresso. Amazon listed it incorectly. Don't give this coffee bad reviews because of someone at Amazon who made a mistake.

I should also note that if you want any coffee to retain it's flavor you should not leave the coffee in the bag. You can always smell the coffee through the bag which means that the bag is not air tight and the flavor of the coffee is dissipating into the air. As soon as you get any coffee you should always put it in a plastic container that is air tight and stored out of direct sunlight. Do not store coffee in the freezer because the air cycling will also suck the flavors away.

Not a bad bean, not my favorite either. The flavor is well rounded with strong herbal scents and related undertones (primarily cut grass, wild flowers) . It grinds well and brews well. It's not an overly oily bean and the resulting coffee is not as viscous as with other blends. It's a more acidic bean than I like.

I prefer the Lavazza Tierra blend, it's oilier and its aroma is less herbal and more chocolaty. It's less acidic as well.

All that being said, I tried buying Lavazza on Amazon to get the free prime shipping, but it's not worth it. I'll go back to buying my favorite beans: Danesi Classic (Kimbo Black Top is very good as well).

I lived in Italy for several years, and Lavazza was my coffee of choice,  This isn't the same by a long shot -- the roast is anemic, and the resulting espresso is thin and tasteless.  The underlying flavor is has some of the distinctive notes from 'real' lavazza, but that really doesn't compensate for the under-roasting.

This is a great value for beans that make rich, creamy espresso and crema coffee just like in Italy.  I use it in an automatic Saeco machine and get great results.  However, as you'll see from other reviewers, don't get this if you are trying to duplicate the mass-market barristas, as this is a flavorful dark roast, but not an acrid one.
This makes excellent espresso. We really like Lavazza. It is good quality and reasonably priced. We have been buying Lavazza for several years now.

OK for espresso, but probably best for latte's.  Really the best latte's I can ever remember having.  Fresh grinding and brewed through a Jura Capressa  Impressa S9 yields a smooth, rich mocha flavor.
The Lavazza brand is one of Italy's best coffees and the "Qualita Oro" is probably among the top of the line if not the top of the line.  Delicious flavor!!!

The Lavazza brand of coffee does not taste anything close to this!!!  I lived in Italy and bought this same product several times and the product from Italy tasted a million times better.  The only thing that is close to the product is the package.  It smells horrible, the color of the beans is too light and dull, and it tastes so bitter and disgusting.  I would actually give the product zero stars if it would let me.  I will still continue to shop with Amazon but do not recommend this product to anyone.
I am not claiming I am a coffee expert or anything but I do like a nice cup of espresso or an Americano in the morning.  I use this bean with my Bialetti Brikka and I love the taste.

This coffee has been favorably described (mostly) by previous reviewers.  Please be aware it is not a dark roast espresso.  It is the lightest northern Italian espresso roast I have experienced.  My personal preference is for a medium dark but not burnt roast and that may be true for other espresso fans.
I AM TRYING TO FIND THE PERFECT COFFEE FOR MY TASTE.  THIS COFFEE IS GOOD, BUT WOULD NOT BE MY FIRST CHOICE.
there is a fruity taste, not my cup of tea, but a great coffee sticking to super crema.

Very nice roast. An aroma to die for. This is the best tasting whole bean I buy at Amazon. First time I bought it, beans looked a little dry. Nice smell, smallish amount for the price. I was skeptical. Well not any more.

These beans in a French Press are hard to beat. Smooth full flavor I just love. The price to wt. value is not that high. Well in line with others and the taste puts it above many others.

This is why I drink coffee.

Lavazza Qualita ORO bean coffee is our favorite. It has become increasingly difficult to find at local supermarkets, so we were pleased to find it at a VERY competitive price (and free shipping) on Amazon. The coffee arrived promptly and fresh from the supplier.
We originally found this coffee while on vacation in Italy and instantly fell in love with it. It is rich and flavorful without being overpowering.
We would recommend this coffe to anyone who loves rich Italian coffee.

This coffee is grrreat! Smooth and not a bad after taste. I am drinking it right now and was searching online to see where I could get another batch. My cousin just brought me some from italy and she is also inlove with it! Yes - the packaging is annoying but I have a coffee tin that I pour the grinds into so that is not a big issue for me.

I use the Lavazza Qualita Oro beans in my Automatic Espresso machine. Subjectively, I believe it is the best choice out there. This coffee is pure Arabica beans, lots of body without the bitterness.
I have made a point of trying different types of espresso beans over the years. The trend tends to be towards over-roasted beans with bitter after-tastes, and this coffee avoids it. It is plenty strong, but roasted perfectly for espresso use, and avoids the bitterness. I don't like to add sugar to my coffee and this bean with a hint of sweet finish works great. It is also not too oily which keeps the machine internals happy.
When you order it with automatic subscription on Amazon, it is also an unbeatable deal. Perfect.
This is a very god coffee. No comparison to domestic brands. Of course for those who can appreciate the difference.

For those on the fence regarding whether or not to try this, I add my "nod" to the rest.  We use a super-automatic and every cup is perfect with this bean.  We are not purists, but we like what we like...  I just subscribed for the ongoing shipments and am so glad to have all of the shopping around behind me.

It was wonderful to find these coffee beans; we've been looking for them since we returned from our trip to Italia.  The wonderful aroma and flavor takes us back to the little kitchens of our cousins and sidewalk cafes of Rome and Bologna.
Only coffee we will use in our espresso machine.  Full bodied, not bitter, excellent after taste.

Lavazza Italian Coffee is the best coffee I have had in a very long time. For many years, I have ground my own coffee beans.  Some times the coffee was o.k. but a lot of the time it would just taste off.  That was the way it was until my son ordered Lavazza Italian Coffee beans for me last Christmas.  It was like a miracle.  From the first time I ground up my beans and made my first pot of Lavazza coffee, life has been so much better for me in the morning.  I drink my coffee black and with Lavazza there is no bitter taste, its honestly just perfect. The beans just blend together to make a cup of dark coffee that is just very smooth and wonderful to drink with my newspaper in the morning.

l have been using ordering Lavazza Italian Coffee, Qualita Oro - bean, 8.8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)through amazon since June 2007. Its a great bean but you need to have the coffee is vacuum sealed, this ensures the taste is fresh. 4 out of 5 shipments the bags have pin holes allowing air to spoil the beans. l will not be buying from this vendor again.

The roast is a light medium.  Tried various grinds with my WEGA espresso machine.  Does not have the body and character to make a good espresso beverage.  Look for a darker roast.  Makes a pretty good drip.
Nowhere on this package does it say it is espresso.  It does make really good coffee, but it is not an espresso roast.  Amazon has mislabeled this product.

I have loved Lavazza Oro since learning to love caffe espresso in the late 1970's while attending Bologna Medical School. I purchased these because I got tired of hauling the ground Lavazza packs in from Italy and the price was good BUT did not notice that they are BEANS not yet ground. I don't have the time or inclination to grind them myself. Still a great coffee. As the late Nino Manfredi used to say in a series of TV ads at the time in what seemed to be a double play on words: "Piu lo butti giu, piu ti tira su." meaning "The more you drink the more it picks you up!" This was in the days before Viagra but the lecherous look in his eyes communicated the meaning well.

I was so surprised when I opened the can to see real shrimp prawns like the ones served in shrimp cocktail! The chicken looks like the canned white meat chicken that my husband and I purchase from Costco to make our homemade sandwiches with.  This is not your usual ground mystery meat that one usually thinks of when talking about wet dog food. This is whole food in a can that looks fit for a human. In fact, I called my husband after I opened the can to tell him that our new puppy was eating shrimp prawns and shredded chicken breast with kale and sweet potatoes and beans. Hubby wanted to know why the dog was eating better than he does. My 3 month old puppy wasn't eating that well and not gaining weight. I will continue to mix this with her dry food because she devoured it and was wagging her tail like crazy during the meal. I will have to see if she gains weight with this.

I just ordered 5 boxes of Solbites to give to my customers at Fiat of Montgomeryville.  Within a week the supply was depleted.  Great packaging, great taste, great addition to the cluttered assortment of snacks.  Solbites gets five stars from Fiat of Montgomeryville.  Look for our next order!

Without a doubt the most amazing and pure product we have ever tried. My wife (a medical/dietary professional) has done the research and believes this oil is the healthiest money can buy. My concerns are more "taste based" and was shocked by how natural and great tasting this brand of olive oil is.
The seller shipped immediately and the packaging technique (kept cold) shows how truly special this product is. A must for any kitchen or health conscious person.

My cats LOVE Natural Value.  They love every flavor.  I have concerns, like others, about the safety of tuna, etc, but I still buy this, because MY CATS LOVE IT.  I have a really hard time finding food they will eat.

Neither of my seafood loving cats liked this at all. It looked very dry, and both my cats love the juices to be plentiful in their half of  one can of wet food a day.  Both cats are crazy, crazy, crazy for an occasional real tuna treat, so i thougt this would be a sure  thing.  Two weeks after I got it I brought home two 12 week old kittens I decided to adopt, and they gave it a sniff, and walked away. Not even  my neighbor who I gave it to for feeding strays could get it eaten. This leads me to believe it wasn't a good  batch~ but the date was fine~ 2013 and the end of it, too. Disappointing for me since i had been looking for a cat food that was tuna and good for the cats, but this isn't it.
This doesn't seem to be the favorite flavor of my cats. They will eat it when they are real hungry, but most of the time they leave about half of it.

My cat that can eat fish loves this food!  I was concerned as well about tuna on a regular basis, but then learned that the tuna in the Pacific has much less mercury than that which is caught in the  Atlantic.  Along with the fact that my super finicky cat loves this keeps me buying it.  I do have to say that the ingredient list is not correct on this website because they do not use the synthetic K...menedione sodium bisulfate, in the large cans.  I don't think they have it in the small cans anymore as well, but not sure about that.  In the ones that I ordered, small cans, it was not included as an ingredient.  Anyway, I also want to say that of all the large cans of tuna with topping, this one looks the best and has big chunks of the albacore on top.  Mabel loves it!  You can not beat the price and quality of this food. Oh, another thing, Mabel even prefers this one to Tiki or BFF tuna and the latter still uses MSB in their foods and have no plans to change in spite of new research.  Doesn't say much for Weruva in my mind.

I love this tea. I found it by accident at a grocery store near me while i was searching for "Wild sweet orange". The minute I openned the packet I smell a rose scent similar to that found with Rose essential oil. (not the scent of rosewater, not the cloying scent of rose perfume nor even the perfumey sweetness of fresh roses, but a scent that is the true essence of roses.) The fragrance flooded me with pleasant memories. I see one reviewer didn't like it. I guess it is not for everyone. I love it. It is truly unique. I have never had a tea like this. After finishing half a box in 3 days, I have been in search of somewhere else to buy it.

The tea itself is more subtle than the aromatics that are released when the packet is openned. That is much harder to discribe . slight smell of rose with a hint of woodiness. It is more subtle than a lot of their teas. Too bad everyone can't try a sample before committing to an entire box.

Edit 12/12/10 OK maybe it is not so much the roses that give the strong scent. maybe it is the geranium oil. Whatever it is, it reminds me of a spa not a chinese herbalist.

Tazo Rest immediately appealed to me because it promises relaxation and deep sleep. The blend of lemon balm, lemon myrtle and valerian are supposed to cause the eyelids to willingly succumb. Since this has ginger in it I added lots of honey which also goes well with the orange peel, lavender ,licorice and ginger. Yes this tea is slighltly spicy with a heady comforting floral fragrance. Even as I type late at night I feel it working its magic. I will be asleep in minutes so good night and rest well and try this wonderful tea at bedtime as often as you like. You deserve it.

~The Rebecca Review

this is the best tea that i have ever tasted i love tazo teas but i think that they should come in the sachets instead if tea bags and sachets actually they should make both kinds and of course all the products they make!

Although the package design is very nice, I did not get the Rose scent at all with this tea.  The smell of the tea bag is appealing yet unappealing at the same time. Basically the ginger overpowers the other flavors.

I love Tazo teas, so when I found this new variety I was excited to try it.  It doesn't  disappoint !  This is a delicious blend of soothing herbs .  It relaxes you  and makes you ready for sleep!  I recommend it to all !

I have to agree with the first reviewer on this. While I'm generally not a fan of fruity or floral teas, I love rose in tea. When I first opened the bag, I almost gagged at the overpowering aroma of citrus and florals - although tazo uses natural ingredients, it seemed almost synthetic. Luckily, the tea (unsweetened and brewed as suggested) does not taste nearly as strong as it smells. Still, I couldn't get past the fact that it smelled overwhelmingly like a funeral home / aunt gertrude's perfume while tasting like a bowl of froot loops.

I suppose I had hoped for a more neutral base with subtle accents of flavor. If you don't mind in your face citrus and florals, then you will probably enjoy this tea.

Tazo normally has decent tea, however they do have a love for citrus and lemon grass. I was so curious about this tea that I decided to buy some, and with the tag of "well-being"-who doesn't want to be a little healthier? That being said my first smell of this tea left me gaging just slightly , but being of Asian decent I have drank medicinal herb brews which can peel paint from walls. I muscled through and took a sip. The taste wasn't nearly as bad as the overwhelming scent of old Chinese apothecary with random bits of leaf and twigs you don't want to know about. In fact it could be drinkable if you're into vile tasting tea with a side of puking in your mouth.

For those that actually do enjoy this tea...more power to you it gave me a headache just by it's pungent aroma.

This is a great summer drink. You don't drink it strieght though. It is an almond based syrup that is sweet. Wehn you mix it you get a mild refreasing drink. Mix 80% Perrier Sparkling Mineral Water, 750ml and lemon ice. Stir gently and serve. The almond and lemon flavors contrast nicly. Another way to make drinks is to use reguler water. You can get the same results and jazz it up with Back to Basics SIT466LP Electric Ice Shaver and Nielsen-Massey Pure Lemon Extract. Just a cap full works for a 16 ounce drink.

The Orzata syrup is quite tasty and I'm happy with that. However, the four bottles were hastily wrapped and thrown in a box. One of the bottles was cracked and had leaked.

My favorite way to use this is to put about a Tbl of syrup in a glass of cold water. It's very refreshing that way.

We've been eating these pears for over 2.5 years at least twice a day.  Gerber's organic variety is the cheapest price per oz I've found for an "organic pear-only" baby food.  Amazon's price (without Prime) is slightly less than our local grocery store when purchased at regular price.  This is the best price I've found outside special sales.  Contrary to the other review, almost all baby food is "cooked" via some method, usually steaming - even if homeade - which I did for a long time before switching to packaged versions for convenience and inaccessibility to organic produce.  The homeade raw puree works better for her child, but this product has been great for us.  It's been solving our constipation issues for over two years, and it works wonderfully!

I've been giving my daughter Gerber fruits, veggies, and meat as everyday-meals since she was 6 months old, thinking that she's got enough vitamins and prebiotics. However, she developed digestive problem and chronic constipation; she almost stopped gaining weight since she was 9 months old. I took her to GI and she told me that those packed fruits are all cooked! And there are additives to keep them fresh for long period of time! I started to puree fruits and veggies using Vitamix, and only use Gerber fruits&veggies when we are out and about. Now, after half a year of probiotics and wholesome food, she's slowly getting better and opens her mouth to food.
Now, think about this: if you puree an apple and leave it alone for 5 minutes, it'll change color due to oxidation. So, how can Gerber's apple puree keep the same color for so long a time?

First off, you can get these 3.5 oz boxes from your local "Wally-World" for 99cents each. So, Amazon is obviously making a killing off of these boxes.  The amount of gummies in the box is deceiving.  The box is extremely big compared to the bag holding the gummies.  I'd rather buy the Angry Bird Fruit Snacks, not sure if I can find them somewhere else .. other than on here.  $7 a box of fruit snacks is pretty ridiculous.
My grandchildren loves the gummies. I will buy the product again. It arrive on time . A good product and will recommend it to friends.
Angry Birds Gummies rock!  They are well packaged, great tasting, and big portions.  The kids go wild for them!  They sell out quick in stores, so I'm glad to have a mail order option.
We got these and the kids are SO sisapointed! They are super tiny boxes (about what you get for 50 cents at the store) Will not buy again!!

I grew up with this wonderful canned bread and have always had trouble finding it in the grocery store. When I could talk the manager into ordering a case for me, I would get very strange looks and then they wouldd never call me to let me know that it was in ... so I don't really know if they even ordered it.
I am so happy that I found it on Amazon. I had looked elsewhere but should have known to start my search with the best "shopping mall" on the internet.
Thank you, Amazon!!!
I am from England and my mother used to open a can of this  bread and spread butter on it and give it to us as a dessert. Its delicious and it's  great in the toaster too.
Old time favorate. Purchased for a friend in NC where she cannot buy it. She said shipped great to her home.

Yummy.  This bread is good when warmed and butter added.  Difficult to find at stores because it is not in the bread isle. Don't ask me why.  So where do you find it?  I still can't say which explains why I bought it online at this high price.  Goes good with beans which explains why it is made by a bean maker.  Although the beans can be made from scratch of course.

Do not buy this product in the bag if you are a lover of the International Coffee Italian Cappuccino in the can!

IT IS NOT THE SAME AT ALL!

I thought I'd be smart and get the stuff in the bag to save money and for the convenience but DON'T GO THERE!

The stuff in the bag has a strong chocolate taste and is heavy, I'd rather drink hot chocolate than this, hot chocolate tastes much better.

So, my point is keep buying International Coffee Italian Cappuccino flavor in the can and FORGET THE BAG STUFF, it's terrible.

Hope this keeps you from making the same mistake that I did, now I'm going to sell the balance of my order on eBay!

I was a huge fan of GFIC's Italian Cappuccino and was really unhappy when they quit making it, so when I saw this, same maker, same name, I thought I was getting the same product. Completely wrong. This item has a similar texture to their Swiss Mocha (liquid is somewhat thickened), and the flavor is totally different (again, more like Swiss Mocha). Tazo's Passion Herbal Infusion is a somewhat tart, deep, flavorful (hibiscus-y tasting) tea. It is not berry-like in taste, although it is red in color. It's difficult to describe what hibiscus tastes like, but I find it a most pleasant taste. My husband says it tastes like pomegranate to him. Although Passion contains licorice root it is not sweet.

The ingredients in Passion are: hibiscus flowers, natural tropical flavors, citric acid, orange peel, licorice root, cinnamon bark, rose hips, lemongrass and red poppy. It is caffeine-free!

Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.

On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "A tantalizing deep red tea made from hibiscus flowers, exotic herbs and natural tropical flavors." On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Passion as "berry, juicy, wine-like, merlot, sweet, earthy, dense". Tazo describes the aroma as "sweet, juicy, red fruits".

I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as very good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not as good as other teas such as Numi, which is why Tazo Passion gets only four stars.

It's easy to make a delicious pie from scratch. First, make enough pie crust dough for a two-crust pie. (Never buy a pie crust when you can make a better tasting one at home).

Place the bottom crust into a deep pie pan and crimp the edges. Next open a can of Oregon Fruit Pitted Red Tart Cherries in water and drain the water. Put contents into a large mixing bowl. Now let your imagination run wild! Add a can of Oregon Raspberries, and perhaps a half a can of Oregon Blueberries, both drained, as I did yesterday, or almost any variety of Oregon berries that you can get your hands on.

Add about 1/2 cup of sugar & 2 tablespoons of cornstarch to the berry mixture and stir it all up. Place into the pie pan and cover with the top pie crust. Make steam slits into the top crust, and dab with milk or butter, and then sprinkle sugar atop. Bake at 375 degrees for about 45 minutes to an hour. That's it!

The end result is a delicious pie that tastes better than anything you can buy in a store or bakery, and has much less sugar. You can, of course, add more sugar to the berry mixture if you like, but I like the cherries to taste tart.

So go ahead and make a pie!
