Both of my kids, my husband and myself love this tea.  It is fruity and smells heavenly when brewing.  I also like the fact that the bags are loose in the box, fewer steps since you do not have to open an individual package.  But that does make them harder to transport in your purse.
All of the pyramid teas are really good. But they are $2 a box at Wal-Mart. Don't pay too much for convenience.

From the moment you open the outer wrapper of these tea bags, the aroma floats out to greet you. After brewing, the tea is marvelously tastful. I would recommend to all tea afficionados.Lipton Black Tea, Bavarian Wild Berry, Premium Pyramid Tea Bags, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)

I love cold tea but hate the price charged for bottled teas. I decided to make my own and Lipton's Bavarian Wild Berry variety works perfectly. I use a ratio of 6 bags to 6 cups of water; I then add Splenda to taste and store in environmentally friendly and safe klean kanteen brand stainless steel bottles. (Hint: if you don't want to buy reusable bottles, save a few of the glass bottles from purchased teas and reuse).

I now have all the convenience of the store bought cold tea for a fraction of the cost. Plus no empty bottles (plastic or glass) to recycle.

An extra bonus: turns out the smell of this tea while it steeps is wonderfully aromatic!
We love this tea all year long, but especially during the summer in our iced tea pot.  It has a slightly sweet taste and doesn't need sugar to be delicious!
I love Lipton's new pyramid flavored teas.  This happens to be my favorite.
I add two of these to my normal sweet tea brew and I just love the taste.  People are always talking about how good it tastes.  Its also great alone!  Its great! A must try!

I drink tea my entire life. Decided to try something different. Bad choice! This tea tastes awful to me. I do not like any cinnamon or any other spices in my tea. The Amazon description should include the list of ingredients for each product!
Its probably my fault for not reading the fine print.The tea tastes great,I thought it was pure green tea not green and white tea mix, as this is what I recieved.
My candied cherries arrived promptly and in excellent condition.  They will be used to make my special fruit cake in the middle of the year.  This product is just what I needed.  Delicious!

I LOVE my mom's Homemade Fruit Cake and this purchase gives me a way to bake fruitcakes all year long, whenever I'm in the mood for the Most Delicious fruitcake you'll ever eat. :-) This product is seasonal at local supermarkets, so purchasing this at Amazon all year long is PERFECT.
I elected to Subscribe & Save, in order to get Free Shipping & an extra discount from Amazon.

If you need these cherries other than close to the holiday season, e.g. to make an English Christmas Cake and give it time to mature, Amazon appears to be the only source. I now have enough of these for several years' worth of cakes, but I would have preferred to buy just one tub. Even better would be to have a grocery store that stocked such cherries year round. Sigh!

Love these red cherries. makes great fruit cake or as granish on cookies or inside your own cherrry cordials. The taste of paradise red cherries is excellent. My son likes to put them in sprite or 7 up.
I have tried all the coffee candies I could find on the internet, and these are simply the best!  A savory treat after meals or when on the road.  Love 'em.
I'm so glad I can now get this at Amazon.  Living in Idaho this is not something readily available to me.
I prefered the seaweed flavor over this cause its too sour to me. since i usually have it in the mornings, it sometimes gives me acid stomach the entire day. but the case may differ on other ppl.
The product was shipped promptly, and was packed well.  Also, the product was fresh.  I will order from this retailer again!

The San Francisco Bay Colombian Supremo has a noticeable coffee flavor to it. If you're like me you doctor your coffee with cream and sugar and sometimes (I'm talking to you, Chock Full of Nuts) that comforting coffee taste and aroma can be overcome by the C&S. Not so here. The flavor stands up to the competition in the cup and tastes just right any time of day. This isn't my FAVORITE coffee, but it could be yours. It's absolutely worth trying.

This 16 ounce order from SweetGourmet surprisingly came in a transparent, thin plastic bag, like it was packaged from bulk or something. Gourmet licorice contains licorice oil that smears the inside of the bag, so it looked pretty ugly by the time I opened it (I had intended to give it as a gift to someone who loves licorice). However, it was the SOFTEST of this brand that I had ever had, even softer than the ziploc bags that have the Kookaburra name and logo on them. I think SweetGourmet has the best price to weight ratio for this item, too. I will certainly order from them again.

As far as licorice goes this one is just so so. If you love real licorice buy RJ's that in my opinion is by far the best there is. This one has great texture and a good initial taste but then a strange bitter note like that of blackstrap molasses hits your tongue and a an unpleasant sulpfur after taste that lingers. It is too sweet and almost more of an anise flavor then real pure licorice. I don't know whats in it it came in a clear bag twist tied from a health food store locally. If you love blackstrap you may like it. I much prefer RJ's it is all natural and much better in both texture and pure real licorice root flavor. I like Panda brand for flavor too but not texture. I would not buy Kookaburra brand again.

It does taste good, but like others, I had an issue with the packaging.  The bag and label have no nutritional data--at all.  I'm on a diet and one of my kids has food allergies.  So I'm guessing at the calorie content, and won't give any to my licorice-loving son because I don't know exactly what's in it.  I have no data on where it was made or packaged. You have to be ridiculously trusting to start eating. But it looked good, so I tried it.  The taste is what I was looking for, but without ingredients or caloric info, I won't be buying this again.
This is sweetgourmet.com branded licorice, not Kookaburra brand. Buyer beware. Very misleading advertising. It was fulfilled by Amazon, so I am even more disappointed.

I purchased this licorice in hopes it was like the kind I purchased at Dylan's Candy Bar in Florida.  It isn't the same, but is very close, and has a very good flavor, and texture. If shipping wasn't an issue, I would purchase again!!!
This is by far one of the best licorices I have ever tasted.However,the two bags I purchased were not the freshest-I have had fresher and softer Kookaburra. It is also a little pricey.

Absolutely wonderful. A real licorice taste. No phony baloney here!
It has a great flavor. I'd purchase it again for sure.

I don't like any kind of licorice, I got this item for my girlfriend because since she travelled to Spain many years ago, she tasted a true black licorice and in Mexico it's really hard to find. So as usual amazon was my solution and bought this, and I she loved it, and even I tasted it and it has a great taste, it changed my mind about licorice.
This was absolutely great stuff.  It was fresh and delicious. It received my item in a couple of days just as they said.  I would definitely use these guys again.
This isn't a bad candy, if you like a real strong molasses taste, but I can barely taste the licorice for the molasses.  I wouldn't call it a good licorice candy.
My sister has many food allergies. She had had this licorice previously and did fine with it. When she asked for some for Christmas this was perfect! She loved every bite.

This licorage is a true treat to eat.
However, next time I will have to order a larger size.

Eva C.
Received fresh and soft and on time. Licorice lovers will love this product! The price was a good one too after comparing other sites prices.
I love black licorice and try any new one I can find. This was delicious licorcie and not too hard and not too soft. Just Great !

I find that this licorice, is one of the most delicious that I have had in many years.  The only thing that ever came close to this when I remember buying it back in the 1950s which was produced by a different company.  The only drawback that I see is that I think it's quite expensive.  As I figured each 16 ounce bag comes to about $10.50 each I myself purchased four of those bags.  And of course let's not forget the shipping that is not included.  I think in the future I'm going to look for a company that sells in larger quantities, because sometimes it's cheaper to buy in bulk as opposed to little individual bags, and also many times shipping is included.

The licorice is the best. The shipping was very fast.

I did send an e-mail the next day saying I wanted a smaller amount, but they sent the larger amount. Probably didn't get it in time.
Carole
This is the very best licorice I have ever eaten.It is tough to stop when I start. If you like licorice, I suggest you try this one.
It tasted good, but was not as soft as some I had tasted on a friend's home.  I'd like the packages to be smaller in size.

The licorice was exactly what I had hoped for, and the gift recipient was very happy.  But... unless I am remembering wrong, the ad said it was a bucket of licorice.  I expected it to come in something more than a cellophane bag.  It was a bit expensive, in that form.  The gift value was great, though.  Ruth

This licorice was really delicious - a must for all true black licorice lovers!  It was soft and chewy but not sticky.  The flavor is very strong with a pleasant, lingering after-taste.  The licorice arrived in an unlabelled plastic bag, but the bag was clean (unlike what another reviewer received), and the product arrived four days after I ordered it.  I will definitely be ordering Kookaburra licorice again!

This stuff was not rediculously expensive, but it was expensive enough. I expected that real gormet.. I wasn't thrilled.. didn't taste very strong and it was way too soft.. haribo's licorice wheels are much better.

Keep in mind that this is Turkish style coffee and so is VERY finely ground, therefore if you are not making it in an Ibrik or something with a good filter this is not for you.  This is very good tasting coffee  and I would certainly recommend it to any and all coffee lovers.
This is just not as tasty as other similar coffees I've tried. Try finding a local international store instead.  I found one called "Alameed" which I like better.

I'm crazy about cardamom and I love the subtle flavor of cardamom in this coffee. A junky old Mr. Coffee coffeemaker does fine with it (the fine grind is no problem at all). I live in Seattle, I drink coffee daily, and love this stuff!
Great shelf life and you can make it so many different ways. It is great to have when we know there is a storm on the way here in Florida.

This stuff is truly amazing...very tasty, indeed! The corned beef was tender and good flavored, without being too salty. The potatoes were billed as reconstituted, but I couldn't tell. Overall, the hash was quite light in texture, as advertised. I'm assuming that half a can is a serving...they're not saying. The stats in grams are pretty darned impressive: 3 saturated fat, 6 fiber, 15 protein, and 5 sugar. Try throwing a can of this hash into a large cast-iron skillet, add some diced pickled beets and yellow onion, and stir-fry with a ration of butter. Congrats, you've now made a fairly respectable "red-flannel hash"!
Corned beef hash is way too pricey at the store, so this was a good alternative option.  Even being the reduced fat version, I was impressed with the quality and taste of Hormel's brand.

My husband and I loved the tasted and consistency.  We ran out of this and had a can of the regular and thought the extra fat made it stick to the roofs of our mouths--yuck!  My only reason for 4 stars is that it still contains a lot of fat.  If we eat this though, we're just careful the rest of the day.  As long as you plan your meals, it's great.  Highly recommend.

I find this a tasty product, as is the original non-reduced fat.  It still has a lot of fat, if that's your issue.  Not mine (I choose where to spend my fat calories), so I had a little non cholesterol margarine when I fry it and it comes out good.  Very hard to find at my local stores.

When I opened the first can, I could smell beef. Cooking this product was a pleasure. Unlike other canned corned beef hashes, it did not melt into a pool of greasy slime when heated. It browns nicely and tastes the way I remember from my childhood. I can even slice it and cook patties. Easily the best commercial hash I've had in 30 years.
I have found this hash an excellent quick meal, going particularly well with steamed cabbage or broccoli and applesauce. It is filling, not too fat, and well seasoned.

This is a mixed review. The hash is great and just what I wanted. My complaint is several cans were dented. Two of them were severely so and had to be thrown away.
The shipping box was undamaged so I have to assume the problem arose when the cans were originally wrapped. Frankly the price through Amazon is not so good that one can afford to throw product away.

Please understand the 5 star rating is for the hash quality only.

I'm not used to soft canned foods but since i just had all my upper teeth extracted, this is day 5 of recovery with temp's in.  I followed the recipe on the can, less the whole corn, and fried in some Pam and sprayed with Olivio when finished.  1 serving = 1/2 can.  i must say.....7 pts on WW, i could have eaten the whole can. easy to eat in my situation and 1/2 the fat of the roast beef hash which i also ordered.  not sorry i made the purchase.
We have been purchasing this since we first discovered this lower fat version.  My husband and I find it more flavorful than the regular corned beef.

This is a great foundation to build upon for a quick meal when you're in a hurry.  Yes, it's true, the potatoes probably outnumber the beefies, but that's inconsequential if you add a slew of healthy veggies while stir-frying this wonderfully non greasy hash to the crispness of your choice.  It's also receptive to a variety of toppings or sauces which fancy it up as well.  I don't know why Hormel even makes the full-fat version anymore when this stuff performs so well!
Nothing wrong with the product - I buy it in the supermarket all the time, but half of the cans were seriously dented in my order.  I won't order this product from Amazon again.

I just bought his item off Amazon. The shipment came very fast, but some of the cans were dented. They packed it very poorly, they literally jut put it in a cardboard box along with a case of another canned food item. There was nothing but a couple of those air-filled bags in there with the 2 cases. They both got banged around pretty good before delivery. Both cases had several dented cans from the shipping, so a very bad score from Amazon for packaging by people that don't care.

As for the CBH itself, I personally found the low-fat version too low in fat! It didn't render any fat when I cooked it in a non-stick frying pan. I had to add oil to keep it from sticking which defeats the purpose of the non-fat feature. Even so, it still came out pretty dry tasting, it didn't have that rich smooth taste that a little more fat will provide. Even without the normal amount of fat, this product still tasted fine.

I can't really say this is a complaint about the product. After all, I knowingly ordered a low-fat version of the product to try it out and put in the disaster prep stockpile. I just want to let people know that this is a good product, but it will not cook or taste like regular CBH will. It is dryer and less flavorful. But, it does have less fat and if that is important to you, then this should fit the bill.

I am knocking off 1 star for the truly awful packing\shipping.

-Mike
If you like potatoes then this product is for you. REAL corned beef hash should have more corned beef then potatoes. This is 90% potatoes.
Forget it-I will not eat nitrates!  Nitrates are terrible and that ingredient alone is makes this a zero star but I had to give it one because zero stars was not an option.

If you're looking for great value and great taste then this product is for you. I was skeptical about artisan salts and sea salts being different than regular salt until I accidentally ordered a case of sea salt from Portugal from our Co-op. Artisan salts and sea salts add flavor and zing to sea food, grilled foods and vegetables. I've never looked back and only use these special kinds of salts on everything. Be advised, though, if you put pink salt on something, it will turn that something slightly pink.

Try this salt and then try salt from Hawaii, Portugal, France, prussian blue from Germany, salt from Japan, Mexico, etc ... You will be surprised at the diversity in taste.

This is really a fantastic salt.  It is on the sharper side of salt.  It will take you up in flavor very quickly, then bring you down fast.  Takin it up, then bringin it down.  Takin it up, then bringin it down.  Yeah, its good.

Not only in the kitchen, but makes beautiful bath salts for gifts as well.  Many aren't aware that different salts impart different flavors  to foods.  If using at the table, this salt requires a good grinding mill as its much to course to use as is.

Good-bye salt!! Hello!! Himilayan magic!!! WOW!! What a flavor enhancer!! Love it to the MAX!! I'm purchasing more!!! Nice job on my order, and you have great associates working for you. I'am extremely pleased with Amazon. Regards, Peter Daniels, Costa Mesa. California.
These are good digestives, crunchy, not too sweet, and very reasonable, especially with subscription.  Great with a cup of tea.

I was so happy to see the great review on these pills that I threw caution aside and purchased a significant quantity of two flavors for personal use. I wanted to have extra for passing around to my friends. I eagerly tasted my coffee with the flavored pills; absent of carbohydrates, great for chocolate and caramel lovers. To my dismay, even with two pills, my coffee was still lack-luster. Neither the chocolate nor the caramel tasted like the real thing, just another ho hum imitation flavor assimilation lacking quality for the taste buds. In my opinion, these pills are not worth buying. This is too bad because such care went into the packaging. If the product had half the class the packaging does,I would purchase their product for my coffee shop.

I did alot of research on dog foods and Merrick was one of the brands rated very well. My minpin Hudson is very picky about his food but he ran into the kitchen as soon as i opened the can. I mix a little in with his dry dog food and he devours it.  i was suprised when i first opened the can because it looked watery and there were whole chicken wings with bones and all not what your accustume to when you open a can of dog food. However, the chicken wings fall apart easily and are very soft the bones literally turn to mush. It looks like whole chicken wings in gravy that have cooked in the crock pot allday and it smells wonderful.  I have tried other high quality brands and he would quit eating them after a day or two.  He eats this every time and it looks like homemade food that I would eat. His coat is glistening and soft and he has great energy. I can't wait to try the other flavors I'll let you know if he likes them. I'm going to switch his dry food to merrick when his Inova is gone.

My two dogs prefer the WingaLing over the other varieties of this dog food. There are actual wings (usually 2) packed into the can along with other meat chunks, veggies and liquid. There is a bit more liquid than I would like but my dogs eat it, it doesn't go to waste and you can see that "real" meat is used.

This is very good dog food.  Much worth it.  I mix it with my dry and my min pin & pomeranian go crazy.  It's healthy and the REAL CHICKEN WINGS come in the can BUT they are easily digestible and safe for your dogs.  I would definitely recommend.

I did not realize that this actually had the bones in it. Not something that I would give to any dog let alone a Yorkie and a Poodle. The bones take up a lot of room in the can. The rest of the can contains little cubes of meat, a few vegetables and lots and lots of gravy. I usually split half a can between the two dogs. The only way I am able to get another meal out of the can is to add more cooked vegetables. The dogs really like it but I will not buy this flavor again. You are getting less for your money since it contains bones and so much gravy. I would recommend the Turducken. They absolutely love that one.
very reasonable price and free shipping to home...what's not to love?  whole wings (not thrilled about the bones but they are soft enough to break with your fingers...or remove if you want) included

As a small dog owner, (Shitshu), we are careful about what our dog can easily get down her throat. She is also a picky eater, as are a fair amount of small dogs.
She loves the Merrick Wingaling, but one day while breaking up one of the large chunks of chicken, I was amazed to find a fairly stout chicken bone within the meat. I removed it, thinking it must be an anomoly. Then it happened again in the same can, then another can, and on and on.
Final word, although my dog likes this food very much, we will stop buying this brand due to the possibility of our dog getting scratches in the throat from chicken bone edges, or worse yet, choking on the bones with a full mouth of food. Many people have said on other dog sites that dogs can digest chicken bones. That is true, if they can get them into their stomachs. The problem arises on the scratches to the throat lining, then possible inflammation or infection, and at the worst, choking and not being able to dislodge a sharp piece of bone. No thanks.
It is just not worth the possible worry, considering the price of this food.

I purchased two cases of Merricks Wingalings and Smothered Comfort. The label states "whole thighs" and "whole wings" but that is a lie. Once opened, the cans have one - if you're lucky two pieces. The rest (3/4 of each can) is processed cubes of who knows what my dog refuses to eat. Merricks should either fill the can with what they advertise - "WHOLE thighs and wings" - plural - or tell the consumer the truth about what they are selling here.
Mr's May's sesame seed snacks are the best thing I've tasted in years!! I had them at a small sandwich shop and was hooked!! Low sugar and gluten free.

The five star review also posted here is right on when it comes to everything it says. I was planning on ordering a box of the blueberry sesame strips because they are small, easy to carry,and satisfying when those hunger pangs hit.  Having saved the wrapper just as I was waiting for Amazon to load I just happened to notice that these tasty morsels are made in China.  Doggone it.  With all the bad press associated with China and their food exports, including pet food within the past couple years, I have to pass.

While the shipping was quick, the product was not good.  It tasted like an ashtray, not the smoked salt I had had a week earlier in a restaurant in Philly.  I actually just threw it away.  I probably have to go for the much smaller much more expensive variety.
This tea ia a little stronger than most English Breakfast flavors I've tried so I just dilute it with more water and then I can enjoy it.

I bought this tea because I like Timothy's Coffee products and figured the tea would be just as good.  I could't have been more wrong.  It has barely any flavor and what you do taste is horrible. I am so sorry I bought the 48 pk.

I agree with the other reviews.  This tea does have a very good flavor.  It tastes as good or better than the Twinings.  Since Twinings English Breakfast decaf is no longer available through Amazon, this is a good alternative.
Excellent tea.  Timothy's need to make their coffee as robust as this tea.  Good stuff!
Purchased this my wife because it was decaffeinted. She loved it and I have to admit I'm kinda fond of it myself. Strongly recommend!
They are amazing and addictive, Once you have one you can't stop. I ate the whole box over a weekend, the are so juicy and delicious.
taste texture is incredible. my favorite candy ever. soooo good.  not much to say other then that it's candy.  all flavors awesome.  I buy by case

This purchase started as a way to get free shipping for an different purchase. I love mangos. The raw fruit is delicious, dried makes for a tasty healthy snack, so I figured I'd give mango candy a try.

It's like skittles but softer & without the hard candy shell. The mango flavor isn't as strong as I'd like but it's enough to satisfy (this is just candy afterall). I engulfed the first 4 packs while at work (day one). Gave a pack to the boss who immediately asked where I bought this addictive candy. Guess I'll have to give him another pack. As another review mentioned, it does have a slight oily feel but it didn't bother me at all. I think that's what helps it stay so chewy.

In short, I like it. It might not be for everyone but I'll be buying more of this tasty candy.

I love mango anything except for this. They have a really oily taste.  Yuck. I was quite disappointed. I wish they came by the pack instead of a whole case so I wouldn't have wasted so much money trying them out.

Our entire family loved this gluten free corn pasta! Very good taste and texture. In fact, it tastes just like regular pasta. I will definitely purchase more of this brand.  We found this brand to be just as good as Le Veneziane pasta (another great gf pasta imported from Italy). We are love the new Caserecci shape.

I used to have EXTREMELY bad cramps during my time of the month. When I say EXTREME, I mean cramping so bad that I would have minor blackouts. My mother-in-law suggested I take some organic virgin coconut oil and I took a tablespoon of it, however it didn't taste good at all. It did make my cramps go away for that entire day. So my wonderful husband went out and bought me some of these capsules from the health food store, I was kind of skeptical b/c he paid $20 for it, but I thanked him and started popping the suggested amount, 3 caps, 3 times a day.

Since the caps have a small amount in each cap, you have to take that many to get it in your system. The first month I took them, the cramps subsided to just enduring slight pain in the morning on my first day. The second month I didn't experience any PMS symptoms and even less pain on the first day. The third month I experienced NO PMS and NO PAIN through my whole 7 days. I've heard it is good for lowering your cholesterol and help maintain weight amongst other things. I'm just happy they made my cramps go away.
My wife is very happy with this product. She takes it , I do not. I don't know what she takes it for.

rated it one star because it wouldn't go to zero star, this stuff is a waste of money, coconut oil, it might work if you put it on a bicycle chain, or a zipper thats sticky otherwise don't waste your time or money.

I am a fan of triple creme cheeses, but this one took the cake.  Nice, nutty, complex, the flavor had different nuances with each bite.  This cheese also kept for a long time and went well with a variety of pairings.

I loved these dried organic olives!!! Very tangy and tasty,
chewy texture, and very healthy as they are raw and still
have all the healthy enzymes intact!! can't wait to get more!
Just what I was looking for. It is getting harder and harder to find this flavor in stores. I'm glad I can still get it here at Amazon.

I've purchased all the usual dog treats for Twiggles, and she's just not interested. She absolutely LOVES these treats! They have a rather peculiar odor, not really horrendous, but I do wash my hands after handling them.

I got these treats the other day hoping that it would help ease the teeth cleaning process for my dogs. My Husky and Yorkie both seemed to like the treats because they devoured them in less than 5min. However, later that night my Husky threw up 3 times with chunks of the treat in her vomit. It is now 2 days later and they are still very gassy and it smells really bad. My Husky seems to be the only one really reacting to the treat. She is having diarrhea now, which is rare for her.

I only gave them one of these treats and unfortunately I regret it. There goes $15! :(

I recently have been purchacing the Nylabone product for my pooch "Rainy
'a 9 year old Peek...his favorite treat for the past 8yrs have been the green dental chews, he begs for them and devours eachone..the last two bags I recieved were not fresh , even the color was off , the entire pkg was hard and had no scent, usually when i open the bag the smell is evident...not so with the last two purchaces. The other problem is Rainy has no intrest any long in his favorite treat...therefore I will not be buying anymore, or is there any way to correct the situation..sincerely Peter J. Colangelo

This product is an excellent dental care product. It certainly helps in keeping Bailey's teeth and gums in better shape. And he loves getting one to chew on each day - he gulps it down. A good product and one the doggie loves too - great combination.

Great price for our dog's favorite treat. We brush his teeth, so I can't attribute his sparkling white smile completely to the NutriDents but I can say Keeper likes them, they digest well (he's a 'senior' and anything he ingests that doesn't agree w/him, we know about instantly!)
Our dog gets one per day after he has gone outside to take care of his morning duty. He loves them so much, he starts howling to be let back inside to get his reward.
These are a hit with our dogs - they're good for their teeth, improve their breath and they provide vitamins and fiber for their diet. The price on Amazon was far better than in the pet store chains.
My dog loves Nylabone Nutrident dental chews, and I love that her breath smells so good after she devours one.
This product is a MUST for my Pomeranian who adores these. They keep his teeth very white, so his dental checks are always very good. I will always keep these on hand for him!
My dog likes them and try to give one everyday to him.  He actually looks forward to them like its a treat so thats a plus.  Had another brand he wouldnt eat so this is a step in the right direction.
This was a no nonsense purchase.  My purchase quickly in good condition.  I found it to much cheaper than a retail store along with the convenience.
my dog is a picky eater but he considers the Nylabone dental chews as a treat worth asking for every night.
My dogs LOVE them and they are packed with vitamins,once I order them they are delivered to my door in a couple of days.
Great!  My dogs beg for them.  One won't even finish his dinner because he wants his Nutri Dent.  Much longer lasting than those new formula Greenies.
This is the kind of treat I want to give my dog, in fact, it's one of the few she will eat. Thank you.
My chihuahuas eat bag after bag of these and have never gotten tired of them. Best treat I've ever got for them.

My guys love these things...and the best part about it is that they're good for them too!!  I shudder to think what I would be giving to my two dogs if Nylabone hadn't created these Nutrident edible chews.

You should monitor your dog very carefully if you give him/her these chews. One of our dogs died as a result of eating these chews, and the other three were very ill for two days. This product is very difficult for dogs to digest and can result in blocked intestines and infection. Since the package did not contain any warnings, we thought they were harmless. Be very careful if you buy these for your dog.

Unfortunately my dog only likes the beef flavor of this product.  I accidentally purchased the green version.  I did not see the beef version offered.  Luckily, I have another dog that likes green just fine.

I had just bought the package, so the expiration date was far away.  After just two minutes of boiling (package indicates 5-7 minutes), almost all the noodles had broken into tiny pieces. This is just an FYI to the folks like me who have to be careful what they eat and drink. The sulfites in this pickling blend are used a preservative, which is completely unnecessary in my opinion. McCormick simply wishes to ensure an indefinite shelf life for this stuff at the expense of individuals' health.

PS - I love to make pickles, jellies and preserves, etc., and to give them as gifts. If you give gifts of pickles made from this spice, please consider warning the recipients about the sulfites. Nothing ruins a gift like associating a friend or loved one with a gift that makes you ill! I speak from experience.

I have seen celebrity endorsements on products before - but I'm the type of person is not easily motivated to buy anything based on what I see and hear strangers tell me on the TV, the radio or the Internet.  But in this case since the Cadbury Mr. Big is on my Top Five list, I was going to buy this item anyway.  But with Alex Ovechkin on the wrapper - it's just a bonus for my Grandson!  He has not figured out that the wrapper does not change what is inside since he is only 5 years old.  I shared a small piece of the Cadbury Mr. Big with him (don't tell his mother...) - but just like Christmas, he probably liked the Special Edition wrapper the most.  Kids are like that...anyway, I just hope he does not chit-chat with his Buds since I will be the one to pay for (and pass around...) the rest of my Mr. Big candy bars.  Yikes!  Bottom Line?  Liked the product since I was much younger and hope that I can keep my teeth (in my head...) long enough to enjoy a lot more of them...

I had not drank green tea in months because I usually just dont find the taste to be very satisfying. I had read good things about the Celestial Seasonings organic green tea and decided to try again for its health benefits. From what I understand, this brand offers the most catechins which are what give you the health benefits.

My shipment arrived quickly and I tried the tea as soon as I got it. I was very impressed. This tea tastes so much better than all the other green teas that I have tried. It's a nice soft flavor. So, overall, I am very glad that I bought the tea. Now, I get a tasty drink and good health benefits. : )

Drinking this tea feels amazing! I've been a devotee of this for over three years now. There's no other tea I've stumbled upon I love so much. Great for immune system, mind, skin, over all well being!

I have been drinking this wonderful green tea for years. It has replaced coffee in my life and I am more relaxed and healthy as a result.  I recommend this fine product to anyone who is searching for a gentle caffeine lift.

I always buy Celestial Seasonings tea whenever I can.
Their product is unsurpassed in quality and taste.
Much better than other "natural" or "organic" teas.
I just wish they would make a better marketing effort with the retailers in my area. Their teas are virtually non existent in the markets in my area.

This tea is a blend, not simply just Green Tea leaves. Though the ingredient list states this, the name and label do not. Is Celestial Seasonings cutting costs this way? It's safe to wonder. It would be nice if the name was altered to reflect its true nature: a potpourri.

I have tried numerous teas from Celestial Seasonings and by and large I've enjoyed them all. Not this one. They prominently display "GREEN TEA" on the box cover, and state "with WHITE TEA for SMOOTH TASTE". But unless you really look, you won't notice that it also has natural lemon, and orange flavors, along with other listed flavorings, and Stevia to boot (for natural sweetness). All this sounds yummy, right? I don't think so. Sure, the first few sips were like "hmm, that's not bad" but quickly the flavor of this bastardized "green tea" became annoying. Probably not so much the flavor, but definitely the sweetness is too much for me. But if you like sweet beverages this one is fairly tame so you'll likely find it OK in that department.

My main problem with this is the fact that it's advertised as "Green Tea" and I believe this is misleading. It doesn't remotely resemble authentic green tea in terms of flavor, in fact you can't even taste the green tea here because it's overpowered by the other flavors. Real green tea is very mild in taste and doesn't need a sweetener because it's smooth and tasty without all the extra ingredients.

Even if it wasn't for the misleading here, this mix is still not my cup of tea. It's "OK" at best, but I wouldn't buy it again and I'm not sure I would even mix a bag or two in with my regular brand of green tea (for iced tea).

Finally, I am NOT in the habit of writing bad reviews for products on Amazon. I believe this is my first. But I know green tea, green tea is a friend of mine, and this sir is no green tea.

I thought I was ordering authentic green tea, so when I got the green tea and it tasted like lemon and other sweet things and anything but green tea, I was very disappointed. Even from the name "antioxidant" green tea, I wouldn't normally expect such a fruit-flavored beverage. Frustrating. Having said that, I do enjoy Celestial Seasonings Authentic Green Tea as one of the most drinkable low-priced greens, and I also appreciate their eco-friendly packaging. (And, really, it was my mistake in ordering the wrong tea, however I think their packaging or description maybe could be clearer about the differences.)

I enjoy Celestial Seasonings teas as an inexpensive source of pretty good tea. I drink a lot of green tea, especially Korean green tea, and so most Western green teas are a bit too heavy-handed for my taste. The problem with this tea, though, is that it is packed with orange flavoring - apparently, vitamins, too, - which is nice, if you wanted to buy orange-flavored tea. The orange flavoring completely overwhelms the necessarily subtle taste of the simple green tea. So if you want an orange (green) tea, this is the product for you. I've rated it one-star because there's nothing about the packaging that conveys the strength of the orange flavoring, which should be mentioned prominently, since it is so prominent in the taste.
We have  eaten these before and enjoy them .  We recommend them to anyone who enjoys cashews particularily with the light touch of pepper which makes them delightful.

Great cashews just wish they came like they were in California at costco.
Much larger container.

If you take regular, old salted cashews and add some pepper yourself, it will taste like this.  The sea salt does not appreciably alter the taste.  However, salted cashews with pepper are a tasty snack.  Good, but nothing special.

I love cashews, and also like a bit of spice added to most foods, so I thought these sea salt and pepper cashews would be interesting.

Unfortunately, the black pepper taste is overwhelming and doesn't really seem to be a good flavor combination to me, the pepper doesn't add to the taste, but ruins the excellent flavor of the cashews.

For someone who REALLY loves black pepper, these will probably be a hit. If you're not a huge pepper fan, I'd skip these and grab the regular Emerald cashews instead.

Have plenty of water handy.  The over-the-top taste of sea salt and cracked pepper nearly overcame all the cashew flavor.  The Emerald almonds were much more enjoyable because they were more subtlely flavored.
These cashews have a definite kick to them. They are spicy and would be perfect with an ice cold beer on a hot summer day. The container keeps them fresh. These nuts are highly recommended.

In wondering how to make a yummy snack even yummier, Emerald has answered the question with this product. The seasonings enhance this already highly-esteemed nut. The ground sea salt and pepper is generous as a topping, and the kick of pepper combined with the saltiness covers any savory hankering.

Its size is a boon, as it makes it easier to stow in a backpack, carry-on, or a picnic basket It's also just enough to keep handy in your pantry for last minute guests. I am adding this to my corral of "What's easy to put out and look really put together?"

This is a keeper.

I'm not big on nuts, so I probably would have never purchased this product had it not been offered in the Vine program.  After tasting however, I am hooked.  The salt and pepper coating fresh cashews is out of this world.  It was a nice surprise, and a great new healthier snack for me.  This is worth a try.

We were so effusive in our praise of the last batch of Emerald nuts we tried that we'll sound like corporate shills when we say this one's the best of the lot.  The pepper adds a nice tang that lingers as the final aftertaste.

I'm not a big fan of pepper and found these a bit too spicy for my personal taste.  But, while I wasn't crazy about these, my 7yo dd, who is a spice fiend (loves pepper), LOVED these, as did my husband.  They both ended up taking the can over to my neighbor, who had to try them, and he told his wife to buy them, as he too now is addicted.  She already purchased 2 cans for him.  While I will be purchasing them again, they won't be for myself though.
... and I do.  I'd never expect that black pepper and cashews would go together but they really do.  I recommend gently chopping a small handful and sprinkling them on cottage cheese!

I thought they were overly salty myself, but he said he could handle it. The pepper was less intrusive but it may well have been that the salt settles during shipping or handling and one cannister may be different than another. Not sure that I would purchase on a consistent basis but they were all eaten in my hosehold.

We loved these.  Delicious--very tasty, remarkably addictive snacks.  I never thought that I would like to have pepper on my salted nuts...but wow--it added a real depth of flavor that I found irresistible.  Delicious.

The cashews are a nice size and mostly whole pieces with some small broken chunks. They have a fresh roasted taste. They are nicely seasoned with ample black pepper. Most pieces, however, are too salty.

If these were slightly less salty, they'd be better.

I wasn't wild about these at first, but they grew on me.  The pepper is a bit overpowering after the first few bites....it sneaks up on you.  However, after eating them several times I enjoyed them more.  My chief complaint is with the plastic packaging.  Although very convenient, it is wasteful and environmentally unfriendly.  PLEASE recycle the canisters!

We have picked up a number of Emerald nuts recently. We liked Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, 11oz Canister (Pack of 4) and absolutely loved Emerald Marcona Almonds, 11.5oz Canister (Pack of 4), but we did not care for these at all. I have no problem with the quality of the product, but I do have a problem with the recipe.

In theory pepper and sea salt sounded like a great combination. Salty with a slight peppery taste sounded great, but in reality, the pepper was overwhelming. Everyone in our family tried them and no one cared for them. The sea salt alone would have been good, and even a lighter coating of pepper would have been okay.

We love Emerald nuts in general, this one just wasn't a hit with our family.
I liked the sea salt and pepper combination. About 9% daily amount of sodium per 1 oz serving. Tastes saltier than that, but not bad.

We loved these at first. While we thought the salt and pepper was very powerful, the cashews themselves were large and flavorful, and the whole thing really worked. We still love them, but it's a hit-or-miss proposition. You never quite know how your taste buds are going to react when you open the container and toss a few in your mouth. Sometimes, without a doubt, it's just a little too overpowering.

The quality of the cashews is fantastic, the salt and pepper adhere to the nuts surprisingly well considering how coarse it all is. There are times when I'd rate these a 4 or even 5, others where I'd want to go as low as 2. 3 it is.

Would we buy them again? I don't think so, but I had to stop and really think about that. Emerald has a great product here, and we loved their Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, 11oz Canister (Pack of 4), but the moments where these are too much, are enough to keep us from going back for more when this can is gone.

Well, this product is pretty self explanatory, and I'm not really sure who buys their nuts from Amazon.com, but when offered some by the Vine program in exchange, I couldn't say no (I love cashews!).  The only thing different about these cashews from your average roasted/salted cashews is the addition of black pepper.  I really did like the pepper addition, although plain salted cashews are still higher on my list.  The flavor is a bit stronger and I can only eat a few at a time.  I also think that if I ate enough of these salt and pepper nuts, I'd probably get sick of them and never want them again, so they're probably best in small doses.  Other than that, I'd say that the cashews themselves are good size and quality, and the roasting was perfect.

We love cashews and as we have teenagers always have a jar of them on the counter for quick snacks so I was very interested to try these flavored cashews.

The first handful was great. The seasoning is nice but if you have more then one handful the flavors become too strong really fast. A few of our teens tried them out also and had the same feedback.

If they had had just a bit less seasoning we would have all liked them much better. If I were to get them again, I'd mix them with the same amount of regular cashews which would be just about the right amount of seasoning for me.

I absolutely love the salt & pepper pistachios that Costco sells and I love cashews so I was looking forward to trying these. Unfortunately these cashews are so heavily seasoned that I got heartburn from them, and I hardly ever get heartburn. In my opinion when your mouth almost burns from pepper then it's TOO MUCH! The idea of a salt & pepper cashew is a good one but I'd take a plain roasted, salted cashew over these any day. To me, the delicious taste of the cashew itself is ruined by the seasoning.

but I liked these. They're tangy and salty, and the pepper adds just a hint of spicy-ness. Some may not like Emerald products; they tend to be heavy on the "flavoring" side of things. I overdosed on caramel covered walnuts once--only for people with a really really sweet tooth. These were much more to my taste--tangy and salty. Try them!

This is good snack that is easy to bring along. Great container too - love the screw-on lid! However, the pepper taste is quite strong, so be warned that if you easily get an upset stomach or deal with heartburn, this is not the snack for you. I can only eat about 5 at a time; however, that is also usually all I need to satify my salt craving at 4 pm...
I would probably buy this again.

The cashew are well roasted giving it a nice flavor and tasty crunch. If you start eating one, it is difficult to stop eating them one after the other - typical nuts ! (except of the excessive saltiniess)

The cashews also been well flavored with ground pepper, but the only problem is that the cashews have been overly salted - I typically have to shake the canister a couple of times to let the salt settle to the bottom before I take a byte.

This product seemed like a contradiction in terms.
The cashew taste was dominated by the salty, spicy,
peppery over-kill taste.I wasn't impressed.
The essense of cashew is the rounded full fresh taste.These qualities were obscured by the spicing.
I love spices and with almonds this would work better .

I asked six people to test out these nuts (three adults and three teenagers).  Four liked the flavor.  One didn't like the pepper flavor and one found it too salty to eat.  Five found it salty and one didn't find it salty at all.

A hint of Pepper is an under-statement!  If you do not like Pepper, than these are are not for you!  For Pepper lovers this may be a perfect snack for you. The container has mostly whole cashews!!  If you love cashews like I do and pepper is what you put on your food (which I don't)than the taste of these will be a different taste experience.  I did like the taste of the sea salt. A good treat for your social gatherings.

What can you say about an Emerald Nuts product?  They are always good quality nuts, and cashews are a personal weakness of mine.  The seasoning is an unusual choice and may be an acquired taste.  The pepper makes this snack surprisingly spicy, so if that's not your thing, don't try them.  I believe the flavor is growing on me, though I find more than a small handful is just a bit overpowering.  Maybe that's a good thing for me, as like with most nuts, this is not a low-fat snack.

These things are absolutely COATED with salt and pepper.

I like salt and pepper nuts (I had some pistachios once that were salt and pepper and they were awesome), and I love cashews, but loading them with enough coating to have greasy, salt and pepper covered fingers is too much. Its overpowering. You can only eat a few before you feel a bit sick.

Football season starts next month and Emerald's SEA SALT & PEPPER CASHEWS might well be a perfect addition to the Game Day broadcast as I watch my guys, the USC Trojans, beat the bandini out of all challengers on the way to the BCS Title Game. Fight on! Of course, fans of that other squad across town, the UCLA Teddy Bears, would probably find this snack just as toothsome, but how great an experience can it be, munching cashews or not, watching grown men dressed out in sissy powder blue?

I'd perhaps prefer a little less salt and a tad more pepper, but then I'd fall into the trap set my wife whose inclinations favor a low-sodium diet. At 270mg of Na per serving, these nuts are a bit too briny for her; if they contained less salt, I might be forced to share. And we can't have that, especially as she thinks football is for Neanderthals.

No edible is perfect, apparently. The hand-wringing, food nannies make sure of that. Their handiwork is evident on the label with the warning:

"ALLERGY INFORMATION: This product is processed on equipment that also processes other tree nuts or peanuts. May contain tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, milk, soy, or sesame seeds."

Happily, perhaps because I grew up in a less fearful age when kids were allowed to go out and play in the dirt and become exposed to all those nasty germs and allergens and thus acquire immune tolerance, I can now eat these SEA SALT & PEPPER CASHEWS by the handful and not worry that I'll go into anaphylactic shock by halftime.

Another nice feature is the ergonomically friendly can, done up in a soothing green color, that allows for an easy hand grip. Also take note of, and visit, the Emerald Nuts website, which is clever and amusing.

These were a bit delicious but I immediately grew a bit tired of them. There's way too much salt in these and I'm the kind of person who likes my cashews salty. The peppery taste was a bit of a nice compliment and when tasted in with the cashews alluded to a bit of a lime-like flavor, but I found it hard to keep myself from thinking  bout how much salt was in these. It was enough to burn my tongue and lips and cause me to stop eating them, even though they tasted good.

I'm a big cashew fan, but was unimpressed by this product. The nuts were fresh, but the seasoning was a bit too heavy-handed - they are very salty and the pepper has more of a bite than I liked.

The seasoning gets stronger the lower you get in the can due to it falling off the upper ones and coating the lower ones. While tolerable when first opened, the seasoning becomes way too overpowering once you get half-way down in the can. I found myself putting the nuts in a dish and rolling them around a bit to dislodge some of the seasoning.

If you're on a sodium restricted diet (or just want to cut down on sodium) you definitely want to pass on this.

If they would dial back the salt by 50% and the pepper by 75%, it would be a great product. As it is right now, however, I'll have to give it only 2 stars.

Everyone in the house loved these nuts, including my fussy hubby.
The flavouring is excellent and might I add, addicting!! We had to hide them from the aforementioned husband.
......and the best of all, this is healthy w/ omegas and a decent salt..not all salt is bad for you.
So much better than chips,candy and so many other snack foods kids and
those who are not health conscious eat.

These cashews are another nice addition to Emerald's line of nut snacks. As someone who's addicted to peanuts and nuts for snacking (I usually have 2-3 containers open at any given time), I'm always looking for some variety, such as these with their salt+pepper seasoning reminiscent, in some ways, more of chips than nuts.

The cashews themselves are high quality, large and meaty.

Note the description is accurate, they liberally use both salt and pepper, so the sodium level in these is more than twice that of the similar cannister of Emerald almonds, and the pepper flavor is distinct. Avoid if you dislike pepper or are on a salt-restricted diet.

A few years ago I gave a dinner party that had all the gay spontaneity of an open grave. Unbeknownst to me, each and every couple I had invited was on the outs with the others, but only in a quiet, teeth-gritted sort of way.
The food, however, was a smashing success, especially some spicy pecans that I threw together as I walked in the door about a half hour before my guests. I have never replicated the success of that first batch, but these cashews come close.
They have a good balance of sweet (the cashews themselves), salty, and peppery flavor. The pepper is not overpowering and strikes me as just right.
The nice thing about the snack is that a few satisfy. I tend to to eat way too many plain cashews when I buy them lightly salted. A very few of these make a nice nibble, and would go great with sake or a martini.

I will admit that I am very fond of cashews. I have to resist the temptations to pick through a bowl of mixed nuts and snag the cashews for myself.

These cashews are salty but also peppery. The peppery flavor means I can only munch a few of these at a time. This is a good thing. They are different. I would serve these at a party and a few make a good snack before dinner.
These nuts seem fresher than most other brands. I don't know if they're packaged more airtightly than most, or harvested  more recently than others. Perhaps both.

I just cracked into the can of sea salt and pepper cashews and they are exactly what I expected.  Large cashews (not pieces), with a generous coating of salt and pepper.  They are salty, so if you are watching sodium or don't like a salty taste this probably wouldn't be for you, but when I want some salt, I want some salt.  The pepper was just enough to give them a bite without being overwhelming.  The valued added seasoning of onion/sugar combo was fine, I really couldn't tell that they were in there- I just know that I liked the taste and the size of the cashews.  Also, I like that the lid holds one serving size.  Short of portioning out your own snack bag this is a clever idea so that you don't overeat (if you don't want to).  Overall, a nice snack product.  I would definitely consider buying these when I buy flavored cashews again.

I think there are a lot of folks that will NOT like these cashews, as they are not faint.  Imagine `salt `n pepper' potatoes chips and replace the potato flavor with cashews.  It is intense, but I am addicted.  These strongly flavored cashews are truly `over-the-top' in flavor and the citric acid and granulated onion only intensify the flavor.  There really isn't anything especially nutritious about these cashews other than nuts are good for your heart, but I'd think the salt would cancel that out.  This is one of those `love it or leave it' food products and I just happen to really, really like these.

I have never thought about using salt and pepper on cashews or any other nut but I have to admit it is quite unique. I am from Texas and am rather fond of "hot". This snack has a bite to it and can stand up to any Tex-Mex jalopeno or Cajun cayenne. Since cashews are a good source for protein and a much better choice than a sugary treat, the added kick of pepper and the mixture with sea salt makes it all the more healthier. I like the canister size and shape as it fits well in the drink holder in your car for easy reach. I would recommend this product to anyone who enjoys a bit of spice to their life. Now, how about peanuts with salt & pepper?

I have to admit that when I first tried Emerald's Sea Salt and Pepper Cashews I didn't like them. Emerald has great cashews and I initially thought that the true quality of the cashews could not be detected because of the seasonings (besides the sea salt and pepper I could really taste onion). However, like Emerald's plain cashews, the sea salt and pepper ones are addicting and once I got used to the seasonings, I couldn't put them down. My one real complaint is that they are a bit too salty, especially when you get to the end of the can where the salt tends to settle. The cashews come in a container designed to fit into a car's cup holder and the lid holds 1.5 ounce serving of nuts which is the FDA daily recommendation for good heart health. The cashews have no trans fats, are high in protein and are a good source of iron and zinc. Although they are seasoned, there are only 160 calories per serving which is the same number of calories as a handful of regular cashews.

Emerald's Sea Salt and Pepper Cashews are addicting and delicious.

Emerald Sea Salt & Pepper Cashews is a pleasant treat for cashew lovers. The saltiness of the product is a little intense at times, but the taste of sea salt (as opposed to ordinary table salt) combined with some nicely-flavored ground pepper does give Emerald Sea Salt & Pepper Cashews a fairly distinctive flavor... and a good one, to boot. Recommended.
The nuts and flavouring would satisfy the palate of any lover of nuts. The product is very high quality for the price, and the nuts were rich and fresh in flavour.

I love nuts as a snack. They're good for you, high in protein (and other nutrients), and they just taste good. (Yes, they also contain fat, but if you don't overdo it, that shouldn't be of much concern.)

So, after years of eating plain old nuts, I was delighted to try these Salt & Pepper Cashews. I was looking forward to trying something different, and these really have a unique flavor.

They're salty, which is a nice compliment to the slightly sweet taste of the cashew, but the pepper is the real star here. It adds a perfect spicy/savory note, which wraps itself around that sweet/salty nuttiness for a real taste treat.

Not too high in calories (my canister said 100 calories per serving), they should please most nut-lovers looking for something new.

Enjoy!

My children and husband and I LOVE nuts! I was worried these would be too strong for the children, but the 6 year old liked it, but didn't want another. The 4 year old ate an entire handful, and said he'd like more, but only with water, and the 3 year old ate about ten before she said, "These are REALLY pepper-ish!"

I really enjoyed the strong taste - reminded me of beef jerky or something. But I could only eat a few - the taste is QUITE strong, but a very good taste! So, if you'd like some nuts that will hang around the house for a few days, these are great! Very fresh, good texture, and delicious, and you can't down the entire box in one sitting for sure.

Sra. Gose
Author of Spanish Fun Activity Calendar

I like the product; Emerald is always tasty, from what I've experienced. But as a casual enjoyer of cashews, and nuts in general, it's hard to say if the sea salt and pepper really add anything to the experience. If you love cashews and eat enough that you're craving something a little different, give this a try.

I really like Emerald's packaging for their nuts -- it fits nicely in your hand. All the easier to indulge in over-eating! It's nice to throw in my daughter's backpack for a snack on the go.

As far as the salt and pepper cashews go, the adults in the house loved them but not a big hit with the kids. The pepper was too much for them. I loved the pepper but thought there was too much salt. This product claims to be a healthy snack, but I think it would be healthier with about half the salt. Don't get me wrong, they taste great as is, I just won't eat as much at one time since I'm concerned about too much salt in my diet. For me it's a guilty pleasure!

Emerald Sea Salt & Pepper Cashew

I sampled a canister of Emerald Sea Salt & Pepper Cashews and like the sea salt, but they should lose the pepper, IMHO, I couldn't finish the canister. If they eliminate the pepper, I'd recommend this product.

Gunner June, 2008

If they eliminate the pepper, I'd recommend this product higher.

I personally would give these a one-star rating because I thought they were awful. A friend, however, really liked them. I was disappointed after trying the cocoa flavored nuts by the same company (loved them!). These were way too salty and too peppery for my taste and left an unpleasant aftertaste.

These were much too salty for me.  I was disappointed as I love pepper but the salt and perhaps other spices overwhelmed the taste of the cashews.  My husband, on the other hand, thought they were delicious which is why I'm giving them 3 stars instead of one.  After three handfuls I had had enough.

First, let me say that I like cashews and was a littly leary of the "Salt & Pepper" labeling. I had almost made up my mind that I wasn't going to like them before I even tasted them, because who could improve on the taste of lightly salted cashews? But I was pleasantly surprised to find out that I did actually like them and that they were quite good in fact. I think it was the "Salt & Pepper" labeling that put me off. Made me think of eating vegetables or eggs for some reason. In my humble opinion, they should be labeled something like "Light Peppery Seasoning" or something like that. The black pepper flavoring is quite light and enhances the cashew taste as does the light salting. I do feel this is a matter of personal taste though as my daughter tried them and wasn't too impressed. I asked her how she would rate them on a scale of 1 to 5 and she said 3. Not bad, but not exceptionally good either. I can't say that they are exceptionally good either, but I would definetly buy them again as I enjoyed the flavor which is slightly spicy but not overpowering.

Contrary to what the Emerald folks might say, it's tough to get tired of "plain old cashews." But you can get excited about cashews with more pizzazz and what's what Emerald Sea Salt & Pepper Cashews delivers.

There's a lot to like about this snack food as long as you are aware of your/its limitations. Yes, it's 160 calories per serving, but read the nutrition label! A serving is defined as approximately 10 nuts!

But the sea salt and pepper does provide a better kick than usual snacks and the absence of trans fat and the high protein content make them a healthful choice over a lot of other snacks... as long as you consume them in moderation. Delicious moderation, but moderation nonetheless!

even though i love cashews, these were just too salty.  the pepper taste was great and they did taste good, but for hours after i ate them, i was so thirsty.  i don't think these would be enjoyable to most people.

Emerald knows what they're doing. So, the 3 out of 5 stars isn't a criticism. It's mostly due to the fact that I wasn't expecting the unusual taste.

The cashews are large and the seasoning is bold. The one thing that I prompted me to look at the ingredient list is that they actually taste very TART which was not expected due to the citric acid that's included.

The product is good but I could do without the "tangi-ness". So these stayed around the house much longer than the dark-chocolate dusted almonds made by the same company.

as another reviewer stated, my family also tested Emeralds Macona Almonds and loved them. So I was excited to try these cashews as cashews are my favorite nut. Sadly, this product is a big time disappointment.

Like many companies, Emerald is now trying the "if "blank" sells well, then "blank" with crazy added seasonings will be better". When it's not true-it takes the simple and delicious cashew and douses it with so much seasoning that the cashew itself can no longer even be tasted. If you like cashews then skip this product and stick with this companies simply roasted cashews instead.

Emerald's Sea Salt and Pepper cashews are moderately spiced and benefit from not being oily or heavy. In addition to salt and a slightly spicy dose of pepper, the cashews are coated with traces of sweetness and onion. These cashews are great to have on hand as a snack, to accompany cocktails, or to add flavor to a stir fry or vegetable dish.

So why a rating of four instead of five stars? I prefer snacks to be packaged in glass containers instead of the plastic Emerald uses (however, chances of damage in shipment are next to zero in plastic packaging, so I see their reasons). In addition, the nuts might benefit from slightly less onion flavor. However, these are minor gripes, and mainly a matter of personal taste.

Emerald's salt and pepper cashews taste great, can be used in a variety of ways, and are a great snack to have on hand. Recommended.

I love cashews and I would give just plain old unsalted cashews five stars, so it takes a lot to get a snack that's naturally five stars for me down to two stars, and that something is lots and lots of pepper.

There's certainly more than a hint of pepper on these cashews. There's actually so much that I can hardly tell I am eating cashews at all. So, if you feel compelled to eat cashews for health reasons, like you need the fat that you'd get by sitting down in front of your favorite TV show and wolfing down a tin of 'em, and you don't want to taste them too much, I would recommend this product. Otherwise, this is just overkill.

I never thought of putting pepper on nuts.  These yummy cashews were salted with sea salt and pepper, and were they ever good!  The pepper really adds some zest to the taste.  I ate almost the whole canister in one sitting.  These cashews were just that good.
Just got this and it was excellent. The salt/pepper combo adds a great flavor to the cashews.

These are the most unique nuts I've ever tasted. The product description says "light" salt and pepper, but that is not my experience. Quite salty, quite peppery, quite intense flavor. I liked them, being a lover of salty things, but a couple people I shared them with found the flavor overpowering. The container is very cool and portable, so it's great for work or sports events.

We opened and tried these cashews, and they were soon gone! The predominant flavors of the sea salt and black pepper complement each other well. The sea salt presents a more rounded and subtle salt sensation than ordinary table salt, and the onion, spice and natural flavor listed on the ingredients list no doubt to the excellent finish.

If you eat the contents of a whole container in one sitting, as we did, you may find them a bit to salty. This is not noticeable when eating just a few.

I received this product from Amazon Vine and I love them!  I would buy this anytime I saw them for sale!  They are so good!  The pepper adds some spice so if you don't like spicy, it won't be to your liking but I very much enjoyed this product.  Buy It!

These are good, excellent flavor, quite fresh out of the package, but a little too salty for my taste.  Not much to add, except to note that once you taste a few of these pepper and salt coated cashews, you want more of them. I like them a lot. My friends seem to like them also, but with one complaint that the salt content was too high. Everyone else (5 people) thought they were excellent as is, and would be better if they only had a good cold beer to go with them. One person thought that there was too much pepper for such a mild tasting nut (cashews). I just caught one of my friends redhanded with their fingers in the nut jar going for more.

I was not sure about the pepper factor with this product but decided to try it out.  The pepper seasoning was actually pretty good and a different twist on the usual cashew snack.  They went way overboard with the salt, however.  This really detracted from the overall quality.  If you are a big fan of very salty items, this is your snack.  If you normally prefer moderate, low, or no salt seasoning then you should pass on this one. ( Or build up some muscle mass by shake-shake-shaking the salt off as much as possible.  :)

The cashews used in this product are high quality and delicious like all the nuts sold by Emerald.  The handy green canister has the same functional design as the other snack products from this company I have tried.  But for my taste buds at least the salt and pepper seasoning is way way too strong. Cashews have a delicious flavor that doesn't need any enhancement or at least that's this reviewer's opinion.  I  realize some people will love this flavor (one of my family members who tried them thinks they are great) but the taste just isn't for me.

Emerald Sea Salt And Pepper Cashews add zesty sea salt and pepper to cashew nuts, resulting in a high-protein snack with a zoom and a zing. These are great for people who like their nuts spicy but not too much so, though the pepper can burn your mouth. Overall, if you like real salt from the ocean, and you also like cashews, you'll LOVE this new snack from Emerald.
It's not that salt and pepper are a bad idea but too much is really bad.  These cashews are almost in the inedible range.  I can not recommend these at all and I really like cashews.

I love cashews and I've loved other Emerald cashews I've tried....but these are just too darned salty (and I love salt). The pepper further adds to the problem. There's just not a lot of cashew taste, because the sea salt and the pepper overpower the taste of the nuts.

I would not purchase these in the store - especially since our local Kroger sells other similar Emerald brands for $6.99 for the 10 oz cannister. That's just too much money for a mouthful of salt.

I like black pepper. When I cook, I grind my own and use as much as is called for by the recipe. On those recipes that I consider "keepers" and decide to tweak, one of the most freqent changes I make is to add more pepper. I tell you all this so you will understand that I'm not a Casper Milquetoast who can't tolerate anything spicier than corn flakes. I am fond of spicy foods, and when I order them in restaurants I do NOT tell the waiter, "Mild, please".

The idea of putting pepper on nuts is, I think, a good one and could work well. But there is just too much pepper in these. And not a little too much, a LOT too much.

The nuts themselves seem fine. Nice and fresh with good texture. I think the amount of salt is good, but that's difficult to determine with taste buds overwhelmed by pepper.

If Emerald would use a quarter to a half as much pepper, I think this could be a winner.

I was sincerely looking forward to enjoying this product and reviewing it, however, it's hard to sing the praises of anything when the roof of your mouth is on fire.

Emerald Sea Salt & Pepper Cashews is a good idea gone terribly wrong. The nuts are wonderful. I plan on soaking off the seasoning and using them in a chicken recipe. But there is no possability I could eat them as the manufacturer has served them up.

To be sure that this was not some oversensitivity on my part, I offered the cannister to a friend -- casually and without comment. He ate two or three and begged me for a beverage to clear his mouth, saying he thought he must be "allergic" to something in them, because they "made his mouth burn."

I'm just baffled that the seasoning is this unpleasantly strong yet sold in a cannister that suggests a mild freshness. I truly regret that I could not give Emerald Sea Salt & Pepper Cashews a higher rating.

When I first opened the canister the smell of pepper was burst forth. At the first taste, first the salt and then the pepper flavors completely overwhelmed the cashew flavor. Finally a hint of cashew came through. When other family members tried these their reactions were similar - too much seasoning and too little cashew.

Those who are fans of cashews will probably be disappointed that there is so little cashew flavor but those who like salt and especially those who like pepper will be pleased. It just seems to me that there is no need to use cashews in this product, peanuts would do just fine since the salt and pepper flavors completely dominate this product.

After having the privilege to test Emerald's Marcona Almonds, I was very much looking forward to testing their Sea Salt and Pepper Cashews. In fact, when the box came in the mail, I raced to open it so I could try out these little gems.

Unfortunately, what I expected to be a favorable experience turned out to be terrible.

My first taste of these nuts was like having orange pith (the white part between the peel and the orange) fried in oil, doused in a vat of salt and sugar and dipped in black pepper. There is virtually no cashew flavor left in these little nuts.

I love cashews. I have eaten them raw and roasted in many ways for years. This experience with Emerald Sea Salt and Pepper Cashews was an assault on my taste buds.

The salt with citric acid combination is terrible. When you combine it with the maltodextrin AND sugar, the cashew flavor is corrupted beyond recognition. Then adding the black pepper makes it even worse. A handful of these *nuts* is like dumping a salt shaker in your mouth. It is almost repulsive.

The nuts themselves are pretty greasy as well.

I am very sorry that these cashews were treated this way.

I would have preferred the graceful simplicity of simple roasted cashews with a DUSTING of sea salt and black pepper over them- nothing more. The sugar and maltodextrin ruin this mix- and the addition of citric acid makes the finish quite bitter. I do not like these at all.

If you love sweet things and don't mind bitterness and a mouth full of salt, you might enjoy these. However, if you love cashews and prefer the seasonings to COMPLIMENT them instead of overpower them, pass on these.

As part of the Vine Voice program, I received a canister of these nuts.

I love cashews...that said, Emerald Sea Salt and Pepper Cashews are greasy and too salty and have no discernible cashew flavor, as those ingredients overpower the flavor of cashew. I would not purchase this product, as it contains sugar and maltodextrin.

By the author of the award winning book, Harmonious Environment: Beautify, Detoxify and Energize Your Life, Your Home and Your Planet

These cashews are as fresh as they can be. That's a big plus.

A slight minus, though, is the overwhelming flavor of the seat salt and pepper. I can only eat a handful before the spices make me stop.

That could be a good thing, though, as the nuts last longer. Or it could be a bad thing because I've still got the munchies.

I think I'll probably stick with the plain old salted cashews from Emerald. You can't buy better ones unless you're visiting the actual farm where they grow.

I love these cashews - they are saltier than regular salted nuts, and the pepper adds enough of a flavorful zing to make them interesting but not too hot. The problem is (and maybe it's only a problem for me!) I want to eat huge amounts! It is very difficult to just eat the "one serving" portion of these, and they are very high in fat and calories. Consider yourself warned.

Personally, I enjoyed both the Marcona Almonds and the Cocoa Roast Almonds better. But I have to admit this particular choice is okay, especially the way the pepper tends to bring out the distinctive flavor. Two things to consider, try to remember to keep a napkin handy + you might want a beverage to wash it down with. Maybe not my personal first choice, but decent.

I guess the title might remind some of a band, but this stuff is much better.  Too often snack foods avoid pepper, or when they do use it, they overwhelm the taste of the pepper with the salt.  This product is an exception.  The tang of the sea salt mixes well the large grained black pepper.  Emerald also uses large high quality cashews for the mix and not cheap smaller nuts that they can disguise with seasoning.  I love cashews in any event, but this product is simply the best seasoned nuts I have enjoyed for some time.

I LOVE cashews but I thought that these were pretty horrible. Well, maybe horrible is too strong of a word.

How about I just try to share with you what tastes I experienced and you can judge for yourself whether you want to give them a try or not:

The package design is superb, a plastic container with a screw top that also fits perfectly in your car's cup-holder. The nuts were nice and crunchy but although I like spicy things, these tasted overly peppery to me. After you get through that, you get hit with an onion/garlic taste that lingers. I probably should have done it beforehand, but when I tasted this I HAD to check the ingredients. Yes, they did indeed not only pepper the cashews, they also added onion powder.

Sooo... If the thought of eating crunchy cashews seasoned with black pepper, onion powder and salt sound like it might be up your alley, then by all means give these a try. Somebody out there must like these, right?

I buy Emerald nuts of all kinds on a regular basis. I tried these and found that the normal cashew taste was present with a very strong presence of salt and prettty spicy pepper. I did not detect that much of an aftertaste. Consistency was pretty much normal for cashews. I highly recommend - as an occasional alternative to the "normal" brand. The novelty factor for a product with this much "zing" is pretty high. What tastes really good with the first handful... could pretty well go south after too long.

I believe that this product makes for a pretty good desk ornament - your visitors will grab one handful, rave about what a trendsetter you are, then leave you without demolishing the whole container (which happens to me regularly with their honey roasted almonds).

One thing that worries me is that so many folks leaving reviews have complained about the aftertaste and consistency. I guess I will have to buy a few more containers to check on the quality control!!!

All the best,

Jay

Recently I had the opportunity to try and review the Emerald Salted almonds. I gave them an overwhelmingly good review, although I had some qualms about the packaging. The flavor was excellent.

Now I have sampled the Emerald Sea Salt and Pepper Cashews. Granted people react to seasonings (salt and pepper) in very different ways, but the combination of salt and pepper on the cashews was not a taste bud delight. The combination of both flavors added to the natural goodness of the cashews was disappointing. Perhaps it would be popular in a party mix, but eaten out of the can the spices were a little too strong and distracting. I like the idea of sea salt as opposed to normal table salt, but the pepper was not a bonus. Edible, but not delicious...
