I took a chance and yes it did pay off these are really delicious I will definitely be buying these again.

Love these tortilla chips made with organic white corn!  They are perfect for dipping in salsa or eating right out of the bag.  3g of fiber per serving and there are 8 servings per bag.  Mine were fresh with an expiration date of June 2011.  I will be buying these again.

These might be the best chips I have ever had.  The "Used By" date is March 2011, but I had to cut this bag open as it was sealed up so tightly (this is the first bag of chips I've had to cut open..if I really reeked on it I could have got it, but I didn't want it to explode in my face).  No worries, you will be happy you got these.
Once you pop one in your mouth...you can tell these ain't Doritos and that it is a quality product...now the secret is to buy em on sale...
The chips are okay Not near as flavorful as the regular blue chips. Nice size bag for a family.

I love these Garden of Eatin Baked Blue Corn Tortilla Chips. Blue corn is a nutritional powerhouse full of anti-oxidants and higher in protein than either white or yellow corn.

These are tasty and low in sodium and low in fat because they are baked!
These are organic super yummy tortilla rounds.  I really like them.  They are on the salty side, but that's good for me.

I was disappointed with all the generic-looking sugar sprinkles at the grocers, so I found these online with Amazon. It was worth the trouble--these are very distinctive with the mini sugar hearts. With the large-sized container, you won't run out after your first batch. Highly recommended.

This sauce is the best I have had for a very low sodium sauce, however, the shipping from this particular company cost more than the sauce itself. Other sauces I have ordered did not charge a shipping and or was very reasonable. $7+ for shipping one bottle of hot sauce was a huge factor as to why I wont buy from them again.

A friend introduced me to Futaba. Though I have purchased similar kinds that were sold near my home, they did not come close to this product. Thanks to Amazon I don't have to drive to LA to get it or worse do without.

I usually eat furikake on rice, although sometimes I put it in soups as well. I have had the nori goma flavored furikake from urashima, which is good, but it tends to have more seeds then anything else. This one has lots of seaweed and an even mixture of the items, so it tastes much better. This furikake brand (futaba) is the best in my opinion. If you are looking for traditional tasting furikake (nori goma) then I highly recommend this brand. Also, if you are looking for a furikake that does not have msg in it, this one does unfortunately. I say this because I had been looking for one myself, but because this one has more ingredients then the others (and the others have msg too) then I prefer this one.

I don't like strong bold coffee, but I do like something with a little "punch" in it to start the day. This coffee is just right. It is a delicious tasting medium bold coffee that is great to drink in the morning, though I drink it other times as well. It has a very pleasant aroma that completes the taste experience. I vacation a lot in Vermont, and this tastes just as good as the coffee in the small country store where I get my morning coffee.

Bottom line: This is one of my favorite "wake up" coffees. I recommend it.

When I started working at my current employer, we had a Keurig and many, many coffee choices, mostly because each person had their own favorites. I was trying all the coffees looking for my favorite when I found a sample pack of Vermont Country Blend. A few cups of coffee later, it had become my favorite, and I ordered a box. Soon, everyone in the office was drinking it, and it's the only coffee we stock now. I always feel pleased when we have guests at the office, and they compliment the coffee - which is most of the time we have guests. It makes me feel like I found a real gem.
I'm really enjoying Vermont Blend in the morning.  It is a little stronger than Nantucket Blend and yet smooth with a bit of a kick.  A great "get up and go" drink.
I've tried all kinds of k-cups and this is my favorite.  It is rather mellow and for myself being a cream/sugar guy, I prefer this black and plain due to the smooth taste.

I usually like dark/very dark roasts, so this surprised me. It's a wonderful light toasty medium roast. I bought it thinking we should have some "regular" coffee on hand for guests, but will have to order more, because I've been drinking it. This is very good basic coffee, medium roast, not acidic tasting, no big bite or aftertaste. Will definitely buy more.

I have tried a lot of different coffees and this one is my all time favorite! the aroma when brewing is an instant wake up. The flavor is just as good as the smell. Not a strong coffee, but very flavorful, not bitter, nice finish, great!

This coffee has a wonderful taste and aroma.  I take my coffee with just a little sugar and no cream/flavorings because I feel that a good coffee should have enough flavor to stand on its own.  This one does.  I love it.  Just enough acidity but not a hint of bitterness.  Very smooth, and yet it still has some character - it's certainly not a weak coffee by any means.  I bought this along with GMC's Wild Mountain Blueberry, which also comes highly recommended.  Between you and me, I enjoy this blend more than the blueberry.

I bought Greenmountain Vermont Country Blend for my home Keurig brewer because it was so good at work.  Got my box delivered to my home and was disappointed to find it way too weak.  Nothing like the brew at work.  I opened up a K-cup and added more coffee to it from another one and it was  normal (very good).  I'm getting an RMA number and sending it back along with the pumpkin spice coffee which was also too weak.

I love this coffee!  I very much enjoy and appreciate my Keurig coffee maker, and I have struck up a great appreication of Green Mountain coffees!  This is the first I've tried the Vermont Country Blend, and once again, oh yes -- great coffee!
This coffee has a very good flavor, and is not bitter at all.  I like also that it is one of the least expensive k-cup options.

When I first ordered on line I thought it was unusual to buy my coffee pods off the Internet. Now I am about to order for the third time. They are too expensive to purchase from the store and the boxes are to small. I love to be able to get a larger quantity and you can't beat the price. Fast delivery and free shipping is great!
I typically go for breakfast blends, but this coffee simply tastes bad. I'd recommend trying some variety packs rather than buying one big pack as I did.

I have had several different flavors of Green Mountain Coffee in the past, but could never remember the name of the one I enjoyed the most so I took a shot in the dark and ordered this one! Am I glad I did! I like a nice medium roast that doesn't taste watery or weak, but isn't going to be super bold or bitter either. If you want a great medium roast with an awesome taste, this is the coffee for you!
this brand has always amazed people with their coffee flavors, and the vermont country blend is just one of them, my husband and i tried it for the 1st time and we loved it....
I'm a huge fan of Green Mountain coffee, and it doesn't disappoint. It's a good, everyday coffee. Great for mornings and after dinner.

We brewed 2 cups of the Vermont Country Blend and found very weak.  We brewed about 5 cups of the Tullys House Blend and did not care for the taste.  I should have gotten all San Francisco Bay coffee's. We purchased French Roast and one other flavor and my whole family loves this coffee.

This blend is one to have on hand that should please most guest.  It is mild enough for those who prefer & not too weak for those of us who like dark french roast.  Will be ordering more to have around.

Vermont Country Blend is my favorite K-Cup. However, There were 2 different selections. Box of 24 for $24.25 and Box of 24 (Pack of 2) for $25.38.
I didn't see the (Pack of 2) for $1.13 more. Bummer!
Green Mountain Coffee Vermont Country Blend Coffee, K-cups For Keurig Brewers, Box of 24 by Green Mountain Coffee, The coffee was for my Mother and she enjoyed it completly,

Why do all those K Cups taste like instant coffee? Ive tried so many brands as I really like the simplicity of the
Keurig coffeemaker. The decaf is even worse. Somebody tell me of a brand that really tastes like brewed coffee.

We tried these while wine tasting and they are just the best.  The seeds and grains add a healthy hearty flavor and texture.  It's hard to find good crackers that are not full of empty carbs.  We tracked them down at Amazon and are so happy to have them in our home!
My most favorite crackers of all time & the only one I buy all the time.  The best product out there.  Tastes great, its healthy, and it was so easy & fast to get my order in from Amazon.
tasty?  yes, also a little sweet.  wish they didn't have yeast in 'em though.

As part of a nutritional program, I use Dr. Krackers (6-8) in stead of bread. I love them with a salad. They have a great taste -- crunchy with a taste of sunflower seeds.  Unlike many crackers, they DON'T taste like cardboard; I really look forward to having them with lunch.

If you know HP sauce you don't need me to explain it any further. If you don't then how do you eat baked beans? Perhaps the only value I can add is the sqeeze bottle works well and is new to me for HP sauce.

product is fresh and is amazing - this is WAY better than going to the store - way better value

Apple Jacks is a family favorite and it is very wonderful to have it show up at my door automatically AND at a very reasonable cost!

These selections of Apple Jacks are the best value that I have found on Amazon. The reason is that you get 2 big boxes of this cereal for a low price. Wonderful blend of smoky flavor with a perfect amount of heat. Don't let the X-Hot fool you it won't burn you mouth off but will give you some warmth. I am addicted to this sauce and put it on everything!

I do not see any difference from the higher priced ones so why waste money. A pretty good buy in that case.

Just yummy, yummy almonds - nothing more, nothing less. Nicely portioned packs that don't have the time to dry out before you finish them. The almonds themselves are fantastic, great flavor and texture. I eat them plain as a snack and I greatly appreciate that they're not coated in oil or salt. They are a great addition to hot oatmeal, I toss a small handful in with some dried fruit and let them sit for a few minutes to soften up. My mouth is watering just thinking about it. Now I can't wait for morning so I can have some! If I'm feeling exceedingly charitable I might toss a couple to the squirrels that live in my yard while snacking on the front porch.

Let us not forget that being part of the Subscribe & Save program makes them even more of a value! Brought right to my door by the smiling deliveryman, I may just give him a bag the next time I see him. I love managing my regularly-purchased dry goods through Amazon. Talk about a time-saver and I get access to products that I can't find in my local grocery.

I am so disappointed with these almonds.  They are soft and have a slightly bitter flavor.  I roasted one bag hoping it would crisp them up, which it did, but didn't improve the flavor.  At least my dog likes them.

I ordered the complete set of Totonac sugar free syrups and tested them out with my morning Kellogg's Eggo waffles.

Some of the syrups are pretty good; others are really not my thing and I threw them out. My verdict/opinion is: Almond, Maple Syrup and Vanilla are pretty good; the Raspberry is okay (if you crave some fruit taste); but I couldn't handle the taste of the Blueberry, Butter Pecan, Caramel, Hazelnut and Vanilla Cinnamon.

The syrup is not thick like most syrups on the market; it's more runny and I find myself pouring some syrup out on to a plate and then dipping pieces of torn waffles.

The reviewers who said the cake is flavorless or doesn't Taste good are right. Unfortunately I had already bought this sat the store and hadn't checked out the reviews and was loathed to return them.

I like it because it is organic but if you are looking to impress guests this needs some modification to have the rich chocolate indulgent flavor.

This is what I did and turned out tasting decadent and rich.

Add an extra egg.
Substitute vege oil with melted butter.
Add 2-3 heapful tablespoon of unsweetened cocoa powder. (the more you add the richer it gets)

I also baked at 25 degrees lower but for at least 25 mins longer in my shiny Kaiser 9" round. Cake was very moist.

My cat, Oliver, is discerning. Sure, that sounds like finicky but he puts polish on the concept of finicky. He maintains his dignity at all costs and cat treats have always created a dignified stand at attention followed by a delicate consumption.... or a snobby refusal.

Until now.

The cat has lost his ever-loving mind. The first time I opened a package of Feline Greenies (I can't even remember the actual flavor) he became a lunatic. He put his paws on me and begged ike a common alley cat. He salivated. He pranced. He did everything but cartwheels.

He has this reaction every time I open any of the flavored packs. They certainly have a stronger and more natural smell to them. They seem to contain crunchy goodness. And they turn my dignified british shorthair into a trolling cat addict. Awesome stuff! It now simply has the nickname "Kitty Crack"
My cat loves his treats,  he will sit and lay on comand when he see the bag come out.  only problem I have to keep it locked up or he raids the kitchen for it.

I have two 3 year old cats one female (Luna) one male (Titan).... I used to buy crappy supermarket treats just to give them something different... We rarely give them treats... But a year ago my vet told me Luna might have dental issues in the future. Also, Titan gained a lot of weight.... I decided to look into something that would help Luna... I found these and bc of all the positive reviews i decided to give it a try... It's only been a couple of weeks but all i know is that they LOVE it... I'm hoping this is a better option health wise and dental wise.... :)

FatKitten who eats like a little goat- I grow him oat grass for his digestive issues, but then he also is known to gobble down kipper snacks and turkey. He does have somewhat of a discriminating palate but Greenies have become aa favorite treat along with Temptations Organic Salmon treats.
My Kitty loves them! I also brush her teeth.  I don't think that this product  alone  will  keep her teeth healthy.

Everybody should give Greeines to their cats & dogs. Their good for the teeth, breath & I've yet to find a pet that didn't go crazy for then. My cats & dogs have learned the sound of me opening the bag....they come running.
My Vet recommended them for my Lil dog to keep his teeth clean & prevent dental work later on. Now, all my pets get Greenies! They don't gum up the teeth or stick to their teeth like most store bought treats do.

This exquisite hot chocolate is like nothing I've ever tasted. I've always had a mediocre relationship with hot chocolate until now. After tasting this wonder, I even have it in place of my habitual morning coffee, and any other excuse I can find to drink it as well.

Ingredients: Unrefined brown cane sugar, cocoa 35% minimum, natural vanilla.

I think so highly of this drink, I even wrote a haiku about it:

Les Confitures à l'Ancienne
Chocolat en Poudre.
Hot chocolate heaven.

It truly is "Hot chocolate heaven!"

Some green teas are bitter but not this one! I drink it by the litre. I'm a complete convert to the Red Leopard range of teas. They are so smooth. I especially like that they use 100% Cotton tea bags and the range is 100% organic. Can you believe that you can make fantastic plant compost from the used tea bags? This range is a real winner.

The best tea, bar none!  The fact that it is organic, naturally caffeine free, and full of antioxidants is just a bonus.  I love that I can brew a big pot and it never becomes bitter or overly strong, even when it sits. The low tannin makes it great for settling an upset stomach and very agreeable to drink.  The more I learn about rooibos tea the more fascinating it becomes. What a great product.

Roland's chicken-flavor Noodles Cup is one of the best instant noodle products I've eaten. What makes it so good is the savory taste the chicken flavor packet imparts to the noodles. Additionally, I like it because it contains a minimum of ingredients. The only remotely "controversial" components are yeast extract and hydrolyzed soy protein, which some people have likened to MSG, as they are chemically similar. They add great flavor, though.

I would like to point out that when I make these, I never use the little packet of dried vegetables. They don't rehydrate very well. However, the ramen is excellent without them.

Additionally, Amazon has a great deal on this 12-pack; it's definitely less than I would pay for 12 of these in a store.

Good value in multi-pack. It shipped well in a shrink wrap plus carton. The cups are light but sturdy. It's a good chicken flavor and the noodles with the addition of boiled water to the fill line have substance. The peas, carrots, peppers rehydrated well. I added about 75% of the flavor packet to reduce salt.
An easy way to have a cup of noodles with broth depending on water added. I ate out of the cup which stayed sturdy.

It does not get any better than Cascadian Farm's Organic fruit and nut Granola - raisins, cherries, cranberries, sunflower & pumpkin seeds & almonds!  What else is there to say?  Each ingredient adds an element to the overall flavor and makes for a truly enjoyable gustatory experience.  I literally eat half a box every morning mixed with 2 yogurts and it helps me start every day off in a better mood and with sustainable energy for the first few hours of the day.  If you like granola with "stuff" in it, you will love this granola - you have to try it!
I was surprised how much I enjoyed this cereal.  Nice combination of sweet and wholesome.  The fruit is soft and not hard.  I bought on a 40% off sale, and love organic products.  Thanks Amazon.

My husband and I love this product, but, with the smaller-size boxes, it goes fast, so ordering the 10-pack works out well.  Plus, it's significantly cheaper than in our local grocery stores.  Transaction was quick and seamless.

I'm a huge fan of eating cereal for breakfast.. It's light, it tastes good and it's fast.. Unfortunately the usual suspects on the market are full of sugar and they do not fill me up for more than a couple of hours. So I was in search of a cereal that will taste good, that will fill me up and will be good for me.. I found this brand at Publix, it was on sale so I gave it a try..  It was soo good!! And it fills me up until lunch time and it's organic!! What else can u want from a cereal... I'm so happy I've found this brand and that Amazon carries it in case Publix discontinues selling it...

I have tried a majority of the organic packaged foods on the market. Cascadian Farms does offer a pretty good price compared to the others, but the quality reflects that unfortunately. I guess if you are trying to buy organic and are on a tight budget, this would be a good option.

This granola [and the two others I tried] tastes like it has been soaked in syrup and then coated in sugar. It was so sweet, I couldn't taste anything else. Not that there was much else to taste because there were about five raisins in the whole box and a only a sprinkling of cranberry bits. There were so few almonds and sunflower seeds that a person with a nut allergy could probably still eat this. Just buy a bag of organic oats and a jug of organic maple syrup, pour the whole jug over the oats along with some oil and bake it. You'll get this granola and it will cost even less money.

I tried this item for the first time yesterday.  I eat primarily fresh organic foods, so I purchased this cereal as a specialty item.  I was very disappointed. Unfortunately, I didn't read the label until after I had gotten home (on me!).  The second ingredient is SUGAR! Gross.  Sugar seems to rob real flavor from foods. The descripton on the front of the box sounded great, but I found that this cereal tasted very similar to over-processed sweetened cereal.

I'm new to the Gevalia brand... for Community has been my number one for several years. They now have a contender! :)

THe coffee is good. Not sure what else to state. It blows away the canned stuff in the stores and here on amazon with the free shipping, the price is as good or better than my local grocery store. I just wish they had larger sized bags and had more selections of 1/2 calf or decalf.

This coffee, with the exception of the espresso flavored one... is now top 2 in my home. Gevalia & Community Coffee.
THIS gEVALIA ONE OF MY FAVORITES COFFEE. GOOD FLAVOR AND AROMA AND GOOD PRICE. HOPE THAT IT HAD MORE AROMA BUT STILL GREAT.
I really like Gevalia Colombian roast, it has so rich aroma and great taste! One of my favorite, drink it several times a day:-)

This coffee is very good, and available several places on-line. I ordered from Amazon because they have shipped very quickly in the past. I love Gevalia coffee for it's flavor and the fact that I can brew it to be strong, without having it upset my system.
Our dogs love Greenies, but of course, which doggies don't?  I bought this for my dashchund and minpin, and it's perfect!  A great price for a great product.  Who could ask for more.
This review is for a box of Greenies Lite for my dog. The package came quickly and was packaged appropriately. I was very satisfied with this purchase and with the seller.

I highly recommend these chews for your dog. They do exactly what they say that they will do; freshen your dog's breath!

I found them to be significantly cheaper to buy them at Amazon compared to the chain pet stores; at least $10 cheaper as of Sept. 2011.

I have read that some dogs do not chew them well enough and have choked. I have not had that happen to my dog but it is probably something you need to take into consideration.

My advice is to buy a smaller bag at a pet store first and see if they work for your animal. Then come back and buy them here!

If you've got hard chewers (like one of our dogs), these things won't really work for the 'brushing' aspect -- they're bussted up and swallowed pretty quickly. We have three Chihuahua mixes, and they dispatched these petite ones too quickly, so we get them the next size up (small, I think). But the product is good, and they really do help a bit with breath -- although the biggest bad-breath-maker is teeth that need brushing, and there is no substitute for real brushing/cleaning.  These are good as part of the process though. We have, and will continue to purchase this product.

I tried Greenies on my dog about 8 years ago and he won't eat them.  So I tried dental rawhide chews which he chewed just fine.  My dog is now 13 years old and he started to swallow the dental rawhide whole and would choke on them.  I'm not sure because of his age that he tries to swallow them whole, but I'm sure it's not good for him.  I thought I would try the Greenies again because the reviews are good and they break into bits when chewed.  I order the large Greenies for him and he loves them.  I'm not sure if they changed the taste or what, but he chews them, and hopefully it will help maintain his teeth.
This is a great product. My 2 year old Golden Retriever hates to have his teeth brushed and this product made his teeth white again. Great seller and great price too!

I was looking for a way to help clean my cat's teeth so at first I tried the feline greenies,but he wouldn't have anything to do with those. I went to the local pet store looking for an alternative and the clerk suggested trying the dog greenies instead. I was skeptical at first so I only bought a couple of individually wrapped samples. Well, my cat absolutely loves the dog greenies! They do seem to help his breath, but I don't know how much they help the plaque and tartar build up. Oh well, it has become the only treat he likes so I will keep buying bulk boxes. I give him one every day, occasionally two, if I need to bribe him to stay inside when I open the door.

Greenies are an excellant way to whiten your dogs teeth. The costs were much lower here, than what you can buy locally at the dog food stores. They have made a great improvment in my dog(s) breath, tarter and overall mouth smell!

My dogs are addicted to these things and it's my fault. Whether or not they are good for my dog's teeth and digestive health is up in the air. All I know is that it keeps them quiet and they will do anything for them.

I would lower the star ratings based on the fact that the manufacturer knows they have, some what, of a monopoly and charge an inordinate amount for these treats; yet, I am dumb enough to buy them so it's basically my fault.
